Elven city in the **north of the main continent**, built in the trees, between the {wiki:Femor Hills}, Carlin and Northport.

By boat: {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais (130 gp), {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin (80 gp), {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore (90 gp) or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron (70 gp). Say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}.
You arrive at the port of {npc:Captain Seagull}, **east** of the centre, 1 floor above ground level ({coord:32735,31668,6}).
If you are on {wiki:Gray Island}, {npc:Scrutinon} takes you to Ab'Dendriel **for free**: {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}.
Go to the port, in the **east**, and talk to {npc:Captain Seagull}: {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}.

Destinations: {key:carlin} (80 gp), {key:edron} (70 gp), {key:thais} (130 gp), {key:venore} (90 gp) and {key:yalahar} (160 gp, only after a mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}). The {wiki:Postman Quest} gives a 10 gp discount on most trips.

Forgotten sewers (also called *Catacombs*) beneath **Rathleton**, west of the city and under the Glooth Factory, with a jade cave full of {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Grim Reaper|Grim Reapers}.

Access is earned in the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}: {npc:Jacob} or {npc:Elliott} give you the permission after you repair 20 valves in the sewers ({key:abandoned sewers}, {key:mission}, {key:ok}, {key:abandoned sewers}).
In **Thais**, say to {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You disembark on {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, on an islet **west** of Oramond.

Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island. Go down to the ground floor, walk **east** to the small boat and use its portal ({coord:33628,32005,7}); head **north** to Rathleton's main gate.

In the city, go to the scrapyard and from there **west** to the wall; climb the stairs onto the wall and follow it **south** until it turns east. At the next exit there is a sewer grate: go down through it and then go down the stairs a little to the north. {npc:Jacob} is in the room to the east ({coord:33571,31983,9}).
From Jacob walk **west**, go down one floor and go through the quest door ({coord:33542,31979,9}). Follow the passage to the jade cave.
Go back the same way: cross the jade cave, go through the quest door and return to Jacob's sewers; go up the stairs and leave through the grate onto the wall.
Depending on the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} votes, there may be a {item:Slime Slide} in the **south-west** part of the dungeon ({coord:33392,32086,10}) that takes you back to {wiki:Upper Rathleton}.

To leave Oramond, do the arrival route in reverse back to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide takes you to the boat) and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
Route from Rathleton to the Abandoned Sewers
Area for **level 200+**: {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Grim Reaper|Grim Reapers} and {creature:Metal Gargoyle|Metal Gargoyles}. The small room south-east of the Slime Slide works as a safe spot.

The large building in the centre of the island of {wiki:Dawnport}, on top of a hill, where the NPCs that help new adventurers are (temple, bank, shops, spell teachers and {npc:Mr Morris} from the {wiki:Dawnport Quest}).
Dawnport is the beginners' island: you are only there at the start of the game. TibiaWiki currently marks the Dawnport page as outdated (the island may have been removed from the game).
After the {wiki:Tutorial}, your character is teleported to a small cave right below the Outpost ({coord:32069,31901,6}).
Go up to the Outpost floors: {npc:Mr Morris} is on the 2nd floor, right above {npc:Inigo}.
If you are in another part of the island, go back to the centre of Dawnport and climb the hill to the Outpost ramps.
The Outpost has **4 exits**; each one changes the character's vocation and gives it a set of items the first time you pass through.

To leave Dawnport: from level 8 you can go to the mainland; an NPC takes you there (the wiki does not say who or where). When you reach level 20 you are teleported automatically, after 5 minutes, to the temple below the starting area.
You can take at most 2000 gp to the mainland (1500 in the bank and 500 in your backpack).
From level 8, dying in Dawnport carries the normal penalty.

Headquarters of the guild that helps new adventurers, on an island **east of Calcanea and west of the Thais lighthouse**; there is no boat: you get there with an {item:Adventurer's Stone} used in the temple of any city.
Go to the **temple** of any city and use an {item:Adventurer's Stone}: you are teleported to the guild.
If you do not have one, ask an NPC in the temple for another: {key:hi}, {key:adventurer's stone}, {key:yes}. (The first stone is also received on the Island of Destiny boat.)
Step on the guild's exit teleport: it takes you back to the temple of the city you came from.
If you prefer to appear in another city, {npc:Charos} ({coord:32210,32296,6}) can change the teleport destination: say {key:hi} and {key:service}.
Charos (changes the teleport destination, 1 floor up)
Cledwyn, next to the Reward Chest

Lake **north-east of Thais**, with a small cave beneath it (a few {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and a {creature:Ghoul}) and frogs around it, among them {npc:A Frog} and the boss {creature:The Frog Prince}.
Leave **Thais** on foot and head **north-east** to the lake ({coord:32393,32118,7}).
By the lake are {npc:A Frog} ({coord:32363,32120,7}) and the sorceress {npc:Loria} ({coord:32385,32131,7}).
The cave beneath the lake (1 floor below ground) is where {npc:Lugri} is ({coord:32389,32118,8}); go down there from the lake.
The entrance of the other cave, **north** of the lake ({coord:32357,32085,7}), is the way to the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair}.
If you are in the cave, go up the same way you came down.
Cave north of the lake (way to the Thais Dragon Lair)
In the cave there are {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and a {creature:Ghoul}: dangerous for very low levels.
Former alchemists' quarter of **Yalahar**, **north-west** of the city centre, destroyed by an explosion and full of mutant creatures and blobs.

The gate mechanism only works after you receive the Alchemist Quarter mission in the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} (ask {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} for {key:mission}). If you see *"The gate mechanism won't move"*, you do not have access yet.

To go to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay) you need the **Novice** rank in the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society}; with {npc:Captain Bluebear} (Thais) you need the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}.

Go to **Yalahar**: {npc:Captain Max} in Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}), {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin (185 gp), {npc:Captain Sinbeard} in Ankrahmun (230 gp), {npc:Captain Seagull} in Ab'Dendriel (160 gp, after a mission of the In Service of Yalahar Quest) or {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais (with the password). You arrive at the port, **south** of the city centre.
Go to the city centre and then to the gate of the Alchemist Quarter, in the **north-west**.
Use the {wiki:Mechanism (Teleporter)|mechanism} next to the gate to cross into the quarter ({coord:32677,31132,7}).
If you went down to any underground level (for example to {creature:Diseased Dan}), go back up the same stairs to the surface of the quarter.
Go back to the gate you came in through and use the mechanism again to return to the centre of Yalahar.

At the port, **south** of the centre: {npc:Karith} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}) takes you to Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore once you have unlocked his routes; otherwise {npc:Captain Cookie} takes you to {key:liberty bay} (400 gp) or {key:thais} (800 gp) with {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}.

Area for level 35–40+: {creature:Mutated Human|Mutated Humans}, {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats}, blobs ({creature:Death Blob|Death}, {creature:Acid Blob|Acid}, {creature:Mercury Blob|Mercury}); in the towers and in the west, behind the hills, there are {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats}, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers} and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}.
On the upper floor only a {creature:Mutated Rat} can reach you if you stay by the wall on the left after the stairs.

The mind of the Ambassador of Rathleton, a dream area **beneath Kilmaresh** that can only be accessed during the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest}, by drinking a hallucinogen while wearing the charged ring in the Bastesh temple, in Issavi.
Premium account and the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest} Ambassador mission in progress.

You need the {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts (Charged)} equipped and a {item:Flask of Hallucinogen} (ask {npc:Faloriel} for {key:hallucinogen}). After you finish the quest, you can only get another flask if someone with the mission open buys it for you.
Go to **Issavi**: by boat from Venore, Darashia, Krailos or Oramond ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}), arriving at {npc:Captain Harava}; or by {wiki:Magic Carpet}, arriving at {npc:Tanyt}.
Buy the {item:Flask of Hallucinogen} from {npc:Faloriel} ({coord:33910,31514,7}), the potion seller.
Go to the **Bastesh temple**, the building to the south on the **west** side of the city ({coord:33864,31527,7}).
**Equip** the {item:Ring of Secret Thoughts (Charged)} and use the {item:Flask of Hallucinogen} on yourself: you are sent to the Ambassador's Mind.
Go back to the mind's **exit teleport** and step into it: you return to Kilmaresh.
There is no other way in: to enter again you always need a new flask and the charged ring.
It is not a hunting area: there are only {creature:Earworm|Earworms}, with strength similar to the other Kilmaresh creatures (the wiki points to level 350).
Teleport to the Ancient Ancestorial Grounds
Scrutinon (Gray Island) — hole south of him
Teleport to the Ancient Ancestorial Grounds
Tomb beneath the Kha'labal desert, **north/north-east of Ankrahmun**, with the entrance hidden under some ancient ruins; it is the tomb of the pharaoh {creature:Vashresamun}.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the captain at your city's port); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city through the **north** exit ({coord:33182,32773,7}) and cross the Kha'labal desert **north/north-east** to the ancient ruins ({coord:33207,32592,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on the entrance spot to open the hole and go down. Right after that you have to cross several **fire fields** to enter the tomb.

In Vashresamun's tomb, the sarcophagus room has an exit teleport that leaves you at the tomb entrance; the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the pharaoh's room, used **without** the pass item, also takes you to the start of the tomb.
From the start of the tomb, cross the fire fields again and use the {item:Rope} on the hole you opened to get out to the surface.
Walk back **south/south-west** to Ankrahmun; at the port, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
The ruins hiding the tomb entrance
The fire fields at the entrance hurt: below level 20, bring one or two potions just to get in.

The deeper you go, the stronger the creatures: on the 2nd floor there are {creature:Vampire|Vampires} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}; the floors after the teleports are for level 50–80+.

Ancient temple built in honour of Banor, just **north-west of Thais's north gate**, with several floors of tunnels beneath it (orcs, trolls, rotworms, cyclops, minotaurs and dragons) and many small quests.
Ancient Temple entrance (north-west of Thais's north gate)
Leave from the temple or depot of **Thais** and exit the city through the **north** gate.
The {wiki:Ancient Temple} is just **north-west** of that gate ({coord:32356,32170,7}). Enter the temple and go down the steps to the underground.
Most of the quests are **2 floors down** (go as far **north** as you can) or even deeper, on the way to {wiki:Mintwallin} (floor -4 and below); bring a {item:Rope} for the holes.
If you already have access to the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}, there is also a GCTS teleport inside the Ancient Temple ({coord:32331,32173,9}).
Go back the same way: use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through and climb the stairs floor by floor up to the temple steps.
You come out on the surface **north-west of Thais's north gate**; enter the city through that gate.

The deepest floors have {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and, in the {wiki:Devil Helmet Quest} area, even {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}: do not go down without the level for it.
In several parts of the caves the rare {creature:Grorlam} (3000 HP) may appear.

Pyramid city in the **south of the island of {wiki:Darama}**, surrounded by desert on three sides with the port to the **south**; around it are the tombs, the djinn fortresses and the Kha'zeel mountains.

Take a boat to Ankrahmun: there are boats in Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore and Yalahar. Say to the captain {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} (for example, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron, 160 gp).
You disembark at the city's **south** port, next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}). The city centre is to the north-east ({coord:33146,32816,7}).

Go to the port, in the **south**, and talk to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}: {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:venore}, {key:edron}, {key:darashia}, {key:port hope}, {key:liberty bay} or {key:yalahar}) and {key:yes}.
On foot, the city's **north** exit ({coord:33182,32773,7}) leads to the Kha'labal desert, the djinn fortresses and the tombs.
Passage by the oasis to Mal'ouquah (green djinns)
Outside the city the desert and mountains have {creature:Dragon|Dragons} (mountains to the west) and tombs full of undead; do not go out unprepared if you are a low level.

Tomb beneath the **Ankrahmun** library, just east of the depot, with several floors that get more and more dangerous; at the bottom is the pharaoh {creature:Ashmunrah} of {wiki:The Ancient Tombs Quest}.
To get through the teleport to the floors below you need one {item:Scarab Coin} per crossing.

Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat, for example with {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or with the captains of Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Darashia, Venore and Yalahar. You disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}).
Go to the Ankrahmun library, just **east** of the depot. The tomb entrance is beneath it ({coord:33142,32838,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on the entrance spot ({coord:33159,32836,7}) to open the hole and go down.
To reach the deep floors (3rd and 4th), step on the {wiki:Mystic Flame} (blue flame) and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the {wiki:Empty Coal Basin}: you are teleported to the other side.
Go back the same way to the start of the tomb. In the pharaoh's room, the {item:Magic Forcefield} used **without** the pass item also takes you to the start of the tomb.
Go up through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope} and you are back in Ankrahmun.
To leave the city, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Tomb entrance (dig with the Shovel; climb out with a Rope)
When you appear on the other side of the Mystic Flame teleport, the creatures next to the flame attack you straight away.

The deeper you go, the stronger the creatures: the 3rd floor has 4 {creature:Vampire|Vampires} and the 4th has {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} and {creature:Lich|Liches}.
A group of pharaoh tombs hidden beneath the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert, around **Ankrahmun** (and one beneath the city itself); almost all of them open by digging in the sand with a shovel.
To get through the teleport found in most tombs you have to sacrifice a {item:Scarab Coin}.

Take a boat to **Ankrahmun**: for example {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or the captains of Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Darashia, Venore and Yalahar. You disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.

Walk to the entrance of the tomb you are looking for (listed in the coordinates below) and dig with the {item:Shovel} on the right spot to open the hole. In the {wiki:Peninsula Tomb} you may have to dig several times until the hole appears.
Example — {wiki:Shadow Tomb}: leave Ankrahmun by the **north-east** ramp and follow the city walls **south** to the south-east part of {wiki:Darama}; dig at {coord:33255,32833,7}.
The {wiki:Horestis Tomb} is different: you do not dig, you enter 1 floor above the dragon spawn north-west of the city ({coord:33062,32731,6}).

The {item:Magic Forcefield} in each pharaoh's room, used **without** the pass item in your inventory, takes you to the start of the tomb. In the {wiki:Ancient Ruins Tomb} there is an exit teleport that leaves you at the entrance; in the others, if you do not see an exit teleport, go back the way you came.
From the start of the tomb, climb the ramps/stairs to the hole you opened in the sand and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface.
To leave Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Bring the antidote spell or poison cures: there are scorpions and other poisonous creatures in all the tombs.
After the teleport in most tombs, more monsters appear at the same time than in the rest of the tomb: judge carefully what you can handle.

Crypt **beneath the {wiki:Femor Hills}**, the first area of the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}; you enter through the teleport **north-west** of the {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub, beneath the Kazordoon crypt.
Premium account and the **Recruitment** mission of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}.

You need the **level 1 crystal shield**, which {npc:Gnomevisor} gives you when you first talk to him ({key:hi}, {key:expecting}, {key:splinters}, {key:missions}, {key:layer}), after the first part of the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}.

Go to **Kazordoon**. The simplest way is the {wiki:Steamship}: in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}); in Cormaya go down 8 floors to {npc:Gurbasch} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. There is also a steamship from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}).
Go down to the Kazordoon crypt (floor 9, 2 floors below ground level), where {npc:Gnomystery} ({coord:32610,31878,9}) and {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard} are.

Walk **north** in the crypt to the great rift ({coord:32603,31845,9}) and walk towards it until you fall to the floor below; go through the teleport and you reach {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub ({coord:32661,31825,10}).
Enter the teleport to the **north-west** of the hub: you are in the Antrum of the Fallen.
Go back to the teleport you came in through: it takes you to {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub.

From the hub, go back to the Kazordoon crypt and climb up to the city (the wiki does not describe this climb in detail). At the underground port, {npc:Brodrosch} takes you by steamship to Cormaya or Farmine.
Area for **level 350+**: {creature:Afflicted Strider|Afflicted Striders}, {creature:Blemished Spawn|Blemished Spawns} and {creature:Eyeless Devourer|Eyeless Devourers}.
The shield loses 1 point every 5 seconds inside the crypts: leave before it reaches zero.

Small frozen island of the southern {wiki:Ice Islands}, between the mainland (north-west of Carlin) and the islands of Senja and Vega, inhabited by {creature:Arctic Faun|Arctic Fauns}; you can only get there by being shipwrecked on one of {npc:Charles}'s shortcuts.

There is no direct trip: you only get here by random **shipwreck** when asking {npc:Charles} in Port Hope for a shortcut ({key:shortcut}). After being shipwrecked at one of the possible destinations, you cannot use the shortcut again for **20 hours**.
Go to **Port Hope** and stand next to {npc:Charles}, on the boat on the **west** side of the city ({coord:32529,32785,6}).

Say {key:hi}, {key:shortcut}, {key:yes} and choose {key:edron} (shortcut for 90 gp). If you reach Edron without being shipwrecked, say to {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} and repeat.

Repeat until you are shipwrecked. The shipwreck can take you to one of several islands; this one is the frozen island with Arctic Fauns ({coord:32113,31742,7}). If you land on another one, wait 20 hours to try again.
Use the {wiki:Ice Portal} on the island: it takes you to Vega, north of Carlin, north of Thais, Fibula or the south coast of Ragnir.
{creature:Arctic Faun|Arctic Fauns} have 300 HP and hit for up to ~240; there are about 10 on the island.
A barrel on the island gives two {item:Small Enchanted Sapphire|Small Enchanted Sapphires} and maybe some other minor loot.
Former leisure area of the Yalahari, by the **west** gate of **Yalahar**: a zoo with destroyed enclosures and loose animals, and an arena with gladiators and several floors.
Arena and Zoo Quarter (west gate of Yalahar)

Travel to **Yalahar**: in Liberty Bay talk to {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}; you need the Novice rank in the Explorer Society) or, in Thais, to {npc:Captain Bluebear} if you bought the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}. With {npc:Karith}'s routes unlocked there is a direct boat from several cities (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the port, **south** of the centre.

**Through the guard (no quest):** go to the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter} (you can enter it directly from the centre) and, at the gate between the Foreigner Quarter and the Arena and Zoo Quarter, say {key:pass} and the destination ({key:arena quarter}) to the guard {npc:Tony}.

**Through the mechanism:** go to the **west** gate of the city centre and use the Arena Quarter {wiki:Mechanism (Teleporter)|mechanism}. It only works after {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} gives you access (mission 5 (*Food or Fight*) of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}).
Go back to the gate you came in through: use the mechanism again to return to the centre, or go through {npc:Tony} ({key:pass}, {key:foreigner quarter}) to the Foreigner Quarter.
In the Arena and Zoo Quarter there is also the guard {npc:Hal}, who lets you through to the {wiki:Alchemist Quarter} ({key:pass} and the destination).

To leave Yalahar, go to the port: {npc:Captain Cookie} ({coord:32804,31276,6}) takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or Thais (800 gp); with the routes unlocked, {npc:Karith} takes you to 8 cities.
Tony — Foreigner / Arena and Zoo Quarter gate
Hal — Arena and Zoo / Alchemist Quarter gate
Arena and Zoo Quarter map (zones A–H)
Ground floor of the Arena and Zoo Quarter

The animals roam free: near the entrance there is a {creature:Massive Earth Elemental}, a {creature:Giant Spider} and a {creature:Wyrm}, and in the east area a {creature:Dragon Lord} and a {creature:Hydra}.
The upper floors of the arena are for levels 50–60+ (undead gladiators by the stairs, with little room to flee).
The Blue Djinn Fortress of {npc:Gabel}, in the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains **north of Ankrahmun**.
The entrance doors only let through players of **level 30** or above.
To trade with {npc:Nah'Bob} and {npc:Haroun} you must have done {wiki:The Djinn War - Marid Faction|Blue Djinn Quest}.
Travel by boat to **Ankrahmun** (for example from Venore with {npc:Captain Fearless} or from Edron with {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}).
Leave Ankrahmun to the **north** and climb the ramp to the mountains ({coord:33120,32578,7}).
Follow the path through the mountains to the fortress ({coord:33101,32527,7}); beware of the {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} roaming there.
{npc:Umar} is at the entrance, one floor up ({coord:33102,32531,6}).
Go back the same way: leave the fortress, go down the mountain ramp to the **south** and return to Ankrahmun.
In Ankrahmun, take the boat at the port to whichever city you want.
Ramp to the mountains, north of Ankrahmun
Jean Pierre's house, a few steps west of the fortress
On the way you may meet {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Larva|Larvas}, {creature:Scarab|Scarabs} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}.
Inside the fortress there are {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns}, {creature:Marid|Marids} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}; the higher you climb in the tower, the stronger the creatures.

Dungeon far beneath {wiki:Tiquanda}, with {creature:Twisted Shaper|Twisted Shapers} and {creature:Broken Shaper|Broken Shapers} and the {wiki:Time Machine}; you reach it through the Holy Portal of the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, north of Thais (part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}).
Arrival at the Astral Shaper Dungeon (Holy Portal)
The Halls of Hope temple must be restored and you must unlock the Holy Portal with {npc:Albinius}: say {key:holy portal} and hand him 50 {item:Incantation Notes}.
Get to **Thais** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain at the port).
Leave the city through the **north** exit and keep going north to the {wiki:Halls of Hope} ({coord:32326,32090,7}), where {npc:Albinius} is ({coord:32335,32091,7}).
Enter the **Holy Portal** (once you have unlocked it): you appear in the Astral Shaper Dungeon ({coord:32780,32685,14}). The {wiki:Time Machine} is to the **east** ({coord:32869,32722,14}).
Walk **west** the same way back to where you arrived ({coord:32780,32685,14}).
Enter the Holy Portal that is there to return to the Halls of Hope, and from there walk **south** to Thais.

The Astral Shaper Boss Dungeon, far **beneath Tiquanda**, where you fight {creature:The Last Lore Keeper} at the end of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}; you reach it through an {wiki:Energy Gate} in the Halls of Hope, north of Thais.
Arrival point from the Energy Gate
You can only enter the Energy Gate of the Halls of Hope after killing the **six bosses** of the elemental portals of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}.
Team of 1 to 15 players for the final boss (recommended level 200).
Go to **Thais** and leave through the **north** exit; keep going north to the **Halls of Hope**, the temple of the Astral Shapers where {npc:Albinius} and {npc:Ivalisse} are ({coord:32326,32090,7}).
In the Halls of Hope, enter the {wiki:Energy Gate}: you arrive at the Astral Shaper Boss Dungeon ({coord:32905,32847,13}).
Walk **south** and go down the hole ({coord:32935,32940,13}); then **north-west** and go down the stairs ({coord:32835,32868,14}).

Go **east** to the {creature:Stone Rhino|Stone Rhinos} and enter the {wiki:Mystic Flame} ({coord:32934,32854,15}); the next teleport leads to the room of the 15 tiles and the lever for the final fight.

The wiki does not describe a dedicated exit from this area. Go back the same way: the Stone Rhinos' Mystic Flame, the stairs (up) and the hole (climb up with the {item:Rope}) to where you arrived through the Energy Gate ({coord:32905,32847,13}).
The wiki also does not describe how to get from the arrival point back to the Halls of Hope. From the Halls of Hope, Thais is a walk to the **south**.
Hole (go down / climb up with the Rope)

On the way there are {creature:Shaper Matriarch|Shaper Matriarchs}, {creature:Broken Shaper|Broken Shapers}, {creature:Twisted Shaper|Twisted Shapers} and {creature:Stone Rhino|Stone Rhinos}. The wiki recommends level 130+.
Asuri citadel in a hidden cave south-east of the Emerald Gardens of {wiki:Marapur}; it is one of the areas of the {wiki:Shards of a Broken Moon Quest}, with very high-level creatures.
Access stones to the hidden cave (Marapur)
**Premium** account; the {wiki:Shards of a Broken Moon Quest} requires the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest} to be completed.
{npc:Sharai} has to give you access to the hidden cave ({key:hi}, {key:moon}) before the stones transport you.
Go to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains}, between Tiquanda and Ankrahmun, and enter the portal at the top of the mountain (floor +5, {coord:33037,32738,2}): you are teleported to {wiki:Marapur}.
In Marapur go **north-east** of the Emerald Gardens to {npc:Sharai} ({coord:33875,32660,5}) and say {key:hi}, {key:moon}.
Use the **stones** to the **south-east** ({coord:33894,32714,7}) to be transported to the hidden cave and the Asura Citadel.
The wiki does not describe another exit: go back the way you came to the point where the stones left you and return to Marapur.
To return to the mainland, go to the magic carpet in **Moonfall** and talk to {npc:Ziyad} ({coord:33804,32769,2}): say {key:hi} and ask him about the destinations (for example **Ankrahmun**).
Access stones to the hidden cave

Creatures with 4000 to 9500 HP ({creature:True Midnight Asura}, {creature:True Frost Flower Asura}, {creature:Winged Jaracal}, {creature:Silverfrost Sentinel}): very high-level area (the quest recommends 400+).
Opulent palace of the asuras in {wiki:Tiquanda}, by the jungle side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}, between **Port Hope** and **Ankrahmun**.
The secret basement (asuras in their true form) is only open to players of level 250+.
The simplest route is from **Ankrahmun**: leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}).
Cross the bridge up there (there is a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down to a staircase that takes you to the jungle side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}.
There you find the merchant {npc:Tarun}, near the wooden bridge of the pass ({coord:32976,32715,7}). Walk **north** to the palace entrance ({coord:32953,32685,7}).
Alternative: come on foot from **Port Hope**, **east** through the Tiquanda jungle.
If you fell into one of the hidden rooms or the basement, climb back up where you fell (use the {item:Rope} if needed) and go down the tower to the ground floor.
Leave through the palace entrance and head back **south** to {npc:Tarun}.
From there follow the Kha'zeel Pass **east** to **Ankrahmun** (the arrival route in reverse) or go back through the jungle **west** to Port Hope.
Tarun (the palace is to the north)
Area for level 200+ ({creature:Dawnfire Asura|Dawnfire}, {creature:Midnight Asura|Midnight} and {creature:Frost Flower Asura|Frost Flower Asuri}, {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}).

At the far **west** end of the ground floor there are cracks ({item:Some Cracks (Hole)}) and in the grass flower bed there is a {item:Pitfall}: they make you fall into rooms with {creature:Lich|Liches} and {creature:Hydra|Hydras}. Other cracks on the upper floors lead to fire and energy elementals and {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}.
Castle and hunting area reached through a teleport in the underground of **Edron**; access is given by the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}. {npc:Lai} lives here.
The teleport only works if you have access from the {wiki:No Rest for the Wicked Quest}.
Go to **Edron** by boat: at your city's port say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}).
Go to the teleport to Azzilon Castle, 1 floor below ground in Edron ({coord:33281,31848,8}), and step into it. The wiki only gives the teleport's position, not the way through the city to get there.
In the castle, {npc:Lai} is on one of the upper floors ({coord:33834,32352,4}).
Leave the castle the same way you came in: go back to the arrival teleport to return to Edron.
In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Former city of the lizards, now in ruins and taken over by apes, in the **north of the Tiquanda jungle**, north-east of **Port Hope**; beneath it are the dungeons and {wiki:Deeper Banuta}.
To use {npc:Lorek}'s ferry you need the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}; without it you go on foot through the jungle.
{wiki:Deeper Banuta} (below floor -2) is part of {wiki:The Ape City Quest}.

Take a boat to **Port Hope**: say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron). You arrive at {npc:Charles}'s port ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
From Port Hope cross the Tiquanda jungle **north-east** to Banuta ({coord:32807,32542,7}).
Shortcut: if you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** of Port Hope ({coord:32679,32775,7}), takes you directly to Banuta for **30 gp**.
{npc:Hairycles}'s temple is in the **south-east** of the city; the stairs furthest **south** ({coord:32826,32576,7}) go down to the dungeon (floor -1).

If you are in the dungeon, go back the same way: on floor -2 return **north** and then **east** to the stairs and go up; on floor -1 go **east** and then **south** to the stairs and go up to the surface, on the **south** side of Banuta ({coord:32826,32576,7}).
If you are in {wiki:Deeper Banuta}, leave through the portal at the start of the floor: it takes you to **Banuta floor -2**; from there climb the stairs to the surface.
From the surface cross the jungle **south-west** to Port Hope.

At the Port Hope port {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}) takes you by boat to other cities: {key:hi}, the name of the destination (for example {key:thais}, {key:edron} or {key:liberty bay}) and {key:yes}.
Stairs furthest south — descent to the dungeon
Floor -1: white circles = 4 stairs to the surface; black circle = stairs to floor -2
Floor -2: green circle = stairs to floor -1; blue circle = teleport to Deeper Banuta
The apes ({creature:Sibang}, {creature:Kongra}, {creature:Merlkin}) use haste and attack in groups: do not chase them and bring health potions.

On the surface, in the jungle around Banuta, there are {creature:Carniphila}, {creature:Terror Bird} and {creature:Tarantula}; in {wiki:Deeper Banuta} there are {creature:Hydra}, {creature:Serpent Spawn} and {creature:Medusa}.

The three settlements of the barbarian clans **south-west of Svargrond** — {wiki:Ragnir} (in an extinct volcano), {wiki:Bittermor} (beneath the glacier) and {wiki:Krimhorn} (on a peninsula) — around the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}.
Buddel's boat at the barbarian camps
To travel with {npc:Buddel} to the camps you may need to have done the Barbarian Test of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}; on foot there are no requirements.

Go to **Svargrond** by boat (in Carlin, Thais or Venore say to the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}; for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.

By boat: go **south** of Svargrond to {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32254,31195,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:camp}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He drops you by the camps, south of Bittermor ({coord:32020,31294,7}). Sometimes he takes you to another island by mistake.
On foot (faster and cheaper): leave Svargrond to the **west**, follow over the top of the mountain/glacier, go down the stairs, cross the small bridge and keep going west to the camps.
The villages: Ragnir ({coord:32136,31334,7}), Bittermor ({coord:31996,31233,7}) and Krimhorn ({coord:32022,31397,7}).
Go back to {npc:Buddel}'s boat where you disembarked ({coord:32020,31294,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Or walk back **east**, over the bridge and the glacier, to Svargrond. There, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you by boat to Carlin, Thais or Venore.

The barbarians (Barbarian Brutetamers, Headsplitters, Skullhunters, Bloodwalkers) move in groups; around there are {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears} and, on the glacier, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}. Recommended level 25+.
Floor below, after the sealed door
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} sends you to your city's temple; it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.
Large Luminescent Crystals in the walls of the Barren Drift
Bathhouse in **Darashia**, in the south-west of the city, on Darashia Street, west of the depot; it was where the infamous {creature:Koshei the Deathless} used to bathe.
Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (at your city's port, {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Petros}) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).
In the city, go to the building **west** of the depot, in the south-west of Darashia ({coord:33199,32456,7}), and go in (it has an entrance with 3 doors).
Leave through the same door: you are in the centre of Darashia.

At the port, {npc:Petros} takes you to Venore (60 gp), Ankrahmun (100), Liberty Bay (200), Port Hope (180), Yalahar (210), Gray Island (150), Issavi (130) or Krailos (110): {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}. {npc:Chemar} has the flying carpet.
Bath of Dreams floor plan, ground floor
Bath of Dreams floor plan, 1st floor
Dwarven city hidden beneath the islands of {wiki:Fenrock} and {wiki:Mistrock}, near Yalahar, ruled by {npc:Emperor Rehal}; you get there by a long underground path from Fenrock.
The first time you have to ask {npc:Maris} about Mistrock **in Mistrock** ({key:hi}, {key:mistrock}); without that the {item:Pick} does not work on the Fenrock crack.

Go to **Yalahar** (for example from Venore, with {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}) and climb to the docks of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter}, in the **north-west** corner of the port, 1 floor above ground.

Talk to {npc:Maris} ({coord:32650,31293,6}): {key:hi}, {key:mistrock}, {key:yes} (100 gp). Once in Mistrock, say to him {key:hi} and {key:mistrock} (required the first time) and then {key:hi}, {key:fenrock}, {key:yes} (50 gp). On later visits you can go straight to Fenrock ({key:fenrock}, 100 gp from Yalahar).

In Fenrock, enter the mountain and go down **two floors** to the {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises} cave. In the **south-east** corner there is a crack in the floor: use the {item:Pick} on it ({coord:32564,31338,9}) and you are teleported down.
Follow the path down (there are only {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Goblin|Goblins} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}) to the dwarf {npc:Nokmir}, at the entrance of Beregar.

On your first visit, walk a little **south** of Nokmir, climb the ramp and use the ore cart on the yellow floor to activate it. On later visits, the cart at the start of the path ({coord:32604,31339,11}) takes you directly to Beregar.
Use Beregar's ore cart ({coord:32607,31510,13}) to return to the start of the path (once you have activated it); otherwise walk back the same way.
Climb up through the Fenrock caves to the surface.
On the Fenrock coast, {npc:Maris} takes you back to Yalahar: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
Crack for using the Pick (Fenrock floor -2)
Ore cart on the Fenrock side

If you stray from the main path you may fall into areas with {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps} and {creature:Lich|Liches}: if you see them, turn back.

Dwarf mines **beneath Beregar**, the hidden city reached through Fenrock (west of Yalahar); the four parts of the mine (north, south, east and west) open up during {wiki:The Hidden City of Beregar Quest}.

Each part of the mine opens with a mission of {wiki:The Hidden City of Beregar Quest}: east mine ({npc:Xorlosh}'s lift, Going Down mission), north mine ({npc:Nokmir}'s door, Justice for All), west mine ({npc:Frafnar}, Sweet as Chocolate Cake) and south mine ({npc:Grombur}).

Go to **Yalahar** (for example in Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}) and go to the docks of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter}, in the **north-west** corner of the port, 1 floor above ground.
Talk to {npc:Maris} ({coord:32649,31293,6}): {key:hi}, {key:mistrock}, {key:yes} (100 gp). In Mistrock ask him for {key:hi}, {key:fenrock}, {key:yes} (50 gp).

In Fenrock enter the mountain and go down **two floors** to the cave of Tortoises and Crocodiles. In the **south-east** corner use the {item:Pick} on the crack in the floor ({coord:32564,31338,9}): you are teleported down.

Follow the path down to Beregar (once you have activated the ore cart, the cart at the start of the path, {coord:32604,31339,11}, takes you there directly). The mine entrances are by the dwarf guards, on the floor at {coord:32611,31501,14}.
Leave the mine through the entrance next to the guard and return to Beregar.
Use Beregar's ore cart ({coord:32607,31510,13}) back to the start of the path and climb up through the Fenrock caves to the surface.
On the Fenrock coast, {npc:Maris} takes you back to Yalahar: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (100 gp).

There are {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}, {creature:Dwarf Geomancer|Dwarf Geomancers}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}; the wiki recommends level 60+ for knights and paladins and 55+ for mages.
Glacier camp of the Norsir barbarian tribe, beneath the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, **south-west of Svargrond**; a good hunting spot for low and medium levels.
To use {npc:Buddel}'s boat to the barbarian camps you need to have done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}; on foot there are no requirements.

Go to **Svargrond**: take the boat in **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** (say to the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({coord:32347,31108,6}), in the **east** part of the city.

**By boat (faster):** **south** of Svargrond talk to {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32254,31195,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:camp}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He drops you by the barbarian camps ({coord:32020,31294,7}), south of Bittermor.
**On foot:** leave Svargrond to the **west**, go over the mountain, go down the stairs and keep going west along the glacier to the raiders' camp.
From the camps head **north** across the thin layer of ice to the entrance of Bittermor.
Go back the same way: cross the ice **south** to the raiders' camp.
Talk to {npc:Buddel} by the camps ({coord:32020,31294,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}. Or walk **east** over the mountain to Svargrond.
In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you by boat to whichever city you want.
Quest door in Bittermor (A Father's Burden)
There is a small chance that {npc:Buddel} takes you to another island instead of the camp.

In the central room there are 3 {creature:Barbarian Brutetamer|Barbarian Brutetamers} and lots of {creature:Barbarian Headsplitter|Headsplitters} and {creature:Barbarian Skullhunter|Skullhunters}: do not run towards the brutetamers, or you will be surrounded. The respawn is very fast.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia
On the mountain between Darashia and Drefia there are lots of {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}: keep some mana to cure the poison.
Invisible portal to the Brain Grounds
Bulltaur lair near the {wiki:Pits of Inferno}, beneath the graveyard of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} (south-west of Venore); you enter through a trashcan and it is a very high-level area.
Trashcan to the Bulltaur Lair (1 floor below the graveyard)
Access to the trashcan is given by the {wiki:20 Years a Cook Quest} (*Bulltaur Lair* mission).
Very high-level area: the wiki recommends level 400+.
Go to **Venore** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and leave the city to the **south-west** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} ({coord:32735,32297,7}).

Go to the graveyard near the {wiki:Necromant House} ({coord:32781,32330,7}) and use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} to open the cave beneath the graveyard (it is the same entrance as {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}).
The trashcan is **1 floor below** the graveyard ({coord:32799,32365,8}). Use it to enter the Bulltaur Lair.
The lair has 4 floors: on each one, head to the next way down.
Go back through the same floors to the point where you arrived through the trashcan and leave the way you came in.
Go up to the graveyard and return to Venore through the Plains of Havoc, to the **north-east**.

Small island **south of Cormaya** (near Edron), connected by a bridge, that is only accessible a few days a year during the world quest {wiki:A Piece of Cake}; the giant cake and {npc:Brutus The Baker} are there.
You can only go there during the world quest {wiki:A Piece of Cake}, after the bridge is built.
Go to **Edron** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the port captain).
At the Edron port talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}): {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You disembark at Cormaya's **north** port, next to {npc:Pemaret}.
Cross {wiki:Cormaya} on foot to the **south** to the bridge at the island's far south ({coord:33303,32050,7}), where the huge cake is.
Cross the bridge to Cake Keep Isle; {npc:Brutus The Baker} is at {coord:33304,32063,7}.
Go back over the bridge and cross Cormaya on foot to the **north** to the north port.
Talk to {npc:Pemaret} ({coord:33287,31956,6}): {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. In Edron you take the boat to whichever city you want.
Bridge and giant cake, south of Cormaya
Underwater quara settlement **north-west of Nargor**, on the seabed west of Liberty Bay; you can only get there with {npc:Captain Max}'s boat and a diving helmet.
Seabed where you land, beneath Captain Max's boat

{npc:Captain Max} only takes you to Calassa from the *Calassa Expedition* mission of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest} ({npc:Berenice} warns him; after that you keep access) — the wiki mentions the **Explorer** rank.
You need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} (or equivalent) to move underwater; Captain Max rents you one for a 5000 gp deposit.

In **Liberty Bay**, look for {npc:Captain Max} on one of the boats on the **east** side of the docks ({coord:32298,32896,6}) and ask him for passage to {key:calassa} (200 gp). If you do not have a helmet, he rents you a {item:Helmet of the Deep}.
You arrive on his boat above Calassa ({coord:31915,32709,6}). Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and jump overboard (leave the platform to the **south**).
Dock on the sea floor ({coord:31914,32717,12}) and you immediately face lots of small quaras ({creature:Quara Mantassin|Mantassins} and {creature:Quara Constrictor|Constrictors}).
Go back the same way to the area where you fell to the seabed, beneath {npc:Captain Max}'s boat ({coord:31914,32717,12}).
Return to his boat ({coord:31915,32709,6}) and ask him to take you back to **Liberty Bay**. If you rented the helmet, say {key:return} to him to give it back and recover your 5000 gp.
Where you land on the seabed
**Never** take the helmet off underwater, or you will drown.

High-level area (the wiki recommends 90–100+): {creature:Quara Predator|Quara Predators}, {creature:Quara Pincher|Quara Pinchers}, {creature:Massive Water Elemental|Massive Water Elementals} and {creature:Thul}.
Kingdom made of sweets, born from the dreams of Tibia's children; it can only be reached from {wiki:Feyrist}, through the giant donut.
Giant donut in Feyrist (entrance to Candia)
**Premium** account and access to {wiki:Feyrist} (fae seal from {npc:Alkestios}, in the {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest}).
The {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)}, which you bake in Feyrist's oven during the same quest.

Go to {wiki:Feyrist}: in any city, enter the corridor of the four elemental arches, choose the arch of your gem's element and **use** the gem on the shrine inside ({item:Small Sapphire} = ice, {item:Small Emerald} = earth, {item:Small Ruby} = fire, {item:Small Amethyst} = energy). The gem is used up.
In Feyrist, go to the giant donut in the **east** part of the island ({coord:33574,32222,7}).
With the {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)} on you, walk under the donut: it takes you to Candia.
If you are in the {wiki:Chocolate Mines} or the {wiki:Dessert Dungeons}, climb back up the same way you came down.
Return to Feyrist through the donut, the same way you entered.
In Feyrist **use** any of the four shrines (you do not need a gem) to return to the mainland.
Giant donut (entrance and exit of Candia)

The surface is peaceful, but in the {wiki:Chocolate Mines} and the {wiki:Dessert Dungeons} there are creatures with around 2500 to 3800 HP ({creature:Nibblemaw|Nibblemaws}, {creature:Candy Horror|Candy Horrors}, {creature:Goggle Cake|Goggle Cakes}).

The **Carlin** graveyard, just **east** of the city, with a crypt and caves overrun by {creature:Troll|Trolls}; it is a good hunting spot for those who have just arrived from Rookgaard and have the {wiki:Fanfare Quest}.
The crypt door may be locked: open it with {item:Key 3520}, which is in a box in the building just **north-west** of the Carlin boat ({coord:32375,31803,7}).
Go to **Carlin** (by boat: say to your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}).
Leave the city to the **east** to the graveyard ({coord:32407,31784,7}).
The crypt is at the far **south** of the graveyard: go down the stairs. Inside, the door to the **west** (Key 3520 if it is locked) leads to a hole to the Troll caves.
Go back the same way to the hole you came down through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the crypt.
Go up the stairs at the far **south** of the graveyard and you are **east** of Carlin again.
Box with Key 3520 (next to the Carlin boat)
A hole in the **south** part of the cave leads to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} section of the {wiki:Carlin Corym Cave}.

The sewers beneath the city of **Carlin**, with Bugs and Slimes for low levels and the rebels' secret bar ({npc:Karl}, {npc:Toothless Tim}, {npc:William}); {wiki:The Exterminator Quest} and missions of Kissing a Pig and Secret Service take place here.
Sewer grate (east of the druids' guild)
Go to **Carlin** by boat (for example in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Greyhound}'s port ({coord:32388,31822,6}).
Go to the sewer grate, **east** of the druids' guild, right in front of the depot ({coord:32327,31816,7}), and go down.
On the first floor of the sewers, walk **south** to {npc:Karl}'s underground bar ({coord:32318,31797,8}). Further south there is a way down to another floor, with more {creature:Slime|Slimes}.
Go back the **same way**: climb to the first floor of the sewers, walk **north** to the entrance and climb the grate to the streets of Carlin, just east of the druids' guild.
At the port, {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
In the {wiki:Secret Service Quest} mission, when you enter the bar 2 {creature:Amazon|Amazons} appear.
Apartments and services inside the castle walls, in the **centre of Edron**: the port and arenas to the north, shops and flats to the east, and the temple underground.

By boat: at your city's port say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais or {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore, 40 gp). You arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat, on the **north** side of the castle ({coord:33176,31764,6}).

By {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} (Darashia, Farmine, Femor Hills, Svargrond, Kazordoon or Issavi): say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Pino}'s carpet, above the north gate, on the 4th floor ({coord:33192,31783,3}).

From the port, enter the castle through the **north** gate: {npc:Falk} is right outside and an Edron Guardsman just inside. The flats are in the walls; {npc:Amanda}'s temple is underground at -1, on the **east** side.

By boat: at the north port, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Ab'Dendriel (70 gp), Ankrahmun (160), Carlin (110), Cormaya (20), Liberty Bay (170), Port Hope (150), Thais (160) or Venore (40); Oramond (110) only with the *Citizen* rank of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}. Say {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.

By flying carpet: climb onto {npc:Pino}'s carpet, above the north gate, and say {key:hi}, the destination ({key:darashia}, {key:farmine}, {key:hills}, {key:svargrond}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:issavi}) and {key:yes}.
On foot: leave the castle through the **south** to the rest of Edron (for example to the **east**, towards {wiki:Stonehome}).
Old cemetery district of **Yalahar**, **north** of the city centre, taken over by the undead; the buildings and crypts are now used for necromancy rituals.

The gate mechanism from the centre to the Cemetery Quarter only works after you have started mission 6 of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}. Without it, enter through the Magician Quarter (which has no mechanism) and get past the guard {npc:Reed}.

To go to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} you need the **Novice** rank in the {wiki:Explorer Society}; alternatively, buy the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (250 gp) so you can travel from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}.

Go to **Yalahar**: in Liberty Bay talk to {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}) or, if you paid {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} for the password, to {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais. You arrive at the Yalahar harbour, **south** of the centre ({coord:32804,31276,6}).
Cross the city centre (Inner City) **north** to the Cemetery Quarter gate and use the gate mechanism (only with mission 6 of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} started).

Without access to the mechanism: enter the **Magician Quarter** (northeast, no mechanism) and go to the guard {npc:Reed} ({coord:32802,31103,7}), between the Magician Quarter and the Cemetery Quarter. Say {key:pass} and the destination district to get through his gate.
You can also get there through the **Alchemist Quarter**, via the guard {npc:Bruce} ({coord:32741,31113,7}), in the same way ({key:pass} and the destination).

Go back to the gate you came in through and use the mechanism again to return to the centre of Yalahar; or ask {npc:Reed} to let you through ({key:pass} and the destination) to the Magician Quarter and leave from there to the centre.
At the harbour, **south** of the centre, {npc:Captain Cookie} ({coord:32804,31276,6}) takes you to the mainland: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} (400 gp) or {key:thais} (800 gp), and {key:yes}.

If you did the mission *Searoutes around Yalahar*, {npc:Karith}, east of Captain Cookie ({coord:32818,31278,5}), takes you more cheaply to Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore.
Reed — guard between the Cemetery and Magician Quarters
Bruce — guard between the Alchemist and Cemetery Quarters

There are normally no creatures on the main road or on the ground floor of the big building, but {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} can attack you over the fence and {creature:Tormented Ghost|Tormented Ghosts} sometimes appear in the building.
Inside the crypts there are {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Banshee|Banshees} and {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}: an area for mid and high levels.

Drifting iceberg inhabited by Chakoyas (and a Frost Giantess at the top) that sometimes runs aground on the coast of **northwest Tiquanda**, north of Port Hope; only accessible while the mini world change is active.
Chakoya Iceberg (coast north of Port Hope)
Only accessible during the {wiki:Chakoya Iceberg Mini World Change}. When it is active, messages such as *"A big iceberg has been washed up at the coast north of Port Hope."* appear.

If you are not in **Port Hope** yet, take a boat there (for example in Thais, Venore, Ankrahmun or Liberty Bay): tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the harbour next to {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
Leave Port Hope on foot and walk **north**, through **northwest Tiquanda**, to the coast where the iceberg ran aground ({coord:32624,32586,7}). You do not need a boat or a rope.
On the iceberg, go up the stairs; to the **northeast** there is an igloo that teleports you down to the inner floors.

Go back the **same way**: if you went down through the holes inside the iceberg, climb back up with the {item:Rope} through the holes you came down by (the sources do not describe any other exit from the igloo floor).
Leave the iceberg onto the Tiquanda coast and walk **south** to **Port Hope**, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to another city.

On the way from Port Hope to the iceberg you may meet {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}. A {creature:Frost Giantess} lives at the top of the iceberg.

Small island **north of Zao**, also called {wiki:Isle of Strife}, with a big dragon arena at the top of the mountain and spawns of high-class lizards and {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters}.
Access to the island is gained through {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} (mission 9, *Mortal Combat*).
The teleport from the Zao Steppe to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} only works after the first 8 missions of The New Frontier Quest.
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine** ({npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}).

In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface. Continue **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
Enter the teleport in the **north** of the steppe to reach the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.

Follow the coast a short way **northeast** to {npc:Zurak}'s boat ({coord:33158,31227,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:trip} and {key:yes} (the trip is free). You arrive at the island's dock ({coord:33102,31048,7}).
To reach the arena, climb the path up several flights of stairs to the top of the mountain, where {npc:Chrak} is.
Go back down the mountain the same way (stairs and lizards) to the dock and talk to {npc:Zurak} to return to the Muggy Plains.
In the Muggy Plains, enter the old lizard teleport to return to the Zao Steppe.

Return to the mountain pass ({coord:33085,31532,7}), climb up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the Farmine elevator. On the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya} ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
Zurak's boat in the Muggy Plains

The climb to the arena is full of {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard High Guard|High Guards}, {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests} and {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters}: an area for levels 90–120+.
Lizard village in a river delta in **southeast Tiquanda**, southeast of Port Hope and next to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} mountains, with a Banuta-style pyramid in the centre.
{npc:Lorek}'s boat only takes you if you have the **Ranger** rank (or higher) in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}.

From **Port Hope**: leave through the **south** part of the town and keep walking **east** (that way you avoid the {creature:Hydra} and the elephants to the north) to the log bridge over the river ({coord:32906,32850,7}).
Enter Chor via the **southwest** log ({coord:32906,32855,7}); go **south**, cross the bridge and turn **east** to reach the centre of the village.

From **Ankrahmun**, the safest way is through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} mountains (you only meet a few {creature:Nomad|Nomads} and {creature:Bandit|Bandits}); on the jungle side, follow the river in the **south** until you find a tree fallen across the river. You can also get there through the {wiki:Darama Terramite Cave}.

With the Ranger rank in the Paw and Fur Society, talk to {npc:Lorek} in the **east** of Port Hope ({key:hi}) and ask for the trip to Chor: 30 gp, **one way only**. You arrive at {coord:32968,32801,7}.
Walk back the same way: leave via the **southwest** log, cross the log bridge and head **west** through the southern half of **Port Hope**.
If you came from Ankrahmun, go back through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} mountains.
{npc:Lorek}'s boat does not make the return trip: there is no boat from Chor.

On the way from Port Hope you meet {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Cobra|Cobras}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles} and {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals}; at the entrance there are {creature:Lizard Sentinel|Lizard Sentinels}, {creature:Lizard Templar|Lizard Templars} and {creature:Larva|Larvas}.
Inside the village there are groups of 6 or more {creature:Lizard Snakecharmer|Lizard Snakecharmers}: do not chase creatures far away, so you do not get caught by a bigger spawn.

Small Christmas bakery hidden under the ice of the island of {wiki:Vega} (Southern Ice Islands, northwest of Carlin), just south of Santa Claus's house; it is the only place where a {item:Gingerbreadman} is baked.
Loose ice pile (way down to the bakery)
To bake the {item:Gingerbreadman} from a {item:Lump of Cake Dough} you must have already learned the Gingerbread Recipe.

Leave **Carlin** to the **northwest** to {npc:Nielson}'s ferry ({coord:32235,31675,7}) and ask for passage to {wiki:Vega} ({key:hi}, {key:vega}; 20 gp). You arrive at {npc:Carlson}'s raft, in the **east** of Vega.
Cross Vega to the **west** to Santa Claus's house. Go past {npc:Ruprecht} and a little **south** of the house: you will find a loose ice pile ({coord:31944,31721,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on the ice pile to open the passage and go down. Follow the short path to the bakery: there are no monsters.
Go back the same short way to the hole you came down by and climb up to the surface of Vega (bring a {item:Rope} just in case; the wiki does not describe the way up).
Return to {npc:Carlson}'s raft, in the east of Vega, and ask for passage back to the mainland: it is **free** and you arrive at Nielson's ferry, northwest of Carlin.
Carlson (raft in the east of Vega)
The loose ice pile on Vega
To bake, use the {item:Lump of Cake Dough} on any oven in the bakery, as if you were making a cake.
Icy island **west of Svargrond**, only accessible between **1 April and 1 May**, with Chakoya igloos, the Chyllfroest mountain (Frost Dragons, Tinder Box) and the frozen Ursagrodon.
It is only accessible from **1 April to 1 May** (mini world change); outside those dates the ice bridge does not exist.
Go to **Svargrond** (by boat, from the harbour captain in your town: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}).
Leave Svargrond and go to the {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls} cave on the way to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} shortcut.
Instead of going down and following the shortcut, head **west**, towards the Quara Scouts cave.

The ice "bridge" to the island starts at {coord:32068,31093,7}: cross it to reach Chyllfroest ({coord:32060,31034,7}). On the way there are {wiki:Chakoyas}, {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} and {creature:Frost Giantess|Frost Giantesses}.
Go back the **same way**: return to the surface, cross the ice bridge at {coord:32068,31093,7} to the **east**, back to the Frost Trolls cave and **Svargrond**.
If you are at the bottom of the eastern dungeon, on the **5th underground floor** there is a **Geyser**: step on it and you are taken back to the surface, at the foot of the mountain.
If you are at the top of the mountain, use {spell:Levitate} on the **east** side to go down from the 6th to the 5th floor, then go down the same stairs and ramps to the ground.
The dungeon Geyser that leads to the surface
Where the Geyser drops you on the surface
Where to use Levitate at the top of the mountain

On the mountain, from floor +1 to -1 there are many {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}: to reach the Ursagrodon (1st underground floor, east side), go around the mountain via the **southeast** and you avoid the dragons.
Mountain floor -2 is a very high-level area, and the 5th floor has {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds} and {creature:Demon|Demons}.
Key 0303 (opens several doors in the fortress)

Small island **south of Edron**, with houses, a fishing harbour to the north, an underground {wiki:Steamship} station and two hunting areas (the {wiki:Cormaya Dwarf Cave} and the {wiki:Dryad Gardens}).
From **Edron**: on the boat **north** of the city talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) and say {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp).
You land at the **north** harbour of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret}, on Cormaya Street ({coord:33287,31956,6}).

From the {wiki:Steamship}: in **Kazordoon** talk to {npc:Brodrosch} at the underground harbour ({coord:32661,31957,15}) or in **Farmine** to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}) and say {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}. You arrive 8 floors below Cormaya, next to {npc:Gurbasch}; go up the stairs (they come out under the Cormaya garden, south of the boat).
You can also get there on foot through the tunnels of the {wiki:Edron Rotworm Cave}, from Edron.
To **Edron**: at the north harbour talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).

To **Kazordoon** or **Farmine**: go down 8 floors to the {wiki:Steamship}, at the end of Cormaya Street, and talk to {npc:Gurbasch} ({coord:33313,31989,15}): {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (160 gp) or {key:farmine} (110 gp; 60 gp after mission 2 of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}) and {key:yes}.
{npc:Pemaret} will also take you for free to the island of the sage {npc:Eremo} ({wiki:Eremo's Island}).
Captain Seahorse — boat from Edron to Cormaya
Groups of {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} from Kazordoon sometimes appear in the **east** part of the island.
Old abandoned coal mine in the **northeast of Newhaven island**, haunted by the souls of buried miners; a beginner hunting area after the Muglex goblin clan.

The Corrupted Mines are on Newhaven island itself (the island where new players start). Leave the village through the **north** exit and go to the **northeast** tip of the island ({coord:32596,32458,7}).
At the northeast tip, go up the stairs ({coord:32598,32418,7}) to the second floor of the mines.
For the higher parts, go **southwest** and climb up through the hole with the {item:Rope} (or {spell:Magic Rope}) at {coord:32580,32445,6}.

Go back the **same way**: go down through the rope spot hole you climbed up by (you do not need a rope to go down), head **northeast** on the second floor and go down the stairs to the northeast of Newhaven.

Return to the village. To leave the island you must be **level 8**: leave through the village's **west** exit (level door) and talk to {npc:Anna} at the docks ({coord:32552,32498,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}. She takes you to {wiki:Targuna}.
At the far end of the {wiki:Newhaven Legion Helmet Quest} cave there is a wall of {item:Poison Gas}; the {item:Magic Forcefield} next to the body takes you back to the **west** end of the cave.

Hidden cave in the far **northeast of Zao**, below the lizard area, full of {creature:Lizard Chosen|Lizard Chosens} and with 4 {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}; only those who have already handed 8 {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge} to {npc:Cael} can enter.
You must have handed in at least **8** {item:Tome of Knowledge|Tomes of Knowledge} to {npc:Cael} in Farmine ({wiki:Tomes of Knowledge Quest}); without that you cannot enter.

Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine** ({npc:Brodrosch} under Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} under Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}). In Farmine take the elevator up to the surface and follow the passage **east** to the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.
Go through the lizard teleport and head **northeast** to the area with {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} and {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs}.

Go up the stairs (there is a Mutated Bat and a Mutated Tiger), go up again, turn **right** and go past the building. You will find wooden ramps: go down them and follow the path to a **hidden hole** — it is the ramp on the **east** side of the temple of missions 4 and 5 of the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest}.

Go down the hole: you arrive at an area with {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards}, {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests} and {creature:Lizard Chosen|Lizard Chosens}. Keep going **south** to a ramp and go down: you are in the Corruption Hole.
Go back to the spot where you fell through the hole and climb up with the {item:Rope}.
Go up the ramp on the east side of the temple and return to Farmine the same way you came (teleport, Zao Steppe, mountain pass and elevator).
Level recommended by the wiki: 140+ for knights, 100+ for paladins and mages. At the bottom of the ramp you are greeted by hordes of Lizard Chosens.
The 4 {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons} are in the **northwest** part of the cave; {creature:The Voice of Ruin} may also appear.
Multi-floor dungeon **under Liberty Bay** where the Corym and other traders deal and bet on creature fights; you enter through a sewer grate in the city.
Travel to **Liberty Bay**: at your town's harbour tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais or {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore).
In the city, go to the sewer grate ({item:Sewer Grate}) at {coord:32268,32835,7} and enter through it.
Go down the dungeon floors to the one you need (for example, {npc:A Captive Forest Fury} and the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest} mark are on **floor -4**).
Go back the same way: climb all the floors up to the sewer grate and you come out onto the streets of Liberty Bay.
At the Liberty Bay harbour take the boat to your town (for example {npc:Jack Fate} to Venore: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).

From floor -2 down there are {creature:Corym Skirmisher|Corym Skirmishers} and, on -4 and -5, {creature:Corym Vanguard|Corym Vanguards}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Forest Fury|Forest Furies} and other creatures from the fight cages.
Mines where the Coryms are forced to work by {npc:Corym Ratter}, behind a teleport at the bottom of the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave}, **east of Venore**.
Teleport to the Corym Mines (bottom of the Venore Corym Cave)
To get through the sealed doors of the mines you need the locals' permission, which you earn in the {wiki:Hidden Threats Quest}.
Go to **Venore** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain of your town; you arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}).
Leave Venore through the **east** exit ({coord:33002,32096,7}) and enter the {wiki:Venore Corym Cave}, in the swamp building ({coord:33073,32085,7}).
Inside, go down through the hole to the **northeast**, then through the next hole, go **south** and go down again: in total that is **4 floors** down.
On the deepest floor go to the **northwest** side, follow the **north** wall to the passage with the teleport ({coord:33055,32012,11}) and enter: you are in the Corym Mines.
Go back to the teleport you came in by: it takes you back to the Venore Corym Cave ({coord:33054,32008,11}).
Climb up through the same holes (with the {item:Rope}) and ladders to the building in the swamp.
Return to Venore by the **east** entrance. At the harbour, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to other cities (for example {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}, 40 gp).
On the way through the Corym Cave there are {creature:Corym Charlatan|Corym Charlatans}, {creature:Corym Skirmisher|Skirmishers} and {creature:Corym Vanguard|Vanguards}.
If you have progressed far enough in the Hidden Threats Quest, the first time you leave through the teleport you have to fight the miniboss {creature:Cave Spider}.
Court of Summer portal (north-east of the Fae Village)
Warehouse of plants and fresh produce belonging to {npc:Talesia}, on Market Street, in the **north of Venore**: 3 floors, with the shop on the 1st floor.

Travel to **Venore** by boat: at your town's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, 170 gp, or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron, 40 gp). You arrive at the **north** harbour of Venore, next to {npc:Captain Fearless}.
The warehouse is close by, in the north of the city, on Market Street ({coord:32976,32037,6}).
Inside: on the 1st floor are the sellers {npc:Livielle}, {npc:Rodney} and {npc:Rose}; {npc:Talesia} is on the upper floor.
Go down the stairs and leave the building onto Market Street.
To leave Venore, go to the **north** harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
Caves under the pirate island of {wiki:Nargor}, west of Liberty Bay, full of crystals that the pirates mine and grind; this is where {wiki:The Cursed Crystal Quest} takes place.
Crystal Gardens entrance (next to One-Eyed Joe, Nargor)

Access to Nargor: {wiki:Eleonore Quest} completed and {wiki:Meriana Quest} done up to *Ray's Mission 1*; to go to Meriana you need the mission *Access to Meriana* from {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.
In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} on the dock ({coord:32347,32859,7}): {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp) to go to **Meriana**.
In Meriana, **south** of Sabrehaven, talk to {npc:Sebastian} ({coord:32347,32623,7}): {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
In Nargor ({coord:32024,32815,7}) go **south**, east of the two ships, to {npc:One-Eyed Joe} ({coord:32025,32885,6}).
Go down the staircase next to her ({coord:32020,32888,6}): you are in the Crystal Gardens. The floors below go down via stairs, ramps and crystal teleporters.

Go back the same way to the staircase that goes up next to {npc:One-Eyed Joe} (from the deepest floors, the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)|crystal teleporters} and the ramp at {coord:32041,32909,9} take you back up).
Go back **north** to {npc:Sebastian} ({coord:32024,32815,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (100 gp) to return directly to Liberty Bay (or {key:meriana} for 50 gp).
Ramp up (way back from the deep floors)
Recommended level 70-80+. Next to the crystal teleporter on floor -3 there is a pirate flag with a warning: *Beware! Dangerous monsters down here!*

Gnome crystal caves, reached through a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} at the **Gnomegate** (the Gnomebase of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}), with {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}, {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}.

You need access to the GCTS (the gnomes' teleport system) through the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}; each time you enter or leave the GCTS you use up a {item:Teleport Crystal} ({npc:Xelvar} sells them with {key:trade}, as do {npc:Gnomette} and {npc:Gnomincia}).
Go to **Kazordoon** and look for {npc:Xelvar}, in the north part of Temple Street, near the northern blessing NPC.

Enter the teleport **east** of Xelvar ({coord:32628,31863,11}): you appear in the GCTS, above the Gnomebase ({coord:32799,31765,9}). There are also GCTS teleports in Thais (Ancient Temple), Darashia (mountain to the northwest), Edron (sewers), Liberty Bay (mountains to the southeast) and Svargrond (hole next to the west exit).
Go down to the Gnomebase (Gnomegate) and enter the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} to the Crystal Grounds ({coord:32795,31761,10}), to the north, about 20 sqm south of {npc:Gnomally}.
If you are in {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha}, first go back to the Gnomegate through the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia}.
Go back to the teleport you came in by: it takes you back to the Gnomegate.

Go up to the GCTS (the room above the Gnomebase, where {npc:Gnomette} is) and enter the teleport for the city you want to go to: Thais, Darashia, Edron, Kazordoon, Liberty Bay or Svargrond. You use up one {item:Teleport Crystal}.
GCTS teleport in Kazordoon (next to the northern blessing NPC)
Area for level 80+: {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}, {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}.
Hidden cave of the voodoo cultists on the island of {wiki:Vandura}, **northeast of Liberty Bay**; the entrance is a hole in the yard of a shed, guarded by a {creature:Jungle Maw}.
Cult Cave entrance (hole in the shed yard)
Go to **Liberty Bay** (for example from Venore, with {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Jack Fate}'s harbour.
Leave the city to the **northeast**, across the island of Vandura, to the sheds northeast of Liberty Bay.
The entrance is a hidden hole in the yard of one of those sheds ({coord:32359,32721,7}), with a {creature:Jungle Maw} planted next to it. Go down the hole: you arrive on floor -1 of the cave.

On floor -1, climb the ladder (*Up the Ladder*) to the ground floor of the cave, where the round room of the {creature:Black Sheep} is (D on the map); the cave also has a floor +1 and deeper floors (-2 to -4).
Go back the same way to the entrance hole, on floor -1.
Use the {item:Rope} on the hole to climb up to the shed yard ({coord:32359,32721,7}) and walk back **southwest** to Liberty Bay.
In Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32556,6}) takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Black Sheep room (ground floor of the cave)
Floor -1: where you appear after going down the shed hole
Ground floor of the cave (A = way up the ladder; D = Black Sheep room)
Map of Vandura (Liberty Bay and surroundings)

The {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} drain mana: low-level mages may run out of mana to heal. There are also many {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult}, {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Dark Monk|Dark Monks} and {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}.
Watch out for the {creature:Jungle Maw} next to the entrance.

Huge underground city built by the {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, hidden behind the mountains **north of Edron**, with several underground floors where dragons, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} also live.
Travel to **Edron**: tell your town's harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}, 160 gp).
Leave the city through a mountain pass to the **west** and continue **north**, behind the mountains.
The entrance ({coord:33250,31698,7}) is marked by large obelisk-shaped stones arranged in a circle. Enter and go down to the floors below.
Climb back up through the floors of Cyclopolis the same way to the entrance, **north of Edron**.

If you are coming from the {wiki:Behemoth Quest} (floor 8), leave the final room through the level 80 door, go back to the stairs of the small platform and use {spell:Levitate} (*exani hur up*) on the **south** edge to get back to the platform; from there climb the 5 floors to the exit.
Walk back **south** to Edron and take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat ({coord:33176,31764,6}): {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.

The upper floors have {creature:Cyclops}, {creature:Cyclops Drone|Cyclops Drones}, {creature:Cyclops Smith|Cyclops Smiths} and {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}; further down {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and, in a room south of floor 5, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} appear.
The wiki recommends level 40+ for knights, 34+ for paladins and 45+ for mages.

The desert and jungle continent where **Darashia**, **Ankrahmun** and **Port Hope** are, with the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert, the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains and the Tiquanda jungle; the name comes from the spiritual leader Daraman.
**Premium** account needed to travel by boat to the Darama cities.
Take a boat to one of the three cities of the continent: tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia} (or {key:ankrahmun} / {key:port hope}), {key:yes}.

**Darashia** (north): you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s boat ({coord:33289,32481,6}). **Ankrahmun** (east): you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}). **Port Hope** (west, in the jungle): you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s dock ({coord:32529,32785,6}).

Between Darashia and Ankrahmun there is a common route on foot through the Kha'labal desert and the northern Kha'zeel pass (see the route maps).
