Between Ankrahmun and Port Hope there is a secret passage: it is at the second stairs **west** of Ankrahmun, following the road very far **east** of Port Hope.

Go back to one of the cities and take the boat: {npc:Petros} in Darashia ({key:venore} 60 gp, {key:ankrahmun} 100 gp, {key:port hope} 180 gp, {key:liberty bay} 200 gp, {key:yalahar} 210 gp, {key:issavi} 130 gp, {key:krailos} 110 gp).
{npc:Captain Sinbeard} in Ankrahmun: {key:darashia} 100 gp, {key:venore} 150 gp, {key:edron} 160 gp, {key:port hope} 80 gp, {key:liberty bay} 90 gp, {key:yalahar} 230 gp.
{npc:Charles} in Port Hope: {key:thais} 160 gp, {key:venore} 160 gp, {key:edron} 150 gp, {key:ankrahmun} 110 gp, {key:darashia} 180 gp, {key:liberty bay} 50 gp.

Crossing the desert between Darashia and Ankrahmun you meet {creature:Sandcrawler|Sandcrawlers}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}; during raids also {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}, {creature:Larva|Larvas} and {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs}.

Cave of {creature:Terramite|Terramites} under the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains} that connects the Kha'labal desert (Ankrahmun side) to the Tiquanda jungle (Port Hope side); it also serves as a shortcut for crossing the mountain.
Entrance on the Kha'labal desert side

**From the Ankrahmun side:** travel to Ankrahmun (by boat, {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to your town's captain; you arrive at {npc:Captain Sinbeard}) and cross the Kha'labal desert **northwest** to the cave entrance ({coord:33104,32697,7}).
**From the Port Hope side:** travel to Port Hope ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Charles}) and cross the Tiquanda jungle **east** to the entrance ({coord:32976,32686,7}).

The cave has two Terramite chambers separated by a small empty area inside the mountain, where you can rest. With a {item:Pick} you can reach at least one deeper cave (use it at {coord:33027,32708,8}).
Leave by either of the two entrances: the desert one ({coord:33104,32697,7}) takes you to the Ankrahmun side, the jungle one ({coord:32976,32686,7}) to the Port Hope side.

Walk back to the city and take the boat: {npc:Captain Sinbeard} in Ankrahmun ({coord:33094,32884,6}) or {npc:Charles} in Port Hope ({coord:32529,32785,6}), with {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
If you only want to cross the mountain, you can also go over the top, via the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}.
Entrance on the Tiquanda jungle side
Pick spot for the deeper cave
Bring food (for example meat from the jungle elephants): the {item:Terramite Eggs} are worth money and you should not eat them. The wiki recommends level 30+.
Arabian-inspired city in the **north of Darama island**, surrounded by the Devourer desert, with Drefia to the west, the Dark Pyramid to the northeast and the Plague Spike to the south; Premium only.
Only characters with a **Premium Account** can travel to Darashia.

**By boat:** in Venore, Ankrahmun, Port Hope or Liberty Bay, tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} (for example, from Venore with {npc:Captain Fearless}, 60 gp). You arrive at the Darashia harbour, next to {npc:Petros} ({coord:33289,32481,6}).
From Edron, first take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and from there {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat to Darashia.

**By flying carpet** ({wiki:Magic Carpet}): from Edron, Kazordoon, Svargrond, Femor Hills, Farmine or Issavi, tell the carpet NPC {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Darashia carpet, next to {npc:Chemar} ({coord:33270,32439,6}).
From {wiki:Gray Island}, {npc:Scrutinon} takes you for free ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}).

**Boat:** talk to {npc:Petros} at the harbour ({coord:33289,32481,6}): {key:hi}, the name of the town (for example {key:venore} or {key:ankrahmun}; Ankrahmun costs 100 gp) and {key:yes}. He also takes you to **Krailos** ({key:krailos}, 110 gp).
**Flying carpet:** talk to {npc:Chemar} ({coord:33270,32439,6}): {key:hi}, the destination (for example {key:edron} or {key:kazordoon}) and {key:yes}.

Dragon lair in the desert **north of Darashia**, with {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Hatchlings} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, and the boss {creature:Demodras} on the deepest level.
The entrance has a {wiki:Gate of Expertise} that only lets players of **level 40** or higher through.
Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by {wiki:Magic Carpet} (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}'s carpet).
Leave Darashia to the **north**, across the desert, to the lair entrance ({coord:33264,32277,7}).
Pass the level 40 door and go down the stairs to the first hunting level (Dragons and Hatchlings). The second level has Dragon Lords and Dragons; the third, Dragon Lords and Demodras.
The lair has no exit teleport: go back the same way, climbing the stairs level by level to the entrance, north of Darashia.
In Darashia, take {npc:Petros}'s boat ({coord:33289,32481,6}) or {npc:Chemar}'s flying carpet ({coord:33270,32439,6}): {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
With full spawns, the number of dragons can surprise those who are not used to it: enter carefully.
On the way up, the Dragons and Dragon Lords you left behind may have respawned — do not go up without full health and mana.

Cursed ruins of a cathedral that was never finished, **west of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}** and south of the Outlaw Camp and the Venore swamp, with three underground floors full of bandits, smugglers and undead.

**From Venore:** leave the city to the **southwest**. **From Thais:** leave by the **east** gate. Either way you have to cross the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} to the ruins ({coord:32664,32344,7}), south of the Outlaw Camp.
The first two underground floors are reached by **stairs**.

The deepest floor (underground -3, where {npc:Angelina} is) can only be reached by the **teleport**: from the stairs on the 2nd floor head **south** to a big room; the teleport is at the end of it ({coord:32615,32473,9}).

Before entering the teleport you have to pull the **6 levers** spread across the 5 rooms around the big room. There is a time limit (between 30 seconds and 2.5 minutes, unconfirmed): do this in a group or clear the monsters first and only then pull the levers.
On the deepest floor, enter the teleport next to {npc:Angelina} ({coord:32635,32402,10}): it takes you out of the deepest floor.
Climb the stairs you came down by up to the surface.
Walk back across the plains: **northeast** to Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat: {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}) or **west** to Thais.
Lever room and teleport (2nd underground floor)
Angelina, next to the exit teleport
In the middle of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} there may be {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} lured by other players — cross carefully.

The 1st floor has {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Assassin|Assassins} and a {creature:Dark Monk}; further down there are {creature:Vampire|Vampires}.

Small closed-off area in {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}, **north of the depot**, with two groups of 3 {creature:Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender}; it only opens from time to time, through a world change.
Dark Grounds (north of the Upper Roshamuul depot)
Only accessible during an unannounced world change, which opens when the server completes the task *Soothing Bad Dreams* of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest} 20 times; it is rarely open.
Upper Roshamuul can only be reached after the server reaches **stage 3** of the Roshamuul Quest (wall open). Premium account.
In **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}) {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). The boat docks at the Inquisition camp, in **Lower Roshamuul**.
From the camp go up the ramp to Lower Roshamuul and cross the bridge **north** to {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}.

Cross Guzzlemaw Valley **northeast** and go through the opened wall into Upper Roshamuul ({coord:33632,32401,7}). The depot is northwest of the wall; if you are a Roshamuul citizen, you can appear directly in the Upper Roshamuul temple, west of the depot.
The Dark Grounds are **north** of the depot ({coord:33556,32329,7}).
Go back to the depot and cross Guzzlemaw Valley **south** to the bridge; go down the Lower Roshamuul ramp to the Inquisition camp, in the southwest of the island.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
Area for level 200–250+. All Roshamuul creatures are very strong, including those on the way through Lower Roshamuul and Guzzlemaw Valley.

Guildhall just **northeast of Thais**, next to the road leaving the north gate (Thaian-Venorean Road); the deepest cellar has a door to the Ancient Temple caves, with access to the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair}, a rotworm cave and a cyclops cave.
It is a guildhall (rented house): normally only the residents and the house's guests can enter.
Get to **Thais** (by boat: tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Leave through the **north** gate of the city and follow the road **northeast**: the Dark Mansion is right next to the road ({coord:32397,32155,7}).
Inside, the stairs go down to the cellar (floor -1) and to floor -2, where a door leads to the {wiki:Ancient Temple} caves.
Leave through the ground-floor door onto the road and walk back **southwest** to the north gate of Thais.
Via the cellar: the door on floor -2 leads to the Ancient Temple caves, connected to the Thais Dragon Lair and the rotworm and cyclops caves.
Cave entrance north of Alatar Lake
Dark Mansion — floor -2 (door to the caves)
The caves under the house lead to the {wiki:Thais Dragon Lair}: watch out for the {creature:Dragon|Dragons}.

The minotaur pyramid (also called *Minotaur Pyramid*) in the desert **northeast of Darashia**, with several floors above and below ground; this is where the {wiki:Stealth Ring Quest} and parts of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}, the {wiki:Koshei the Deathless Quest} and the {wiki:Cults of Tibia Quest} take place.

Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour, {coord:33289,32481,6}) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}, {coord:33270,32439,6}).
Leave the city and head **northeast** through the desert to the pyramid ({coord:33307,32286,7}). At ground level there are only {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.

For the lower floors: go down the stairs; head **southwest** and go down another staircase; go **east/northeast** and go down; on the next floor go **north** and go down again. On the last floor, the **southwest** room has a hole ({coord:33293,32291,11}) that leads to {npc:Angelo} and the Exanima Cave.
Go back the same way: climb the stairs you came down by (**south**, then **west/southwest** and finally **northeast**) up to the ground floor of the pyramid. You do not need any item.
Return to **Darashia** to the **southwest** and take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Hole at the bottom of the pyramid (to Angelo)

The deeper you go, the stronger the minotaurs: {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} and rooms full of {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}; at the bottom there is a {creature:Mummy}.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia
Former beginner island **southwest of the {wiki:Ghostlands}**, where new characters tried out the vocations before going to the mainland; the wiki says it has since been **removed from the game**.
Arrival at Dawnport (cave under the Adventurer's Outpost)
New characters only: there was no way to get there from the mainland.
You could leave from level 8 and were forced to leave at level 20.
There is no boat or path to Dawnport: the new character appeared there automatically when entering for the first time (after the {wiki:Tutorial}, if you had enabled it).
At the end of the tutorial, the {item:Crystal Teleporter} took you to a small cave right under the {wiki:Adventurer's Outpost} ({coord:32069,31901,6}).
From level 8, go to the Dawnport temple and talk to {npc:Oressa} ({key:hi}): she lets you choose your final vocation and leave for the mainland.
Leave the Adventurer's Outpost through the door of your vocation: at that point you get the basic spells of the chosen vocation and lose the ones you tried with {npc:Garamond} and {npc:Ser Tybald}.
At level 20 you are automatically teleported to the temple, below the starting area, after 5 minutes, and can no longer return to the shops: take care of your buying and selling before you reach 20.
To go to {wiki:Rookgaard} (only characters that are not the first on the account, up to level 9), talk to {npc:Inigo} at the Adventurer's Outpost.
You could only take 2000 gp to the mainland (1500 in the bank and 500 in the backpack); the rest had to be thrown away or donated. Dawnport-exclusive items do not carry over to Rookgaard.
Until level 8 you did not lose items when dying; from level 8 the normal death penalty applied.
The deep dungeons under the monkey city of {wiki:Banuta}, in Tiquanda (northeast of Port Hope), full of {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns} and {creature:Medusa|Medusas}.
Magic Forcefield to Deeper Banuta (Banuta floor -2)
Access is gained in {wiki:The Ape City Quest}.
The four deepest floors only open with the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}.
The secret tunnel from Tiquanda only opens with an {item:Egg of the Many}.

Take a boat to **Port Hope** ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and cross the Tiquanda jungle **northeast** to {wiki:Banuta} ({coord:32807,32542,7}). With the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek} takes you there directly for 30 gp.
In {npc:Hairycles}'s temple (southeast of the city, {coord:32827,32575,7}) go down **twice**.
Go **north** along the corridor to the hall full of monkeys, turn **west** and go down the stairs at the far end ({coord:32802,32546,8}).
On floor -2, enter the {wiki:Magic Forcefield} ({coord:32839,32533,9}): you appear on the first floor of Deeper Banuta.

Go back the same way to the first floor of Deeper Banuta and leave through the portal at the start of the floor. If the wall has come back and you are on the inside, use the lever next to the wall to open it.
The portal takes you to the **second floor of Banuta** (with monkeys), not to the floor you came from. Go up the stairs to the surface, next to {npc:Hairycles}'s temple ({coord:32826,32576,7}).
Cross the jungle **southwest** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}) takes you by boat to other cities.
Secret tunnel from Tiquanda (needs an Egg of the Many)
High-level area (knights 120+, paladins 90+, mages 95+): {creature:Hydra|Hydras}, {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}, {creature:Medusa|Medusas} and {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}.
In Banuta itself there are many monkeys and other creatures on the way to the Magic Forcefield.

Catacombs with the coffins of the old families of Darashia, entered in the **southeast of the city**, next to the flying carpet and the boat; the lower floors are opened with a torch puzzle and lead to {creature:Koshei the Deathless}.
Go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).
The catacombs entrance is in the **southeast** of the city, next to the flying carpet and the boat ({coord:33281,32445,7}).
To go down to the lower floors: light the **2 torches (statues) to the north and east** and leave all the others **unlit**; then use the {item:Ancient Sundial} next to the stairs.
You hear a *CLICK* in the room to the **southwest**: a secret staircase has opened inside a coffin. Go down it (the staircase disappears and the lights come back on).
Go back the same way to the catacombs entrance, in the southeast of Darashia, using the {item:Rope} where you need it.
Warning: the secret staircase in the coffin disappears after you go down and the trapdoor in Koshei's area only works downwards; the wiki does not describe the way out from Koshei's area.
Light the north and east torches and use the Ancient Sundial
Map of the lower floors up to Koshei's room
On the lower floors there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers}.

Main area of {wiki:The Inquisition Quest}, at the bottom of the {wiki:Edron Hero Cave}, behind the level 100 door of the {wiki:Temple of Xayepocax}: full of demons and the minions of {wiki:The Ruthless Seven}.
**Premium** account and **level 100** (level 100 door); on the way there is a **level 70** {item:Gate of Expertise}.

In {wiki:The Inquisition Quest} you can only enter mission 7 if you have absorbed the spirit of at least one of {wiki:The Ruthless Seven} in {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest} and reported Ungreez's mission.
Go to **Edron** by boat (for example, in Thais tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
Leave the city to the **north** to the Hero Cave entrance ({coord:33164,31638,7}) and go down to the {wiki:Temple of Xayepocax}, a room with many different creatures.
Pass the **level 70** {item:Gate of Expertise} in the **south** of the room and enter the teleport that is behind the **level 100** door.

On the other side you are immediately attacked by {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}. Kill them and go **south** to the **Retreat**, the hub with teleports to each section.
In any section, the teleport at the start takes you back to the **Retreat** without losing progress; after the mission, the Shadow Nexus teleport also takes you to the Retreat.
From the Retreat, go back the way you came in to the Temple of Xayepocax and climb up through the Hero Cave to the surface, north of Edron.
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) takes you to Thais ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or to other cities.

Area for high-level teams (100+ minimum, 150+ recommended): right at the entrance there are 6 {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters} (3800 HP) and inside are the most dangerous demons in Tibia.
When you enter a boss room you may be right next to the exit teleport: do not move until you work out where you are.
Deep area of the {wiki:Hero Cave} of **Edron**, past the level 100 door, with 5 spawns of {creature:Demon|Demons} (plus 4 in the {wiki:Demon Helmet Quest} room).
**Level 100** to pass the level door (Gate of Expertise).
{item:Key 6010} (golden key), from the {wiki:Parchment Room Quest}, for the door right after.
**Two players** on the switches to open the wall (Gate of the Lost Souls).
Take a boat to **Edron** (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
From the harbour go **north** to the {wiki:Hero Cave} entrance ({coord:33164,31638,7}) and go down to the level 100 Gate of Expertise, near the spawn of a single Demon.
Pass the level door and open the next door with {item:Key 6010}.
Put two players on the switches ({coord:33191,31629,13}) to open the wall ({coord:33211,31630,13}) and go through.

After the wall go **north** and **east**, go down the stairs to the pit with about 15 {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, go up the stairs, pass the rope holes/ramps (with the {item:Rope}) and enter the teleport: you go down to the lone Demon's room.

In that room use the hole to the **east**: below there is another hole and you fall **2 floors** at once, into the main part of the Demon Hell. Far to the **east** is the teleport to the {wiki:Demon Helmet Quest} room.
In the main part, the stairs up are a little **west** of where you landed. Climb them and the next ones: you return to the lone Demon's room (you cannot go back down by those stairs).
In that room enter the teleport, which takes you back to the first teleport.

Retrace your path in reverse: ramps and rope holes (with the {item:Rope}), the Fire Elemental pit, the wall (if it is closed, two players have to go back to the switches) and the level 100 door; then climb the Hero Cave to the entrance.
Outside, go **south** to Edron and talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the harbour ({key:hi}, town name, {key:yes}).
The level 100 door (with the locked door at the end)
The two switches that open the wall
The wall that opens with the two switches
The hole east of the lone Demon's room does **not** take you to the pit with the 5 Demons that you can see (you only get there with {spell:Levitate}); you fall 2 floors at once.

In the Hero Cave, on the way, there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} and others; down there, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Banshee|Banshees}.

Underground city of the {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}, hidden **far below the {wiki:Fields of Glory}** (north of Carlin), under the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls}; this is where the Purple Tome, the Crystal Wand and the Demona Ring Quest are.
At the end of the Maze of Lost Souls you have to pass the **level 60** **Gate of Expertise**.
Go to **Carlin** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to your town's harbour captain; you arrive at {npc:Captain Greyhound}).
Leave the city to the **north**, through the {wiki:Fields of Glory} ({coord:32362,31683,7}), and head **northeast** to the cave a little **south** of {wiki:Northport} ({coord:32488,31610,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on this spot to open a hole and enter ({coord:32512,31624,7}).

Follow the **blue line** on the first map to the next hole and continue to a small grove inside the cave. Behind the trees (**red** dot) there is a hole: go down and flip the lever to the **right** to open the MoLS entrance. Leave the hole.
Follow the third map to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls, crossing some {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}.
Inside the MoLS follow the map step by step (the {wiki:Griffin Shield Quest} is in the first room) to the end of the passage and cross the **Gate of Expertise** (level 60).
Go **north** and always follow the **right-hand** passage to the stairs; go up: you are in Demona ({coord:32479,31663,14}).

Go back to the pentagram room and go down to the MoLS. Follow the exit map (it is the shortest and safest route) and then leave the cave by the **same way** you came in, using the {item:Rope} on the holes, up to the surface south of Northport. Return **southwest**, through the Fields of Glory, to Carlin.

Alternative: **northwest** of the Star Room go down the stairs ({coord:32451,31655,14}), walk **north** and then **west** to the end of the tunnel and head **south**. At the end of the corridor there is a teleport ({coord:32400,31657,15}) that takes you to the {wiki:Fields of Glory}; from there walk **south** to Carlin.
Stairs northwest of the Star Room
Exit teleport to the Fields of Glory
Route 1: follow the blue line to the next hole
Route 2: the grove and the lever hole (red dot)
Route 3: to the entrance of the Maze of Lost Souls
Route 4: inside the Maze of Lost Souls
Exit route from the Maze of Lost Souls
The {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} hit very hard with magic and turn invisible; level 70–100+ recommended and lots of potions and area runes.
In the Maze of Lost Souls there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}: do not stray from the paths on the maps.
Desecrated underground glade beneath the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} (between Thais and Venore), reached by entering the {wiki:Stony Pond}; part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}.

**On foot:** the {wiki:Outlaw Camp} is **east of Thais** and **west of Venore**. Leave Thais through the east gate (or Venore through the west gate) and follow the road to the camp ({coord:32643,32222,7}).

**Via the Earth Portal** (Forgotten Knowledge Quest): in the Halls of Hope, north of Thais, talk to {npc:Albinius}, say {key:earth portal} and hand him 50 {item:Acorn|Acorns}; the portal drops you at the Outlaw Camp ({coord:32635,32257,7}).
Look for the {wiki:Stony Pond}, next to the {npc:Weakened Forest Fury}, a little **southwest** of where the portal leaves you ({coord:32615,32266,7}).
**Walk** into the Stony Pond: you appear in the Desecrated Glade ({coord:32720,32243,8}).
Go back the **same way** to the point where you arrived in the Desecrated Glade and climb up to the {wiki:Stony Pond}, next to the {npc:Weakened Forest Fury}.
From the Outlaw Camp, enter the {wiki:Earth Portal} ({coord:32635,32257,7}) to return to the Halls of Hope, or follow the road on foot **west** to Thais (or **east** to Venore).
Earth Portal (arrival and return to the Halls of Hope)
Albinius (Halls of Hope, north of Thais)
Inside there are {creature:Cave Parrot|Cave Parrots}, {creature:Orclops Ravager|Orclops Ravagers} and {creature:Orclops Doomhauler|Orclops Doomhaulers}. The wiki recommends level 100+.
Cave maze under the **Jakundaf Desert**, **west of Venore** and **south of Kazordoon** (between Venore and Thais), where {wiki:The Desert Dungeon Quest} and the {wiki:Panpipe Quest} take place.
Before you go in, learn the way to the exit teleport next to the {item:Gate of Expertise} of the Desert Dungeon Quest: it is the only safe way out.
Walk to the **Jakundaf Desert**: from Venore head **west** (the desert is between Venore and Thais, south of Kazordoon).
The entrance is a {item:Loose Stone Pile} in the middle of the desert, near {npc:Adrenius}'s temple ({coord:32648,32094,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on the stone pile and go down. Inside, go down **5 staircases** in a row to the bottom (the {creature:Spider|Spiders} floor).
You cannot leave through the hole you came in by. Go back to the spider floor (the bottom, after the 5 descents).
From there go **north**, turn **east** as soon as you can and follow the cave **south** to the staircase; go up.
Go **west** to another staircase and go up (do **not** go down the hole to the south with the warning sign). Go **south** and go up the next staircase.
Go **east** and **north** (there is a hole: do **not** go down), then **east** and **north** again to the last staircase; go up. You reach the {item:Gate of Expertise}.

Next to the Gate of Expertise is the **exit teleport**: enter it and you appear next to {npc:Adrenius}, in the Jakundaf Desert temple. Go out to the surface and walk back to Venore (**east**). Completing the Desert Dungeon Quest is the other way out.
Hollow stone with Key 4055 (next to the entrance)
Unreachable room with lever and teleport (Banshee)
It is a maze where even experienced players get lost, and there are holes with no rope spot on the other side: do not go down holes you do not know.
There are rooms with creatures that are dangerous for poorly prepared players ({creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}); level 25–35+ recommended.
Dungeons under the **Gingerbread Castle**, in {wiki:Candia}, the kingdom of sweets reached from {wiki:Feyrist}; full of hostile sweet creatures and nightmares from Roshamuul.

Access to {wiki:Feyrist}: the fae seal that {npc:Alkestios} gives you in Ab'Dendriel in the {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest}, and a small gem ({item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire}) for each entry.
The {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)}, made in the same quest, to get past the giant donut into Candia.
In any city, go to the corridor with the four elemental arches (ice, earth, fire and energy), enter the arch of your gem's element and **use** the gem on the shrine: you are taken to Feyrist.
In Feyrist, go to the **east** part of the island, to the giant donut ({coord:33574,32222,7}), and pass under it with the Gingerbread Key: you arrive in Candia.
In Candia, go down to the Dessert Dungeons, under the Gingerbread Castle. The wiki does not give the exact spot of the descent.
In the {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest}, the {wiki:A Taffy Bunny|Taffy Bunny} wanders on the first floor, to the **southwest** ({coord:33414,32189,8}).
Climb up from the Dessert Dungeons the same way you came down to Candia.
Return to Feyrist through the donut.
In Feyrist, **use** any of the four shrines (you do not need a gem to leave) and you are teleported back to the mainland.
Giant donut in Feyrist (entrance to Candia)
Top of the Gingerbread Castle (Candy Lipstick)
Strong creatures: {creature:Angry Sugar Fairy|Angry Sugar Fairies}, {creature:Candy Floss Elemental|Candy Floss Elementals} and {creature:Goggle Cake|Goggle Cakes}.
The **Devourer** is the desert around **Darashia**, on the surface, with nomads, hyaenas, lions, lots of poisonous creatures and the wasp towers that produce Darashia honey.
Go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).

Leave the city on foot: the desert starts right around Darashia. The north coast (where the {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change} teleport appears) is **north** of the city ({coord:33216,32273,7}).
Everything is on the surface: walk back to Darashia.

At the port, {npc:Petros} takes you to Venore (60 gp), Ankrahmun (100), Liberty Bay (200), Port Hope (180), Yalahar (210), Gray Island (150), Issavi (130) or Krailos (110): {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}. {npc:Chemar} has the flying carpet.
Confined Giant Spider (west of the desert)

Most desert creatures are poisonous ({creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wasp|Wasps}); bring a way to cure poison. There are also {creature:Nomad|Nomads}, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas} and {creature:Lion|Lions}.
In the west there is a closed-off {creature:Giant Spider} and, further northeast, the Dark Pyramid with {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.
Uninhabited island off the **northeast coast of Ab'Dendriel**, considered a dragon graveyard, with a pyramid full of undead and underground lairs of {creature:Dragon|Dragons}.
To enter the {wiki:Hellgate} you need {item:Key 3012} (the guard {npc:Elathriel}, next to the door, sells it for 5000 gp).
There is no boat: the only access is a tunnel under the sea that passes through the {wiki:Hellgate} and comes up through the {wiki:Redbone Castle}.
In **Ab'Dendriel** go down to the {wiki:Shadow Caves}, underground **northwest** of the depot ({coord:32655,31670,8}).
Go down 2 more floors and head **south** and **east** to the Hellgate door ({coord:32676,31671,10}); open it with {item:Key 3012}.

Enter the **north** teleport and follow the route to the {wiki:Redbone Castle} ({coord:32666,31672,15}). From there on the way is **one-way** and takes you up to the surface of Draconia. The full route, with maps, is in the {wiki:Draconia Quest}.

**With a Dragonfetish (faster):** take a {item:White Mushroom} to {npc:An Old Dragonlord}, at the top of the mountain in the north of the island ({coord:32796,31557,2}), and greet him ({key:hi}): he trades it for a {item:Dragonfetish}.
Sacrifice the {item:Dragonfetish} in the exit teleport room, in the dragon lair under the **southeast** of the island: you are teleported to **Ab'Dendriel**.

**On foot:** go down to the Redbone Castle and leave by the normal Hellgate route ({wiki:Route:Hellgate}), with {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}) to climb 2 floors. You come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel ({coord:32603,31705,7}).
You can also leave by finishing the {wiki:Draconia Quest} (the portal on the 7th floor of the pyramid only opens with the quest keys).
An Old Dragonlord (trades the White Mushroom)
The way from the Redbone Castle to Draconia is **one-way**: do not count on coming back through it without knowing the Hellgate route.
{npc:An Old Dragonlord} only gives you **one** Dragonfetish; if you talk to him again he tells you to leave the island.

Since 2010, {creature:Dragon|Dragons} can no longer be pulled up to the surface with a rope. On the Hellgate route there are {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and sometimes {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords} brought by other players.

Large mountain range of {wiki:Zao} that separates the {wiki:Zao Steppe} (to the south) from the {wiki:Muggy Plains} (to the north), with Dragons, Dragon Lords and Frost Dragons on the peaks and the underground fortress of the Draken and the High Class Lizards.
Rope hole to the surface in the Dragonblaze Peaks

The **south** part of the peaks becomes accessible as soon as you start the first mission of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}; the **north** part only in a later mission of that quest (the lizard teleport to the Muggy Plains only works after the first 8 missions).

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.

Cross the steppe **north** to the mountains ({coord:33228,31305,7}). To climb up, go north through the small crevices of the mountain to the only rope hole to the surface ({coord:33175,31306,7}) and climb up with the {item:Rope} **twice**. There are 14–15 staircases through the mountain that lead to the various dragon areas.
For the **north** part, use the teleport to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks ({coord:33198,31350,7}) (available later in the New Frontier Quest).
Go back the **same way**: return to the rope hole you climbed up by ({coord:33175,31306,7}), go down the two floors and head **south** across the steppe.
On the steppe return to the pass at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
In Farmine talk to {npc:Thorgrin} on the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Teleport to the north of the Dragonblaze Peaks
Gravestone in the north of the peaks (next to the coast)

The peaks are full of {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}; underground there are strong {wiki:High Class Lizards}. The wiki recommends level 40–50+.

Dream realm of the {wiki:Nightmare Knights} and the {wiki:Brotherhood of Bones}, reached by *dreamwalking*; it lies under the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, southwest of Venore, and is where {npc:The Dream Master} and {npc:The Bone Master} live.
Hidden hole next to the Knightwatch Tower
The first time you can only get there by completing the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest} (missions 1 to 4).

After joining one of the factions (**Novice** rank in the Nightmare Knights or **Maggot** in the Brotherhood of Bones), you can use the teleport at the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}; each trip uses up 1 {item:Orichalcum Pearl}.

First time: in the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, southwest of Venore, go **east** from the temple to the ruined building ({coord:32837,32253,7}); use the {item:Shovel} on the hole to the **northeast** and go down, and further on make your way through with a {item:Pick}. Follow the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest} to the Dreampaths, which take you to the Dream Realm.

Once you have the rank: go to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, in the south of the Plains of Havoc, and enter through the hole hidden behind a tree, next to the water, a little **north** of the tower ({coord:32816,32322,7}).
Go up to the **2nd floor** of the tower and use the teleport to the Dream Realm (you need to bring an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}).
Enter the teleport near {npc:A Ghostly Guardian}.
With an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} and your faction's rank, the teleports on the **2nd floor** of the Knightwatch Tower take you to **Thais** or **Carlin**.
Without a pearl, walk back through the Plains of Havoc to **Venore**, to the **northeast**.
Hidden hole behind the tree (Knightwatch Tower)
The Plains of Havoc are a dangerous area (many strong monsters on the surface); do not cross on foot if you are a low level.
Former Thais colony swallowed by the sand, now full of necromancers and undead, **west of Darashia**, on the other side of the mountains that separate Ankrahmun, Darashia, Drefia and Tiquanda.

Go to **Darashia** first: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia} and {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour, {coord:33289,32481,6}) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}, {coord:33270,32439,6}).
Leave Darashia to the **west**, towards the mountains that separate Darashia from Drefia. On the mountain there are many {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}: keep mana to cure the poison.
Use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain at this rope spot ({coord:33048,32429,7}) or come through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
On the other side you reach Drefia ({coord:33018,32443,7}). The entrance to the main dungeon is here: {coord:32996,32413,7}.

There is no exit shortcut: if you are underground, climb back up the same floors (use the {item:Rope} where you went down through holes) to the surface, for example via the main dungeon entrance ({coord:32996,32413,7}).
Cross the mountain back to **Darashia** the same way you came: via the rope spot ({coord:33048,32429,7}) or the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
In Darashia take {npc:Petros}'s boat ({key:hi}, town name, {key:yes}) or {npc:Chemar}'s flying carpet.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia
Drefia is split into two halves: the **south** half is the easier one. Underground there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, vampires and necromancers.
Beyond the {wiki:Medusa Shield Quest} there is a big spawn of {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms} ({wiki:Drefia Wyrm Lair}), for high levels only.
Lair of {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms} at the bottom of the {wiki:Drefia} dungeon, **west of Darashia**, beyond the {wiki:Medusa Shield Quest} room and the level 60 gate.
Level **60** to pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} that gives access to the lair.
Go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).

{wiki:Drefia} is **west** of Darashia ({coord:33018,32443,7}), on the other side of the mountains. For example, use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain at {coord:33048,32429,7}, or come through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
Enter the main Drefia dungeon ({coord:32996,32413,7}); it is a good idea to cast {spell:Invisible} first. Follow the green lines on the map to the **3rd floor**.
On the 3rd floor walk **north** about 18 steps: on your **left** there is a hole; open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down.

Go **east** and pass the level 60 {item:Gate of Expertise}. Cross the altar room (Star Room) with {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers} and {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}: beyond it is the Wyrm Lair ({coord:33070,32396,13}).
There is no exit shortcut: go back the same way. Pass the {item:Gate of Expertise} again, return to the hole you opened with the {item:Shovel} and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the 3rd floor.
Climb the floors of the main dungeon up to the entrance ({coord:32996,32413,7}) and cross the mountain back to **Darashia**.
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia
Green lines to the 3rd floor of the main dungeon
On the mountain there are many {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}: keep mana for {spell:Cure Poison} (or bring {item:Antidote|Antidotes}).
After the gate there is an army of undead that respawns: keep {spell:Invisible} active on the way back too.
In the lair there are about 20 Wyrms, almost always in pairs, and a {creature:Grim Reaper} in a tomb next to the east wall. The wiki recommends level 80–90+.

Caves at the **southern tip of the Kazordoon city mine**, near the Steamship, with {creature:Drillworm|Drillworms}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}, {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
Drillworm Caves entrance (south of the Kazordoon mine)

Go to **Kazordoon**. The easiest way is by Steamship: in {wiki:Cormaya} (with {npc:Gurbasch}) or in **Farmine** (with {npc:Thorgrin}) say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}). You can also walk in through the mountain entrance.
Inside Kazordoon, go to the **south** part of the city mine, near the Steamship: the cave entrance is at {coord:32657,32010,13}.
Go back the same way to the Kazordoon city mine.
To leave Kazordoon, take the Steamship with {npc:Brodrosch} or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
The floor below has two caves: the one to the **west** is the easiest (only 2 Wyverns near the entrance); the one to the **east** has 3 {creature:Drillworm|Drillworms} right at the entrance.
Dungeon of enchanted gardens on the island of {wiki:Cormaya}, **southwest of the boat**, entered by using a stone pond; it is full of leaf golems, forest furies and treelings.
Go to **Edron** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}).
Tell {npc:Captain Seahorse} {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp). You land at the **north** harbour of Cormaya, next to {npc:Pemaret} ({coord:33287,31956,6}).
Go **southwest** of the boat to the {item:Stony Pond}, next to a warning sign ({coord:33264,32014,7}), and **use** the pond to enter the Dryad Gardens.
Go back the same way to the entrance (the wiki does not describe another exit).
Once in Cormaya, go to the north harbour and talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp) to return to Edron.
Top of the central hill (Earth Elemental)
On the hills there are {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings}, {creature:Elder Forest Fury|Elder Forest Furies} and {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals}: level 40-50+ recommended.
Controlled PvP arenas that existed in **Ankrahmun, Edron, Kazordoon, Rathleton and Thais**, next to each city's depot; they were deactivated in March 2022 and officially removed in February 2023.
The Duelling Arenas are **no longer in operation** (deactivated on 29 March 2022 and permanently removed on 14 February 2023). When they existed, they required **Premium** from all participants.
Each arena was near the depot of its city, with a supervisor NPC who organised the fights:
**Edron**: **northeast** of the depot, next to the north gate ({npc:Shadowpunch}).
**Rathleton**: **north** of the temple and **west** of the depot ({npc:Roughington}).
The hall and the stands were part of the city: leave the same way to the depot.
While waiting you could withdraw by leaving the waiting room; once in the fight you could only leave by death, victory or when time ran out.
For the {wiki:Measuring Tibia Quest}, the arena halls and stands count as part of the city's subarea.
Troll cave (on the map: *Kazordoon Troll Den*) between Kazordoon and Venore, **east of the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}**, with the entrance hidden behind a tree; this is where the {wiki:Longsword Quest} is.
Walk to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, which is **northeast of Thais** and **northwest of Venore**.
Cross the bridge and head **east** to the cave entrance ({coord:32662,31966,7}).
The entrance is a hole **hidden behind a tree**: open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
Inside, the stairs to the floor below are to the **south**; the {item:Troll Green} is in a little room with {creature:Bug|Bugs} and {creature:Bat|Bats}, **west** of the entrance.
Go back the same way: if you are on the floor below, return **south** to the stairs and go up; then head **north** to the entrance hole.
Climb up through the hole with the {item:Rope}.
Outside, cross the Dwarf Bridge to return to Thais (**southwest**) or head **southeast** to Venore.

A good cave for low levels ({creature:Troll|Trolls}, {creature:Troll Champion|Troll Champions}), but on the floor below there is a {creature:Minotaur Archer} and a {creature:Minotaur Mage} that can be lured up to the surface.
The dwarves' prison island, in the depths **under Kazordoon** (also called Kazordoon Prison), with dwarves, orcs, minotaurs and cyclopes.
Hole in the centre of the prison
The prison door opens with {item:Key 3802} (Kazordoon Prison Key), which is a reward from the {wiki:Emperor's Cookies Quest}.
Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}), by {wiki:Magic Carpet} (Premium) or on foot through the mountain.
Go to the **main gate** of Kazordoon (you can take the wagons to "Main Gate").
Go down the stairs that are well to the **east** of the wagons and keep going down until you reach the door of Dwacatra; open it with {item:Key 3802}.

Inside the prison there are small holes that open with the {item:Shovel} and open holes with creatures: do not go without a shovel or a rope. The hole in the centre ({coord:32597,31930,14}) leads to the room with the sealed door of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}.
Go back the same way: climb up with the {item:Rope} (or {spell:Magic Rope}) through the holes you came down by and up the stairs to the main gate of Kazordoon.
In Kazordoon, take the {wiki:Steamship} from {npc:Brodrosch} (far below the city) to Cormaya or Farmine, or the {wiki:Magic Carpet} at the top of the mountain ({coord:32587,31941,0}).
Basin of The Lightbearer (far north of the prison)

There are {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Cyclops} and {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}. The wiki recommends level 30+ for knights and paladins and 27+ for mages.

Bridge in the centre of the continent, **northeast of Thais**, **southeast of Carlin**, **southwest of Ab'Dendriel** and **northwest of Venore**, guarded by dwarves; it is the usual passage between the southern and northern cities.
The bridge can only be reached on foot. From **Thais**, head **northeast**; from **Venore**, leave by the **southwest** exit and follow the road **northwest** to the bridge.
You can also get there from **Carlin** (to the southeast) or from **Ab'Dendriel** (to the southwest). Kazordoon is close by, **west** of the bridge.
Cross the bridge and walk to the city you want: **southwest** to Thais, **southeast** to Venore, **northwest** to Carlin or **northeast** to Ab'Dendriel.
In those cities you take the boat from the harbour ({npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore, {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin, {npc:Captain Seagull} in Ab'Dendriel).
Storkus, west of the Dwarf Bridge (near Kazordoon)
Troll cave, east of the bridge (hole behind a tree)
Venore Rotworm Cave entrance (on the way to Venore)
Three {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and two {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} live on the bridge: dangerous for very low-level players coming from the south who do not see them.
As a lot of people pass through here, it is a common spot for PKs.
A set of dwarf mines **west of and under Kazordoon**: 6 mines with a surface entrance, west of the mountain, and others that can only be reached from inside the city.

Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} to the carpet NPC; you arrive at the top of the mountain, next to {npc:Gewen}) or by {wiki:Steamship} (from Cormaya with {npc:Gurbasch} or from Farmine with {npc:Thorgrin}; you arrive at the underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}).

Leave the Kazordoon mountain through the city entrance (see {wiki:Route: Kazordoon|the Kazordoon route}) and walk **west**, on the surface. Around the mountain there are **6 mine entrances**, each to a different mine.

The **northernmost** entrance is the yellow mine (A, *Old Ore Mine*, from the {wiki:Iron Ore Quest}). The entrance that leads to {npc:Budrik} and the {wiki:Grothmok Tunnel} is here: {coord:32531,31914,7} (inside, walk **north** and go down the hole).
The **south** entrance ({coord:32550,31989,7}) is the *Pick 'N Shovel Mine* one (green, E), which also leads to the {wiki:Sunken Mines}.

On the 3rd floor down, mines A, B, E and F are connected by the {wiki:Mine Hub}. The mines that can only be reached from inside Kazordoon start from the central area under the city ({coord:32622,31938,13}).
Go back the same way: on each floor return to the hole you came down by and use the {item:Rope} to climb up, to the mine entrance on the surface.

Kazordoon is just **east** of the entrances: enter through the main entrance of the mountain. From there leave by carpet (at the top, with {npc:Gewen}) or by Steamship (at the bottom, with {npc:Brodrosch}).
Dwarf Mines entrance (way to Budrik and the Grothmok Tunnel)
Central area of the mines under Kazordoon
Surface: the 6 mine entrances west of Kazordoon
3rd floor down: mines A, B, E and F connect through the Mine Hub
Exit routes from the Dwarf Mines
There are hidden holes on the paths around Kazordoon: bring a {item:Shovel} and {item:Rope}.

To go deeper in the blue mine (F) you pass a **level 32** {item:Gate of Expertise}; in the green mine (E) the door is **level 35**. On the deeper floors there are {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and access to the {wiki:Caves of the Lost}, with much stronger dwarves.

Multi-floor crypt **far below the {wiki:Ice Islands}**, the third area of the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}; it is reached through the teleport in the {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub, under the Kazordoon crypt.
Premium account and the **Recruitment** mission of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}.
You need the **level 3 crystal shield** from the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest} (40 splinters); the deeper floors require levels 4, 5 and 6.

Go to **Kazordoon**. The simplest way is the {wiki:Steamship}: in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}); in Cormaya go down 8 floors to {npc:Gurbasch} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. There is also a steamship from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}).
Go down to the Kazordoon crypt (floor 9, 2 floors below ground level), where {npc:Gnomystery} ({coord:32610,31878,9}) and {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard} are.

Walk **north** in the crypt to the great rift ({coord:32603,31845,9}) and walk towards it until you fall to the floor below; go through the teleport and you reach {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub ({coord:32661,31825,10}).
In the hub, enter the Dwelling of the Forgotten teleport (the shield must be at level 3 or higher).

Go back through the floors of the Dwelling of the Forgotten to the teleport you came in by: it takes you back to the {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub. The wiki does not describe the exit from the boss room or the way up from the last floor.

From the hub, go back to the Kazordoon crypt and climb up to the city (the wiki does not describe this climb in detail). At the underground port, {npc:Brodrosch} takes you by steamship to Cormaya or Farmine.
Red teleport (Fishing in Lava Pools, 2nd floor)
Teleport to the lever room (last floor)
Area for **level 350+**: {creature:Cave Chimera|Cave Chimeras}, {creature:Varnished Diremaw|Varnished Diremaws} and {creature:Tremendous Tyrant|Tremendous Tyrants}.
The shield loses 1 point every 5 seconds inside the crypts: leave before it reaches zero. The heat also rises — use the machines in the area to lower it.

Dworc camp, a square area surrounded by bamboo fences in the **Tiquanda** jungle, **east of Port Hope** and right **north of the {wiki:Medusa Tower}**; it only exists when the Dworcs dominate the {wiki:Jungle Camp Mini World Change}.
The camp alternates with the Hunter Camp ({wiki:Jungle Camp Mini World Change}): the message of the day says which side controls the sacred grounds.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s harbour ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
Leave Port Hope and cross the Tiquanda jungle **east** to the sacred grounds ({coord:32900,32792,7}), right **north** of the {wiki:Medusa Tower} ({coord:32860,32829,7}).
Go back through the jungle **west** to Port Hope.
At the harbour, {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, town name, {key:yes}).

In the camp there are {creature:Dworc Fleshhunter|Dworc Fleshhunters}, {creature:Dworc Venomsniper|Dworc Venomsnipers} and {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}; sometimes the boss {creature:Oodok Witchmaster} appears.

Dragon lair on a hill **north of Edron**, west of the Hero Cave and Cyclopolis gates, with {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Hatchlings}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and some {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} nearby; this is where the {wiki:Fire Axe Quest} is.
Go to **Edron** (for example from Thais, with {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

Leave the {wiki:Edron Castle} by the **south** and follow the path **east**, towards {wiki:Stonehome}. After crossing the bridge at the exit of Edron, head **north** along the mountain to {wiki:Avar Tar}.
Go up the ramp **west** of Avar Tar to the mountain pass of the {wiki:Edron Wyvern Hill}, follow it always **west** and go down at the end.
Go **north** to a big hill, turn **west** and continue to another hill: this is the Edron Dragon Lair ({coord:33097,31703,7}). Go down the ramp inside the mountain (2 Dragons on the surface).
Go back the same way inside the lair: use the {item:Rope} to climb up through the holes you came down by, then go up the ramps until you leave the mountain.
Return to Edron through the mountain pass (to the **east**), past Avar Tar and over the bridge, the way you came.
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
The entrance to the Edron Dragon Lair
The dragons appear two or three at a time; low-level mages should stay on the surface, where there are only 2 dragons.
The legendary boss {creature:Orshabaal} may appear near the entrance.
The {wiki:Fire Axe Quest} area is beyond a level 60 door, with Dragon Lords.
Cave of {creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} **north of Edron**; good for mages, less suitable for knights and paladins because the elementals resist physical attacks.
Entrance of the Edron Earth Elemental Cave
Get to **Edron** (by boat: tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}).
Leave the city on foot to the **north**, up to the cave entrance ({coord:33158,31719,7}).
The wiki does not describe any other exit: go back the same way to the entrance (use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down by).
Walk back to the **south** to Edron and take the boat at the harbour ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
On the way to the entrance you meet {creature:Bat|Bats}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Poacher|Poachers} and sometimes a {creature:Hunter} or a {creature:Wyvern} brought by other players.
{creature:Earth Elemental|Earth Elementals} are strong against physical damage: knights and paladins should use enchanted weapons or arrows.

**Premium** city on the island of the same name, **east** of the mainland, with {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s harbour, {npc:Pino}'s magic carpet and access to areas such as the {wiki:Hero Cave}, the {wiki:Edron Dragon Lair} and the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave}.
Edron is only available to **Premium** accounts.

By boat: at your city's harbour talk to the captain — for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore or {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin — and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (from Carlin it costs 110 gp).
You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}), on the **north** side of the city.

By magic carpet: at the Kazordoon carpet (on top of the mountain, {npc:Gewen}) say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you land on {npc:Pino}'s carpet, at the top of a tower in Edron ({coord:33192,31783,3}). Go down the stairs to the street.
From {wiki:Cormaya}: at the **north** harbour of the island talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp).

Go to the harbour, in the **north** of the city, and talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, the name of the destination (for example {key:thais}, {key:carlin}, {key:venore} or {key:cormaya}) and {key:yes}. He sails to Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Venore, Port Hope, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay, Cormaya, Gray Island, Oramond, Krailos and Travora.
For Kazordoon (which has no boat), go up to the carpet tower and talk to {npc:Pino}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}.
Entrance of the Hero Cave (north of the city)
Edron Orc Cave (through the Edron Flats sewer)
North of the city's mountains there are strong creatures (Dragons, Dragon Lords, Heroes, Behemoths and Demons): do not wander too far if you are a low level.

Apartment building in the centre of **Edron**, just **south of the castle**; in the basement there is a {item:Sewer Grate} that leads through the sewer to the {wiki:Edron Orc Cave} peninsula and the caves south-west of the city.
Take a boat to **Edron** (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the harbour next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Go to the castle, in the centre of the city: the Edron Flats are just **south** of it (bordering Castle Street to the north-west, the Castle Flats to the north and Central Circle to the east).
To get to the other side (orc peninsula), go down to the building's basement, enter the {item:Sewer Grate} and follow the sewer until you come out on the surface on the other side.
If you came from the orc peninsula: go back to the sewer entrance and, if it is covered, **dig it open with the {item:Shovel}**; follow the sewer to the Edron Flats basement and go up to the street.
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Entrance of the Edron Orc Cave (on the other side of the sewer)
On the other side of the sewer there are already {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Orc|Orcs} on the surface.
Cave of {creature:Goblin|Goblins}, {creature:Bug|Bugs} and {creature:Wasp|Wasps} in the south of the {wiki:Edron Troll-Goblin Peninsula}, west of **Edron**; a good hunting spot for beginners.
Get to **Edron** (by boat: tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
From the Edron depot, go down the sewer in the **south-west** corner of the castle ({coord:33165,31828,7}).
There is only one path: follow the cave until you come out in a grassy area ({coord:33129,31811,7}), already on the troll and goblin peninsula.
Head **south-west** until you find the goblin hill and go down the hole ({coord:33107,31848,7}).
Go back the same way: return to the holes you came down by and use the {item:Rope} on each one to climb up, until you come out on the goblin hill ({coord:33107,31848,7}).
Head **north-east** to the grassy area ({coord:33129,31811,7}) and retrace the cave to the sewer of the **Edron** castle ({coord:33165,31828,7}).
Easy area (level 10+), but the peninsula also has the {wiki:Edron Troll Cave}, further north.

Graveyard on the surface **north of Stonehome**, north-east of the city of Edron, with twenty graves, a crypt with a {item:Stone Coffin} and {item:Grave Flower|Grave Flowers} that grow back every day.
Only **Premium** players have access (island of Edron).
Travel by boat to **Edron** (at your city's captain: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}, 160 gp). You arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s harbour.
Walk **north-east** to **Stonehome** and keep going **north** to the graveyard ({coord:33315,31734,7}). {npc:Cornell}'s boat to Grimvale ({coord:33305,31720,7}) is also north of Stonehome.
Walk back the same way to Edron (to the **south** to Stonehome and then to the **south-west** to the city).
At the harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
Cornell (boat to Grimvale, north of Stonehome)

A {creature:Skeleton} appears in the crypt and there are a few more in a hole north of the graveyard. In the {wiki:Research and Development Quest}, each measurement on a grave makes a {creature:Squidgy Slime} appear.

Cave full of orcs on a peninsula **south-west of the Edron castle**, reached through a sewer in the basement of the {wiki:Edron Flats}; it has several quests (Barbarian Axe, Dark Armor, Poison Daggers, Shaman Treasure, Against the Spider Cult, Cults of Tibia).
Entrance of the Edron Orc Cave (peninsula south-west of the castle)
If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat (at your city's harbour captain say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.

Go to the {wiki:Edron Flats}, the apartments just **south** of the Edron castle, and go down to the basement. Look for the {item:Sewer Grate}, enter it and follow the sewer until you come out on the surface on the other side, on the orc peninsula.

On the surface, head **south** to the cave entrance ({coord:33173,31900,7}). It is hidden under a mountain: if you cannot see it, use the minimap. If it is covered, dig it open with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
On the first floor, if a stone blocks your way, pull the lever to remove it. The following floors go down through holes (maps below).

Go back the **same way**: on each floor return to the hole you fell through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up (following the maps in reverse). On the first floor head back **north** to the entrance and leave to the surface ({coord:33173,31900,7}).

On the surface, head **north** to the spot where you left the sewer and **dig it open with the {item:Shovel}** (to get back to Edron you always have to dig this passage open). Follow the sewer to the basement of the **Edron Flats**.
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities: {key:hi}, the city name (for example {key:thais}) and {key:yes}.
Hole to the Cultish Orcs area (level 150+ only)
The Sewer Grate in the Edron Flats basement
The entrance of the Edron Orc Cave, hidden under the mountain
The lever that removes the stone from the way on the first floor
Without a {item:Shovel} you cannot get back to Edron on your own after coming out on the peninsula: the sewer passage always has to be dug open.

There are orcs on every floor, including the surface, and it is easy to get surrounded. Below level 150 do not enter the hole at {coord:33123,31919,9}: it gives access to the much stronger Cultish Orcs.

Cave of {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms} **south of Edron**, with several entrances on the surface, which connects underground to {wiki:Cormaya}; good for those arriving from Rookgaard.
Entrance of the Edron Rotworm Cave (south of Edron)
Get to **Edron**: by boat (at your city's captain say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}, {coord:33176,31764,6}) or by magic carpet (you arrive at {npc:Pino}).
Leave the city to the **south**. There are three entrances on the surface: {coord:33213,31890,7}, {coord:33218,31911,7} and {coord:33238,31902,7}.
The cave also has entrances in {wiki:Cormaya} (the island south of Edron; {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you there with {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}, 20 gp).
Leave through one of the entrances south of Edron (use the {item:Rope} if you came down a hole) and walk back **north** to the city.

You can also cross the cave on foot to **Cormaya**: in Cormaya, {npc:Gurbasch}'s Steamship, 8 floors below ground level ({coord:33313,31989,15}), takes you to Kazordoon ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}) and {npc:Pemaret}, at the north harbour, takes you to Edron.
Another entrance of the Edron Rotworm Cave
Another entrance of the Edron Rotworm Cave
Besides the Rotworms and Carrion Worms, the {creature:Rotworm Queen} may appear, summoning helpers.
Troll cave in the **northern** part of the troll and goblin peninsula, **west of Edron**; a good first hunting spot for low levels.
Entrance of the Edron Troll Cave

Get to **Edron**: by boat (at your city's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat, {coord:33176,31764,6}) or by {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} ({key:edron}; you arrive at the Edron carpet, {coord:33192,31784,3}).
Leave Edron to the **west**, to the troll and goblin peninsula.
The Troll Cave is in the **northern** part of the peninsula ({coord:33117,31781,7}); the {wiki:Edron Goblin Cave} is further south and the Lost Mines between the two, near the sea.
Go back the same way to the cave entrance (the wiki does not describe other exits; bring a {item:Rope} just in case).
Walk back **east** to Edron, where {npc:Captain Seahorse} has boats to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Entrance of the Edron Troll Cave
Entrance of the Lost Mines (further south)
Area for low levels (the wiki recommends level 8+). On the 2nd underground floor, to the **south-west**, there is a small goblin worship room; to the **north-west**, a room with bears.
Vampire crypt **north/north-west of Edron** (near the {wiki:Edron Dragon Lair}), with five floors of undead and vampires; on the last floor is the access to {creature:Zorvorax}'s lair.
Entrance of the Edron Vampire Crypt (small cave)
Go to **Edron** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to your city's harbour captain); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Leave the city to the **north/north-west**, past the mountains, to the small entrance cave ({coord:33109,31722,7}), in the Edron Dragon Lair area.
Enter the cave and go down the floors. The room with blood pools is on **floor -4** ({coord:32999,31611,11}).
On the last floor use the exit teleport ({coord:33019,31605,11}): it takes you to the Stone Blocks next to the cave entrance ({coord:33052,31698,8}).
From there go up the entrance path to the surface and head back **south** to Edron; at the harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities.
Stone Blocks next to the entrance (teleport arrival)

Recommended for level 50–60+: from the 3rd floor there are {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts} and {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}; on floors 4 and 5, {creature:Vampire Viscount|Vampire Viscounts} and {creature:Vampire Bride|Vampire Brides}.
Small hill full of {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} **north of the city of Edron**, crossed by a mountain pass; on the north side is {creature:Heoni}'s room.
If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Leave {wiki:Edron Castle} through the **south** and follow the path to the **east**, towards {wiki:Stonehome}.
When you cross the bridge at the edge of Edron, head **north** along the mountain until you find {npc:Avar Tar} ({coord:33250,31764,7}).
Go up the ramp **west** of Avar Tar: you are now on the Wyvern Hill mountain pass ({coord:33221,31769,7}).
Go back over the hill the same way: go down the ramp next to {npc:Avar Tar} and head **south** along the mountain to the bridge.
Cross the bridge and head back **west** to Edron. At the harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
Alternative: follow the mountain pass all the way **west** and go down at the end (it is the way to the {wiki:Edron Dragon Lair}).
Far east end of Wyvern Hill
The hill is small but has many {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} and it is easy to get surrounded: level 40–45+ recommended, with {item:Health Potion|Health Potions}.
Former Red Legion prison castle, now occupied by orcs, minotaurs, trolls and elves, on an **island just west of Ab'Dendriel**; you can only get in through an underground cave.
Elvenbane entrance (hole surrounded by four stones)
Get to **Ab'Dendriel** (for example by boat: at your city's captain say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}, {coord:32735,31668,6}).
Leave through the Ab'Dendriel gate and head **south**, then **west** and then **north** to the area in front of the Elvenbane island.
Go down the hole surrounded by **four stones** ({coord:32579,31680,7}): you end up in the cave beneath the island.
In the cave, run **north** and then **west** to the opening and go around to the castle's **central tower** ({coord:32590,31645,7}).
Go back the same way: go down the central tower by the same stairs and cross the cave back (to the **east** and then to the **south**) to the hole you came down by.
Use the {item:Rope} on the hole to climb up to the surface ({coord:32579,31680,7}).
Return to Ab'Dendriel by the reverse route (**south**, **east** and **north** to the gate). At the harbour, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Elvenbane entrance: the hole surrounded by four stones
The castle corridors are so narrow that only one person can pass at a time: watch out for players blocking you when an {creature:Orc Berserker} or a {creature:Minotaur Guard} comes.
In the central tower there is a floor covered in poison fields (bring {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}) and a {creature:Dragon} on the floor above.

Small island between **Edron and Cormaya** where the hermit {npc:Eremo} lives, who sells {item:Amulet of Loss|Amulets of Loss}, {item:Protection Amulet|Protection Amulets} and the blessing *The Wisdom of Solitude*.
Get to **Edron** (for example from Liberty Bay, on {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) takes you to **Cormaya**: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp).
At the **north harbour** of Cormaya, ask the boatman {npc:Pemaret} ({coord:33287,31956,6}) for passage to the hermit's island: {key:hi}, {key:eremo}, {key:yes}. The trip is **free**.
Talk to {npc:Eremo} and say {key:hi} and {key:cormaya} (he also accepts {key:tibia}, {key:back} or {key:teleport}): he sends you back to Cormaya.
In Cormaya, {npc:Pemaret} takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).

Industrial district of **Yalahar**, **south-east** of the city centre, full of ancient Yalahari machines and golems ({creature:Worker Golem|Worker Golems}, {creature:War Golem|War Golems}) and {creature:Mad Scientist|Mad Scientists}.

Go by boat to **Yalahar**: {npc:Captain Max}, in Liberty Bay, takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 400 gp; you need to have started the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}). If you already have that quest's routes, there is a direct boat from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore.
You arrive at the harbour, in the {wiki:Trade Quarter}. Go to the gate between the Trade Quarter and the Factory Quarter, guarded by {npc:Peter} ({coord:32857,31302,7}).
Tell him {key:hi}, {key:pass} and the destination (the Factory Quarter) to get through.
Alternative: if you already have access to the gate mechanisms (from the In Service of Yalahar Quest), go to the gate from the city centre to the Factory Quarter and use the mechanism.
If you went down to the underground floors, go back to the surface the same way (use the {item:Rope} on the holes).
Leave through {npc:Peter}'s gate ({key:pass} and the destination, the Trade Quarter) or through the gate mechanism to the centre.
At the harbour, {npc:Captain Cookie} takes you to Liberty Bay (400 gp) or Thais (800 gp); {npc:Karith} takes you to the cities on the In Service of Yalahar routes (for example Venore).

It is easy to get surrounded: use area spells on the small monsters. If you cannot cope, run through the gate to the Sunken Quarter, go up the ramp to the Inner City or go down underground (there are usually only 1–2 Damaged Worker Golems).
The {creature:War Golem|War Golems} hit hard; level 30–35+ recommended.
Dwarven base underground in the mountains of {wiki:Zao}, **east of Yalahar** and **north of Edron**, connected to the rest of the world by the underground {wiki:Steamship}.
Farmine's depot, tavern, bank, shops and citizenship only open up as you complete the missions of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Farmine's magic carpet only becomes available after you complete the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} (and carpets are for Premium accounts only).
From **Kazordoon**: go down to the underground {wiki:Steamship} harbour and talk to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}): {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.
From **Cormaya** (next to Edron): talk to {npc:Gurbasch} at the Steamship ({coord:33313,31989,15}): {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.
You arrive at the Farmine harbour, next to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}). {npc:Ongulf} is near the steamship.

After completing the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} you can come by {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} from Darashia, Edron, Femor Hills, Svargrond, Kazordoon or Issavi: tell the carpet pilot {key:hi}, {key:farmine} (or {key:zao}) and {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Melian}'s carpet, high in the mountains above Farmine ({coord:32984,31540,1}).

Go down to the steamship and talk to {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp), and {key:yes}. From Cormaya you take the boat to Edron and from there boats to the other cities.

With the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed, {npc:Melian}'s carpet ({coord:32984,31540,1}) takes you to Darashia (60 gp), Edron (60), Femor Hills (60), Svargrond (60), Kazordoon (70) or Issavi (100): {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.

To the {wiki:Zao Steppe}: head **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, go through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**; the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain. Head **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the steppe at {coord:33085,31532,7}. To go back, do the route in reverse (go up with Levitate and head **west** to the elevator).
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe

If you pay for the carpet with large coins (for example a Crystal Coin), bring free space and capacity for the change: if it does not fit, you still travel but the change stays at the departure carpet.
Mines inside the **Farmine** mountain, in Zao, with one of the biggest spawns of {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, plus {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} and {creature:Gozzler|Gozzlers}.
Teleport to the Farmine Mines (in Farmine)
They only become available after you complete a certain mission of the {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}). You arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
Inside Farmine, enter the mines teleport ({coord:33030,31485,10}).

The mines are further down ({coord:33037,31478,11}): on the first floor there are Gargoyles and Stone Golems near the teleport and Gozzlers at the end of each tunnel; on the second floor all three creatures are everywhere.
The wiki does not describe the exit in detail: go back through the tunnels to the teleport area you entered by and return to Farmine.

Hills full of {creature:Goblin|Goblins} between **Carlin**, **Ab'Dendriel** and **Kazordoon** (east of Carlin, south-west of Ab'Dendriel and north of Kazordoon), with the jungle grass tower, the Whitewatch Tower and a magic carpet on top.
**With Premium (faster):** take a {wiki:Magic Carpet} in Darashia, Edron, Farmine, Svargrond, Kazordoon or Issavi and tell the pilot {key:hi}, {key:femor hills} (or {key:hills}) and {key:yes}.
The carpet lands on top of a mound in the **south-west** of the hills, **3 floors above ground level** ({coord:32535,31837,4}), next to {npc:Uzon}. Go down the floors to the ground to explore.

**On foot:** from **Carlin** head **east** (from Thais take {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}). You can also reach it on foot from **Ab'Dendriel** (heading south-west) or from **Kazordoon** (heading north).
Bring a {item:Rope}; on some paths you also need a {item:Shovel} and a {item:Machete} (the tower's grass grows back quickly and you have to cut it).

**With Premium:** go back up to the carpet on top of the mound ({coord:32535,31837,4}) and tell {npc:Uzon} {key:hi}, the destination (for example {key:kazordoon}, {key:edron} or {key:darashia}) and {key:yes}.
**On foot:** head back **west** to Carlin, **north-east** to Ab'Dendriel or **south** to Kazordoon.
In Carlin, {npc:Captain Greyhound} ({coord:32388,31822,6}) takes you back to Thais: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}.
Caramellia (top floor of the grass tower)
Thanita (Whitewatch Tower, north of the hills)
Femor Hills map at ground level
Besides the goblins there are {creature:Hunter|Hunters}, {creature:Cyclops} and a {creature:Demon Skeleton} underground in the centre of the hills — dangerous for low levels.
Every now and then there are orc invasions near the Whitewatch Tower, with {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and stronger orcs.

Tower hidden among the peaks of the {wiki:Femor Hills} (between Carlin, Ab'Dendriel and Kazordoon), with its entrance blocked by {item:Jungle Grass} enchanted by the druid Minz; on the top floor is {npc:Caramellia}.
You can only cut the grass at the entrance after learning to cut grass ("lawn mowing") in {npc:Hoggle}'s garden, during the {wiki:Kissing a Pig Quest}.
Take a boat to **Carlin** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}.
Walk **east** to the Femor Hills ({coord:32569,31803,7}); bring a {item:Rope} and, for some paths, a {item:Shovel}.
Look for the tower blocked by the fast-growing grass, cut it with the {item:Machete} and go in.
Go up the stairs to the top floor, where {npc:Caramellia} is ({coord:32588,31786,1}).
Go down the tower by the same stairs and walk back the same way **west** to Carlin (Ab'Dendriel and Kazordoon are also close).
In Carlin, {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, for example {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
The grass at the entrance grows back quickly and works like a wall: cut it again if it blocks the way.

Island **west/south-west of Yalahar**, near {wiki:Mistrock} and {wiki:Vengoth}, with barbarians on the surface and caves of {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises}; beneath it lies the hidden city of {wiki:Beregar}.
Go to **Yalahar** (for example with {npc:Captain Max} in Liberty Bay, or with the captains of Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun or Thais who run that route).
In Yalahar go to the docks of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter}, all the way **north-west**, 1 floor above ground level, and talk to {npc:Maris} ({coord:32649,31293,6}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:fenrock} and {key:yes} (100 gp; 50 gp if you leave from Mistrock).
If you are in the caves, go up to the surface the same way you came down.
At the Fenrock dock talk to {npc:Maris} again: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He also takes you to {wiki:Mistrock}, where there is a mailbox.
Teleport in the north of the Tortoise area (floor -2)
