Crack in the ground (use the Pick) to go down to Beregar

On the surface there are {creature:Barbarian Headsplitter|Barbarian Headsplitters}, {creature:Barbarian Skullhunter|Skullhunters} and {creature:Barbarian Brutetamer|Brutetamers}; on floor -2 there are {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises} and {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}.
There is no mailbox on the surface of Fenrock: the nearest one is in Mistrock.
Forest and hill area **east of Kazordoon**, **north-west of Venore** and south-east of Ab'Dendriel, west of the Rorc Plains; it has Wyvern hills, the Kazordoon Dragon Lair and the Poacher Caves.

The simplest way is through **Venore**: take the boat ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to your city's harbour captain, for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais). You arrive next to {npc:Captain Fearless}.
From Venore walk **north-west**, passing north of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}, to Ferngrims Gate.
The main Wyvern hill is between the Gate and the Rorc Plains ({coord:32780,31831,7}); the {wiki:Ulderek's Rock|Orc Fortress} is just to the **east** ({coord:32930,31774,7}).
The whole area is on the surface: walk back **south-east** to Venore, passing north of the Green Claw Swamp.
In Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
There are {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {creature:Poacher|Poachers} in the area; level 45–55+ recommended to hunt here.

{creature:Ferumbras}'s tower, on the forbidden island of {wiki:Kharos} (Shattered Isles, west of Liberty Bay), full of {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}, {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Demon|Demons}.
Access to Goroma and the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} to Malada, from {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.

Before entering you have to **try to step on the energy barrier** of the citadel and then ask {npc:Zoltan} in Edron for permission: {key:hi}, {key:Ferumbras}, {key:yes}, then {key:permission} and {key:yes} (**500 gp**).
The permission is only valid for **one** entry: each time you want to enter again you pay another 500 gp. To confirm, check the Quest Log "The Shattered Isles" → "Access to Ferumbras' Citadel".
Go to **Liberty Bay** (for example from Edron, with {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 170 gp).
In Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to Goroma: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes}.
In Goroma go down to the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} and always use the **right-hand** teleport (Goroma → Ramoa → Talahu → Malada). In Malada go up the hub stairs.
Head **south** of Malada to the trapdoor ({coord:32024,32734,7}) and go down: you arrive underground in Kharos, where the citadel is ({coord:32121,32688,7}).
With {npc:Zoltan}'s permission, cross the energy barrier and enter the citadel.
After you pass the barrier you cannot leave through it. Head **east**, go down a hole, head **west** and go up through a rope hole with the {item:Rope}.
Then go down the hole to the **east** ({coord:32138,32697,7}), where the one-way teleport that takes you to Goroma is.
In Goroma talk to {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to go back to Liberty Bay.
Hole with the teleport back to Goroma
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
The Malada trapdoor only works for going down: the way out of Kharos is the one-way teleport to Goroma.

When you enter the citadel you are greeted by several {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} and maybe some attracted {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}. Below ~level 150, do not move and stay against the wall until everything around you is dead; above that you can run **north-east** to the stairs to the underground.
With a pair of {item:Boots of Homecoming} you go straight to the citadel from any protection zone.
Fae peninsula **north-west of Roshamuul**, with a village in the centre ({npc:Maelyrra} and {npc:Gerimor}); you can only get there through the elemental {wiki:Holy Shrine|Holy Shrines} in the cities.
You need the Fae seal from the {wiki:Threatened Dreams Quest}: {npc:Alkestios}, in Ab'Dendriel, marks you with it ({key:hi}, {key:mission}) and from then on you can use the shrines.
Get a small gem: {item:Small Amethyst}, {item:Small Emerald}, {item:Small Ruby} or {item:Small Sapphire} (one per trip; the gem is used up).

Each city has a corridor with four arches (ice, earth, fire and energy) that lead to the {wiki:Holy Shrine|Holy Shrines}. Enter the arch of your gem's element and **use** the gem on the shrine inside.

Each shrine drops you in a different spot in Feyrist: the {wiki:Ice Shrine} on a beach ({coord:33430,32279,7}), the Earth Shrine at {coord:33540,32208,7}, the Fire Shrine at {coord:33587,32262,7} and the Energy Shrine on top of the mountain ({coord:33528,32300,4}).
The village is in the centre of the peninsula: {npc:Maelyrra} is at {coord:33485,32237,7} and {npc:Gerimor} a little to the west ({coord:33450,32246,7}).
**Use** any of the four shrines in Feyrist (it does not matter which one you came in by) and you are teleported back to the mainland. To leave you **do not need a gem**.
To {wiki:Candia}: with the {item:Gingerbread Key (Moon Melon, Raspberry and Lemon)}, walk under the giant donut in the **eastern** part of Feyrist ({coord:33574,32222,7}).
The caves of Feyrist and {creature:Kroazur}'s lair have nightmare creatures; on the surface the area is peaceful.
Small island and fishing village **south-west of Thais**, connected to the mainland by the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel}; beneath it lies the dangerous {wiki:Fibula Dungeon}.
From **Thais**, head **south-west** to the entrance of the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} ({coord:32261,32385,7}).
Walk through the tunnel (it is five small caves; there are only {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}) until you come out on the island of Fibula.
Alternative: the teleport to Fibula in the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} (only for those with the required rank in the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest} who carry an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}).
Do the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} in reverse, to the **north-east**, back to the mainland.
The {wiki:Fibula Dungeon}, beneath the village (entrance through the well), has much more dangerous creatures than the island; some doors require the {item:Key 3940}.

Large dungeon beneath the island of **Fibula**, south-west of Thais, with rotworms, orcs and bonelords on the upper floors and the dragon cave of the {wiki:Deeper Fibula Quest} further down; you enter through the village well.
The door right after the well may be locked (it depends on who went in last): open it with the {item:Key 3940}, which {npc:Simon the Beggar} sells for 800 gp on the south coast of Fibula.
The dragon part (Deeper Fibula) also needs the {item:Key 3980} and goes through a level 50 door.
Go to **Fibula**, the small island **south-west** of Thais: from Thais cross the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} ({coord:32261,32385,7}) or use the teleport on the second floor of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}.
In the village, use the {item:Draw Well|well} in the middle of the village ({coord:32171,32440,7}) to go down to the dungeon.

Down there, follow the path **south**, **east** and then **north**, cross a bridge and open the door with the {item:Key 3940} if it is locked (some {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} may show up along the way).

Go in and down the stairs. From there there are doors to several areas: **east** (the "treasure" and the teleport room), **north** (orcs), **west** (rotworms and carrion worms, good for low levels) and **south** (destroyed city with bonelords and skeletons).
Go back the **same way**: go up the ladder and the stairs, return over the bridge and through the door to the well you came in by, and climb up to the village of Fibula.

If you are in the dragon cave, the portal in the **south-west** part of the last room takes you back to the dungeon entrance. In the "treasure" area to the **east** there is also a room with two teleports, one of them to the exit.
From the village, go back to Thais through the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel}, to the **north-east**.
The central room of the Fibula Dungeon, with the doors to the various areas
Near the stairs there may be {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} or {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} attracted by other players.
The **south-east** area is full of fake holes.
Underground tunnel that connects the mainland, **south-west of Thais**, to the island of {wiki:Fibula}; it is five small caves, the deepest one surrounded by lava.
Leave **Thais** and head **south-west** to the tunnel entrance on the mainland ({coord:32261,32385,7}).
Go down and follow the tunnel through the five caves (the deepest one is just a platform surrounded by lava) and climb up again on the other side: you come out on the island of {wiki:Fibula}.
To go to Fibula, leave through the island side; to go back to Thais, do the tunnel in reverse, to the **north-east**, and leave through the mainland entrance ({coord:32261,32385,7}).
Fibula Tunnel entrance on the mainland
The deepest floor of the tunnel, surrounded by lava
On the top two floors there are a few {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}; otherwise the tunnel is safe.
Underwater area of the {creature:Deepling|Deeplings} beneath the {wiki:Gray Beach} of {wiki:Quirefang}, with unique sea creatures such as the {creature:Manta Ray}.
Hole south-east of Gray Beach (to Fiehonja)
Access is granted by the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest}: to walk underwater you need {npc:Spectulus}'s upgrades (first part of the quest).
The open area depends on the stage of the {wiki:Deeplings World Change}: at stage 1 almost nothing is accessible; at stage 3 you have access to everything.
Take a boat to {wiki:Gray Island} (for example {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore): {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
On Gray Island enter the hole **south** of {npc:Scrutinon}, head **north-east** on floor -1 and enter the {item:Water Vortex}.
On the other side use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground and head **north** to Gray Beach ({coord:33471,31304,7}).

Enter the hole furthest **south-east** of Gray Beach ({coord:33514,31323,7}) and go down the giant staircase; at the bottom follow the cave **south** to a ramp and follow the one-way path to the main part of Fiehonja.
Shortcut: once you have done the Liquid Black Quest shortcut, the Gray Beach teleport drops you next to the statue of {wiki:Qjell}.
Go back to the protected area of the Qjell statue and use the shortcut teleport to Gray Beach (there you have a depot and a temple).
No boat docks at Quirefang: go down to the entrance **south** of the Gray Beach village and do the underground passage in reverse to Gray Island.
Talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: {key:hi}, {key:passage} and the city name ({key:ab'dendriel}, {key:darashia}, {key:edron} or {key:venore}). The trip is **free**.
The path through the giant staircase is one-way: to leave use the teleport next to the Qjell statue.
Area for level 120+ ({creature:Deepling|Deeplings} and other sea creatures).
The area **north of Carlin**, an old battlefield between humans and orcs; underneath it has a maze of tunnels with weak creatures and the hidden entrance to the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls}.
Go to **Carlin** (if you come by boat, tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Greyhound}, {coord:32388,31822,6}).
Leave the city to the **north**: the Fields of Glory start right there ({coord:32362,31683,7} is the centre).
To the **north-east** is {wiki:Northport} and {npc:Bron}'s hut ({coord:32364,31626,7}); the blesser {npc:Humphrey} is in the Fields of Glory, 1 floor above ground level ({coord:32359,31683,6}).
If you are in the tunnels below, go up the same way you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes).
If you are in {wiki:Demona}, there is a teleport at the end of a tunnel west of the Star Room ({coord:32400,31657,15}) that leads back to the Fields of Glory.
Cave south of Northport (path to Demona)
Teleport from Demona to the Fields of Glory
A {creature:Witch} shows up in the tower to the south: on non-PvP worlds it is a usual spot for PKers.
There are {creature:Amazon|Amazons}, {creature:Valkyrie|Valkyries} and {creature:Poacher|Poachers} on the surface; be careful if you are a very low level.

The largest of the three {wiki:Ice Islands}, **west/north-west of Carlin**, with Winter Wolves, Polar Bears and Frost Trolls on the surface and big caves below (Minotaurs, Orcs, Slimes and Water Elementals at the bottom).
Go to **Carlin** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to your city's harbour captain).
Go to the boatman {npc:Nielson}, **north-west** of Carlin ({coord:32235,31675,7}), and say {key:hi}, {key:folda}, {key:yes} (20 gp).
You arrive at the Folda dock, next to {npc:Svenson} ({coord:32045,31580,7}).
For the caves: the main entrance is **inside the mountain** ({coord:31999,31571,7}); you can also go down through the hole in the ice **south** of the mountain.
If you are in the caves, go up to the surface the same way you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes).
Go back to the dock and talk to {npc:Svenson}: {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}. The trip back to the mainland is **free** and leaves you near Carlin.
Nielson — boat to Folda (north-west of Carlin)
A {creature:Yeti} may show up on the surface: if you see it, run.
The upper floors of the mountain have {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}; low-level players should avoid them.
On the 1st underground floor, south of the main entrance, there may be a {creature:Minotaur Archer} lured there.

Dangerous area in the north-east of {wiki:Tiquanda}, **east of Banuta**, closed off by a large palisade, with giant footprints and monsters such as {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and {creature:Hydra|Hydras}.
{npc:The Blind Prophet} only takes you after {npc:Hairycles} gives you permission (mission 8 of {wiki:The Ape City Quest}).

Take a boat to **Port Hope** (tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and cross the jungle **north-east** to {wiki:Banuta} (or use {npc:Lorek}'s ferry, if you have the Ranger rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}).
**East** of Banuta, at the foot of the mountain and next to the palisade of the Forbidden Lands, is {npc:The Blind Prophet} ({coord:33022,32604,7}).
Tell him {key:hi}, {key:transport} and answer {key:yes}: he takes you to a ramp inside the Forbidden Lands.
Go back the same way to the ramp where {npc:The Blind Prophet} dropped you off and leave from there to Tiquanda (the wiki does not describe this exit in detail).
Head back **west** to Banuta and from there through the jungle to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} has a boat to other cities.

High-level area (60–100+): {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} (one of them next to the arrival ramp), {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Massive Earth Elemental|Massive Earth Elementals}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles} and {creature:Hydra|Hydras}.
To avoid most of the monsters, stay close to the **southern** palisade.
Temple buried under the sands of {wiki:Kha'labal}, **north-east of Ankrahmun**, inhabited by Low Class Lizards and members of a cult that worships a lizard god; it has four underground floors.
Forbidden Temple entrance (hidden by a tree; dig with the Shovel)
Take the boat to **Ankrahmun** (at your city's harbour captain: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}).
Leave the city and cross the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert **north-east** to the temple entrance ({coord:33315,32675,7}), hidden by a tree.
Use the {item:Shovel} on the ground at the entrance: you may need to dig a few times before it opens. Go down.
Go back the **same way** to the entrance (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes) and leave to the desert.
Head back to **Ankrahmun** to the **south-west**; at the harbour, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:venore}, and {key:yes}).
The Forbidden Temple entrance, hidden by the tree

The 3rd underground floor has many {creature:Voodoo Cultist|Voodoo Cultists} and {creature:Low Class Lizard|Low Class Lizards} and it is easy to get surrounded; on the 4th there are {creature:Enlightened of the Cult}, {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts of the Cult}, a {creature:Lizard Snakecharmer} and sometimes the boss {creature:Tzumrah the Dazzler}. Almost everything attacks from a distance.
Do not confuse it with the temple of the {wiki:Cults of Tibia Quest} that you reach through the {item:Gate of Deathstruction}: that is another area, near Carlin.
Immigrants' district in the **south-west of Yalahar**, where orcs, elves, minotaurs and humans live; it has {npc:Maris}'s dock (boats to Fenrock and Mistrock) and {npc:Zarak}'s knights' guild.

To go to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay) you need the **Novice** rank of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}. Alternatively, pay 250 gp to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (west of Kazordoon) for the password ({key:whizzkid}) and travel from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}. With the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} there are direct boats from several cities.

Go to **Yalahar**: in **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Max} on one of the boats **east** of the harbour ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 400 gp). If you have already done the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}, there are direct boats from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore.
You arrive at the Yalahar harbour, **south** of the city centre (Inner City).
From the centre, head **south-west** to the Foreigner Quarter gate: this district **has no gate mechanism**, so you enter directly from the centre.
If you come from the Arena and Zoo Quarter, the guard {npc:Tony} ({coord:32695,31257,7}) lets you through: say {key:hi}, {key:pass} and the name of the destination district.
{npc:Maris}'s dock is at the **north-west** end of the district, 1 floor above ground level ({coord:32649,31293,6}).
Go back to the Yalahar centre through the same gate and go to the harbour, **south** of the centre.

At the harbour, {npc:Captain Cookie} takes you to **Liberty Bay** ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or to **Thais** ({key:thais}, 800 gp). If you have already unlocked the In Service of Yalahar routes, {npc:Karith}, next door, takes you to 8 cities ({key:hi}, {key:passage}).
To go to the islands, {npc:Maris} at the north-west dock takes you to **Fenrock** ({key:hi}, {key:fenrock}, {key:yes}) or **Mistrock** ({key:hi}, {key:mistrock}, {key:yes}), for 100 gp.
Maris — Foreigner Quarter dock (1 floor up)
Tony — gate to the Arena and Zoo Quarter

The ground floor near the entrance is safe from level 20, but off the ground floor the district quickly becomes very dangerous ({creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, and {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns} in the elf camp). A {item:Stealth Ring} or the {spell:Invisible} spell helps a lot here.
Part of the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter} of **Yalahar**, south-west of the depot, where elves live; below are the deep caves called {wiki:Crystal Lakes}, full of {creature:Dragon|Dragons}.

Travel to **Yalahar**: in Liberty Bay talk to {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}; you need the Novice rank in the Explorer Society) or, in Thais, to {npc:Captain Bluebear} if you bought the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}. With {npc:Karith}'s routes unlocked there is a direct boat from several cities (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the port, **south** of the centre.
The Foreigner Quarter has no gate mechanism: you enter directly from the city centre.
The elf area is **south-west** of the Yalahar depot: head **south** and then walk to the entrance ({coord:32753,31289,7}).

For the {wiki:Crystal Lakes}, go down the ladder in the middle of this area and keep going down: after 2 floors you reach a room with 4 ramps (north, south, east and west) that lead to the dragon caves.
Go back the same way: go up the ramps and stairs to the surface of the elf area and head back **north-east**, to the Yalahar centre.

To leave Yalahar, go to the port: {npc:Captain Cookie} ({coord:32804,31276,6}) takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or Thais (800 gp); with the routes unlocked, {npc:Karith} takes you to 8 cities.

On the surface there are only {creature:Elf|Elves}, {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists} (level 20+), but the caves below have up to 15 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} together, {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns} (level 50+; the deepest caves 110+).
Icy glacier **west of Svargrond**, on the island of {wiki:Hrodmir}, which stretches to the southern Norsir settlements; on the peaks there are Ice Golems and inside are the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}.

Go to **Svargrond** by boat (for example in Carlin or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.
Leave Svargrond to the **west** and use {spell:Levitate} to go up onto the glacier.
Head **west** across the glacier ({coord:32102,31144,7}). The entrance to the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} is the stairs at {coord:32145,31123,7}.
Go back **east** the same way and go down with {spell:Levitate} at the spot where you went up, already near Svargrond.
If you are in the Formorgar Mines, the Hoist ({coord:32155,31126,11}) also brings you back to the glacier.
You need to know {spell:Levitate} to go up and down the glacier.

On the peaks there are {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Ice Witch|Ice Witches}; {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants}, {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} and, in the specific areas, {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} also appear (level 30+ recommended).

Two {creature:Mammoth|Mammoth} hunting areas on the Formorgar glacier, in the {wiki:Ice Islands}: a small one **west of Svargrond** (near The Bloodtusks' lair) and a bigger one **south-west** of the city.
**Premium** account (Svargrond can only be reached by boat).
Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Breezelda} ({coord:32347,31108,6}).
**Large area (more Mammoths), fastest way:** leave Svargrond to the **west**, cross a small bridge and go up the ramp at {coord:32180,31230,7}.

**Large area, alternative:** in the **south** of Svargrond talk to {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32255,31197,7}): {key:hi} and {key:camp} (raiders' camp); if he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp (if he drops you on the wrong island, ask again). He drops you at {coord:32153,31375,7}; from there head **north** and go up the ramp at {coord:32158,31355,7}.

**Small area:** leave to the **west**, cross the small bridge and go up 5 times with {spell:Levitate} at {coord:32172,31161,7}; or leave to the **north** through the two ramps ({coord:32245,31112,7}), head **west** to the frozen waterfall ({coord:32148,31080,5}) and go up 3 times with {spell:Levitate}.
Go back the same way to Svargrond (go down the ramps or use {spell:Levitate} downwards at the spots where you went up).
From the raiders' camp, {npc:Buddel} also takes you back: {key:hi} and {key:svargrond}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp.
In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin (110 gp), Thais (180 gp) or Venore (150 gp).
Ramp to the large area (fast way)

Besides the {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths} there are {creature:Barbarian Brutetamer|Barbarian Brutetamers}, {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls} and sometimes {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}; level 28-30+ recommended.
Former abandoned and frozen mining complex, beneath the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, **west of Svargrond**, with several floors of cultists, golems and mammoths.
You can only enter after doing the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} up to mission 9 (*Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission*).
To cross the glacier you need {spell:Levitate}.

Go to **Svargrond** by boat (for example from Carlin, or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.
Leave Svargrond to the **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the route (see image) across the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier} to the mine entrance.
At the end of the path go down the stairs ({coord:32145,31123,7}): you are on the first floor of the mines ({coord:32146,31120,9}).
There is no quick way out: go back the same way, floor by floor, to the first floor and go up the exit ramp/stairs (yellow circle on the first floor map).
Outside, retrace the glacier route to **Svargrond**, using {spell:Levitate} (downwards) at the spot where you went up.
In Svargrond take {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}/{key:thais}/{key:venore}, {key:yes}. To go to Hjaern ask {npc:Iskan} for {key:passage}.
If you have done the {wiki:Formorgar Mines Hoist Quest}, the Hoist ({coord:32155,31126,11}) takes you between the floors and to the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, near Svargrond.
Hoist (needs the Formorgar Mines Hoist Quest)
Ice Portal to the Halls of Hope (Forgotten Knowledge Quest)
Hole next to the Ice Portal (go up with Rope)
Route from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines
First floor: yellow circle = exit; pink circles = stairs to the 2nd floor

Even the first floor has {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices} and {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes of the Cult}, {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}; the deeper floors are for level 100+.

In the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest} you reach the mines through the {wiki:Ice Portal} of the {wiki:Halls of Hope} and come back through the same portal (first go up with the {item:Rope} through the hole north-east of it).
Ice guildhall with three towers decorated with mammoth tusks, on a cliff in the **north-east of Svargrond**, 2 floors above the city.

Go to **Svargrond** by boat: {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin (110 gp), {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore (150 gp) or {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais (180 gp): {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.
Leave the city to the **north** and go up **2 floors** along the cliffs, going around them on the **right**, to the main door ({coord:32287,31106,5}); there is a mailbox right at the door.
Go down the cliffs the same way to Svargrond.
At the harbour, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin (110 gp), Thais (180 gp) or Venore (150 gp): {key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}.
Frost Manor floor plan (floor +1 on the wiki)
On the cliffs around there are {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}.
It is a rentable guildhall: the interior is only accessible to those with access to the house.
Icy underwater trench a little **south of the island of Tyrsung**, full of Quaras and Massive Water Elementals; you enter by diving with the {item:Helmet of the Deep} from the hunters' boat.
Planks south of the hunters' boat (where you dive in)
You need to have done the *Undersea Kingdom* part (Calassa) of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}; the *Frozen Trench* mission also requires *Formorgar Mines 3* of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
To go to Tyrsung with {npc:Buddel} you need the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and to have started the *Nibelor 2* mission of the Ice Islands Quest.

In **Svargrond**, go to the boat **south** of the city and talk to {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung} (50 gp; if he asks for a {item:Dwarven Ring}, say {key:no}). You land at the Tyrsung dock ({coord:32332,31230,7}).

In Tyrsung, head a long way **south**, pass a smugglers' camp and reach a docked boat. Climb onto the boat (in the Explorer Society mission you have to kill the 3 {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers} and the {creature:Pirate Cutthroat}).
Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and jump into the water from the planks on the **south** side of the boat ({coord:32366,31372,6}).
Underwater, head **south** to a cliff and go down with {spell:Levitate} ({coord:32385,31423,11}). For the deepest pits use Levitate or parcels/boxes.
Go back the **same way** to the cliff ({coord:32385,31423,11}), climb it with {spell:Levitate} and head back **north** to the spot where you jumped into the water, next to the hunters' boat.
Cross Tyrsung to the **north** to {npc:Buddel}'s dock and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} to go back to Svargrond.
Do not take off the {item:Helmet of the Deep} while you are underwater.

There are many {creature:Quara Constrictor|Quara Constrictors}, {creature:Quara Mantassin|Mantassins}, {creature:Quara Predator|Predators}, {creature:Quara Hydromancer|Hydromancers} and {creature:Massive Water Elemental|Massive Water Elementals}. The wiki recommends level 40–70+.
Dungeon of fire creatures far beneath **Edron**, which you can only reach through a {wiki:Fury Gate} during the {wiki:Fury Gates Mini World Change}.
It only opens when the {wiki:Fury Gates Mini World Change} is active on your server (message *"A fiery fury gate has opened near one of the major cities somewhere in Tibia."*).
The Fury Gate only teleports **Premium**, **promoted** players of **level 60** or higher (140+ recommended).

When the world change is active, look for the Fury Gate outside one of these cities: Ab'Dendriel (south-east, {coord:32679,31722,7}), Ankrahmun (east, {coord:33263,32840,7}), Carlin (south-west, {coord:32262,31844,7}), Darashia (north-east, {coord:33302,32371,7}), Edron (south, {coord:33220,31921,7}).

Or: Kazordoon (south, {coord:32574,31978,7}), Liberty Bay (north, {coord:32349,32697,7}), Port Hope (north-west, {coord:32531,32714,7}), Thais (north-west, {coord:32268,32164,7}) and Venore (west, {coord:32832,32083,7}). Check the locations until you find the open gate.
Enter the Fury Gate: you are teleported to the Fury Dungeon, beneath Edron, whichever city the gate opened in.
The wiki does not describe a dedicated exit from the dungeon: go back the **same way** to the spot where the Fury Gate dropped you. Keep supplies for the return.

The dungeon is full of {creature:Massive Fire Elemental|Massive Fire Elementals}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, {creature:Dragonling|Dragonlings}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Infernalist|Infernalists}, {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds} and the {creature:Furyosa} ({creature:Demon|Demons} also appear in raids). Do not go in below the recommended level without a team.
Do not confuse it with the {wiki:Oramond Fury Dungeon}, which is a different area.

Underground gardens of the black priestesses in **Drefia**, west of Darashia, **east of the Necromancer Halls**: dark and white sand, dry trees, strange shrines and {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}; they are part of {wiki:The Gravedigger of Drefia Quest}.
Gardens of Night entrance (painting "Apothecary and Holy Grounds...")
Go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).

Cross the mountains to the **west** to {wiki:Drefia} ({coord:33018,32443,7}): for example, go up with the {item:Rope} at {coord:33048,32429,7}, or come through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
Enter the main Drefia dungeon ({coord:32996,32413,7}) and go down **3 floors**.

Head **north-east** to the cyclops pit. Go straight **north** through 2 rooms and turn **east**; keep going east past a bar and turn **north**. You are in the Gardens of Night ({coord:33037,32357,10}).
Go back the same way: **south**, **west** to the cyclops pit and go up the 3 floors to the main dungeon entrance ({coord:32996,32413,7}).

Cross the mountain back to **Darashia** (through the rope spot {coord:33048,32429,7} or through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun). In Darashia take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia

In the gardens there are {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Shadow Pupil|Shadow Pupils} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}; on the mountain on the way to Drefia there are many {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} (keep mana to cure the poison).

One of the deadliest dragon lairs in Tibia, inside the {wiki:Souleater Mountains} in the **north of Zao**, near the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp}; the teleport to the task boss {creature:Zanakeph} is also here.
To reach the north of Zao you need to have progressed in the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} (Lion's Den in mission 1 or the link to the rebels' hideout after mission 2).
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine** ({npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}).

In Farmine, head **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, go through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**; on the surface follow the pass **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate}, to the Zao Steppe ({coord:33085,31532,7}).

Head to the north of Zao by the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} route: through the Lion's Den or, after mission 2, through the blue flame in the {wiki:Muggy Plains} to the rebels' hideout ({coord:33213,31058,9}).
Near the hideout, go up into the {wiki:Souleater Mountains}; the lair is inside the mountains (the wiki does not give the exact position of the entrance).
Go back the same way to the rebels' hideout and step on the blue flame **south** of {npc:Chartan} to go to the Muggy Plains.

In the Muggy Plains go back to the Zao Steppe by the teleport, head **south-west** to the mountain pass, go up with {spell:Levitate} and head **west** to the Farmine elevator. At the steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon or Cormaya.
Area for **level 130–150+**: the {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons} hit hard and curse. It is easy to walk into the lair by accident when moving around the Souleater Mountains.
Cursed lands just **west of Carlin**, closed off by a magic hedge, with a weak surface and holes that go down to caves full of undead (Ghouls, Demon Skeletons) and a half-destroyed graveyard.

Go to **Carlin** by boat: at your city's harbour tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} (for example {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore). You arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}.
Leave the city to the **west**. The Ghostlands are closed off by a wall/hedge: enter by going under it through the entrance hole/cave ({coord:32219,31768,7}).

On the other side you are on the surface of the Ghostlands. The **first hole** to the caves is at {coord:32190,31782,7} and the **second**, further south, at {coord:32190,31839,7}; the abandoned house is to the **south** ({coord:32246,31837,7}).
If you went down into the caves, go back the same way and use the {item:Rope} on each hole you fell through until you are back on the surface.
On the surface head back **north/east** to the entrance cave ({coord:32222,31767,7}) and go under the wall to the Carlin side.
Walk **east** to Carlin; at the harbour, {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, for example {key:thais} or {key:venore}, and {key:yes}).
How to enter the small cave of the third hole (watch out for the Slimes)
The fourth hole is inside a house, next to a Skeleton Warriors spawn

On the surface there are {creature:Skeleton Warrior|Skeleton Warriors} and {creature:Slime|Slimes}; on the floors below {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} show up (level 20+ recommended).
Ghost ship that appears at sea between the {wiki:Cake Keep Isle} and the Darama mainland; it sometimes hijacks the boat from Venore to Darashia. The {wiki:Plate Armor Quest} is here.
Go to the **Venore** harbour and travel to **Darashia** with {npc:Captain Fearless} ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}).
There is a **10%** chance of the boat being hijacked by the Ghostship (the captain warns you of the threat). If you arrive in Darashia normally, repeat the trip until it happens.
You can also end up on the Ghostship if you fail the book reading in mission 9 of the {wiki:Shadows of Yalahar Quest}.
Go down the stairs and follow the bridge **south** (there are {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}).
Go up the stairs in the **north-east** corner and enter the portal: you are teleported to **Darashia**. A {creature:Ghost} guards the portal; you can kill it or ignore it.
In Darashia take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet to continue your trip.

In the hold of the south boat (**west** stairs, the one with the Plate Armor Quest reward) there are 2 {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, 1 {creature:Demon Skeleton} and 1 {creature:Ghost}; {creature:Captain Jones} may also show up.
Small hill with {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} on the surface, **north-east of Edron** and west of Cyclopolis; north-east of it there is a small graveyard with skeletons and ghouls (the Unholy Cemetery).
Get to **Edron**: by boat (at your city's captain say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seahorse}, {coord:33176,31764,6}) or by magic carpet (you arrive at {npc:Pino}).
Leave Edron to the **north**/north-east, on foot across the surface (you do not need a rope or a shovel). On the way you pass the {creature:Hunter|Hunters}' camp.
You reach the Ghoul Hill ({coord:33203,31680,7}); the Unholy Cemetery is right next to it, on the surface ({coord:33196,31695,7}).
Walk back **south** to Edron, the same way.
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Watch out for the {creature:Hunter|Hunters} at the camp you pass. In the graveyard to the north-east there are also {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia

Old ruined glooth factory in the **west** part of Rathleton (Lower Rathleton), in {wiki:Oramond}, abandoned after an accident; the new factory is the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory}, in the Workshop Quarter.
At the **Thais** harbour talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You land on a raft **west** of Oramond, next to {npc:Captain Gulliver} ({coord:33479,31986,7}).

Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island, where there are minotaurs ({coord:33539,32014,7}). Go down to the ground floor and head **east** to some buildings with a small boat: the boat's portal ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you to the other side of the water, closer to the city.
From there head **north** to the main gate of Rathleton. With the *Citizen* rank of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}, the Slime Slide next to the boat takes you directly to the city.
In Lower Rathleton, the factory is the big ruined building across the street from {npc:Fillias} ({coord:33549,31928,7}).
Leave the building through the same door to the Lower Rathleton street.

To leave Oramond, do the route in reverse to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide takes you back to the boat) and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp). With the Citizen rank he also takes you to **Edron**, **Venore**, **Port Hope** and **Krailos**; **Issavi** is always available.
Inside the factory (lots of Steel Spiders)
Path from the raft to Rathleton
The path between the raft and the city goes past minotaurs: the wiki advises level ~100 or going in a group (or having the Citizen rank to use the direct Slime Slide).
Three small caves of {creature:Gnarlhound|Gnarlhounds} scattered across the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, in the {wiki:Zao Orc Land}, east of the Farmine mountain.
{spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) to go down the mountain between the Farmine elevator and the steppe.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya}. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}).

In Farmine head **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, go through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the pass **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate}, until you come out onto the Zao Steppe ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
The three caves are **north-east** of that exit: {coord:33119,31457,7}, {coord:33193,31473,7} and {coord:33101,31389,7} (the last one further **north**).
Leave the cave by the same spot and go back across the steppe to the **south-west** to the pass at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
In Farmine talk to {npc:Thorgrin} at the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp) and {key:yes}.
Exit of the Farmine pass onto the Zao Steppe

The entrances are surrounded by {creature:Gnarlhound|Gnarlhounds}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen}, {creature:Orc|Orcs} and {creature:Sandcrawler|Sandcrawlers}; {creature:Orc Marauder|Orc Marauders} patrol the steppe.

Outpost of gnomes and dwarves in the war against *Those Below*, very deep **under the sea to the east**; you enter from Kazordoon and it is the base of the {wiki:Dangerous Depths Quest} and of Warzones 4, 5 and 6.
Gnome Deep Hub entrance (Kazordoon, near the north blesser)
To use the {wiki:Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} you need level 80+ and {npc:Xelvar}'s permission; each trip uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp).

Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} (with {npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine (with {npc:Thorgrin}), saying {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the underground harbour next to {npc:Brodrosch}. You can also go on foot through the mountain entrance (bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}).
In Kazordoon, go to the blesser in the **north** of the city, **4 floors below** ground level, and enter the Gnome Deep Hub passage ({coord:32624,31868,11}).
Alternatively, at level 80+, use the GCTS crystal teleport right next to the entrance ({coord:32628,31863,11}).
You arrive at the hub, under the sea to the east ({coord:33752,32190,14}); {npc:Gnomus} is just **north** of where you arrive.
From the Warzones, go back through the Lava Pump room and along the Warzone path to the hub.
From the hub, leave through the same entrance to **Kazordoon** ({coord:32624,31868,11}).

To leave Kazordoon: take {npc:Brodrosch}'s {wiki:Steamship} ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), use the crystal teleport next to the hub entrance, or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
Descent to Gnomus's task area (east of the hub)
High-level area (the wiki recommends 100+): {creature:Deepworm|Deepworms}, {creature:Diremaw|Diremaws} and {creature:Lava Lurker|Lava Lurkers} in the hunting areas around the hub.
Base of the Bigfoot Company's elite soldiers, a separate part of {wiki:Gnomegate}; from here you go to the {wiki:Mushroom Gardens}, the Hot Spot, the Golem Workshop and Warzones 1 to 3.
**Premium** and **Rank II** (more than 120 reputation points) in the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} to use the Gnomegate {item:Large Crystal Teleporter}.
Access to the {wiki:GCTS|GCTS} (level 80 and {npc:Xelvar}'s permission) and one {item:Teleport Crystal} for each GCTS entry and exit.

Go to {wiki:Gnomegate} through the GCTS: in **Kazordoon**, enter the teleport **east** of {npc:Xelvar}, next to the north blesser ({coord:32628,31863,11}); there are also GCTS teleports in Thais, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay and Svargrond. You use up one {item:Teleport Crystal}.
From the GCTS hub go down to Gnomegate.
In Gnomegate enter the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} that leads to Gnomebase Alpha ({coord:32797,31779,10}).
You arrive at Gnomebase Alpha ({coord:32989,31884,9}); {npc:Gnomeral} is in the **west** part of the base.
Use the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia} ({coord:32979,31868,9}) to go back to Gnomegate.
In Gnomegate go up to the GCTS hub and enter the teleport of the city you want to go to (Kazordoon, Thais, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Svargrond). You use up another {item:Teleport Crystal}.
Large Crystal Teleporter to Gnomebase Alpha (Gnomegate)
Gnomincia, next to the teleport back to Gnomegate
Ramp to the Mushroom Gardens (south of the base)
Spiral stairs to the Mushroom Gardens
Always bring at least two {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals}; {npc:Gnomincia} also sells them.

Underground city of the gnomes and base of the Bigfoot Company, hidden beneath Ferngrims Gate and the sea between Venore and Edron; you can only reach it through the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} (GCTS).

**Level 80** and {npc:Xelvar}'s permission in Kazordoon — this is the start of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}: {key:hi}, {key:adventures}, {key:recruiting}, {key:partners}, {key:gnomes}, {key:help}, {key:join}.
One {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp) for each GCTS entry and each exit.
Go to **Kazordoon** and look for {npc:Xelvar} ({coord:32622,31861,11}). If you do not have access yet, ask him for permission (see requirements).
Enter the GCTS teleport that is **east** of Xelvar, near the north blesser ({coord:32628,31863,11}). You use up one {item:Teleport Crystal}.

There are also GCTS teleports in **Thais** (Ancient Temple, {coord:32331,32173,9}), **Edron** (sewers, {coord:33154,31835,10}), **Darashia** (mountain to the north-west, {coord:33186,32384,8}), **Liberty Bay** (mountains to the south-east, {coord:32403,32817,6}) and **Svargrond** (hole next to the west exit, {coord:32196,31183,8}).
You appear at the GCTS hub, above the Gnomebase, where {npc:Gnomette} is ({coord:32799,31765,9}). Go down to Gnomegate; {npc:Gnomally} is in the **north** part ({coord:32794,31746,10}).
Go up from Gnomegate to the GCTS hub (the teleport room where {npc:Gnomette} is).

Enter the teleport of the city you want to go to: **Kazordoon** (next to the north blesser), **Thais** (Ancient Temple), **Edron** (sewers), **Darashia** (mountain to the north-west), **Liberty Bay** (mountains to the south-east) or **Svargrond** (hole next to the west exit). You use up another {item:Teleport Crystal}.

Always bring at least **two** {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals} (there and back). You can buy them from {npc:Xelvar} ({key:trade}), {npc:Gnomette}, {npc:Gnomincia} (Gnomebase Alpha) or on the Market.
Primal Menace teleport (north of the Monster Graveyard)

The gnomes' crystal golem workshop, connected to the **south** part of {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha}, with {creature:Damaged Crystal Golem|Damaged Crystal Golems} and {creature:Enraged Crystal Golem|Enraged Crystal Golems}; this is where the mission *The Tinker's Bell* of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} takes place.
You need access to the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}: **level 80** and {npc:Xelvar}'s permission in Kazordoon (start of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}).
The teleport to Gnomebase Alpha only works from **Rank II** of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest and with a **Premium Account**.
Each GCTS trip uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp).

In **Kazordoon**, enter the GCTS teleport **east** of {npc:Xelvar}, next to the north blesser ({coord:32628,31863,11}). There are also GCTS teleports in Thais (Ancient Temple), Edron (sewers), Darashia, Liberty Bay and Svargrond.
You appear at the GCTS hub, above Gnomegate: go down to Gnomegate.
In Gnomegate, enter the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} that leads to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha} ({coord:32797,31779,10}).
In Gnomebase Alpha, enter the crystal teleport furthest **south**: it takes you to the Golem Workshop ({coord:32943,31953,10}).
Leave through the teleport you came in by: you return to Gnomebase Alpha ({npc:Gnomeral} is in the **west** part).
Use the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia} ({coord:32979,31868,9}) to go back to Gnomegate.
Go up to the GCTS hub (where {npc:Gnomette} is) and enter the teleport of the city you want to go to, using up another {item:Teleport Crystal}.
Gnomincia, next to the teleport back to Gnomegate
The largest of the {wiki:Forbidden Islands}, **north-west of Liberty Bay**: a dry, hot island with a large volcano, home to a voodoo cult and many undead pirates.
Jack Fate's ship on the east coast of Goroma
{npc:Jack Fate} only takes you to Goroma after you do the *Access to Goroma* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.
To get past the electric sparks and enter the deepest part of the island you have to complete the {wiki:VoodooMaster Quest}.
Go to **Liberty Bay** and, at the harbour, talk to the captain {npc:Jack Fate} on his boat.
Say {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). He drops you at his ship, stranded on the **east** coast of Goroma ({coord:32161,32558,6}).
The centre of the island is **west** of the ship ({coord:32095,32583,7}); the {wiki:Hellgore} volcano is to the south ({coord:32097,32631,7}).
Go back to {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship on the **east** coast of the island ({coord:32161,32558,6}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:passage} (or {key:liberty bay}) and {key:yes}: he takes you back to **Liberty Bay**.
Jack Fate — arrival and return (east of Goroma)

On the boat trip between Liberty Bay and Thais (at level 20 or higher) there is about an 8% chance of being shipwrecked on Goroma. In that case you can only leave by collecting 30 {item:Wood} to repair the boat ({creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls} drop wood).

Level 60+ recommended (knights 70+): there are {creature:Pirate Ghost|Pirate Ghosts}, {creature:Blood Crab|Blood Crabs}, {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons} in the volcano.

During the {wiki:Fire from the Earth Mini World Change} the volcano fills up with {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters} and {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}: wait for it to end.

Small graveyard very deep in the tunnels of {wiki:Mount Sternum}, north-east of Thais; it was once Thais's municipal cemetery and now has {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Rat|Rats} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}.
Mount Sternum centre stairs (near the graveyard)
Get to **Thais** (by boat: tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}) and leave on foot to the **north-east** to {wiki:Mount Sternum} ({coord:32494,32072,7}), on the way to Kazordoon.
Find the hole in the centre of the mountain and go down to the Mount Sternum centre stairs ({coord:32441,32008,13}).
Follow the path on the map below to the **west** and then to the **north**: you pass through the Graveyard of the Doomed.
Go back the same way to the stairs in the centre of the mountain ({coord:32441,32008,13}) and go up to the surface (use the {item:Rope} where needed).
From there walk back to the **south-west** to Thais.
Mount Sternum: entrance and hole in the centre of the mountain
Path through the Graveyard of the Doomed
There are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} on the way; on the floors below (Undead Cave) the creatures get stronger.
Small village in the south of the island of {wiki:Quirefang}, in the seas east of Zao, with no houses but with a depot and a temple underground; you can only get there through {wiki:Gray Island}.
Take a boat to {wiki:Gray Island} in **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** or **Edron** (150 gp): talk to the harbour captain and say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes}.
On Gray Island enter the **only hole** on the island, **south** of {npc:Scrutinon} ({coord:33189,31982,7}).
On floor -1 follow the underground passage **north-east** and enter the {item:Water Vortex}.
On the other side use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground to go up and head **north** to Gray Beach. The depot and the temple are underground, **north-west** of the village.
Do the underground passage in reverse: head back **south** to the rope spot, go down and enter the {item:Water Vortex} to return to Gray Island.
On Gray Island talk to {npc:Scrutinon} ({coord:33189,31982,7}): he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:venore}, and {key:yes}).
Scrutinon (Gray Island) — hole south of him
Hole south-east of Gray Beach (to Fiehonja)
To the north is the {wiki:Hive} (Hive Born) and to the south-east, underground, {wiki:Fiehonja} (Deeplings): these are high-level hunting areas.
Islet **south of Edron** and west of Cormaya, with a sundial, the boatman {npc:Scrutinon} and a single hole that gives access to the underground passage to {wiki:Quirefang} and {wiki:Gray Beach}.

There are only boats to the island from **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** and **Edron** (150 gp): at the harbour tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} (in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}; in Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}).
Talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore, whichever city you came from ({key:hi}, city name, for example {key:venore}, and {key:yes}).

For Quirefang/Gray Beach: enter the hole **south** of Scrutinon, head **north-east** on floor -1 and enter the {item:Water Vortex}; on the other side use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground and head **north** to Gray Beach ({coord:33471,31304,7}).
Gray Beach (end of the underground passage)

Undersea reef beneath the main island of **Marapur**, reached by diving into a vortex on the west island of the Stardance Mountains; home of the {creature:Foam Stalker|Foam Stalkers} and the {creature:Two-Headed Turtle|Two-Headed Turtles}.
Access to Marapur: you need the {wiki:The Lost Brother Quest} and the {item:Asuri Talisman} (first part of the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest}) to use the portal in the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains}.
A diving helmet: {item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea}.

Go to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains}, between Tiquanda and Ankrahmun, and enter the portal at the top of the mountain (floor +5, {coord:33037,32738,2}) with the {item:Asuri Talisman}: you are taken to Marapur. Many routes to the upper floors can only be done with {spell:Levitate}.
In Marapur, go to the **west** island of the Stardance Mountains.
Put on the {item:Helmet of the Deep} (or the {item:Depth Galea}) and jump into the vortex ({coord:33743,32779,7}): you arrive at the reef, beneath the island ({coord:33743,32774,8}).
Keep the helmet on, go back to the area where you fell through the vortex and climb up the same way to the surface.
To leave Marapur, use {npc:Ziyad}'s magic carpet in Moonfall ({coord:33804,32769,2}): say {key:hi} and ask him about destinations (Premium only).
Great Pearl Fan Reef (beneath the island)
Do not take off the diving helmet while you are on the reef.
There are {creature:Foam Stalker|Foam Stalkers}, {creature:Two-Headed Turtle|Two-Headed Turtles} and {creature:Venerable Foam Stalker|Venerable Foam Stalkers}.

Dangerous swamp between **Kazordoon and Venore**, west/northwest of Venore, with amazons, valkyries, witches and many poisonous creatures; it has the Venore Amazon Camp, Villa Scapula, the Dusalk troll clan cave and the Tainted Caves.
If you are not in **Venore**, take a boat (from the harbour captain in your city: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Fearless}).
Cross the swamp from Venore's **northwest** exit; or leave through the **southwest** exit and follow the road **northwest**, towards the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}.
You can also come from the **west** (from Kazordoon) over the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge} and walk **east**.

Inside the swamp, use the {item:Machete} on the {item:Jungle Grass} blocking the paths. Useful entrances: Venore Rotworm Cave ({coord:32699,32018,7}, open the {item:Loose Stone Pile} with the {item:Shovel}), the Tainted Caves to the **north** ({coord:32711,31939,7}) and the hole on the north side of the swamp ({coord:32737,31953,7}).
If you are in one of the caves, go back the same way to the swamp (use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through).
From the swamp, go back **southeast** along the road to Venore's southwest exit, or **east** to the city's northwest entrance. Alternatively, head **west** to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}.
In Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).

Bring {item:Antidote Potion|antidotes}: there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions} and other poisonous creatures, as well as {creature:Amazon|Amazons}, {creature:Valkyrie|Valkyries} and {creature:Witch|Witches}. In some spots a {creature:Mummy}, a {creature:Black Knight} or even a {creature:Giant Spider} shows up.
Small, quiet village on a peninsula **north of Thais**, reached through a mountain pass; it has the ship *The Tibianic*, Greenshore Villa and, near the pass, a hole to the orc caves beneath Thais.
Go to **Thais** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the harbour of {npc:Captain Bluebear}).
Leave Thais and follow the dirt path **north**, through the mountain pass, to the village ({coord:32262,32074,7}).

Enter the village by the ramp ({coord:32304,32119,7}). To the west, a small bridge leads to the area where {creature:Insectoid Scout|Insectoid Scouts} appear during the {wiki:Insectoid Invasion World Change}.
For the orc caves: after crossing the bridge, there is a hole hidden behind a tree, a few steps **north** of the ramps ({coord:32300,32097,7}).
Go back the same way: cross the bridge to the **east**, leave the village by the ramp ({coord:32304,32119,7}) and follow the dirt path **south** to Thais.
If you went down into the caves, climb back up through the same holes (with the {item:Rope}) to the hole hidden behind the tree.
Hole hidden behind the tree (orc caves)
On the surface there are only weak creatures; in the hidden hole there are {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}.

Small island **northeast of Stonehome and Edron**, with a cursed village: around the full moon (12th to 14th of each month, peaking on the 13th) the {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and {creature:Badger|Badgers} give way to were-creatures.
Travel to **Edron** (from the harbour captain in your city: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; from Thais it is {npc:Captain Bluebear}, 160 gp).
In Edron, walk **northeast** to **Stonehome**. North of Stonehome is {npc:Cornell}'s small boat ({coord:33305,31720,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:sail} (or {key:passage}) and {key:yes}: the trip to Grimvale costs **100 gp**.
You land at the **south** dock of Grimvale ({coord:33341,31694,7}), near the village.
If you are in the dungeon, go back the same way to the surface, climbing up with the {item:Rope} through the floors you came down.
At the **south** dock of the island ({coord:33341,31694,7}) say {key:hi}, {key:sail} and {key:yes} to {npc:Cornell} (100 gp). He takes you back to **Edron**, to the dock north of Stonehome.
In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination (for example {key:thais}) and {key:yes}.
Dungeon entrance pitfall (northeast of the island)
Maeryn (small house in the southwest of the village)

From the server save on the 12th to the one on the 15th of each month (full moon) the surface fills with {creature:Werebadger|Werebadgers} and {creature:Wereboar|Wereboars}; on the lower floors there are also {creature:Werebear|Werebears} and {creature:Werewolf|Werewolves}. The wiki lists level 100 for hunting here.
You enter the dungeon by falling through the {item:Pitfall} in the northeast of the island: bring a {item:Rope} so you can climb back up.

Sealed tunnels at the bottom of the {wiki:Dwarf Mines}, **west of Kazordoon**, closed after a cave-in that killed the famous dwarven kisser Shearton Softbeard; today they are full of {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}.
The sealed tunnel door only opens with {npc:Budrik}'s permission: give him 5 {item:Pick|Picks} ({key:hi}, {key:pick}, {key:yes}) in the {wiki:Kissing a Pig Quest}.
Walk to the {wiki:Dwarf Mines}, **west** of Kazordoon (northeast of Thais), and enter through the surface entrance ({coord:32531,31914,7}).
Walk a little **north** and go down the hole: you are on the first underground floor, where {npc:Budrik} is ({coord:32524,31906,8}).
Go **west**, take the lower passage and go down another hole; then go straight down the nearest hole (2 sqm away).
Go **west** (there are {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}) and go down one more hole.
Pass 3–4 {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}, walk a little **south**: to the **west** is the sealed door of the Grothmok Tunnel. {npc:A Dwarven Ghost} is at the far end ({coord:32410,31918,12}).
Go back the same way, climbing up with the {item:Rope} through all the holes you came down, up to Budrik's floor.
Climb to the surface through the Dwarf Mines entrance and walk back **east** to Kazordoon (or **southwest** to Thais).
In the tunnel there are 5 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}; along the way you meet {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers}, {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.
Lava cave **far below the {wiki:Ice Islands}**, the second zone of the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}; you get there through the hub teleport of {npc:Gnomevisor}, beneath the Kazordoon crypt.
Premium account and the **Recruitment** mission of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}.
You need the **level 2 crystal shield** from the {wiki:Too Hot to Handle Quest}: with 20 splinters say {key:shield} to {npc:Gnomevisor}.

Go to **Kazordoon**. The simplest way is the {wiki:Steamship}: in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}); in Cormaya go down 8 floors to {npc:Gurbasch} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. There is also a steamship from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}).
Go down to the Kazordoon crypt (floor 9, 2 floors below ground level), where {npc:Gnomystery} ({coord:32610,31878,9}) and {npc:Brodraem Orcbeard} are.

Walk **north** in the crypt to the great rift ({coord:32603,31845,9}) and walk towards it until you fall to the floor below; go through the teleport and you reach {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub ({coord:32661,31825,10}).

Enter the Grotto of the Lost teleport (level 2 shield or higher). For the tasks, go down the stairs (or levitate) and head **northwest** to the ramp ({coord:32176,31417,15}); the task teleports are above it.
Go back to the teleport you came in through: it takes you to {npc:Gnomevisor}'s hub.

From the hub, go back to the Kazordoon crypt and climb up to the city (the wiki does not describe this climb in detail). At the underground port, {npc:Brodrosch} takes you by steamship to Cormaya or Farmine.
Zone for **level 350+** with fire creatures: {creature:Lavafungus}, {creature:Lavaworm} and {creature:Streaked Devourer}.
The shield loses 1 point every 5 seconds inside the crypts: leave before it reaches zero.
The 8 rooms of the monster puzzle
Maze map (you start in the north-west)
Path around the ruins to the lever room
Arrival at the Grounds of Fire
Shortcut teleport (after the first Lord of the Lice)
Rocky valley full of ruins in **Roshamuul**, between the Lower Roshamuul bridge and the wall of {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}; very high-level hunting zone (Frazzlemaws, Guzzlemaws, Silencers).
The valley is only accessible once the Roshamuul **bridge** has been repaired (it depends on your server's stage in the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest}).
In **Thais**, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the harbour: {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp).
The boat docks at the southern camp, in {wiki:Lower Roshamuul}, next to {npc:Captain Chelop} ({coord:33493,32569,7}).
Go up the ramp from the boat and the camp and cross the **bridge** to the **north**: on the other side the Guzzlemaw Valley begins.
The **west** part has ruins with stairs (temporary shelter); to the **east/northeast** is the wall to Upper Roshamuul ({coord:33632,32401,7}) and, to the **southeast**, the {wiki:Silencer Plateau}.
Go back **south** over the bridge and down the ramp to the Lower Roshamuul camp.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul

Zone for level **200–250+**: {creature:Frazzlemaw|Frazzlemaws}, {creature:Guzzlemaw|Guzzlemaws}, {creature:Silencer|Silencers} and {creature:Shock Head|Shock Heads}. Bring protection against Life Drain.
If few Blowing Horns tasks were done the previous day, {creature:Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender} may appear anywhere in the valley.
Go **east** and go up the stairs. Keep heading **south** and go down the stairs.
Portal to the Halls of Ascension
Surface temple of the Astral Shapers, **north of Thais**; once restored (in the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}) it has six coloured portals to the boss areas.
The portals only appear once the temple is restored (you hand over {item:Heavy Old Tome|Heavy Old Tomes} to {npc:Albinius}: {key:hi}, {key:temple}, {key:yes}).

Each portal, except the fire one, is paid for once to Albinius by saying the portal's name: {key:energy portal} (50 {item:Marsh Stalker Feather|Marsh Stalker Feathers}), {key:death portal} (50 {item:Pelvis Bone|Pelvis Bones}), {key:ice portal} (50 {item:Fish}), {key:earth portal} (50 {item:Acorn|Acorns}) and {key:holy portal} (50 {item:Incantation Notes}).
The **Fire Portal** only lets through those who have completed the whole {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Go to **Thais** (by boat, you arrive at {npc:Captain Bluebear}, {coord:32310,32210,6}).
Leave the city through the **north** exit and keep walking **north** to the temple ({coord:32326,32090,7}).
Take the same path **south** to Thais.
If you used one of the portals, go back to the spot where you arrived in the boss area: each area has a matching portal that brings you back to the Halls of Hope.
Earth Portal → near the Desecrated Glade (Mounted Thorn Knight)
In a new world the temple starts unfinished: no portals, just ruins and an {item:Imbuing Shrine}.
Street in the **centre-west of Thais**, next to the harbour: it has the boat of {npc:Captain Bluebear}, the docks, the depot, the paladin guild, a watchtower and, to the south, the {wiki:Thais Jail}.
Captain Bluebear (Thais harbour, northwest of the street)

Go to **Thais** by boat: at your city's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain (for example {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore). You arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}), on the 2nd floor of the harbour, in the **northwest** of Harbour Street.

Go down from the harbour to the street. Harbour Street meets Main Street to the **north**, Sorcerer's Avenue to the **west** and the Swamp Lanes to the **east/southeast**; if you are in the temple, head south/west down to the harbour.
The street is part of the city: walk wherever you need through the streets of Thais.
To leave the city by boat, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the harbour: {key:hi}, the city name (for example {key:carlin}, {key:venore} or {key:edron}) and {key:yes}.
Tower at the end of Harbour Street
Taking ectoplasm from a Mutated Egg

Secret office and underground prison of the Planegazers, somewhere in the east of the map; the only way in is through the {item:Energy Gate} that opens at the forge in the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub} during the {wiki:Opticording Sphere Quest}.
You must have completed the previous steps of the {wiki:Opticording Sphere Quest} (goggles used at the five forges and the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere}).
You need access to the task area of {npc:Gnomus} in the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub}.
Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}), with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}, or on foot through the mountain entrance.
The entrance to the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub} is in Kazordoon, near the **north** blesser, 4 floors below ground level ({coord:32624,31868,11}); the GCTS crystal is right next to it.

In the hub, enter the task area of {npc:Gnomus}: go to the **easternmost** part, go down at the marked spot ({coord:33838,32178,14}), go up the next ramp and follow the cave **east** to the **Lost Ruin** ({coord:33980,32177,14}).
Use the {item:Skull Pillar (Stone)|Skull Pillar} once and the {item:Pillar Vine} once: you are sent to the forge.

At the forge, use the {item:Opticorder Rectifier} with the {item:Complete Opticording Sphere} in your backpack; a portal appears on the other side of the room. Enter the {item:Energy Gate}: you are at the headquarters.
The wiki describes no other exit: go back the same way to the Gnome Deep Hub forge and return to the hub through the area of {npc:Gnomus}.

Leave the hub through the **Kazordoon** entrance ({coord:32624,31868,11}) or use the GCTS crystal next to it. At Kazordoon's underground harbour, {npc:Brodrosch} takes you by steamship to Cormaya or Farmine.
Inside there are {creature:Ghost of a Planegazer|Ghosts of a Planegazer} and a portal to the Chamber of Reflections, where you can fight boss reflections and the {creature:Last Planegazer}.
Small island **northeast of {wiki:Hrodmir}**, near Svargrond, overrun by undead because of a necromantic experiment by {creature:Braindeath}; below it is a multi-floor dungeon.
You can only go to the island after reaching the mission *The Secret of Helheim* in the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} ({npc:Hjaern} gives you permission).
Go to **Svargrond** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to the captain of Carlin, Thais or Venore).
From Svargrond, go **south** to the boat of {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32254,31195,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:helheim} and {key:yes}. When he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay **50 gp**. You land at {coord:32465,31174,7}.
To enter the dungeon, go **southeast** from the boat and climb the mountain/stairs; then head **northeast** and go down (2 ramps / through the hole) to the first floor.
Go back the same way to the surface: climb the stairs and ramps you came down (use the {item:Rope} on the hole at the start).
Outside, go down the mountain to the **southwest** and back **northwest** to the boat of {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32465,31174,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} and {key:yes} (say {key:no} if he asks for the Dwarven Ring and pay 50 gp). You end up at the dock **south** of Svargrond.
{npc:Buddel} sometimes drops you on the wrong island: if that happens, ask for the trip again.

Right at the entrance there are {creature:Mummy|Mummies} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}; on the lower floors there are {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and, in closed rooms, the {creature:Braindeath} and the {creature:Elder Bonelord}.
Ancient dungeon with no protection zone **beneath Ab'Dendriel**, where the elves throw criminals; it has the {wiki:Hellgate Library}, the treasure room and the entrance to {wiki:Draconia}.
You need the {item:Key 3012} to open the two entrance doors; {npc:Elathriel} sells it to you for **5000 gp**.
Travel to **Ab'Dendriel** (for example from Thais, on the boat of {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}).
In Ab'Dendriel, go down to the floor below (the shop area), go down again next to the little houses and go down once more.

Head **south** and then **east** to the door with the *Hellgate* painting ({coord:32676,31672,10}) and open it with the {item:Key 3012}. If you do not have it, the guard {npc:Elathriel}, nearby ({coord:32684,31671,9}), sells it to you for 5000 gp.

Just to the **north** there is a second door that also requires the {item:Key 3012}. Go through it and enter the portal to Hellgate ({coord:32675,31647,10}). **Do not** use the portal on the **west** side of the room: that one takes you out.
In Hellgate you appear on a platform with a staircase: go up it to start exploring.

The Ab'Dendriel portal is **one-way only**: leave on foot via the {wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}. Go back to the first crossing next to the entrance staircase and follow the long corridor **west** (only {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}); go down the hole at the end.
Go **east** along another long corridor (more Skeletons) and go down the next hole.
Go **west** and loop around the long corridor (only {creature:Spider|Spiders} and Skeletons) to the rope spot (the yellow circle on the map) and go up with the {item:Rope}.

Go **southeast** (a few {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}), go down the hole, walk a little **south** (2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}) and go up. Follow the path **south** (more Ghouls and Rotworms) and go up again.
Go **south** and go down the **first** hole you see (the second rope spot has {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and 1 Ghoul).
Go **west** and cross the big Ghoul room (about 15 Ghouls, about 5 Skeletons and 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}) hugging the **south** wall; go down the hole.
Go **northwest** (no monsters), go up **2 floors** with {spell:Levitate} or by stacking 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}, and go up the staircase.
Go **southwest** and go up through the hole (do not take the hole to the **southeast**: it goes down to the lava floor).
If the bridge on the floor above is raised, pull the lever. Then follow the only way up (lots of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}) until you come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel ({coord:32603,31705,7}).
In Ab'Dendriel, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to Carlin, Edron, Thais, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Exit 1: Skeleton corridor west from the entrance staircase
Exit 2: corridor east to the next hole
Exit 3: go back along the Spider corridor to the rope spot
Exit 4 and 5: Rotworm cave, to the south
Exit: big Ghoul room (hugging the south wall)
Exit: go up 2 floors with Levitate or Parcels
Exit: hole to the southwest, bridge and path to the surface

There is no protection zone in Hellgate and the way out is long: Skeletons, Ghouls, Bonelords and, sometimes, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords} drawn in by other players.
Always bring a {item:Rope} and 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} (or {spell:Levitate}): without them you cannot get out.
There is an alternative exit through {wiki:Draconia} and the {wiki:Redbone Castle}, but from the Redbone Castle onwards the path is one-way up to the surface of Draconia.

Deep cave beneath the island of {wiki:Goroma}, **northwest of Liberty Bay**, full of Ghazbaran cultists, fire creatures and, at the bottom, {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}.
{npc:Jack Fate} will only take you to Goroma after you complete *Access to Goroma* in the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.
Go to **Liberty Bay** by boat (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron or {npc:Captain Sinbeard} in Ankrahmun: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}).
At the Liberty Bay harbour, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} on his boat: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You land on the **east** side of Goroma ({coord:32161,32556,6}).
Cross the island to the **southwest** to the cave entrance ({coord:32097,32631,7}) and go down.
Climb back up the same way to the surface of Goroma.
Go back to the boat of {npc:Jack Fate}, on the **east** of the island, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Jack Fate's boat in the east of Goroma (arrival and return)
Kerberos boss teleport (Killing in the Name of)
On the surface of Goroma you may find {creature:Crab|Crabs}, {creature:Island Troll|Island Trolls}, {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons} and {creature:Pirate Ghost|Pirate Ghosts}.

Zone for level 80–100+: {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} right on floor -1; on floor -3 there are dozens of {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes} and {creature:Adept of the Cult|Adepts of the Cult}, {creature:Witch|Witches} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}; further down there are Demons.
This cave does **not** lead to the forbidden island of Ramoa: the only connection is the Goroma volcano.

Large cave (also called Edron Ruins) beneath the valley **north of Edron**, near Cyclopolis and the dragon lairs; it has the main Demon and Hero spawn and many quests (Annihilator, Demon Helmet, Ring, Double Hero, among others).

If you are not in **Edron**, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the Edron harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}).
From the harbour, leave the city to the **north** to the valley north of Edron: the Hero Cave entrance is at {coord:33164,31638,7}.
{creature:Hunter|Hunters} (and {creature:Poacher|Poachers}) guard the entrance. Go in and down the hole.

Inside, follow the maps for each floor (images below) and use the {item:Rope} and the {item:Shovel} on the holes. The main floor for the quests and the Demons is the **6th floor** of the cave (floor -6).
Go back the **same way**: follow the maps in reverse, climb the stairs you came by and use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through, up to the Hero Cave entrance.
Outside, head **south** to the city of **Edron**.
To leave the island, talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the harbour: {key:hi}, the city name (for example {key:thais}) and {key:yes}.
Ungreez room (4 floors below the entrance)
Teleport to the Demon Wars area

The {creature:Hunter|Hunters} at the entrance attack from a distance; on the lower floors there are {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and, at the bottom, {creature:Demon|Demons} and {creature:Hero|Heroes}. The wiki recommends level 50+ (mages) to 70+ (knights), and 130+ for the Demons.
Small lizard dungeon for beginners on the island of {wiki:Targuna} (the island new players go to after {wiki:Newhaven}), reached by some stairs in the north of the island.
Hidden Lizard Temple entrance (stairs, north of Targuna)
Only on {wiki:Targuna}: you arrive on the island at the end of the {wiki:Newhaven} tutorial. The island is designed for levels 8 to 20.
On Targuna, talk to {npc:Lizzie} in the **south** of the island ({coord:31941,31920,7}) — {key:hi}, {key:save}, {key:yes} — and she marks the temple entrance on your map.
Head **north** and go down the entrance stairs ({coord:31936,31863,7}).
After defeating the {creature:Lizard Commander}, enter the portal: it takes you back to Targuna.
If you need to leave earlier, go up the same entrance stairs ({coord:31936,31863,7}).

To leave Targuna, {npc:Captain Indigo} ({coord:31973,31892,6}) takes you to **Thais** ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}) if you pay 5000 gp or have a {item:Sail Pass}. The wiki does not describe a way back from the mainland to Targuna.
The {creature:Lizard Commander} (160 HP) is much stronger than the other lizards; bring potions.
Outpost of the {wiki:Hive Born} in the **west of Vandura**, west of Liberty Bay, which only exists while the {wiki:Hive Outpost Mini World Change} is active.
It only exists on days when the {wiki:Hive Outpost Mini World Change} is active.
Take a boat to **Liberty Bay** (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}).
Leave the city and walk **west/southwest**, through the sugarcane fields, to the **west side of Vandura**.
