Look for the ramp that goes down to the ground floor of the outpost ({coord:32163,32838,7}). Inside you can go up or down: the strongest creatures are on the floors above and below.
Go back up the same ramp and walk back **east** to Liberty Bay, where you can take a boat.

It is full of Hive Born insects: {creature:Swarmer|Swarmers}, {creature:Insectoid Worker|Insectoid Workers}, {creature:Waspoid|Waspoids}, {creature:Crawler|Crawlers}, {creature:Spitter|Spitters}, {creature:Spidris} and {creature:Kollos}.

Lift that the Carlin miners installed in the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}, near **Svargrond**, to carry loads between floors; it works again once you recover the mine floor plan and the instructions ({wiki:Formorgar Mines Hoist Quest}).
Access to the Formorgar Mines: have done the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} up to the mission *Formorgar Mines 1: The Mission*. Premium account.

With the {item:Floor Plan of the Formorgar Mines (Book)|floor plan} you can go from floor 2 to 3; with the {item:Instructions to the Formorgar Mines Hoist (Book)|instructions} you can go from 3 to 2, from 2 to 3 and from 2 to 1. Without the floor plan you **cannot** go from floor 1 to 2.

Go to **Svargrond** (by boat from Carlin, Thais or Venore: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Breezelda} ({coord:32347,31108,6}), in the **east** part of the city.
Leave Svargrond to the **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the route across the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier} to the mine entrance ({coord:32145,31123,7}).
Go down the stairs: you are on the first floor of the Formorgar Mines ({coord:32146,31120,9}). The Hoist is near the entrance ramp (yellow circle on the first-floor map).
Alternatively, if you have unlocked the {item:Ice Portal} of the {wiki:Halls of Hope} (north of Thais), it takes you straight to a mine tunnel ({coord:32206,31027,10}).
With the instructions, use the Hoist to go up from floor 2 to floor 1; on the first floor, the ramp out of the mines is near the Hoist.

Outside, retrace the Formorgar Glacier route to **Svargrond** (go down with {spell:Levitate} where you went up) and take the boat of {npc:Captain Breezelda} ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:thais} or {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
Or go back through the Ice Portal ({coord:32206,31027,10}; first go up through the hole northeast of the portal with the {item:Rope}) to the Halls of Hope.
Ice Portal back to the Halls of Hope
Hole next to the Ice Portal (go up with the Rope)
Formorgar Mines entrance and Hoist location
Route from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines
First floor of the mines (the yellow circle is the exit ramp)

The lower floors of the mines have {creature:Enlightened of the Cult|Enlightened of the Cult}, {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} and even a {creature:Destroyer}: level 120 recommended.
Tomb of the pharaoh {creature:Horestis} in the desert **northwest of Ankrahmun**, with 6 hunting floors that get harder and harder; the entrance is 1 floor above the dragon spawn closest to the city.
Horestis Tomb entrance (1 floor above ground)
Travel to **Ankrahmun** by boat: at your city's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun} and {key:yes}. You arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}).
Leave the city to the **northwest**, through the desert, to the ramp at {coord:33061,32740,7}.
Go up the ramp and head straight **north**; the tomb entrance is 1 floor above ground, above the dragon spawn ({coord:33062,32731,6}). Follow the path that goes down to the tombs.
Inside you go down floor by floor using the stairs: the first underground floor is the easiest and each floor below is more dangerous.
Go back the same way: climb the stairs on each floor up to the entrance, go down the ramp ({coord:33061,32740,7}) and walk back to **Ankrahmun**, to the **southeast**.
At the Ankrahmun harbour, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
An Ancient Priest (next to the tomb entrance)
The entrance is above a dragon spawn: be careful on the way if you are a low level.
Levels recommended by the wiki: floor 1 from 20, floor 2 ~30, floor 3 ~35, floor 4 ~45, floor 5 ~45–50 and floor 6 ~65–70.

Lava hunting zone connected to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha}, the most dangerous of the five regular zones of the {wiki:Gnomegate}, with {creature:Massive Fire Elemental|Massive Fire Elementals}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Vulcongra|Vulcongras}; this is where the *Grindstone Hunt* of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} takes place.
You need access to the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}: **level 80** and {npc:Xelvar}'s permission in Kazordoon (start of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}).
The teleport to Gnomebase Alpha only works from **Rank II** of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest and with a **Premium Account**.
Each trip through the GCTS uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp): bring at least two.

In **Kazordoon**, enter the GCTS teleport **east** of {npc:Xelvar}, next to the north blesser ({coord:32628,31863,11}). There are also GCTS teleports in Thais (Ancient Temple), Edron (sewers), Darashia, Liberty Bay and Svargrond.
You appear at the GCTS hub, above Gnomegate: go down to Gnomegate.
In Gnomegate, enter the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} that leads to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha} ({coord:32797,31779,10}).
At Gnomebase Alpha, enter the crystal teleport in the **southwest** of the base (it is **southeast** of {npc:Gnomeral}): it takes you to the Hot Spot.
Leave the Hot Spot through the teleport you came in by: you return to Gnomebase Alpha.
Use the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia} ({coord:32979,31868,9}) to go back to Gnomegate.

Go up to the GCTS hub (where {npc:Gnomette} is) and enter the teleport of the city you want to go to (Kazordoon, Thais, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Svargrond), using one more {item:Teleport Crystal}.
Gnomincia, next to the teleport back to Gnomegate
The beams of the {creature:Vulcongra|Vulcongras} and the {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} do a lot of damage: do not pull more than 3 or 4 monsters at a time and bring company if you can.

The largest of the Ice Islands, **north of the main continent** and west of Yalahar: to the east is the city of **Svargrond**, in the centre the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier} (with the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} beneath it) and to the southwest the barbarian villages of Bittermor, Krimhorn and Ragnir.

Take a boat to **Svargrond**: {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin (110 gp), {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore (150 gp) or {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais (180 gp). Say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}.
You arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Breezelda}, in the **east** part of Svargrond.

For the barbarian villages in the southwest (and for {wiki:Tyrsung}, {wiki:Okolnir} or {wiki:Helheim}), go to {npc:Buddel}, **south** of Svargrond: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, the destination ({key:camp}, {key:tyrsung}, {key:okolnir}, {key:helheim}) and {key:yes}; it costs 50 gp. The villages are at {coord:32020,31294,7}.

For the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, leave Svargrond to the **west** and go up with {spell:Levitate}. For {wiki:Nibelor}, {npc:Iskan} (dog sled, on the ice **north** of the city) takes you with {key:hi}, {key:passage}, after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
If you are in the barbarian villages, return to Svargrond with {npc:Buddel}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
At the harbour, in the **east** of Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin (110 gp), Thais (180 gp) or Venore (150 gp): {key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}.

{npc:Buddel} is always drunk and often takes you to the wrong place. If you have a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he always gets it right (and you do not pay), but he keeps the ring; say {key:no} when he asks for it if you want to keep it.
On the glacier there are {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants}, {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.

Two caves on ice platforms on the **northwest coast of Hrodmir** (Svargrond's island), beyond the Formorgar Troll Caves and the {wiki:Barbarian Settlements}; full of Quara Scouts, good for low levels.
Go to **Svargrond** (by boat, for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}).

Head to the {wiki:Barbarian Settlements}, southwest of the city: with {npc:Buddel}, **south** of Svargrond ({coord:32254,31195,7}), say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:camp}, {key:yes} (50 gp; you need the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}); or on foot, leaving Svargrond to the **west** across the glacier and over a small bridge.

From there head **north/northwest**, past the Formorgar Troll Caves and the settlements (Bittermor is at {coord:31996,31233,7}), to the ice platforms on the northwest coast. The wiki does not describe the exact route.
Both caves are entered through holes: the **west** one at {coord:32023,31123,7} (larger, for levels 66–80) and the **east** one at {coord:32086,31093,7} (smaller, for levels 50–65).
Climb up the hole you came in by (use the {item:Rope}) and go back the same way **south** to the barbarian settlements.
At the boat of {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32020,31294,7}) say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} (50 gp), or walk back **east** across the glacier to Svargrond.
Buddel's boat at the Barbarian Settlements

When you go down either hole you may be surrounded straight away by 4–5 {creature:Quara Constrictor Scout|Constrictors} and {creature:Quara Mantassin Scout|Mantassins}: Poison Bomb or wall runes help.
On the way across the glacier there are {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.

Two caves of {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} on the island of {wiki:Hrodmir} (Svargrond's island), created for the tasks of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest}.
**Premium** account (Svargrond can only be reached by boat, carpet or GCTS).
Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Breezelda} ({coord:32347,31108,6}).

**Cave 1** (has two floors): it is **west** of Svargrond, at {coord:32065,31194,7}. The wiki only gives the coordinates: leave the city to the west, cross the small bridge and keep going until you get there.

**Cave 2**: it is at {coord:32081,31375,8}, **west** of the raiders' camp. To get there faster, in the south of Svargrond talk to {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32255,31197,7}): {key:hi} and {key:camp}; if he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring} say {key:no} and pay 50 gp. He drops you at {coord:32153,31375,7}.
Leave the cave by the same place you came in and walk back **east** to Svargrond (from the raiders' camp, {npc:Buddel} also takes you: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}).
In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin (110 gp), Thais (180 gp) or Venore (150 gp): {key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}.
Recommended level 15-20+: the {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} (270 HP) and the {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} (250 HP) can take a lot of hits.

Hunter camp surrounded by bamboo walls in the **Tiquanda** jungle, just north of the {wiki:Medusa Tower}; it only exists when the Hunters control the {wiki:Jungle Camp Mini World Change} (otherwise a Dworc Camp is there).
**Premium** account (to go by boat to Port Hope).
The camp is only the Hunter Camp when the Hunters control the world change; on other days the {wiki:Dworc Camp} is there.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** (for example, with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the dock of {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
Leave Port Hope and cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **east** to the square camp with bamboo walls ({coord:32900,32792,7}).
If you reach the {wiki:Medusa Tower} ({coord:32860,32829,7}), the camp is right to the **north** of it.
The camp is on the surface: take the same path through the jungle to the **west** to Port Hope.
In Port Hope take the boat of {npc:Charles} ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}) to wherever you want.
The camp's {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {creature:Poacher|Poachers} attack anyone who enters; the boss {creature:Arthom the Hunter} sometimes appears.
The Tiquanda jungle has dangerous creatures along the way.
Underground lairs of the {creature:Werehyaena|Werehyaenas} beneath the desert **north of Darashia**, where the *An Ancient Feud* part of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest} takes place.
Go to **Darashia**: for example {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}, 60 gp) or the flying carpet. You arrive at the harbour of {npc:Petros}.
Leave the city to the **north**, through the desert, to the entrance next to a big standing stone.
Go down through it to the first underground floor ({coord:33212,32359,8}).
Go back the same way: climb the rope spots with the {item:Rope} up to the entrance next to the big stone.

Return to Darashia to the **south**. At the harbour, {npc:Petros} takes you to Venore (60 gp), Ankrahmun (100), Liberty Bay (200), Port Hope (180), Yalahar (210), Gray Island (150), Issavi (130) or Krailos (110): {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}. {npc:Chemar} has the flying carpet.
Domizian (Grimvale Quest), west of the boat
Zone for level 200+: {creature:Werehyaena|Werehyaenas}, {creature:Werehyaena Shaman|Werehyaena Shamans} and {creature:Lich|Liches}.
Mountain in the **east of Tiquanda**, in the mountains between the jungle and Ankrahmun (north of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}), with {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.

The simplest way is from **Ankrahmun** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city). Leave the city to the **west** through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}: climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge up there and go down to the stairs on the jungle side.
From there head **north**, into the mountains where the hydra spawn is ({coord:32987,32681,7}) and Hydra Mountain ({coord:32978,32637,7}).
You can also come on foot from **Port Hope**, to the **east** through the Tiquanda jungle.
Go back **south** to the area of the wooden bridge of the Kha'zeel Pass (near {npc:Tarun}) and follow the pass **east** to Ankrahmun, or cross the jungle **west** to Port Hope.
In Ankrahmun {npc:Captain Sinbeard}, and in Port Hope {npc:Charles}, take you by boat to other cities.
Hydra spawn (mountains north of the pass)
Tarun (wooden bridge of the Kha'zeel Pass)

Two groups of icy islands in the Nordic Sea, **north of the continent**: the Southern Ice Islands (Folda, Senja, Vega), northwest of Carlin and open to Free Accounts, and the Northern Ice Islands (Premium), north of Carlin, with the city of Svargrond.
Nielson — ferry to the Southern Ice Islands (northwest of Carlin)
The Northern Ice Islands (Svargrond, Hrodmir, Nibelor, Grimlund, Okolnir, Tyrsung, Helheim) are for **Premium** accounts only.
{npc:Buddel} only travels with you after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}; the sled of {npc:Iskan} to Nibelor also requires the first mission of the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.

**Southern Ice Islands**: leave Carlin to the **northwest** to the ferry of {npc:Nielson} ({coord:32235,31675,7}). He takes you to {wiki:Folda}, {wiki:Senja} or {wiki:Vega} for 20 gp (say {key:hi} and the island name, for example {key:folda}). Between islands the trip costs 10 gp, with the ferrymen {npc:Svenson} (Folda), {npc:Anderson} (west of Senja) and {npc:Carlson} (east of Vega).

**Northern Ice Islands**: take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Breezelda} ({coord:32347,31108,6}). Svargrond also has a {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} ({coord:32252,31098,4}) to/from Darashia, Edron, Farmine, Femor Hills, Kazordoon and Issavi.

From Svargrond to the other northern islands: {npc:Buddel}, on the boat **south** of the city ({coord:32254,31195,7}), takes you to the barbarian camps ({key:camp}), to {wiki:Tyrsung} ({key:tyrsung}) or to {wiki:Okolnir} ({key:okolnir}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, destination (50 gp). For {wiki:Nibelor}, talk to {npc:Iskan} on the ice **north/northeast** of the city ({key:hi}, {key:passage}).
From the Southern Ice Islands: ask the island's ferryman for the trip back to the continent, which is **free**; you arrive at the ferry of {npc:Nielson}, northwest of Carlin.
From Svargrond: {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
From the other northern islands: return to Svargrond with {npc:Buddel} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}) or, on Nibelor, with the sled of {npc:Nilsor} ({key:hi}, {key:passage}).
The {wiki:Arctic Faun's Island} has no ferry: you only end up there by chance, in a random shipwreck on the {npc:Charles} shortcut from Port Hope.
{npc:Buddel} is drunk and sometimes takes you to the wrong place: ask again until you get there.

Cave beneath the western peninsula of the barbarian camps area, **southwest of {wiki:Bittermor}** (and of Svargrond), with {creature:Ice Witch|Ice Witches}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.
Recommended level: 60+ (mages), 70+ (paladins), 80+ (knights); for the first floor, level 70 is more or less enough.
The {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} pits, beneath the temple, can only be reached with {spell:Levitate}.
Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Breezelda}, in the **east** part of the city.
Leave Svargrond and walk **southwest**, over the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}, to the {wiki:Bittermor} area ({coord:32003,31228,7}).
Keep going **southwest**, to the western peninsula: the Ice Witch Temple entrance is at {coord:31923,31360,7}.
Go back the same way: leave the cave and head back **northeast**, past Bittermor and the Formorgar Glacier, to Svargrond.
In Svargrond take the boat of {npc:Captain Breezelda} ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Beneath the temple there are pits with {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling|Frost Dragon Hatchlings}.
The wiki does not describe a detailed route from Svargrond: use the coordinates on the map to find your way.
The Iks' "lost city of gold", now undead, hidden beneath the **Tiquanda** jungle, southeast of Port Hope; you enter through a secret passage in some ruins.
Access is obtained in the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}: you need {item:The Key Intihuatac}.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** (for example, with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}).
Cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **southeast** to the ruins where the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest} begins ({coord:32727,32876,7}).
Use {item:The Key Intihuatac} on the inscriptions: the secret passage takes you into Iksupan.
Go to the room with the **two blue flames**, on the third floor of Iksupan (if you are in the {wiki:Iksupan Last Stand}, first go back the same way up to it).
Use the {item:Slab with a Skull}, just **east** of the blue flames: you are teleported to the entrance, in the Tiquanda ruins.
Walk back through the jungle to the **northwest** to **Port Hope**, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat.
The Iks ({creature:Iks Aucar}, {creature:Iks Pututu}, {creature:Iks Ahpututu}) and the {creature:Cursed Ape|Cursed Apes} have 1200 to 1700 HP each: zone for level 150+.

Last zone of the lost city of gold, **Iksupan**, beneath Tiquanda (southeast of Port Hope), inhabited by the undead Iks and the Mitmah; you get there through a teleport next to the lever room of {creature:Ahau}.

Access is obtained in the mission *Galthen and the City of Gold Part II* of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest}: you must defeat {creature:Ahau} and accept the help of {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}.
To enter Iksupan you need {item:The Key Intihuatac}.

From **Port Hope**, follow the jungle to the **southeast** to the Tiquanda ruins and use {item:The Key Intihuatac} on the inscriptions ({coord:32727,32876,7}): you enter the secret city of gold, Iksupan.
Find your way to the **third floor** of Iksupan and keep heading **north**, past the lava area, to the room with **two blue flames**; the **north** one leads to Ahau's lever room.

After defeating Ahau, talk to {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}, outside the lever room, and say {key:yes}. From then on you can use the {wiki:Spheric Teleporter|spheric teleporter} in that room, which takes you near the underground city.
Follow the corridor and go up the stairs to a tomb with an opening to the **east**; go down the hole and you reach the Iksupan Last Stand.
The wiki does not describe an exit shortcut from the bottom of the zone: go back the way you came to the **blue flames** area on the third floor of Iksupan.
Use the {item:Slab with a Skull}, just **east** of the blue flames: it teleports you to the entrance in the Tiquanda ruins.
From there walk back through the jungle to the **northwest** to Port Hope, where you can take a boat.
Zone for level 400+ ({creature:Iks Yapunac|Iks Yapunacs}, {creature:Mitmah Scout|Mitmah Scouts}, {creature:Mitmah Seer|Mitmah Seers}).
There are many spike traps that take a percentage of your current health; in the trap corridor, if the counter reaches zero, you go back to the start.
System of pipes and rooms beneath Iksupan, the "lost city of gold" of the undead Iks, hidden under the Tiquanda ruins southeast of Port Hope.
Access teleport to the Iksupan Waterways
Access obtained in the Galthen and the City of Gold Part II part of the {wiki:Adventures of Galthen Quest} (after defeating {creature:Ahau} and talking to {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}).

Go to **Port Hope** (boat: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and walk through the jungle to the **southeast** to the Tiquanda ruins; use {item:The Key Intihuatac} on the inscriptions ({coord:32727,32876,7}) to enter Iksupan.

On the third floor of Iksupan, the room with the **two blue flames** has the {wiki:Spheric Teleporter|spheric teleporter} (only after you talk to {npc:Ahau's Dead Chamberlain}, {key:yes}) that takes you near the underground city.
Follow the corridor, go up the stairs to the tomb with an opening to the **east** and go down the hole to the Iksupan Last Stand.

From there go to the other spheric teleporter ({coord:34077,31581,10}) that leads to the Waterways: walk **north**, pass the {wiki:Enormous Statue of Tukh} and head **east**, or use {spell:Levitate} on a shorter shortcut.
The wiki does not describe an exit shortcut from the Waterways: go back the way you came to the **blue flames** area on the third floor of Iksupan.
Use the {item:Slab with a Skull}, just **east** of the blue flames, to be teleported to the entrance in the Tiquanda ruins.
From there walk back through the jungle to the **northwest** to Port Hope, where you can take a boat.
There are {creature:Iks Yapunac|Iks Yapunacs}, {creature:Mitmah Scout|Mitmah Scouts}, {creature:Mitmah Seer|Mitmah Seers} and {creature:Cursed Ape|Cursed Apes}.
On the way back, watch out for the spike traps in the corridor and the lava on the third floor of Iksupan (it takes health proportional to your maximum health): do not walk by map-click.
Chakoya settlement, with igloos and long tunnels beneath them, on the island of **Grimlund**, just **east of {wiki:Nibelor}** (Northern Ice Islands, near Svargrond).
The sled of {npc:Iskan} (Svargrond → Nibelor) only accepts you after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
The sled from Nibelor to Inukaya only becomes available after mission 5 of the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} (handing the ingredients over to {npc:Nilsor}).
Go to **Svargrond** by boat (in Carlin, Thais or Venore: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}).

In Svargrond, go to the ice area **north/northeast** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the owner of the dog sled ({coord:32301,31083,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to the island of {wiki:Nibelor}.
On Nibelor, get on the dog sled that is just **east** of where you arrive ({coord:32367,31058,7}). The dogs eat a {item:Ham} and take you to Inukaya, on Grimlund.
Go back to the same sled you arrived on and get on again: the dogs eat another {item:Ham} and take you to **Nibelor**.
On Nibelor, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of the stone circle ({coord:32329,31044,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you back to **Svargrond**.
Bring enough {item:Ham|Hams} for the trip there **and** back: without them the dogs will not take you.
The wiki recommends level 25–30+ for hunting in Inukaya.
Transit island between **Rookgaard** and the mainland, where players coming from Rookgaard choose their vocation, do the *Festival of Initiates* and set off on the boat of {npc:Captain Kurt}.
Captain Kurt's boat (north of the island)
You only get here from **Rookgaard**, at **level 8 or 9** and with your account email confirmed.
You cannot carry more than 2000 gp: 1000 gp in the bank and 1000 gp in your backpack. With more than 1000 gp in your backpack, {npc:Captain Kurt} will not take you.
In **Rookgaard**, go up to the 1st floor of the {wiki:Rookgaard Academy} and talk to {npc:The Oracle} ({coord:32104,32190,6}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again: she teleports you to the Island of Destiny. **You cannot go back to Rookgaard.**
Choose your vocation in one of the four buildings (knight in the northwest, paladin in the northeast, druid in the southeast, sorcerer in the southwest).

Go to the boat of {npc:Captain Kurt}, in the **north** of the island, 1 floor above ground ({coord:32099,31965,6}). Talk to him ({key:hi}) and choose one of the available cities: Ab'Dendriel, Carlin, Thais or Venore (and, with a Premium account, Ankrahmun, Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay or Port Hope).
Once on board, open the boat's chest: it has an {item:Adventurer's Stone} and a {item:Paper (Adventurer's Guild)|Paper}.
When you reach **level 10** on the island, the dungeons close and, after a few minutes, you are teleported out: go to {npc:Captain Kurt}.
There is PvP in the island's dungeons. If you die and drop to level 5, you go back to Rookgaard as on the mainland.

Island **east of Mistrock** where the {creature:Evil Mastermind} has his castle; it is the final stage of the {wiki:The Isle of Evil Quest} and you only get there on the submarine boat of {npc:Rapanaio}, in Kazordoon.
Stairs to the Isle of Evil castle
You can only go to the island during the {wiki:The Isle of Evil Quest}, after finishing missions 1 to 6 for {npc:Rapanaio}.
The way to the boat goes through a **level 35** {item:Gate of Expertise}.

Go to **Kazordoon**. The easiest way is by Steamship: in {wiki:Cormaya} (with {npc:Gurbasch}) or in **Farmine** (with {npc:Thorgrin}) say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch}.
Pass the level 35 {item:Gate of Expertise} to the **south** and go down the stairs ({coord:32681,31994,14}). Rapanaio is waiting for you next to the submarine boat.
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} to him and answer {key:yes} to all the questions (8 confirmations) until he says *"So be it!"*. He takes you to the Isle of Evil.
On the island, fight your way to the castle stairs ({coord:32741,31492,7}) and go up.
Go back to {npc:Rapanaio}, next to the boat on the island, and say {key:hi}, {key:back} and {key:yes}. He takes you back to **Kazordoon**, next to the Steamship.
In Kazordoon take the Steamship (for example from {npc:Brodrosch}) or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
Rapanaio (one floor above the Kazordoon Steamship)
Stairs to the boat (behind the Gate of Expertise)

The island and the castle are full of "evil" creatures ({creature:Killer Rabbit|Killer Rabbits}, {creature:Evil Sheep|Evil Sheep}, {creature:Vampire Pig|Vampire Pigs}, {creature:Demon Parrot|Demon Parrots}...) and one boss per floor: bring enough potions and runes.
There is a free {item:Mailbox} at the tower door.
Island of the monks **southwest of Carlin** (south of the {wiki:Ghostlands}), with a monastery, the library and deep catacombs where the ancient kings of Thais are buried.
Isle of the Kings (monastery and catacombs entrance)
{npc:Dalbrect} only takes you after you hand him the {item:Family Brooch} — it is the first mission of the {wiki:The White Raven Monastery Quest}.
If you enter the restricted area on the 3rd floor of the monastery and do not pay the fine to {npc:Costello} ({key:crime} or {key:absolution}), Dalbrect stops transporting you.
Travel to **Carlin** (for example from Venore, with {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}).
Leave Carlin to the **north/west** to the hut and the boat of {npc:Dalbrect}, at the harbour north of the {wiki:Ghostlands} ({coord:32211,31755,6}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:yes}: he takes you to the island for **10 gp**.
On the island, the catacombs entrance is inside the big monks' building; {npc:Costello} is on the 1st floor of that building.
If you are in the catacombs, climb back up the same way to the monastery (use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through).
Go to the boat docked at the island and talk to {npc:Captain Jack} ({coord:32189,31957,6}): {key:hi} and {key:tibia}. He takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Dalbrect — boat to the island (north of Carlin)
You can also reach the catacombs (floor -7) via the route of the {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest}, but it is long and dangerous.

Small island in the sea east of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, southwest of Venore, known as the "druids' island": only druids can enter, through a {wiki:Magic Forcefield} south of the Plains of Havoc temple.
Magic Forcefield to the island (Plains of Havoc)
Go to **Venore** (by boat, you arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}) and walk **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}.
In the middle of the plains is the temple of {npc:Oldrak}, 1 floor above ground ({coord:32816,32260,6}), where you can rest.
**South** of that temple, near some {creature:Orc|Orcs}, enter the {wiki:Magic Forcefield} ({coord:32831,32295,7}): you are teleported to the Isle of the Mists.
The wiki does not describe the way off the island: go back to the spot where you appeared after crossing the Magic Forcefield and look for the way back to the Plains of Havoc there.
Once on the plains, head **northeast** to Venore (or rest in the temple of {npc:Oldrak}).

On the way through the Plains of Havoc you may meet {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}. On the island the boss {creature:Fernfang} sometimes appears (upper floor) and there are {creature:War Wolf|War Wolves}.
Issavi sewers, in the **north** zone of {wiki:Kilmaresh}, west of the city: one of the hideouts of the {wiki:Fafnar Cultists|Fafnar cultists}, with several entrances around the city.
Very high-level zone: the wiki recommends level 300–350+.

Go to **Issavi**: there are boats from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond** (say {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes} to the captain); you arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Harava}, at the harbour **north** of the city ({coord:33902,31462,6}). You can also come by {wiki:Magic Carpet|flying carpet} from any city with that service ({key:issavi}); you arrive at the platform of {npc:Tanyt} ({coord:33958,31514,0}).
The sewers have several entrances around the city, on the **west** side of Issavi. The wiki does not give the entrance coordinates.
Go back to the entrance you came down by and climb up to the city (the wiki describes no other exits).
To leave Issavi, {npc:Captain Harava} takes you to Venore, Darashia, Krailos or Oramond ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}); or use the carpet of {npc:Tanyt}.
The cultists here drop {item:Empty Honey Glass}, used in the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest}.
Street in the **northeast of Liberty Bay**, next to Admiral's Avenue (west) and Trader's Point (south), with jewellers, the Explorer Society headquarters and the tower of {npc:Malunga}'s magic shop.

Take a boat to **Liberty Bay**: at your city's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (for example {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore, 180 gp, or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron, 170 gp). You arrive at the Liberty Bay docks.
Cross the city to the **northeast**: the Ivory Circle is **north of the depot**, connected to Admiral's Avenue and Trader's Point.

Clockwise, starting from the northwest: Ivory Circle 1, the jewellers ({npc:Bertram}, {npc:Chantalle}, Theodore Loveless on the 2nd floor), {npc:Berenice}'s Explorer Society, Ivory Circle 2 and the magic shop tower ({npc:Frederik} downstairs, {npc:Malunga} on the 3rd floor).

Go back to the Liberty Bay docks and talk to {npc:Jack Fate}: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes} — Ankrahmun (90 gp), Darashia (200), Edron (170), Port Hope (50), Thais (180), Venore (180) or Yalahar (275).
For Meriana, {npc:Captain Waverider} is on the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot ({key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes}, 50 gp).
Captain Waverider (peninsula southeast of the depot)
On the trip from Liberty Bay to Thais with {npc:Jack Fate} there is about an 8% chance of being stranded on {wiki:Goroma}.

Laboratory and dungeon of the mad Professor Maxxen, very deep **beneath the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory}** of Rathleton, with 4 big hunting rooms; this is where the {wiki:Hero of Rathleton Quest} takes place.
Dungeon entrance door (bottom of the Underground Glooth Factory)
To use the {item:Slime Slide} of the Underground Glooth Factory you need at least the **Citizen** rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}; the Hero of Rathleton Quest requires the **Squire** rank.
Recommended level 200+ and a {item:Dwarven Ring} (essential in the first three rooms, even just passing through).

Get to **Rathleton**: with the Squire rank there is a boat to Oramond in Thais ({npc:Captain Bluebear}), Edron ({npc:Captain Seahorse}) and Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}): {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}. You land on the raft of {npc:Captain Gulliver} ({coord:33479,31986,7}); the Slime Slide there takes you to the city (with the Citizen rank go directly).

In Rathleton, go to the Workshop Quarter, to the building just **east** of the stairs to Upper Rathleton, and enter the {item:Slime Slide} ({coord:33651,31942,7}): it takes you to the Underground Glooth Factory.
In the Underground Glooth Factory, walk **west** and go down to the bottom of the "well" ({npc:Strange Pipe} is on the **west** side).
On the lowest level, leave the factory through the {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door} on the **east** side ({coord:33567,31950,14}): you are in Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon.
After Professor Maxxen, leave through the {item:Slime Slide} **east** of the reward room: it takes you back to Rathleton.
If you did not reach the end, walk back the same way to the factory door (there is no return shortcut: you have to pass the creatures again).
To leave Oramond, talk to {npc:Captain Gulliver} on the raft: {key:hi}, the city name (for example {key:thais}, {key:edron}, {key:venore} or {key:port hope}) and {key:yes}.
Slime Slide to the Underground Glooth Factory
Shortcut teleports (east of the first room)

Creatures: {creature:Blood Beast}, {creature:Devourer}, {creature:Enslaved Dwarf}, {creature:Lost Basher}, {creature:Lost Berserker}, {creature:Lost Husher}, {creature:Metal Gargoyle}, {creature:Rot Elemental}, {creature:Rustheap Golem} and {creature:Glooth Golem}.

Anyone who has already completed the Hero of Rathleton Quest can use the 3 teleports east of the first room to go straight to the 2nd, 3rd or 4th room (from left to right), but there is no shortcut back.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia

Small desert **west of Venore** and south of Kazordoon (east of {wiki:Mount Sternum}), between Thais and Venore; it has the temple of {npc:Adrenius}, the {wiki:Demon Tower} and, beneath it, the labyrinth of the {wiki:Desert Dungeon}.

Go to **Venore** (for example from Thais, on the boat of {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and walk **west** to the desert ({coord:32633,32113,7}). You can also get there on foot from Thais, to the **northeast**.
For the {wiki:Desert Dungeon}: in the middle of the desert, near the temple of {npc:Adrenius}, use the {item:Shovel} on the {item:Loose Stone Pile} ({coord:32649,32093,7}) and go down the hole.
The desert is all on the surface: walk back **east** to Venore (or southwest to Thais).
If you are in the Desert Dungeon, the exit teleport next to the {item:Gate of Expertise} drops you beside {npc:Adrenius}, in the desert temple.
On the surface there are only weak creatures ({creature:Lion|Lions}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Snake|Snakes}); the Desert Dungeon below has one-way holes.

Dwarven city carved inside the mountain **The Big Old One**, in the middle of the continent, with several floors above ground and a large underground part (mines, depot, temple and the {wiki:Steamship} harbour).

**By Steamship (the simplest):** in {wiki:Cormaya} talk to {npc:Gurbasch} (at the bottom of the island, 8 floors below the harbour) or in **Farmine** to {npc:Thorgrin} and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. You arrive at Kazordoon's underground harbour, next to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}).

To get to Cormaya: first go to Edron (from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and, at the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}).

**By flying carpet:** at the Edron carpet, talk to {npc:Pino} ({coord:33192,31783,3}) and say {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Gewen}'s carpet, on top of the Kazordoon mountain ({coord:32587,31941,0}); go down the stairs to the city.
**On foot:** go to the main entrance in the mountain (see the route images below). Bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}: along the way there are rope spots and hidden holes.

Inside the city you can use the {wiki:Ore Wagon|Ore Wagons} to get to the entrance, the depot, the temple, the Steamship and the shops; you need a **250 gp** licence bought from {npc:Lokur} (Kazordoon's postman).

**Steamship:** go down to the underground harbour and talk to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}): {key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}. From Cormaya, {npc:Pemaret} at the north harbour takes you to Edron ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}).

**Flying carpet:** go up to the top of the mountain and talk to {npc:Gewen} ({coord:32587,31941,0}): {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. In Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you by boat to Venore ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
**On foot:** leave through the main entrance of the mountain the same way you came in; Venore is to the **east**. Use the {item:Rope} on the rope spots.
Gewen — flying carpet on top of the mountain
A = rope spot, B = hidden hole
On the walking route there are hidden holes: always bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}.

Along the way you meet {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} and {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} on the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}.
Minotaur territory **west of Kazordoon**, just outside the {wiki:Dwarf Mines}: a tower on the surface and underground caves (floors -1 and -2), commanded by {creature:The Horned Fox}.
Loose stone pile (way down to the caves)

Get to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} or Farmine ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}), or on foot (for example from Thais through the {wiki:Mount Sternum} pass). Leave the mountain through the **main entrance** ({coord:32614,31923,7}).

From the main entrance, follow the white line on the map to a hole with a spot for the {item:Rope}, where there are a few {creature:Spider|Spiders}. Head **north** and come out by a ramp to ground level (there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and a few {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}).
Keep following the white line **south**, cross **two bridges** and pass other mine entrances.
**West of Kazordoon** you find the loose stone pile ({coord:32448,31993,7}): use the {item:Shovel} on the {item:Loose Stone Pile} and go down to floor -1 of the minotaur caves.
Go back the same way to the hole you came down through and use the {item:Rope} to climb to the surface, west of Kazordoon.

On floor -1, the ways up lead (from north to south) to a dead end with 3 {creature:Bear|Bears}, to the grassy area around the tower, to the inside of the tower and to the peninsula south of the mines.
Then retrace the white line path (two bridges, the ramp and the rope hole) to the main entrance of Kazordoon.
Loose Stone Pile — way down to the caves
Loose Stone Pile behind the Plum Tree (Steel Helmet Quest)
Path from the main entrance of Kazordoon to the minotaurs (white line)
Minotaur caves, floor -1 (the red X is the exit to the Dwarf Mines)
Minotaur caves, floor -2 (teleport to The Horned Fox's room at the far south)

Along the way you may meet {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Bear|Bears}; in the caves there are many {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}.
The wiki recommends level 15–20 for the area and 30–35 for the tower ({creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards} and {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}).

The desert around **Ankrahmun** (between Ankrahmun and Darashia), devastated by the djinn civil war; on the surface there are few structures, but beneath the sand are the pharaoh tombs and caves of {creature:Larva|Larvas} and {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}.
**Premium** account to get to Ankrahmun or Darashia by boat.
Go by boat to **Ankrahmun** (for example, with {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}).
Leave the city to the **north** (through the north gate or the **northeast** ramp): the desert starts right outside the walls ({coord:33174,32695,7}).
You can also get there on foot from **Darashia**, heading **south** through the desert and the mountain pass between the two cities.
The tomb and cave entrances are hidden in the sand: they open by digging with the {item:Shovel} in the right spot.
The desert is on the surface: walk back **south** to Ankrahmun (or **north** to Darashia). If you are in a tomb, climb up through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
In Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Venore, Edron, Port Hope, Liberty Bay or Yalahar ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Kha'zeel Scarab Lair entrance (north of the desert)
Tar pits (Nightmare Isles world change teleport)
On the surface there are {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas} and packs of {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}; beneath the sand, the tombs have much more dangerous undead.

Mountain range separating the Kha'labal (the **Ankrahmun** desert), the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle (Port Hope) and the Darashia desert; it has many caves but few passes, and on the desert side are the djinn fortresses.

**From the Ankrahmun side:** take a boat to **Ankrahmun** ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain) and leave the city to the **west**, climbing the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}).

To cross through the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}: at the top of the mountain cross the bridge (there is a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down, with no monsters, to a ladder that takes you to the jungle side, near the merchant {npc:Tarun} ({coord:32976,32715,7}).
For the djinn fortresses: {wiki:Ashta'daramai} via the ramp to the mountains **north** of Ankrahmun ({coord:33120,32578,7}); {wiki:Mal'ouquah} via the pass next to the oasis ({coord:33101,32657,7}).
**From the Tiquanda side:** from **Port Hope** walk **east** through the jungle to the foot of the mountains. There is also an underground passage, the {wiki:Darama Terramite Cave}.
Go back the same way: east, over the Kha'zeel Pass bridge, to **Ankrahmun**, where {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}) has a boat ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Or go down to the jungle side and head **west** to **Port Hope** (the southernmost route is easier and safer), where {npc:Charles} has a boat.
Tarun, next to the Kha'zeel Pass bridge (jungle side)
Kha'zeel Pass — the bridge at the top
Kha'zeel Pass — descent to the ladder

The desert side has many {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, as well as {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}; the jungle side has {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.
In the jungle, after the pass, watch out for {creature:Hydra|Hydras} brought by other players.
Three dragon lairs in the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains, entered from the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert, **north of Ankrahmun**: the south one is the easiest and the north one ("Ank 9") the hardest.
Travel to **Ankrahmun** by boat: at your city's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun} and {key:yes}. You arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}).
Leave the city on foot to the **north**, through the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert, to the Kha'zeel mountains.

Choose a lair: **south** ({coord:33060,32736,7}, the easiest, 3 floors with few dragons), **middle** ({coord:33095,32690,7}, the "Ank 3x", with {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}) or **north** ({coord:33116,32606,7}, the "Ank 9", the hardest, with {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} on the 4th floor).
Go back the same way to the lair entrance (the wiki describes no other exits).
Walk back **south**, through the desert, to **Ankrahmun**, where {npc:Captain Sinbeard} has boats to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Dragons and Dragon Lords breathe fire: the wiki recommends level 25–40+ and, for low-level mages, using summons as blockers.
The northern lair has 4 Dragon Lords on the 2nd floor and 8 Fire Elementals on the 4th.

Two sets of dragon lairs in the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains, entered from the {wiki:Tiquanda} side (the Port Hope jungle), north of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}; it is the location of the {wiki:The Great Dragon Hunt Quest}.
From **Port Hope**: take the boat to Port Hope ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city). Cross the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle to the **east** to the Kha'zeel mountains.

From **Ankrahmun**: take the boat to Ankrahmun ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}). Leave the city to the **west**, climb the mountains (with {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}), cross the bridge at the top (with a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and go down to the ladder: you are on the Tiquanda side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}. From there head **north**.

The **north** lairs (3 caves, easier) are entered at {coord:33009,32604,7}; the **south** ones (4 caves, with many {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}) are entered at {coord:32983,32646,7}. Go down through the underground passage.
Go back through the same underground passage to the entrance you came down by and climb to the surface (bring a {item:Rope} for the holes).

Return to **Port Hope** through the jungle (to the **west**) and take the boat of {npc:Charles} ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}), or go to **Ankrahmun** via the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass} (**south** and then **east**, the way you came).

In the jungle there are {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Elephant|Elephants}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles} and, sometimes, {creature:Hydra|Hydras} drawn in by other players.
The south lairs have 21 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and 9 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}: the wiki recommends level 40–50+.

Darama mountain range between the Darashia (Devourer) and Ankrahmun (Kha'labal) deserts and the Tiquanda jungle, with three branches: the {wiki:Plague Spike} to the northeast, the pass between the two deserts and the main branch with the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}, the djinn fortresses and the portal to Marapur.
Pass between the Devourer and the Kha'labal

**From Ankrahmun** (the simplest way): take the boat to Ankrahmun ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}). Leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains ({creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}) via the {wiki:Kha'zeel Pass}: up there is a bridge (with a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}) and on the other side a ladder that goes down to the jungle side, near {npc:Tarun} ({coord:32974,32716,7}).

For the djinn fortresses, from Ankrahmun: the ramp to {wiki:Ashta'daramai} is in the mountains **north** of the city ({coord:33120,32578,7}); the pass to {wiki:Mal'ouquah} starts next to the oasis ({coord:33101,32657,7}).
**From Darashia:** head **southwest** through the desert to the mountain; the pass between the two deserts is at {coord:33172,32551,6}.
**From Port Hope:** walk **east** through the Tiquanda jungle to the Tiquanda side of the Kha'zeel Pass.
The portal to {wiki:Marapur} is at the top of the mountain, on floor +5 ({coord:33037,32738,2}).
Go down the **same way** you went up (where you went up with {spell:Levitate}, go down with Levitate too).

Return to **Ankrahmun** ({npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you by boat to other cities), to **Darashia** (boat of {npc:Petros} or carpet of {npc:Chemar}) or, via the jungle side, to **Port Hope** (boat of {npc:Charles}).
Tarun (jungle side of the Kha'zeel Pass)
Altar at the top of the Plague Spike
Dragon Gate (to The First Dragon's Lair)
The three branches of the Kha'zeel Mountains (1 = Plague Spike, 2 = pass between deserts, 3 = main branch)

The most dangerous creatures on the mountain are the {creature:Massive Energy Elemental|Massive Energy Elementals}, which can kill an unwary level 80–90 player. There are also {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} on the way to Ashta'daramai and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} at the Plague Spike.
Many areas can only be reached with {spell:Levitate}: pay attention to the places where you can climb up.

Surface passage through the Kha'zeel mountains, linking the Kha'labal desert (Ankrahmun) to the Tiquanda jungle (Port Hope); on the jungle side are the merchant {npc:Tarun}, the wooden bridge and the {wiki:Asura Palace}.
Tarun, next to the wooden bridge (Tiquanda side)
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the captain at your city's port); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city to the **west** and climb the mountains (there are {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}).
At the top, cross the bridge (there is a {creature:Nomad} and a few {creature:Bandit|Bandits}).
Go down with no monsters along the path until you reach a ladder that takes you to the jungle side, near {npc:Tarun} ({coord:32976,32715,7}).
Alternative: come on foot from **Port Hope**, to the **east** through the Tiquanda jungle. There is also an underground route through the {wiki:Darama Terramite Cave}.
To Ankrahmun: take the route in reverse — go up the ladder, cross the bridge at the top and go down **east** to the city. At the harbour, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities.

To Port Hope: head **west** through the Tiquanda jungle. Going straight west usually takes longer because of the plants and trees; the further **south** you go, the easier and safer the terrain is. In Port Hope, {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities.
Ankrahmun → Port Hope route (1): climb the mountains west of Ankrahmun

On the jungle side there are {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Elephant|Elephants}, {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds} and {creature:Dworc Venomsniper|Dworcs}; watch out for {creature:Hydra|Hydras} drawn onto the path.

Scarab cave in the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains, **north of the Kha'labal desert** (north of Ankrahmun), with {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}, {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} and {creature:Larva|Larvas}.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city).
Leave the city to the **north**, to the Kha'zeel mountains, north of the Kha'labal desert. The cave entrance is at {coord:33077,32547,7}, west of the {wiki:Ashta'daramai|blue djinn fortress}.
Go down: floor -2 ({coord:33078,32532,10}) is the spot marked in the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}.
Go back the same way to the entrance, using the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through.
The {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} are the most dangerous in the cave (up to ~380 damage); do not go down without enough potions.
The smallest island, in the southeast, of the Forbidden Islands (Shattered Isles), **west of Liberty Bay**, where the {wiki:Ferumbras Citadel} is; you get there underground from Malada.
You need access to Goroma, Ramoa, Talahu and Malada from the {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} (Kharos access section).

To cross the Citadel's energy barrier you need permission from {npc:Zoltan} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:Ferumbras}, {key:yes}, then {key:permission}, {key:yes}: 500 gp for each entry). Before that you must try stepping on the barrier once.
In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} at the docks: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You land in the east of Goroma.
On Goroma go down the stairs of the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} ({coord:32038,32561,7}) and always use the **right** teleport (Goroma → Ramoa → Talahu → Malada).

On Malada go up the hub stairs and head **south** to the trapdoor ({coord:32024,32734,7}): go down to underground Kharos, where the Ferumbras Citadel is ({coord:32121,32688,7}). The trapdoor **only goes down**.
If you have already passed the Citadel barrier, you cannot leave through it: head **east**, go down a hole, head **west** and go up through a rope hole with the {item:Rope}.
Go to the hole to the **east** ({coord:32138,32697,7}) and go down to the **one-way** teleport that takes you to Goroma.
On Goroma, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} on his ship ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Stairs to the Goroma Teleportation Hub
Stairs of the Malada Teleportation Hub
Hole with the teleport back to Goroma
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
The Malada trapdoor is down-only and the exit teleport is one-way to Goroma: bring a {item:Rope} and supplies.
Zoltan's permission is valid for **one** entry; to enter the Citadel again you pay 500 gp once more.
{creature:Killer Caiman|Killer Caimans} cave in the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, **southwest of Zao's central orc camp**; a good hunting spot for knights from level 60.

Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Head **northeast** across the steppe to the cave entrance ({coord:33137,31448,7}), southwest of the central orc camp.
Leave the cave and go back across the steppe to the **southwest** to the pass at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
On the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp): {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Bring mana potions and a few {item:Strong Health Potion|Strong Health Potions}: 3 or more {creature:Killer Caiman|Killer Caimans} at once do real damage.

Hot, dry island east of {wiki:Krailos}, ruled by a Sphinx empress; the capital is **Issavi**, built at the fork of the Nykri river, and around it are steppes, mountains, catacombs and the ruins of Nuur.

Take the boat to **Issavi** in **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** or **Oramond**: say {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes} to the captain. You arrive at the boat of {npc:Captain Harava}, at the harbour **north** of the city ({coord:33902,31462,6}).
Alternatively, come by magic carpet from any city with that service: you arrive at the platform of {npc:Tanyt} ({coord:33958,31514,0}).
The other zones of the island (steppes, {wiki:Kilmaresh Catacombs}, Nykri Delta, mountains) are reached on foot from Issavi.
Go to the Issavi harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Harava}: {key:hi}, the destination ({key:darashia}, {key:venore}, {key:krailos} or {key:oramond}) and {key:yes}.
You can also use the magic carpet of {npc:Tanyt}, at the carpet platform.
Catacombs beneath the **west side of Issavi**, hideout of the {wiki:Fafnar Cultists}, connected to the **Nykri Delta** by tunnels with an exit on the steppe.

Go to **Issavi**, on the island of {wiki:Kilmaresh}: there are boats from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond** ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, at the port in the **north** of the city ({coord:33902,31462,6}).
Alternatively, come by magic carpet: you arrive at {npc:Tanyt}'s platform.
The catacombs lie beneath the **west** side of the city. The safest entrance is from the **north**, through the cave of the {creature:Sphinx|Sphinxes} and the {creature:Crypt Warden|Crypt Wardens}.
You can also get there through the tunnels that connect the catacombs to the **Nykri Delta**, with an exit on the steppe.
Go back the way you came to the cave where you entered and climb up to the surface (or follow the tunnels to the exit at the Nykri Delta) and return to Issavi.

At the port of Issavi, {npc:Captain Harava} takes you to {key:darashia}, {key:venore}, {key:krailos} or {key:oramond} ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}); you can also use {npc:Tanyt}'s magic carpet.
Mirror Mask door (next to the main entrance, 2 floors down)
Silver Mask doors (access from the north)

Area for very high levels (**300+**): {creature:Crypt Warden|Crypt Wardens}, {creature:Sphinx|Sphinxes}, {creature:Priestess of the Wild Sun|Priestesses of the Wild Sun}, {creature:Black Sphinx Acolyte|Black Sphinx Acolytes} and {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators}.

Mountains in the **centre of the island of Kilmaresh**, between the central steppe and the southern steppe (south of Issavi), where the Nykri river rises and the only {creature:Gryphon|Gryphons} in the game live.

Go to **Issavi**: there are boats from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond** ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes} to the captain) — you arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat, at the port in the **north** of the city. Or come by {wiki:Magic Carpet} and you arrive at {npc:Tanyt}'s platform ({coord:33958,31514,0}).

Leave Issavi to the **south**, across the island, to the centre of Kilmaresh, between the central steppe and the southern steppe: the mountains are there (the wiki does not describe a detailed route).
The {item:Gryphon Nest} for the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest} is at the highest point of the mountain, **4 floors above ground level** ({coord:33841,31682,3}).
Come down the mountain the same way you went up and head back **north** to Issavi ({coord:33907,31512,7}).
In Issavi, take {npc:Captain Harava}'s boat ({coord:33902,31462,6}) or {npc:Tanyt}'s magic carpet: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.

Very dangerous area: the wiki recommends level 300+ for knights and 250+ for paladins and mages. There are {creature:Priestess of the Wild Sun|Priestesses of the Wild Sun}, {creature:Black Sphinx Acolyte|Black Sphinx Acolytes}, {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators}, {creature:Lamassu} and {creature:Gryphon|Gryphons}.

Nightmare Knights' outpost tower in the **south of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}** (southwest of Venore), which serves as a base for those who have done the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest}: it has teleports to Thais, Carlin, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel, Fibula, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Mintwallin and the Dream Realm.
Hole hidden under a tree, next to the water (north of the tower)
The teleports only work for **Premium** players and if you carry at least one {item:Orichalcum Pearl}.

2nd floor (Thais, Carlin, Dream Realm): rank 1 of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest} (Novice/Maggot). 3rd floor (Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel, Fibula): rank 2 (Initiate/Hyaena). 4th floor (Darashia, Ankrahmun, Mintwallin): rank 4 (Lord Protector/Dread Lord).
Go to **Venore** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the port captain in your city).
Leave Venore and walk **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} ({coord:32747,32258,7}). No boat or special equipment is needed.
In the **south** of the plains, a little **north** of the tower, look for the hole hidden under a tree next to the water ({coord:32816,32322,7}) and go in: that is how you get to the tower.

With the required rank and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl}, use the teleports: **2nd floor** to Thais, Carlin and the Dream Realm; **3rd floor** to Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and Fibula; **4th floor** to Darashia, Ankrahmun and Mintwallin.

Without the rank or without a pearl, the wiki does not describe another way out of the tower: go back to where you came in and walk back through the Plains of Havoc to **Venore**, to the **northeast**.

Large steppe peninsula **north of Oramond**, dominated by tribes of {creature:Ogre|Ogres}; **Krailos Village** is home to the Bloody Skull tribe and the hub of the {wiki:Krailos Quest}. It can only be reached by sea.

Take the boat to Krailos in **Venore** ({npc:Captain Fearless}, 100 gp), **Darashia** ({npc:Petros}, 110 gp), **Edron** or **Oramond** (Rathleton): say {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes} to the captain. From **Issavi**, {npc:Captain Harava} also takes you ({key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes}, 80 gp).
You arrive at {npc:Captain Pelagia}'s boat ({coord:33492,31710,6}). Because of the reefs she cannot reach the shore: go down from the pier and swim to land.
Walk **east** across the steppe to **Krailos Village** ({coord:33639,31656,7}), where {npc:Larek} and the other NPCs are.

Go back to {npc:Captain Pelagia}'s boat, **west** of the village. Say {key:hi}, {key:sail} and the destination: {key:venore} (110 gp), {key:edron} (100 gp), {key:darashia} (110 gp), {key:oramond} (60 gp) or {key:issavi} (70 gp), and {key:yes}.
Dark Stone Totem (northeast of the village)
The steppe has aggressive {creature:Ogre|Ogres} outside the village; only the Bloody Skull tribe, in Krailos Village, tolerates humans.

Mines beneath the island of **Krailos**, where the ogres make slave goblins mine {item:Opal|Opals} and {item:Onyx Chip|Onyx Chips} under {npc:Grubokk}'s orders; the entrance is in the southwest of the Krailos Steppe.
Stairs to the mountains in the south (entrance)
The mine gate opens with the {item:Key 0555} (Goblin Bone Key), which is found in the {item:Draw Well|well} next to {npc:Grubokk} ({wiki:Krailos Quest}).
Take the boat to **Krailos** in Edron, Darashia, Venore or Oramond (Rathleton): {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Pelagia} ({coord:33492,31710,6}).
Walk **east** across the steppe to Krailos Village ({coord:33639,31656,7}) and then to the mountain range **south** of the village.
Go up the stairs at {coord:33693,31775,7} and follow the only path (up and down several times) to {npc:Grubokk} ({coord:33683,31792,6}). Use the well next to him to get the {item:Key 0555}.

Go down the hole to the **left** of Grubokk. In the cave, head **west** between the rocks to the gate ({coord:33671,31795,7}) and open it with the key. Go down, go down the ramp again, head **northeast** and go down the hole ({coord:33625,31747,9}): you are in the mines.
Go back the same way: climb up the holes with the {item:Rope}, go up the ramp and pass the gate to the cave below Grubokk; use the rope to climb up the hole next to him.
Come down from the mountains the same way to the stairs at {coord:33693,31775,7}, go back to the village and the port, and say {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Pelagia}.
Sometimes there are unannounced raids of {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers} and {creature:Drillworm|Drillworms} in the mines.
Ruins in the **northwest of the island of Krailos** (Oramond continent), with a cave of {creature:Nightmare Scion|Nightmare Scions}; hunting area for level 110+.

Take a boat to **Krailos**: in **Venore** ({npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes}, 100 gp), **Darashia** ({npc:Petros}, 110 gp), **Edron**, **Oramond** (Rathleton) or **Issavi** ({npc:Captain Harava}, 80 gp).
You disembark at the port of Krailos, next to {npc:Captain Pelagia} ({coord:33492,31710,6}).
Head to the **northwest** of the island to the entrance of the ruins ({coord:33580,31584,7}).
Go back up the same way to the entrance of the ruins ({coord:33580,31584,7}).
Go back to the port and talk to {npc:Captain Pelagia}: {key:hi}, the destination ({key:edron}, {key:venore}, {key:darashia}, {key:oramond} or {key:issavi}) and {key:yes}.
Sarcophagus with the Red Gem (2 floors down)
According to {npc:Narsai}, there is also a secret tunnel in the Ruins of Nuur (Issavi) that connects to Krailos, with a sealed door that opens by drawing a sun symbol on the door.

Special dimension where the player was taken **only once**, at the end of the old {wiki:The Beginning Quest} (the Rookgaard tutorial), to face the {creature:Kraknaknork's Demon}; it is the place where you die for the first time.
Only accessible **once**, when you finish {wiki:The Beginning Quest}: there is no way to go back there afterwards.
At the end of {wiki:The Beginning Quest}, when you leave the bridge and take a few steps, you are automatically teleported to this dimension. There is no other way to get there.

The wiki does not describe an exit: the {creature:Kraknaknork's Demon} kills you (unless you have passed equipment and supplies over from another character, and even then the chances of killing it are minimal). After dying you return to the normal game.
Do not confuse it with the lair of {creature:Kraknaknork} from {wiki:The Rookie Guard Quest}, which is in the orc dungeon of Rookgaard and is reached through the teleport guarded by an orc.
The largest of the Norsir barbarian camps, on a peninsula **southwest of Svargrond** (island of {wiki:Hrodmir}), with the Ice Witch Tower where {npc:Freezhild} lives.
{npc:Buddel}'s boat only takes you after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}; on foot there are no requirements.
Go to **Svargrond** by boat (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}).

By boat: head **south** of Svargrond to {npc:Buddel}'s boat ({coord:32254,31195,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:camp}, {key:yes} (50 gp). You disembark from his boat at the barbarian camps ({coord:32020,31294,7}); from there head **south** to the Krimhorn peninsula.

On foot (faster and free): leave Svargrond to the **west**, go over the mountain and across the glacier ({wiki:Formorgar Glacier|Formorgar}) and cross the small bridge to the west; the wiki also mentions access via the mountain **east** of Krimhorn, full of {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}.
Go back **north** to {npc:Buddel}'s boat at the camps ({coord:32020,31294,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Or walk back across the glacier and the mountain to Svargrond, to the **northeast**.
Buddel's boat at the barbarian camps
{npc:Buddel} is always drunk and sometimes takes you to the wrong place: ask again until you arrive.

On the glacier there are {creature:Mammoth|Mammoths}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}. The wiki recommends level 35–45 for Krimhorn and 70–80 for the Ice Witch Tower.
Three small tropical islands **southeast of Liberty Bay** (southeast of the {wiki:Shattered Isles}), with no port, full of frogs and turtles and with a small amazon village.

You can only use the {wiki:Sea Turtle|sea turtles} after the mermaid {npc:Marina} gives you permission, in the *Access to Meriana* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} (say {key:hi}, {key:date} to her the second time).

In **Liberty Bay**, go to the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you to Sabrehaven, on the island of {wiki:Meriana}.
On Meriana, go to the coast where the turtles are and step on one: it takes you to the Laguna Islands.
Use the turtles to hop from island to island (for example to the **northeast** island, where {npc:Erayo} is, 1 floor down).
Step on a turtle at the shore to go back island by island to **Meriana**.
On Meriana, go **south** of Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Sea turtle used as transport between the islands
The turtles are a protection zone, but they do not accept loot bags: to send items, use the royal mailbox on the Laguna Islands.

There are {creature:Toad|Toads}, {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises}, {creature:Thornback Tortoise|Thornback Tortoises}, {creature:Blood Crab|Blood Crabs} and {creature:Amazon|Amazons}; the wiki recommends level 27–30+.

Small cave in the **northeast of {wiki:Cormaya}** (the island next to Edron), ruled by a witch who brings trees to life; it has {creature:Swampling|Swamplings}, {creature:Leaf Golem|Leaf Golems} and {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings}.
Entrance to the Lair of the Treeling Witch
Take the boat to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes} (20 gp) to {npc:Captain Seahorse} to go to {wiki:Cormaya}.
On Cormaya, head to the **northeast** of the island to the cave entrance ({coord:33338,31972,7}); there are {item:Starlight Buttercup|Starlight Buttercups} next to the entrance. Go down to floor -1.
Go back up the same way you came down.
Go back to the northern port of Cormaya and talk to {npc:Pemaret}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (20 gp) to return to Edron.
Recommended level 30+: on floor -2 there are {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings} and {creature:Wilting Leaf Golem|Wilting Leaf Golems}, and the {creature:Witch} roams floor -1.

Lake in the Tiquanda jungle, **north of Port Hope** and southwest of Banuta, where the fisherman {npc:Yawno} waits; it is the only place where {item:Shimmer Swimmer|Shimmer Swimmers} can be fished ({wiki:Twisted Waters World Change}).
If you are not in **Port Hope**, take a boat: say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain. You arrive at {npc:Charles}'s port.
In Port Hope, head **north** of the temple and the depot, through the jungle, to the lake ({coord:32612,32655,7}). {npc:Yawno} is at the water's edge ({coord:32614,32651,7}).
Take the same route **south** back to Port Hope.
At the port, {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}) takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
The lake polluted during the Twisted Waters World Change

On the way there are {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Filth Toad|Filth Toads} and other jungle creatures (level 20+ recommended). Next to the water there is a spot where you only face 2 slimes at a time.

Five caves hidden under the sands of {wiki:Kha'labal}, around **Ankrahmun**, with Larvae, Scarabs and, on the deeper floors of some, Ancient Scarabs; they are opened by digging the sand with a shovel.
Larva Cave next to the west exit of Ankrahmun (the biggest)
Take the boat to **Ankrahmun** (from the port captain in your city: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.

Choose one of the 5 caves: next to the **west exit** of the city ({coord:33072,32760,7}); **north of the north exit** ({coord:33153,32686,7}); **west of the Stone Tomb** ({coord:33257,32743,7}); between the tar pits and the ancient ruins ({coord:33219,32640,7}); or **northeast of the oasis** ({coord:33161,32598,7}).
At the entrance spot, use the {item:Shovel} on the sand. It may not open the first time: keep trying until the hole appears, and go down.

For the {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs}: in the west exit cave go down at {coord:33096,32749,9} and then at {coord:33053,32776,10}; in the Stone Tomb one, at {coord:33217,32772,9} and {coord:33251,32812,10}; in the north exit one, at {coord:33117,32676,9} and {coord:33063,32651,10}.
Go back the **same way**: go up the stairs and use the {item:Rope} on the hole you came in through to return to the desert surface.
Return to **Ankrahmun**; at the port, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}).
Fleshcrawler's lair (end of the west exit cave)
Do not let yourself get surrounded by {creature:Larva|Larvae} and {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}: in a group they deal a lot of damage (poison).

The west exit cave is the biggest and the hardest, dangerous for low-level paladins and mages. In the north exit one there is only a single gap between the stairs and the wall, and a summoned Larva can block you.
Hideout of were-creatures connected to the Ley Lines, in a dungeon **east of Cormaya village** (near Edron), behind a {item:Mystic Flame}.
Dungeon with the Mystic Flame (entrance to the Last Sanctum)
You can only enter after performing the ritual at the Moonshadow Temple in Grimvale (The Curse Spreads part of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}).
Go to **Edron** and, at the port, take {npc:Captain Seahorse}'s boat to Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
On Cormaya, go **east** of the village to the dungeon with the {item:Mystic Flame} ({coord:33353,32000,7}) and walk through the flame.
Inside, follow the cave **southwest** and go down the ramp ({coord:33353,32093,9}).
Go back the same way: go up the ramp, follow the cave **northeast** to the {item:Mystic Flame} and come out in the dungeon **east** of Cormaya village.
To return to Edron, talk to {npc:Pemaret} at the northern port of Cormaya ({coord:33287,31956,6}): {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}.
After you finish The Curse Spreads, you can use the {item:Death Portal} in the Last Sanctum ({coord:33429,32083,9}) to go directly to Edron's lycanthrope cave.
Death Portal in the Edron cave
It is full of were-creatures: {creature:Werefox|Werefoxes}, {creature:Werebadger|Werebadgers}, {creature:Werewolf|Werewolves}, {creature:Wereboar|Wereboars} and {creature:Werebear|Werebears}.

The largest human city on the island of **Vandura**, in the Shattered Isles (Kingdom of Thais), with a port, depot, temple and the fort; starting point for Goroma, Calassa, Treasure Island and Meriana.
**Premium** account city: you can only get there by boat.

Take the boat to Liberty Bay at the port of your city: say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} to the captain (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron, 170 gp).
The boat docks at the Liberty Bay docks, where {npc:Jack Fate} is.

At the docks, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, city name (for example {key:venore}, {key:edron}, {key:thais}) and {key:yes}. With {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} he also takes you to Goroma ({key:goroma}).
On the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot, {npc:Captain Waverider} takes you to Treasure Island or, with {key:peg leg}, to Sabrehaven on {wiki:Meriana} (50 gp).
On one of the boats on the **east** side of the docks is {npc:Captain Max}, who takes you out to the boat above {wiki:Calassa}.
Captain Waverider (peninsula southeast of the depot)
Arrival of the boat from Treasure Island

A floor of the dungeon of {wiki:Ramoa}, in the {wiki:Forbidden Islands}, full of undead, {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers} and {creature:Lich|Liches}; the long, optional part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} sends you here to fetch a book.
You should have done the Ramoa part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}: only then can you use the teleport from Goroma to Ramoa.
{npc:Jack Fate} only takes you to Goroma after the *Access to Goroma* part of the same quest.
At the port of **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Jack Fate}: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You disembark on the **east** coast of Goroma.
On Goroma, head **west** to the Teleportation Hub stairs ({coord:32038,32561,7}), go down and enter the **right** teleport: you arrive in Ramoa.
Follow the maps: you enter at the red circle and go to the blue circle (twice, on different floors).
Next to the blue circle on the last map, use the {item:Pick} on the ground to open the hole to the Lich Hell and go down.

The wiki does not describe the way out: go back the same way to the hole you opened with the Pick (bring a {item:Rope} to climb up) and retrace the maps in reverse to the Ramoa Teleportation Hub ({coord:31946,32557,7}).

At the Ramoa hub, enter the **left** teleport: you appear at the **Goroma** hub. Go up the stairs and head **east** to {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
Path to the Lich Hell, 1st map: from the red circle to the blue one
Path to the Lich Hell, 2nd map: from the red circle to the blue one
Use the Pick on the ground next to the blue circle to open the hole

Not a place for low-level knights: the creatures summon many minions, the Priestesses drain mana and there are a few {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} (bring an elemental weapon or runes). Now and then {creature:Undead Cavebear|Undead Cavebears} show up.

Rock formation **northwest of Darashia**, near the Gnomebase portal, with a multi-floor cave (Bonebeasts, {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} and {creature:Roaring Lion|Roaring Lions}); this is where the {wiki:Lion's Rock Quest} takes place.
**Premium** account (Darashia can only be reached by boat or carpet).
Go to **Darashia**, by boat (for example, from Venore: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}) or by magic carpet from Edron with {npc:Pino} ({coord:33192,31783,3}).
Leave the city to the **west-northwest** to Lion's Rock, a rock formation near the Darashia portal to the Gnomebase ({coord:33138,32358,7}).

Above the entrance there are ramps and stairs on the outside of the mountain (that is where the {item:Stump} with the {item:Lion's Mane} and the holy water fountain are). The cave goes down from the entrance; near the start is the {item:Dead Explorer} ({coord:33145,32342,8}).
The wiki does not describe a shortcut out: go back the way you came to the {item:Mystic Flame} area on the first underground floor and climb to the surface along the cave path.
Return to Darashia to the **east-southeast**. At the port, {npc:Petros} ({coord:33289,32481,6}) takes you to Venore, Ankrahmun, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Yalahar and other cities.
Stump with Lion's Mane (above the entrance)
Some creatures here cannot be blocked. On the lower floors the {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} respawn quickly and can paralyse and surround you. Recommended level 60-70+.
Werelion sanctuary beneath {wiki:Lion's Rock}, **northwest of Darashia**; access opens during the An Ancient Feud mission of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}.
Access obtained in the An Ancient Feud mission of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest} (with {npc:Domizian}, in Darashia).
If the door asks, say the phrase: *The sun guides our hearts. The moon guards our dreams*.
