For the lower part of the sanctuary you need the {item:Lion Ring} that {npc:Domizian} gives you.
Travel to **Darashia** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} to the port captain in your city).
Leave the city to the **northwest** to the entrance of {wiki:Lion's Rock} ({coord:33138,32358,7}).
Inside Lion's Rock go down to the **3rd floor**, where the stairs leading to the Lion Sanctum are (if the door asks, say the phrase above).
Go down the stairs: you are in the Lion Sanctum ({coord:33128,32251,11}).
Go back the same way: go up the Sanctum stairs to the 3rd floor of Lion's Rock and keep going up to the entrance, northwest of Darashia.
From there return to **Darashia** (southeast), where you take the boat or the carpet.
Domizian (Darashia, 1st floor of the building west of the boat)
It is full of {creature:White Lion|White Lions}, {creature:Werelion|Werelions} and {creature:Werelioness|Werelionesses}, who hit hard.

Drainage area beneath the sewers of **Rathleton** (Oramond), full of fungus creatures that hit hard and turn invisible; missions of the {wiki:Oramond Quest} and the {wiki:Opticording Sphere Quest} take place here.
Sewer Grate in the Workshop Quarter (sewer entrance)

Go to **Oramond**: in **Thais**, say {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp) to {npc:Captain Bluebear}. You disembark at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft ({coord:33479,31988,7}), **west** of Oramond.

Enter the {item:Slime Slide} (it takes you to a mound on the main island), go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to the small boat: the portal on that boat ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you near the city. Head **north** to Rathleton.
In the Workshop Quarter, go **southwest** of {npc:Doubleday}'s building, under the docks, and enter the {item:Sewer Grate} ({coord:33622,31978,7}). You go down 2 floors.

In the sewers, head to the ramp at {coord:33660,31892,9} and go down to the Lower Drainage Area ({coord:33643,31893,10}). Shortcut: one floor below the stairs there is a teleport ({coord:33614,31985,10}) that brings you closer to the ramp.
Go back the **same way** to where you arrived through the grate and climb the {item:Rungs In The Wall|rungs in the wall} (use them like a ladder) to the Workshop Quarter.
To leave the island, go back through the boat portal and the Slime Slide to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
Ramp to the Lower Drainage Area
Teleport (shortcut), one floor below the stairs
Not a good place to hunt: the fungus creatures hit hard, often turn invisible and the loot is poor. The wiki recommends level 150+.

Hunting area of **Roshamuul** between the Inquisition base camp (where the boat docks) and the bridge to Guzzlemaw Valley, with underground caves on the ground floor to the east; dangerous (suggested level 200).
In **Thais**, go to the port and say to {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}): {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp).
The boat docks at the Inquisition base camp, in the south of Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop} ({coord:33493,32569,7}) and {npc:Sandomo}.

Go up the camp's ramp: Lower Roshamuul starts right there and stretches **west** and **east**. To the **east** there are more ramps that go down to the mountainous ground floor, with access to the underground caves.
Return to the southern camp by going down the Lower Roshamuul ramp (if you are in Upper Roshamuul, cross Guzzlemaw Valley and the bridge to the **south** first).
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
If you get stuck in the Lava Holes cave, enter the {item:Instable Vortex} at the far **left** (west) end to escape.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
Map of Roshamuul with the areas marked
Dangerous area: the wiki suggests level 200 (minimum 130–150).
The ground floor can be full of monsters; the caves help, but they do not always come out where you went in. In one of them there are Lava Holes that attack you.

The last three floors (-6, -7 and -8) of {wiki:The Spike}, the gnome cave reached through a crystal teleport in Kazordoon; it is the section for the {wiki:Spike Tasks Quest|daily tasks} for level 80+.
You can only enter the section for your level: the Lower Spike is for **level 80+** (25–49 Upper Spike, 50–79 Middle Spike).
Go to **Kazordoon** (on foot through the mountain or by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}).

In the temple area, enter the **north** teleport, near {npc:Xelvar} ({coord:32623,31857,11}). It is a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)|large crystal teleporter} and does not use up {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals}. You arrive at The Spike.
Go down the floors of the Spike to the Lower Spike. {npc:Gnomargery}, who gives the tasks for this section, is on floor **-7** ({coord:32243,32598,14}).
Go back to the section's safe zone and climb up to the area where you arrived at The Spike.
Use the crystal teleport back to the **Kazordoon** temple area ({coord:32623,31857,11}).

The mix of creatures makes hunting hard (the wiki says level 150+). The {creature:Lost Basher|Lost} cause heavy drunkenness: use a {item:Dwarven Ring}. Beware of the throwers {creature:Lost Thrower} and {creature:Lost Husher}.

Mages' district in the **northeast of Yalahar**, less run-down than the others but full of evil sorcerers; it is divided into six zones (Marid, Efreet, Research Centre, Restricted Area, Residential Area and Academy of Magic) and in one of them the floor opened up for creatures from hell.

Travel to **Yalahar**: in Liberty Bay talk to {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; you need the Novice rank in the Explorer Society) or, in Thais, to {npc:Captain Bluebear} if you bought the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}. With the In Service of Yalahar routes there is a direct boat from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore. You arrive at the port, **south** of the centre.
From the city centre head **northeast**: the Magician Quarter has no gate mechanism, so you enter directly from the centre.

Alternatively, from the port go from district to district past the gate guards, saying {key:pass} and the destination to each: {npc:Peter} (Trade → Factory Quarter), {npc:Oliver} (Factory → Sunken Quarter) and {npc:Barry} (Sunken → Magician Quarter).
Go back to the centre of Yalahar through the same gate (or through {npc:Reed}, to the {wiki:Cemetery Quarter}, or through {npc:Barry}, to the {wiki:Sunken Quarter}: {key:pass} and the destination).

At the port, {npc:Captain Cookie} ({coord:32804,31276,6}) takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or Thais (800 gp); with the routes unlocked, {npc:Karith} takes you to 8 cities.
The hunting areas are separated from the main road by walls, but inside there are {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, djinns and demons: recommended level 40–45+.
Some entrances (such as the Research Centre) have {item:Gate of Expertise|Gates of Expertise} with a minimum level.
Research centre in the {wiki:Magician Quarter} of **Yalahar** (northeast of the city), taken over by cult members; it has Gates of Expertise for levels 30 and 40 and goes down to floor -4.

To go to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay) you need the **Novice** rank of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}. Alternatively, pay 250 gp to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (west of Kazordoon) for the password ({key:whizzkid}) and travel from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}. With the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} there are direct boats from several cities.
**Level 30** for the {item:Gate of Expertise} at the building entrance and **level 40** for the one on floor -1.

Go to **Yalahar**: in **Liberty Bay**, {npc:Captain Max} takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}, 400 gp); {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais also takes you, if you have the password. If you have already done the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}, there are direct boats from several cities. You arrive at the port, **south** of the city centre.
From the city centre, enter the {wiki:Magician Quarter}, to the **northeast**: this district has no gate mechanism, you enter directly from the centre.
Go to the Research Centre building ({coord:32826,31082,7}). Outside there are about 15 {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices of the Cult}.
Enter through the level 30 {item:Gate of Expertise}. To go further down, on floor -1 pass through one of the level 40 {item:Gate of Expertise|Gates of Expertise} and continue to floor -4.
Go back up the same floors and pass through the two {item:Gate of Expertise|Gates of Expertise} again to the street.

Go back to the centre of Yalahar through the Magician Quarter gate and go to the port, **south** of the centre: {npc:Captain Cookie} takes you to **Liberty Bay** ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or to **Thais** ({key:thais}, 800 gp); with the In Service of Yalahar routes, {npc:Karith} takes you to 8 cities.
Blood Crystal chest (floor -3, Blood Brothers Quest)

Inside there are {creature:Novice of the Cult|Novices} and {creature:Acolyte of the Cult|Acolytes of the Cult}; on the deeper floors (down to -4) stronger cultists appear, and a {creature:Serpent Spawn}.
Fortress of {npc:Malor}'s green djinns (Efreets), hidden in the Kha'zeel mountains **north/northwest of Ankrahmun**; the traders {npc:Alesar} and {npc:Yaman} are here.
Passage next to the oasis to Mal'ouquah
Only players of **level 30** or higher can pass the entrance doors.
To buy from and sell to {npc:Alesar} and {npc:Yaman} you must have done {wiki:The Djinn War - Efreet Faction} (Green Djinn Quest).
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the captain at your city's port); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city to the **north** to the oasis and follow the passage that goes into the mountains ({coord:33101,32657,7}).
The passage leads to the fortress ({coord:33041,32627,7}); the entrance is on the **1st floor above ground**. Pass the level 30 doors.
Go back the same way: leave the fortress through the 1st-floor entrance, go down the mountain passage to the oasis and head **south** to Ankrahmun.
At the Ankrahmun harbour, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Mal'ouquah, the fortress of the green djinns

Inside the fortress there are {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns}, {creature:Efreet|Efreets}, {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} and {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} (mostly on the underground floors); the hunting area is for level 50+.

The southernmost island of the {wiki:Forbidden Islands}, southwest of Goroma, with a swamp on the surface ({creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, quaras) and an underground maze full of quaras; it is the last stop of the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} teleport chain.
Stairs of the Malada Teleportation Hub
You need {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat to Goroma and to have unlocked the Goroma → Ramoa → Talahu → Malada teleports, all through {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.
In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} at the port: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You disembark in the **east** of Goroma.
On Goroma go to the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} stairs ({coord:32038,32561,7}), go down and enter the **right** teleport (Ramoa).
At the Ramoa hub enter the **right** teleport again (Talahu) and, at the Talahu hub, the **right** one (Malada).
Go up the stairs of the Malada hub ({coord:32018,32679,7}) and you are on the surface of the island.

The first time, the teleport to Malada does not work yet: you have to cross on foot from Talahu (go up to the surface, head **southeast** and follow the Shattered Isles Quest route); when you reach the Malada hub through the **left** teleport you unlock the trip.
Go down to the Malada Teleportation Hub ({coord:32018,32679,7}) and always use the **left** teleports: Malada → Talahu → Ramoa → Goroma.
On Goroma go up the hub stairs and head **east** to {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)

Area for level 60–70+: lots of {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} and quaras; underground {creature:Hydra|Hydras} also appear.
The hole in the southeast of the island is the only connection to {wiki:Kharos} (Ferumbras Citadel) and only works for going down.
At the hub there is a Royal Mailbox: bring a {item:Parcel} and a {item:Label} if you want to send loot to the depot.
Tropical archipelago of the Nagas, **south of Roshamuul and east of Ankrahmun**, with two settlements: Silvertides (coastal Nagas) and Moonfall (mountain Nagas).
Go to the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains}, the mountain range between Tiquanda (Port Hope) and Ankrahmun.
Climb to the top of the mountain, **5 floors above ground level**, to the portal ({coord:33037,32738,2}). Enter the portal: you are teleported to Marapur.

Marapur is also part of the {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} network (Premium only): the island's carpet is in **Moonfall** ({coord:33805,32768,2}). Ask the carpet operators about the available destinations.
Go to the magic carpet in **Moonfall** ({coord:33805,32768,2}) and talk to {npc:Ziyad}: say {key:hi} and ask him about the destinations. The carpets only serve Premium players.
The wiki does not describe a return portal to the Kha'zeel Mountains; without Premium, the page does not indicate another way out.
Portal to Marapur (top of the Kha'zeel Mountains)

The climb up the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains} passes through areas with {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}, wyverns and dragons; the wiki warns that {creature:Massive Energy Elemental|Massive Energy Elementals} can kill an inattentive level 80–90 player.
Small area in the **northeast of the Guzzlemaw Valley**, east of the Roshamuul wall, where the boss {creature:Mawhawk} lives; it only opens as a world change.
The entrance only appears (world change) after the desecrating shrines task in the Guzzlemaw Valley has been done about **500 times** since the last time the lair closed.
You must be able to reach the {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} (repaired Roshamuul bridge).

In **Thais**, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the port: {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). You disembark at the camp in the south of Lower Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop} ({coord:33493,32569,7}).
Go up the ramp from the camp and cross the bridge to the **north** to the {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}.
Cross the valley to the **northeast**, pass the Roshamuul wall ({coord:33632,32401,7}) on the outside and continue **east** to the lair entrance ({coord:33698,32461,7}), if it is open.
Go back the same way to the **west/southwest** through the Guzzlemaw Valley, cross the bridge to the **south** and go down the ramp to the Lower Roshamuul camp.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Area for level 140–180+: {creature:Frazzlemaw|Frazzlemaws}, {creature:Guzzlemaw|Guzzlemaws} and the boss {creature:Mawhawk} (45,000 HP). The route through the Guzzlemaw Valley is also very dangerous.
3-floor maze in the {wiki:Pits of Inferno} (beneath the Plains of Havoc, southwest of Venore) that leads to the throne room of {wiki:Bazir}, the lord of lies; it is full of traps and fake monsters.
Reach the main room (teleport room) of the Pits of Inferno by following the {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest} (gear, {item:Holy Tible}, level 80 door, etc.).

Shortcut: once you have already entered a throne room, the {item:Sealed Door|sealed door} of the {wiki:Necromant House} (one floor above the teleport to the Void) takes you to the Hub Shortcut ({coord:32837,32235,13}), right before the main room.
Follow the route of the {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest} to the main room of the Pits of Inferno (or use the Necromant House shortcut, if you already have it).
In the main room, enter the Throne of Deceit (Bazir) teleport: you start on the lower floor of the maze ({coord:32806,32328,15}).
Follow the **green lines** on the maps: each one ends at a hole or rope spot where you go up or down; when one ends at a tile that is neither a hole nor a rope spot, you have reached the end.
In the final room, pull the lever on the **southeast** side (it may be covered by an {creature:Orc} corpse); a teleport appears in the **southwest** hole: enter it to leave the maze.
Follow the next rooms to the throne room; after stepping on the throne, step on the carpet next to the knight statue in the **northwest** to return to the main room.

To leave the Pits of Inferno: go back through the realm of the Ruthless Seven following the exit signs, or ask {npc:A Ghostly Sage} for a teleport (right before the rewards room). You appear in the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave under the Plains of Havoc; climb to the surface and walk **northeast** to Venore.
Full map with instructions and rope holes
**Always** check the minimap before going up a rope hole: on the upper floor, any rope hole takes you to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}, **with no way back**.

Never use levers or {item:Magic Forcefield|Magic Forcefields} inside the maze (only the final lever): they send you to the wrong places. The locked door with a hole leading to a teleport is also a trap.
There are {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Demon|Demons}, fake {creature:Demon (Goblin)|"Demon" Goblins} and, rarely, {creature:Countess Sorrow}.

Maze of tunnels (the *MoLS*) several floors **beneath the Fields of Glory**, north of Carlin, built by trolls on the orders of the warlocks to protect {wiki:Demona}; it holds the {wiki:Griffin Shield Quest} and is the way to the {wiki:Crystal Wand Quest}.
Maze of Lost Souls entrance hole
You need **level 30** to enter the maze; to get past to Demona there is a **level 60** {item:Gate of Expertise}.

Start from **Carlin** (by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city). Leave the city to the **north**, through the {wiki:Fields of Glory}, and head **northeast** to the cave a little **south** of {wiki:Northport} ({coord:32488,31610,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} to open a hole at {coord:32512,31624,7} and go in. Follow the **blue** line on the map to the next hole.

Keep following the blue line to a small forest inside the cave. Behind the trees there is a hidden hole: go down and flip the lever to the **right** (if it is already on the right, flip it to the left and then right again). Go back up.
Continue to the entrance hole ({coord:32483,31633,9}), crossing a few {item:Energy Field|Energy Fields}, and go down: you are in the Maze of Lost Souls.
Inside the maze you cannot always go back through the same tunnel: follow the exit route on the map (there are other exits, but this is the shortest and safest).
Then leave the cave the **same way you came in** (lever and holes area, climbing up with the {item:Rope}) to the surface, south of Northport.
Walk back to the **southwest**, through the Fields of Glory, to **Carlin**.
Alternative (level 60+): cross {wiki:Demona} to the teleport that drops you in the Fields of Glory ({coord:32400,31657,15}).
Spot to dig with the shovel
Another descent indicated by the wiki
Teleport from Demona to the Fields of Glory
First part of the route (blue line) after the hole opened with the shovel
Exit route from the Maze of Lost Souls
It is very easy to get lost: mark the dead ends on the map, or use stones on the floor to mark corridors already explored. A {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} is the emergency exit.
There are creatures of all kinds, from {creature:Rat|Rats} to {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}.
Cave of {creature:Medusa|Medusas} and {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns} beneath {wiki:Talahu} (the island of the Hydras, in the Shattered Isles west of Liberty Bay), behind a level door.
Talahu (the cave lies beneath the island)
Access to Talahu through the {wiki:Teleportation Hub}, unlocked in {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} (mushroom puzzle in Ramoa).
Get past a level door (gate of expertise) underground at Talahu.
Go to **Liberty Bay** (boat: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}) and, at the docks, ask {npc:Jack Fate} to take you to Goroma: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes}.
On Goroma go down to the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} and use the **right** teleport (to Ramoa) and, at the Ramoa hub, the **right** one again (to Talahu).
Go up the Talahu hub stairs ({coord:31921,32658,7}). On the surface there are 20–30 {creature:Hydra|Hydras}.

Go down to the cave maze beneath Talahu (full of {creature:Quara Scout|Quara Scouts} and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}) and follow the route on the map. Two floors down there is a square maze of Quara Scouts; to the **north** of it is the level door that leads to the Medusa Cave.
Go back the same way to the surface of Talahu and the Teleportation Hub stairs ({coord:31921,32658,7}).

At the hub use the **left** teleport (Ramoa) and, in Ramoa, the **left** one again (Goroma). Go up the Goroma hub stairs and talk to {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
Medusas and Serpent Spawns hit very hard and respawn quickly: do not go down to the deepest floor if you cannot handle the full respawn of the floor above.
On the way there are many {creature:Quara Scout|Quara Scouts} in addition to the {creature:Hydra|Hydras} on the Talahu surface.
Lizard-style tower in the **southwest of the Tiquanda jungle**, east of Port Hope and just south of the Hunters/Dworcs camp; the creatures get stronger with each floor you climb.
Go to **Port Hope** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain in your city); you arrive next to {npc:Charles}.
Leave Port Hope and cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **east** to the Hunters/Dworcs camp ({coord:32900,32792,7}).
The tower is just **south** of the camp. You do not enter through the door: go down the **hole north of the tower** and follow the tunnel to the basement.
From the basement go up the stairs to the ground floor ({coord:32865,32830,7}) and to the upper floors.
Go down the floors to the basement and return through the tunnel to the hole you came in by.
Use the {item:Rope} on the hole to climb up to the surface and walk back to the **west**, through the jungle, to Port Hope ({npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities).
Ground floor: ranged attack lines next to the stairs
Ground floor: safe spot to fight
Recommended area for **level 200+**: from the 1st floor there are {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}, and higher up Serpent Spawns and Demon Skeletons.

On the ground floor and the 1st floor you are attacked from a distance over the wall as soon as you arrive from the stairs: go to the **south** side of the stairs and protect yourself with {item:Fire Bomb Rune|Fire Bomb Runes}; bring {item:Energy Bomb Rune|Energy Bomb Runes} for the Behemoths.
Small island in the {wiki:Shattered Isles}, **north of Vandura** (near Liberty Bay), where the rebels founded the village of **Sabrehaven**, hidden behind the mountains of the south coast.
{npc:Captain Waverider} only takes you if you know the password {key:peg leg}, which you get in the *Access to Meriana* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} (after gaining Eleonore's trust).
Go to **Liberty Bay** (for example from Venore, with {npc:Captain Fearless}, or from Edron, with {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}).
In Liberty Bay, go to the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} ({coord:32347,32859,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes}: he takes you to **Sabrehaven**, the rebels' village on Meriana, for **50 gp**.
On Meriana, the mermaid {npc:Marina} is on the **north** coast, north of Sabrehaven ({coord:32329,32528,7}); {npc:Sebastian} is **south** of Sabrehaven.
Go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven ({coord:32347,32623,7}), and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes}: he takes you back to **Liberty Bay** for **50 gp**.
In Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32556,6}) takes you by boat to other cities (for example {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
Captain Waverider — boat to Meriana (Liberty Bay)
Sebastian — return to Liberty Bay (south of Sabrehaven)

The island is quite safe (frogs, crabs, wasps), but in the mountains there are spiders, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and a {creature:Tiger}; the {wiki:Meriana Gargoyle Cave} has {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} and {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}.

Cave beneath the island of {wiki:Meriana}, entered through the Meriana garden, full of {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}, {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and {creature:Thornback Tortoise|Thornback Tortoises}.

In **Liberty Bay**, go to the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you to Sabrehaven, on the island of {wiki:Meriana}.
On Meriana, go to the island's garden ({coord:32389,32604,7}): that is where the cave entrance is. Inside there are 4 floors.
Go back the same way to the Meriana garden (the wiki does not describe another exit).
To return to **Liberty Bay**, go **south** of Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
The wiki recommends level 30–35+. The {creature:Blood Crab|Blood Crabs} and Tarantulas poison you: bring potions.
Middle section of {wiki:The Spike}, the gnome tower connected to Kazordoon, on floors 4 and 5: this is where {npc:Gnombold} gives the {wiki:Spike Tasks Quest} tasks to players of **level 50 to 79**.
You can only enter the section for your level: the Middle Spike is for **level 50–79** (25–49 go to the {wiki:Upper Spike}, 80+ to the {wiki:Lower Spike}).
Go to **Kazordoon** (on foot through the mountain entrance, or by Steamship from {wiki:Cormaya} or Farmine: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}).

In the temple area, enter the **north** teleport, near {npc:Xelvar} ({coord:32623,31857,11}). It is a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)|large crystal teleporter} and does not use up {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals}. You arrive at {wiki:The Spike}.
Go to the **4th floor** of the Spike, to {npc:Gnombold}'s safe zone; from there you exit to the Middle Spike caves.
Go back to the safe zone of your section and return to the area where you arrived at the Spike.
Use the crystal teleport back to the **Kazordoon** temple area.

Beware of the {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}: they are the most dangerous monsters in this section and the area deals a lot of earth damage (there are also {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} and {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs}).
Street in the **northeast of Thais**, between Temple Street (west) and the city wall (east), with the mill, {npc:Gamon}'s furniture shop and the shops of {npc:Topsy} and {npc:Turvy}.
Travel to **Thais**: by boat, at the port of your city say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the port of Thais, next to {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}).
Cross the city to the **northeast** to Mill Avenue. It starts in the west, next to the north gate (guard {npc:Grof, The Guard}), and runs east to the wall.

From west to east: the mill, the Mill Avenue 1 and 2 shops, the Venore branch warehouse, {npc:Gamon}'s furniture shop ({coord:32408,32170,7}), {npc:Topsy}'s magic shop, {npc:Turvy}'s armour shop and, at the northeast post (3rd floor), the guard {npc:Miles, The Guard}.

Go back to the port of Thais and talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes} — for example Ab'Dendriel (130 gp), Carlin (110), Edron (160), Liberty Bay (180), Port Hope (160), Svargrond (180), Venore (170) or Yalahar (200).
On foot, leave Thais through the **north** gate, at the start of Mill Avenue.
Room three floors below ground level in the {wiki:Dwarf Mines} outside Kazordoon, where four mine tunnels connect; it has three royal mailboxes and is guarded by the only Dwarf Guards on that floor.
You may need the {item:Key 3802} to open the room (obtained in the {wiki:Emperor's Cookies Quest}).

Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}), with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} (you arrive next to {npc:Brodrosch}); or on foot through the mountain entrance (bring a {item:Rope} and a {item:Shovel}).
The mines outside the city are to the **west** of and beneath Kazordoon, outside the mountain, and have 6 entrances (see the ground floor map below).

Enter one of the tunnels that pass through the Mine Hub — **A** (yellow, Old Ore Mine), **B** (pink, Splintered Stone Mine), **E** (green, Pick 'N Shovel Mine) or **F** (blue, Drunken Fellow Mine) — and go down to the **3rd underground floor**, where these four tunnels meet at the Mine Hub.
Go back up the **same tunnel** you came down by, to the surface, west of Kazordoon.

To leave the area, go back to Kazordoon and take the {wiki:Steamship} of {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of the city ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
Dwarf Mines, ground floor: the 6 entrances
Dwarf Mines, 3rd underground floor: tunnels A, B, E and F connected by the Mine Hub
The room's {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards} hit hard against low levels: close the doors behind you so you do not release them on other players.
Minotaur cave in the **north of Rookgaard**, at the bottom of the island's big cave (north of the level 2 bridge); this is where the {wiki:Minotaur Hell Quest} is.
In the village of **Rookgaard**, head **north**, cross the level 2 bridge and keep going to Rookgaard's big cave ({coord:32094,32137,7}); go down.
Floor -1: cross the cave to the **east** (there is a {creature:Rat}, a few {creature:Troll|Trolls} and maybe {creature:Spider|Spiders}) to the stairs and go down.
Floor -2: head **north**; at the first junction go **northeast** and at the second **northwest**, to the next stairs. Go down.
Floor -3 (wolf maze): head **north**, between {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Orc|Orcs}, to one more stairs: that one leads to the Minotaur Hell.
Go back the same way, stairs by stairs: the wolf maze (-3) to the **south**, floor -2 back through the two junctions and floor -1 to the **west**.
You come out in the big cave north of the level 2 bridge; from there go back **south** to the village of Rookgaard.
The monsters come in large numbers (minotaurs, orcs and wolves): use a {item:Box|box} to block paths and let only 1–2 creatures attack you at a time.
Sometimes the boss {creature:Apprentice Sheng} appears. The {creature:Minotaur Mage} you see in a room to the west is unreachable.
Underground city of the minotaurs, hidden far below the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just **northwest of the north gate of Thais**; it is reached by a long route of tunnels.
Ancient Temple (start of the route to Mintwallin)
Recommended level: knights 35+, paladins 30+, mages 27+ (the city is full of minotaurs of all kinds).
In **Thais**, leave through the **north** gate and go to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just northwest of that gate ({coord:32356,32171,7}).
Go down **two floors** and head as far **north** as you can; then go down one more floor to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} floor.
Head **east** and then **south** and go down the ladder.

On the next floor there are many {item:Poison Field|poison fields}: run across them and cure the poison with {item:Antidote Rune|Antidote}, or clear a path with {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field}. Then go down one more floor.
Head **east** and **north** (beware of the {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}) and go down the hole marked with a circle on the map: 2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} are waiting for you below.
After killing the Cyclopes, follow the route maps (there are hardly any monsters now, maybe a {creature:Rat}); on the last map follow the **blue** line, from A to B.
When you reach the **two ladders**, go down either one and take a few steps to the **west**: you are at the gate of Mintwallin.

Alternative (Premium): the 4th floor of the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, in the Plains of Havoc, has a teleport to Mintwallin; it only works with the 4th rank of the {wiki:Dreamer's Challenge Quest} and an {item:Orichalcum Pearl} in your backpack.
Leave through the Mintwallin gate, climb one of the two ladders and do the route in reverse to the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, using the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through.
Shortcut on the way back: follow the **red** line on the route maps to a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, go down it and continue along the **blue** line to the exit.
From the Ancient Temple you return to Thais through the north gate.
A Prisoner (prison, west side of the city)
Teleport east of the Mintwallin entrance
Route to Mintwallin — map 10 (blue and red lines)
The route has **down-only holes**: if you are not careful you can fall where you do not want to.
The hole on the Bonelords shortcut is down-only (there is no place for the rope): it cannot be used to go back to Mintwallin.

On the way you may meet {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, a {creature:Dragon}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, a {creature:Fire Devil} and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}.

Former PvE arenas (2016–2021) where teams of up to 5 premium players faced 10 waves of Pit Demons; they were **replaced by the {wiki:Tibiadrome}** in the Summer Update 2021. The entrances were next to the {wiki:Duelling Arena|Duelling Arenas} of five cities.
Thais arena entrance (Main Street, next to the depot)
The fights were for **premium** accounts only; Free Accounts could watch from above.
They no longer exist: the same entrances now lead to the {wiki:Tibiadrome}.
Go to one of the five cities with an arena and enter the {item:Mystic Flame} next to the Duelling Arena:
**Thais**: next to the depot, on Main Street ({coord:32352,32221,7}).
**Edron**: next to the north gate, in {wiki:Castle Flats} ({coord:33200,31785,7}).
**Rathleton**: next to the temple, in Rathleton Shops ({coord:33603,31889,6}).
**Kazordoon**: next to the north gate of The Market ({coord:32603,31914,8}).
The sources do not describe the way out of the arena; go back through the entrance you came in by, which drops you in the city where you entered.
For the {wiki:Measuring Tibia Quest}, the arena halls and stands count as part of the city's subarea.
Primal Menace teleport (north of the Monster Graveyard)

Large lair beneath the sands of the Kha'labal, the desert **north of Ankrahmun**, with {creature:Larva|Larvae}, {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}, {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs}, {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts} and {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}.
Mother of Scarabs Lair north entrance
Take a boat to **Ankrahmun** (say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the port captain); you disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city into the desert **north** of Ankrahmun.
**South entrance:** at {coord:33290,32603,7}; here you may have to dig a few times with the {item:Shovel} to open the hole.
Go back the same way to the entrance you came down by (use the {item:Rope} on the holes).
Walk back to Ankrahmun. {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}) takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes}).
Sarcophagus with the Ocarina (2 floors down)
Recommended level 55–60+: there are many mummies, some {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts} and about 2 {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}.

Mountain **northeast of Thais** and southwest of Kazordoon, with deep caves of {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, undead and a dragon lair on the deepest floor; it used to be the only route between Thais and the rest of the continent.
Go to **Thais** (if you are in another city, take a boat and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain).
Leave Thais on foot to the **northeast**, towards Kazordoon, to the mountain ({coord:32494,32072,7}).
Enter through the **west entrance** ({coord:32450,32070,7}) and go down the stairs into the caves.
The {wiki:Mount Sternum/Undead Cave|Undead Cave} also has a surface entrance at {coord:32418,32017,7}, near the witch's tower south of Kazordoon.
Go back the same way: climb the floors you went down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes where needed) to the west entrance and return to Thais, to the **southwest**.
You can also cross the mountain to **Kazordoon** through the {wiki:Route:Thais to Kazordoon|secret passage of Mount Sternum} (see maps below).
If you came in through the Dwarf Mines, the exit on the other side is the Pick 'N Shovel Mine, west of Kazordoon ({coord:32548,31987,7}).
Undead Cave entrance (next to the witch's tower)
Stairs in the middle of Mount Sternum
Passage from Thais to Kazordoon through Mount Sternum (part 1)
Passage from Thais to Kazordoon through Mount Sternum (part 2)
Be careful not to get surrounded by the {creature:Cyclops Smith|Cyclops Smiths} at a low level; if you are only passing through, a {spell:Magic Shield} helps.

On the passage to Kazordoon you may meet {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and, if someone lures them, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers}, {creature:Mummy|Mummies} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}.
Multi-floor undead cave beneath {wiki:Mount Sternum}, **north of Thais** and southwest of Kazordoon; the monsters get stronger with each floor you go down.
Surface entrance, next to the witch's tower south of Kazordoon

Get to **Thais** (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain) and leave the city on foot to the **northeast**, towards {wiki:Mount Sternum} ({coord:32494,32072,7}), on the way to Kazordoon.
**North entrance (more direct):** keep going to the surface entrance at {coord:32418,32017,7}, near the witch's tower south of Kazordoon, and go down.

**Through the Cyclops cave:** go down at the west entrance of Mount Sternum ({coord:32450,32070,7}), head **northwest** through the {creature:Cyclops} cave and go down at {coord:32418,32041,8}: you reach the Undead Cave, with {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}.
From there, each hole takes you one floor deeper (see the floor maps below).
Go back the same way: climb the floors you went down and use the {item:Rope} on each hole.
Leave through the north entrance ({coord:32418,32017,7}), next to the witch's tower, or through the Cyclops cave to the west entrance of Mount Sternum.
From the mountain walk back to the **southwest** to Thais (or to the **north** to Kazordoon).
West entrance of Mount Sternum (Cyclops cave)
Descent from the Cyclops cave to the Undead Cave
Stairs in the centre of Mount Sternum
You need a {item:Pick} to reach parts of the 5th floor and below.
It is far from the cities and is a usual spot for PKs on PvP worlds.
Tomb under the Kha'labal desert, **north of Ankrahmun**, next to the mountains and the Giant Spider hill (hence also called "GS Tomb"); it is the tomb of the pharaoh {creature:Dipthrah}.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the captain at your city's port); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city through the **north** exit ({coord:33182,32773,7}) and head **north** across the desert to the foot of the mountains, near the ramp to {wiki:Ashta'daramai} ({coord:33120,32578,7}).
The entrance is at {coord:33132,32568,7}: use the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down.
The {item:Magic Forcefield} in the pharaoh's room, used **without** the pass item in your inventory, takes you to the start of the tomb; if there is no teleport, go back the way you came.
At the start of the tomb use the {item:Rope} on the entrance hole to get out to the surface.
Walk back **south** to Ankrahmun; at the port, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
The deeper you go, the stronger the creatures: the 1st floor is for low levels, but the 2nd has {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and the floors after the teleports are for level 50–80+.
Plains of {wiki:Zao} dominated by high-class lizards, **north of the Dragonblaze Peaks**; you can only get there through the old lizard teleport of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.
The Zao Steppe lizard teleport only works after you complete the **first 8 missions** of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch} at the bottom of Kazordoon ({coord:32661,31957,15}) or {npc:Gurbasch} 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}).
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage to the **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
In the **north** of the steppe, south of the Dragonblaze Peaks, use the old lizard teleport ({coord:33198,31350,7}): it takes you to the Muggy Plains.
Go back to the lizard teleport the same way and return to the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.
Cross the steppe to the mountain, climb up with {spell:Levitate} where you came down and take the lift to Farmine.
At the port of Farmine, talk to {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Lizard teleport to the Muggy Plains (north of the Zao Steppe)
Area of strong lizards ({creature:Draptor|Draptors}, {creature:Dreadmaw} and, sometimes, {creature:Flamecaller Zazrak}): recommended for high levels.
From time to time the area fills with {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles}, which reduce distance skill.
Fortified camp of the Muglex clan goblins in the **northwest of the island of Newhaven**; it is the first threat new players face in the {wiki:Newhaven Quest}.
The camp is on the island of Newhaven itself (the island where new players start).
Leave the village through the **north** exit, which leads to the hunting area, and head **northwest** to the camp ({coord:32526,32430,7}).
Take the same route **south** back to the village of Newhaven.

To leave the island you must be **level 8**: leave through the **west** exit of the village (level door) and talk to {npc:Anna} at the docks ({coord:32552,32498,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}. She takes you to {wiki:Targuna}.
{creature:Muglex Clan Footman|Muglex Clan Footmen}, {creature:Muglex Clan Assassin|Assassins} and the chief {creature:Muglex Clan Chief} live there.

Museum of Tibian art (MOTA) run by {npc:Gareth}, reached through a teleport **beneath the Thais Games Hall**; at night the statues on the 2nd floor come to life and on the 3rd floor there are cultists.
Teleport to the museum (beneath the Thais Games Hall)
The teleport only works with a **Premium account**.
For the {wiki:Cults of Tibia Quest} mission you have to become a patron of the museum: say {key:hi}, {key:patron} and {key:yes} to {npc:Gareth} (10,000 gp).
Go to **Thais** (by boat, with the captain in your city: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Go to the Games Hall ({coord:32387,32210,7}), west of the Knights Guild, and go down **1 floor** (underground -1).
Enter the teleport ({coord:32395,32193,8}): you are taken into the museum, where {npc:Gareth} is ({coord:33305,32140,8}).
Go back the same way to the museum's entrance teleport: it takes you back to the basement of the Thais Games Hall.
Go up to the street; the port of Thais ({npc:Captain Bluebear}, {coord:32310,32210,6}) is to the west.

At **night** the statues on the 2nd floor come to life (including an {creature:Animated Guzzlemaw}); low-level players should not walk around that floor at night. The wiki points to level 100 for hunting here.
On the 3rd floor there are {creature:Goldhanded Cultist|Goldhanded Cultists} and {creature:Goldhanded Cultist Bride|Cultist Brides}.
Gnome mushroom gardens on the lower floors of {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha}, beneath the Gnomegate, where the Spore Gathering mission of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} takes place.
Mushroom Corkscrew Stairs (descent to the Mushroom Gardens)

Access to the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}: **level 80** and {npc:Xelvar}'s authorisation in Kazordoon (start of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}: {key:hi}, {key:adventures}, {key:recruiting}, {key:partners}, {key:gnomes}, {key:help}, {key:join}).
The teleport to Gnomebase Alpha only works with **rank II** of the Bigfoot's Burden Quest (more than 120 reputation points) and a Premium Account.
One {item:Teleport Crystal} (150 gp) for each entry and exit of the GCTS.

In **Kazordoon**, enter the GCTS teleport **east** of {npc:Xelvar}, near the northern blesser ({coord:32628,31863,11}). There are also GCTS teleports in Thais (Ancient Temple), Edron (sewers), Darashia (mountain to the northwest), Liberty Bay (mountains to the southeast) and Svargrond (hole next to the west exit).
You appear at the GCTS hub, above the Gnomegate; go down to the Gnomegate.
At the Gnomegate, enter the {item:Large Crystal Teleporter} that leads to {wiki:Gnomebase Alpha} ({coord:32796,31780,10}).
In Gnomebase Alpha, walk **south** and go down the ramp ({coord:32997,31901,9}).
Walk a few steps **north** and go down the mushroom spiral stairs (Mushroom Corkscrew Stairs, {coord:32991,31885,10}). You are in the Mushroom Gardens.
Go back up the same spiral stairs and the ramp to Gnomebase Alpha.
Use the teleport next to {npc:Gnomincia} ({coord:32979,31868,9}) to go back to Gnomegate.

Go up to the GCTS hub and enter the teleport of the city you want to go to (Kazordoon, Thais, Edron, Darashia, Liberty Bay or Svargrond). It costs one more {item:Teleport Crystal}: always bring at least two.
Teleport from the Gnomegate to Gnomebase Alpha
The second largest island of the {wiki:Shattered Isles}, **west of Liberty Bay**, surrounded by reefs and mountains; it is the biggest known pirate base, full of caves and traps.
The boat to Meriana needs the password {key:peg leg} (*Access to Meriana* mission of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}).
The wiki says that access to Nargor is gained with the {wiki:Meriana Quest}.
At the Liberty Bay dock talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} ({coord:32347,32859,7}): {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you to **Meriana**.
In Meriana, **south** of Sabrehaven, talk to {npc:Sebastian} ({coord:32347,32623,7}): {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
You disembark in Nargor next to {npc:Sebastian}'s other boat ({coord:32024,32815,7}).
Go back the same way to where you disembarked ({coord:32024,32815,7}).
Talk to Nargor's {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (100 gp) to return directly to Liberty Bay, or {key:meriana} (50 gp) for Sabrehaven.
Teleport in the pirate leaders' hideout

The island is full of pirates ({creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}, {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Pirate Cutthroats}, {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Pirate Buccaneers}, {creature:Pirate Corsair|Pirate Corsairs}), caves and traps; recommended level 35–45+.
Large house of the necromancer Arcian in the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **east of the Dark Cathedral** (southwest of Venore), built over the Shrine of Wonders that guards the way to the Pits of Inferno.

The real teleport to the main room of the Pits of Inferno (1 floor above the broken teleport) is behind a sealed door: you can only open it if you have already entered at least one throne room in {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}.

Go to **Venore** (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}) and leave the city on foot to the **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} ({coord:32735,32297,7}). The Plains temple, where {npc:Oldrak} is, serves as a landmark.
The house is **east** of the {wiki:Dark Cathedral} ({coord:32781,32330,7}). According to the wiki, you enter through the **underground cave south** of the house.

Next to the house there is a graveyard: using the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} opens the narrow cave used in {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest} (there are several piles, all lead to the same cave).
Go back the same way to the surface of the Plains of Havoc and walk back to the **northeast** to Venore.
In Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} ({coord:32955,32022,6}) takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
Trashcan to the Bulltaur Lair (1 floor below the graveyard)
The ground-floor teleport is broken and leads to the "Void" (there is a sign warning: *"Somehow the teleporter got damaged."*).

In the Plains of Havoc there are {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Dragon|Dragons} west of the temple — be careful at low level.
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} sends you to your city's temple; it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.
Beginners' island (since October 2025), a peaceful coastal village **east of Bounac** where new characters start, learn the basics and level up to level 8 before leaving for the mainland.
Only new characters start here; anyone who leaves Newhaven **can never come back**.
The **west** exit of the village is a level door that only opens from **level 8**.
There is no travel to Newhaven: new characters start here automatically, right after choosing their vocation, and receive the *Welcome to Newhaven* mission of the {wiki:Newhaven Quest}.
The hunting area is at the **north** exit of the village; the {wiki:Corrupted Mines} are reached by climbing the stairs at the **northeast** tip ({coord:32598,32418,7}).
When you reach **level 8**, leave the village through the **west** exit (level 8 door) and go to the docks.
Talk to {npc:Anna} ({coord:32552,32498,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}. The trip is **one-way only**: it takes you to {wiki:Targuna}, on the Thais peninsula (Monks go to the Blue Valley).
Small icy island **northeast of Svargrond**, home to the guardian shamans ({npc:Hjaern}, {npc:Siflind}, {npc:Nilsor}); in the south it has two holes into the {wiki:Nibelor Ice Cave}.
{npc:Iskan} only takes you after you have done the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
Go to **Svargrond** by boat (from Carlin, Thais or Venore: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Breezelda}, in the **east** part of the city.
Go to the ice area **north/northeast** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the owner of the dog sled ({coord:32301,31083,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to Nibelor.
On the island, {npc:Hjaern} is in a cave to the **north** ({coord:32349,31026,7}) and {npc:Siflind} on the northern mountain, 1 floor up ({coord:32361,31029,6}).
Talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of the stone circle ({coord:32329,31044,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}. His sled takes you back to **Svargrond**.
In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you by boat to Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Hole to the Nibelor Ice Cave
Another hole to the Nibelor Ice Cave

Just **east** of where you arrive there is another {wiki:Dog sled|dog sled}: that one does not go back to Svargrond, it takes you to **Inukaya** (island of Grimlund) and the dogs eat a {item:Ham} per trip.

Cave of {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} on the island of {wiki:Nibelor}, **northeast of Svargrond**; you enter through two holes in the south of the island.
{npc:Iskan} only takes you to Nibelor after the first mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest} (finding the dog Sniffler), which requires the Barbarian Test to be done.
Take the boat to **Svargrond** (in Carlin, or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({coord:32347,31108,6}).
Go to the **northeast** of Svargrond and talk to {npc:Iskan} ({coord:32301,31085,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He takes you to Nibelor.
The two entrance holes are in the **south** of Nibelor ({coord:32356,31087,7} and {coord:32388,31075,7}). Go down through one of them.
Climb back up the same hole with the {item:Rope}.
To return to Svargrond, talk to {npc:Nilsor}, **west** of Nibelor's stone circle ({coord:32329,31044,7}), and ask for {key:passage}.
In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin (110 gp), Thais (180 gp) or Venore (150 gp): {key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}.
The {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders} (1250 HP) are considerably stronger than the {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems}: recommended level 45-60+.

Nightmare zone made of platforms connected by magic stairs, full of very dangerous creatures; you can only enter through a portal that appears in the **Darama** desert with the {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change}.
**Premium**. The portal only exists with the {wiki:Nightmare Isles Mini World Change} (active every day, in one of three places). Recommended **level 250**.
Go to **Darashia** (boat: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}) or to **Ankrahmun** (boat, you arrive at {npc:Captain Sinbeard}).
Read the message of the day to find out where the portal is and walk there across the desert:
*"Avoid the river near Drefia!"* → next to the Plague Spike, on the river near the Drefia mountains ({coord:33037,32404,7}).
*"Avoid the northernmost coast!"* → north of the Devourer, on the Darashia coast ({coord:33216,32273,7}).
*"Avoid the Ankrahmun tar pits!"* → Kha'labal, in the Ankrahmun desert ({coord:33265,32653,7}).
Enter the portal: you arrive at the Nightmare Isles. The platforms are connected by magic stairs that work like teleports (as in the {wiki:Roshamuul Cistern}).
The wiki does not describe an exit of its own: go back along the same magic stairs, platform by platform, to the point where you arrived through the portal.
Back in the Darama desert, walk back to Darashia or Ankrahmun, depending on the portal you entered through.

Some platforms have more than ten creatures that attack you all at the same time: {creature:Silencer|Silencers}, {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors}, {creature:Choking Fear|Choking Fears} and {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps}. Almost certain death for weak players.
Keep supplies for the return: the way out is the same way.
Breeding ground of the giant dragons of Nimmersatt, in **Zao**, reached through an {item:Ominous Trashcan} in the {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium}, in the north of the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.
Access is gained in the {wiki:20 Years a Cook Quest}.
The teleport from the Zao Steppe to the Muggy Plains only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}).

In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface. Continue **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
Use the old lizard teleport in the **north** of the steppe to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.
The {wiki:Temple of Equilibrium} is in the **north** of the Muggy Plains ({coord:33176,31199,7}). Use the {item:Ominous Trashcan} ({coord:33187,31190,7}) to enter the Breeding Ground.
Go back through the same floors to the point where you arrived through the trashcan and leave the same way, to the Temple of Equilibrium.
Return through the Muggy Plains and the lizard teleport to the Zao Steppe; from there climb the mountain at {coord:33085,31532,7} with {spell:Levitate} and head **west** to the Farmine lift.
On the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya} ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
Area for level 400+: {creature:Dragolisk|Dragolisks}, {creature:Mega Dragon|Mega Dragons} and {creature:Wardragon|Wardragons}.
Large cave of the nomads beneath the mountain pass between **Darashia and Ankrahmun**, good for hunting at low levels; the leader {npc:Muhad} lives inside.
Official entrance of the Nomad Cave (east of the pass to Darashia)
Official entrance: you have to start the {wiki:Arito's Task Quest} (talk to {npc:Arito} in Ankrahmun with a {item:Nomad Parchment}: {key:hi}, {key:nomads}, {key:yes}).
Secret entrance (back): the door inside only opens after you complete the {wiki:Arito's Task Quest}.
Go to **Ankrahmun** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Sinbeard}'s port).

Head **north** through the mountain pass that connects Ankrahmun to Darashia. The entrance is just **east** of that pass, in a small cave with a rock in the middle and a crack in the floor ({coord:33205,32544,7}).

**Official entrance** (with Arito's Task started): put a {item:Scimitar} on the crack tile and pour water on a tile **2 squares to the right** of it. A gate appears; go through it and enter the teleport in the small cave.

**Secret entrance** (with Arito's Task completed): in the desert nearby ({coord:33214,32553,7}) dig with the {item:Shovel} (sometimes you need to dig several times on the right tile), go down and pass through the door.
Go up the stairs behind {npc:Muhad} ({coord:33279,32526,9}) — the back exit.
Use the {item:Rope} to climb to the surface through the desert hole ({coord:33214,32553,7}).
From there walk **south** across the desert to **Ankrahmun**, or **north** through the mountain pass to **Darashia**.
Secret hole in the desert (at the back)
Official entrance: crack in the cave
If you enter through the official entrance after the quest, the {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads} attack you; the back door avoids problems with them.

The seven Ivory Towers in the **eastern part of Edron**: a magic academy with shops, the premium spell teachers, the Edron library and, beneath the central tower, the shrines of the {wiki:Elemental Spheres Quest}.

Go to **Edron** by boat, for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the port in the **north** of the city, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}).
Cross the city to the **east** to the seven ivory towers ({coord:33267,31849,7}).

Useful towers: in the **southeast tower**, top floor, is {npc:Arkulius} ({coord:33280,31845,3}); in the **northwest tower**, upper floors, {npc:Milos} ({coord:33259,31826,3}); in the **central tower** is {npc:Wyrdin} ({coord:33268,31838,6}) and, on the lowest floor, the elemental shrines ({coord:33267,31835,10}).
Go down/up to the ground floor of the tower you are in and leave to the streets of Edron.

Go back **west** and **north** to the harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes} — Thais 160 gp, Venore 40 gp, Carlin 110 gp, Ab'Dendriel 70 gp, Ankrahmun 160 gp, Port Hope 150 gp, Liberty Bay 170 gp, Cormaya 20 gp.

The rafts connecting the mainland, **northwest of Carlin**, to the icy islands of {wiki:Folda}, {wiki:Senja} and {wiki:Vega}: 20 gp from the mainland to an island, 10 gp between islands and free from an island to the mainland.
Get to **Carlin** (by boat: tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}; for example {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron).
Head **northwest** out of the city to {npc:Nielson}'s raft ({coord:32235,31675,7}).
Say {key:hi}, the name of the island ({key:folda}, {key:senja} or {key:vega}) and {key:yes} (20 gp).
You land in **Folda** next to {npc:Svenson}, in the **west** of **Senja** next to {npc:Anderson}, or in the **east** of **Vega** next to {npc:Carlson}.
To go back to the mainland (free): in Folda talk to {npc:Svenson} and in Senja to {npc:Anderson} ({key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes}); in Vega to {npc:Carlson} ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}).
You end up northwest of Carlin, next to {npc:Nielson}; from there walk to the city. Travelling between islands costs 10 gp.

The corrupted plantations in **northern Zao**, at the edge of the {wiki:Souleater Mountains} and near the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp}: a high-class lizard area, with a path to {wiki:Razachai} and a lizard tower in the far east.
Plantations above the Zao Rebel Camp
Access to northern Zao is through the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}: via the Lion's Den (mission 1) or, after mission 2, via the reactivated link to the rebel hideout.
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya}), with {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.

In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates), to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
Use the teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, in the north of the Zao Steppe ({coord:33198,31350,7}).

With mission 2 of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest done, follow the reactivated link to the rebel hideout, the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp} ({coord:33213,31058,9}), and go up to the plantations ({coord:33192,31081,7}).

The first time (mission 1), enter the Lion's Den with the {item:Shovel} at the hole in the east of the Muggy Plains ({coord:33353,31182,7}), get past the defences in disguise and come out in a watchtower in the **east** of northern Zao ({coord:33326,31082,7}).
After mission 2: in the Rebel Camp, go **south** of {npc:Chartan} and step on the blue flame, which takes you to the Muggy Plains.

In the Muggy Plains, go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport you arrived by and head **southwest** to the mountain pass ({coord:33085,31532,7}). Climb it with {spell:Levitate} and go **west** to the Farmine elevator.
On the Farmine Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp): {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}.
Before mission 2 there is no quick way back: the wiki describes no other exit than the tunnel you came through.
Exit of the Farmine pass onto the Zao Steppe
Hole to the Lion's Den (use the shovel)

The plantations have {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests} and {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards}; along the way there are also {creature:Souleater|Souleaters} and mutated animals. The east tower is easier (at most 6 lizards per floor).
A small fishing village **northeast of Carlin** and west of Ab'Dendriel, with an Explorer Society post; a little to the south is the cave that leads to the {wiki:Maze of Lost Souls}.
Go to **Carlin** (if you come by boat, tell the captain in your city {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Greyhound}).
Leave the city to the **north**, through the {wiki:Fields of Glory} ({coord:32362,31683,7}), and head **northeast** to Northport ({coord:32488,31610,7}).
Walk back **southwest**, through the Fields of Glory, to Carlin.
In Carlin take {npc:Captain Greyhound}'s boat to whichever city you want.
Mortimer (Explorer Society post, east of Northport)
Graubart (house in the south of Northport)
Along the way there are only weak creatures ({creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Spider|Spiders}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}), but the caves south of the village are much more dangerous.

Event island of the {wiki:Tibia Anniversary}, **northeast of Zao** and north of Gray Island, with old graphics, the museum, the graveyard and the Nostalgia Arena; it only exists during the Tibia anniversary (January).
It is only accessible during the {wiki:Tibia Anniversary} (every January, since 2019).
In **Thais**, go to {npc:Kendra}, just **southwest** of the city (south of the Open-Air Theatre, {coord:32263,32265,7}).
Say {key:hi} and {key:passage}: she takes you to {wiki:Vigintia} ({coord:33480,31031,7}).
In Vigintia, cross the **long bridge** that leaves the **east** coast of the island to Nostalgia. It is the only way: you can only get there on foot.
Go back **west** over the same bridge to Vigintia.
In Vigintia talk to {npc:Kendra} again: {key:hi} and {key:passage} to return to Thais.

Just like in the old days, not all the tiles are done properly: there are protection zones where you do not expect them, places without PZ where you would expect one, and grass that is water on the map (you cannot walk on it).
A tomb under the desert, just **north of the oasis** near Ankrahmun; in the deep parts lives the pharaoh {creature:Rahemos}.
For the deep parts you need a {item:Scarab Coin} (to put in the {item:Coal Basin}) and to get through an experience door for **level 75**.
Recommended levels: 1st floor from level 10–13; the floors after the teleports are for level 50–90.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city).
Head out into the desert and go to the oasis; the tomb entrance is just **north** of it ({coord:33132,32641,7}).
Dig with the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down.
For the deep parts: go down to floor -4, continue to the {item:Coal Basin}, step on the {item:Mystic Flame} (blue flame) and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin.
Go back to the start of the tomb and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.

On the upper floors there are {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}, {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and {creature:Slime|Slimes}; at the bottom, {creature:Demongoblin|Demongoblins}, {creature:Warlock|Warlocks} and {creature:Rahemos}.
Without the {item:Ancient Rune} in your inventory, the {item:Magic Forcefield} in Rahemos' room sends you back to the start of the tomb.

A small icy island **southeast of Hrodmir**, the only one of the icy islands with geysers on the surface; it is the land of {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} and {creature:Frost Dragon Hatchling|Frost Dragon Hatchlings}.
{npc:Buddel} will only take you after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}.
Go to **Svargrond** by boat (from Carlin, Thais or Venore: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}).
In Svargrond, go **south** to {npc:Buddel}'s boat ({coord:32254,31195,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:okolnir}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Since he is drunk, you may end up on another island: in that case ask for {key:okolnir} again until you reach his boat on Okolnir ({coord:32224,31382,7}).
To get to the interior of the island, go up the ramp just **west** of Buddel, follow the mountain **east** and go down the ramp that leads back to the surface ({coord:32284,31410,6}).
If you went down into the lairs, climb up through the holes you came down by with the {item:Rope} to the surface.
Go back up to the mountain by the ramp ({coord:32284,31410,6}), follow it **west** and go down the ramp next to {npc:Buddel}'s boat.
Say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} (50 gp). If you end up on another island, ask for {key:svargrond} again.
Ramp between the mountain and the surface
{creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons} hit for up to 1160 damage: it is said you only make a profit here from level 120.
A {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack makes Buddel take you to the right place for free, but he keeps the ring.

Ruins of an ancient fortress **northeast of Edron**, similar to the Hero Cave, with {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} at the entrance and {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers} and {creature:Vicious Squire|Vicious Squires} inside.
Go to **Edron**: tell the harbour captain in your city {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}, 160 gp). You arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
Leave the city on foot to the **north/northeast** until you reach the ruins ({coord:33224,31652,7}). The wiki does not describe the way in detail or where the stairs down to the inner floors are.
For the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest} you only need to use the map on the surface, in the middle of the ruins ({coord:33223,31648,7}).
The wiki does not describe a dedicated exit: go back the same way to the surface and walk back **south/southwest** to Edron.
At the Edron harbour, {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}) takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.

At the entrance there are {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}; on the 1st floor, {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers} and {creature:Vicious Squire|Vicious Squires}. The wiki recommends level 60+.

Former Black Sphinx property (*Black Sphinx Estate*), below sea level **north of Ulderek's Rock**; you can only enter through the **Death Portal** of the {wiki:Halls of Hope} and it is part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}.
Arrival through the Death Portal (portal back)
Temple of the {wiki:Halls of Hope} restored and the Death Portal paid for: say {key:death portal} to {npc:Albinius} and hand over 50 {item:Pelvis Bone|Pelvis Bones}.
Go to the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, **north of Thais**: leave the city by the north exit and keep heading north to the temple ({coord:32326,32090,7}).
Talk to {npc:Albinius} ({key:hi}, {key:death portal}) and hand over the 50 {item:Pelvis Bone|Pelvis Bones}, if you have not paid yet.
Enter the **Death Portal**: you appear in the Old Masonry ({coord:32806,31657,8}). From there walk **southeast** and go down at this spot ({coord:32849,31697,8}) to the lower floors.
Retrace your steps through the floors of the Old Masonry (go down and up at the same places) to the arrival point ({coord:32806,31657,8}).
If you are in the boss area, light the {item:Ghostsilver Lantern} and use the wall **north** of the pre-boss room ({coord:32902,31626,14}) to get out.
Enter the Death Portal at the arrival point: it takes you back to the Halls of Hope, from where you walk **south** back to Thais.
Way down to the next floor
Pre-boss room (wall to the north = exit)

On the upper floors there are {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Renegade Knight|Renegade Knights} and {creature:Vicious Squire|Vicious Squires}; on the lower ones, Astral Shapers ({creature:Broken Shaper}, {creature:Twisted Shaper}, {creature:Shaper Matriarch}). Recommended **level 120+**.

An underground dungeon **north of Rathleton** (Oramond), whose creatures change according to the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} votes: golems, Oramond minotaurs or demons (Destroyers, Demons, Juggernauts...).
Slime Slide at the Rathleton Magistrate (dungeon entrance)
To be able to enter you must have cast **at least 50 votes** in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}.

Go to **Oramond**: in **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). If you already have the Squire rank in the Rathleton Quest, there are also boats from Edron ({npc:Captain Seahorse}) and Venore ({npc:Captain Fearless}).
You arrive at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft ({coord:33479,31988,7}), on a small island **west** of Oramond. Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island.
Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat; the portal on that boat ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you across the water, near the city.
Head **north** to the main gate of Rathleton and then **west** to the ramp up to the upper city (Upper Rathleton).

Go to the {wiki:Rathleton Magistrate} (Rathleton Magistrate Plaza) and use the {item:Slime Slide} there ({coord:33669,31887,5}): it takes you to the dungeon, beneath the north of the city ({coord:33467,31778,8}).
The wiki does not describe the exit from the Oramond Dungeon (it only documents the entrance through the Magistrate's Slime Slide); look for the way back to Rathleton in the dungeon itself.
To leave the island, go back the same way (boat portal, mound Slime Slide) to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off

The creatures change every 14 days according to the vote, and the respawn is random: a room with 5 {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers} may later have {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}, {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts} and a {creature:Demon}. The wiki recommends level 120–200+ and, for knights and mages, hunting as a team.

A dangerous dungeon **north of Rathleton**, on the island of Oramond, full of {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Spectre|Spectres} and {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons}; access is earned in the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}.
Access is granted during the {wiki:Dark Trails Quest}.
In **Thais**, say to {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You disembark on {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, on an islet **west** of Oramond.

Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island (with minotaurs). Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat; the portal on that boat ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you across the water, near Rathleton.
Go to the **east** bridge of Oramond. The dungeon door ({coord:33666,31924,7}) is **north** of that bridge: go around the mountain and go down the ramp just north of the entrance.
Go back the same way to the door and return to Rathleton.

To go back to the mainland, retrace your steps to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the *Citizen* rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide takes you straight to the boat). Say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp).

This is a high-level area: {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls}, {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers} and {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons}.
A cave of {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders} in the **west of Oramond**, northwest of Rathleton, where the {item:Peppermoon Bells} grow.
The boats from Venore and Edron to Oramond require the **Citizen** rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}; the one from Thais does not.

Go to **Rathleton** (Oramond) by boat: {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}, 150 gp), or, with the Citizen rank, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron. You arrive at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft ({coord:33479,31986,7}).
Leave Rathleton to the **west/northwest** until you reach the entrance hole ({coord:33517,31906,7}) and go down.
Go back to the hole you came down by and climb up with the {item:Rope}.

Return to Rathleton to the **east**. At {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp); with the Citizen rank he also takes you to Edron, Venore, Port Hope and Krailos, and Issavi is always available.
The way to the cave (and back) can be very dangerous because of the frequent quara raids on the surface of Oramond.
An area for level 100–120+: {creature:Hydra|Hydras} and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}.
Minotaur plains in the **eastern part of Oramond**, east of Rathleton and the Rathleton Workshops, divided into the East Plains, the North Plains and the hills with the strongest minotaurs.
Go to **Oramond**: in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}, 150 gp). You arrive at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, on a small island **west** of Oramond.
Enter the {item:Slime Slide}, go down to the ground floor, walk **east** to the small boat and use its portal; then continue to **Rathleton**.
From Rathleton cross the Rathleton Workshops to the **east** and pass the entrance mound ({coord:33682,31942,7}). You can also reach this mound coming from the southern plains (via the teleport).
Inside the camp, the next ramp is at {coord:33707,31938,7}; the North Plains are reached by passing the mound at {coord:33725,31919,7}.
Go back **west** past the entrance mound ({coord:33682,31942,7}) and cross the Workshops to Rathleton.
Depending on the votes in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}, there may be a {item:Slime Slide} at {coord:33703,31939,6} that serves as a shortcut back to Rathleton.

To leave Oramond, retrace your way from the arrival (or, with the Citizen rank, use the Rathleton Slime Slide that leads to the boat) and tell {npc:Captain Gulliver} {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:thais}) and {key:yes}.
Ramp in the centre of the camp
Slime Slide back to Rathleton (if it exists)

In the East Plains there are only the weaker minotaurs ({creature:Mooh'Tah Warrior|Mooh'Tah Warriors}, {creature:Minotaur Hunter|Minotaur Hunters}, {creature:Worm Priestess|Worm Priestesses}); in the North Plains and the hills {creature:Execowtioner|Execowtioners} and {creature:Moohtant|Moohtants} appear, and they spawn very close together.

Along the way, in the Workshops, there are {creature:Metal Gargoyle|Metal Gargoyles} and {creature:Rustheap Golem|Rustheap Golems}. The wiki recommends level 80+ for knights, 70+ for paladins and 120+ for mages.

An isolated island (the "Secluded Island" region) where the {wiki:Orcsoberfest} event takes place, ruled by the orc {wiki:King Chuck}; it is only accessible during the event, via a teleport south of Thais.
It only opens during the {wiki:Orcsoberfest} event: from the second to the third Friday of **October** and **March** (plus the following weekend).
During the event, leave **Thais** by the **south** exit.
Go to the tent that appears just south of the city and step into the teleport inside it ({coord:32361,32294,7}).
You are taken to Orcsoberfest Island ({coord:33771,31059,7}), where {npc:Xaver} is.
Go back to where you arrived on the island and retrace your steps to the tent south of Thais.
From the tent, enter **Thais** through the south gate.
Teleport in the tent south of Thais

The Feeding Grounds (teleport north of the dock, 10 Schnitzel Points) have {creature:Orger|Orgers}, {creature:Bellicose Orger|Bellicose Orgers} and {creature:Loricate Orger|Loricate Orgers} with 700 HP.
The island shares the same spot on the map with {wiki:Percht Island}: the automap may look strange if you have visited both.

An island **south of Chor and Ankrahmun**, with jungle in the west, steppe in the east and the city of Oska in the central mountains; it is the sanctuary of the beast-men ({creature:Weretiger|weretigers}, {creature:Werepanther|werepanthers} and {creature:Werecrocodile|werecrocodiles}).
Tonar's boat in Oskayaat (arrival and departure)

The boatman {npc:Tonar} will only take you after you return the stolen {item:Ocarina} to him — this is the *Paradise Lost* part of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest} (it starts with {npc:Domizian}, in Darashia).
The Ocarina is in the {wiki:Mother of Scarabs Lair}, north of Ankrahmun: go down **two floors** and use the sarcophagus a little to the **north** on that floor.
Go to **Ankrahmun** (for example from Darashia, on {npc:Petros}' boat: {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 100 gp).
In Ankrahmun, find the boatman {npc:Tonar} ({coord:33182,32883,7}) and ask him for {key:passage}.
You arrive at {npc:Tonar}'s boat in Oskayaat ({coord:33067,32918,7}); this is where you return whenever you want to leave the island.
If you are in the caves, go back the same way (through the {item:Fog Portal} and the Weretigers cave) to the surface.
Go to {npc:Tonar}'s boat in Oskayaat ({coord:33067,32918,7}): he takes you back to **Ankrahmun**.
In Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}) has boats to Darashia ({key:darashia}, 100 gp), Venore, Edron, Port Hope, Liberty Bay and Yalahar.
