The creatures on the island and in the caves ({creature:Werepanther|Werepanthers}, {creature:Weretiger|Weretigers}, {creature:Werecrocodile|Werecrocodiles}) have 4000 to 6400 HP: a high-level area.
Path from the Ankrahmun entrance to the hub
Path from the Zao entrance to the hub
Path from the Svargrond entrance to the hub
One of the *Otherworld* dungeons, far below the plain **southeast of Thais**, reached through a {item:Glowing Vortex} in a cave next to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, between Thais and Kazordoon.
Walk to the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, on the plain between Thais and Kazordoon (northeast of Thais).
The cave entrance is **southwest** of the bridge ({coord:32540,32020,7}); go down into the cave (1 floor down).
In the cave, kill **10 creatures** and enter the {item:Glowing Vortex} ({coord:32519,32019,8}): you arrive in the Otherworld.
The wiki does not describe a quick exit from the bottom of the Otherworld: climb up through the holes you came down by (use the {item:Rope}).
Retrace your way **north** to the spot of the {item:Glowing Vortex} you arrived by and from there climb up to the cave entrance, southwest of the Dwarf Bridge.
Outside, walk back to Thais (**southwest**) or head on to Kazordoon/Venore.
Cave entrance (southwest of the Dwarf Bridge)
The entrance vortex is not always there: sometimes it disappears and comes back after a few minutes (or hours).
Strong creatures ({creature:Burster|Bursters}, {creature:Instable Breach Brood|Instable Breach Broods}, {creature:Instable Sparkion|Instable Sparkions}): level 90+ recommended (knights 100+).
A surface village of outlaws, **east of Thais** (and Blood Bay) and **west of Venore**, west of the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}; home of the {wiki:Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest}.
From **Thais**: leave by the **east** gate and walk along the road to the **east** until you reach the camp ({coord:32643,32222,7}).
From **Venore**: leave by the **west** gate and head **west**/southwest through the forest to the camp.

Inside the camp, a stone path leads to the main houses: {npc:H.L.} is among the houses ({coord:32643,32212,7}) and {npc:Rottin Wood} is in the building furthest **north** ({coord:32657,32201,7}). {npc:Snake Eye}'s tavern is underground in that main building.
The minotaur tower ({wiki:The Outlaw Camp Quest}) is **south** of the houses ({coord:32615,32253,7}).
Walk back the same way: **west** to Thais or **east**/northeast to Venore.
In Thais {npc:Captain Bluebear} and in Venore {npc:Captain Fearless} take you by boat to other cities: {key:hi}, the name of the destination and {key:yes}.
Stairs to the underground (Water Vortex path)

Around the camp there are {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} and, further south, {creature:Cyclops}: be careful if you are a low level.
The {wiki:Outlaw Castle}, south of the houses, belongs to player guilds.

A cave of {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} on a small island in the river **south of the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}**, between Thais and Venore; it is only accessible when the river floods with the {wiki:Down the Drain Mini World Change}.
Cave entrance (on the island, on the surface)

Only while the {wiki:Down the Drain Mini World Change} is active. Messages: *"The river south of the outlaw camp is flooding. A small island there should now be reachable safely."* or *"Hear ye! Hear ye! A river is flooding, south of the outlaw base. [...]"*.
Go to the {wiki:Outlaw Camp}: leave **Thais** by the east gate (or **Venore** by the west gate) and walk along the road to the camp ({coord:32643,32222,7}).
From the Outlaw Camp go **south**, to the river that has flooded, and cross to the small island ({coord:32589,32308,7}).
On the island, go down into the cave ({coord:32590,32314,7}); you arrive 1 floor down ({coord:32590,32314,8}).
Leave by the same spot you came down by ({coord:32590,32314,8}) and return to the island.
Walk back **north** to the Outlaw Camp and from there to Thais (**west**) or Venore (**east**). Do this before the world change ends: the island is only accessible while the river is flooded.
There are 10 {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} in the cave and 1 on the surface: when you go down they may all come at once.
On the way from the Outlaw Camp you may meet {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors} and {creature:Bandit|Bandits}.
A large apartment building (flats from the ground floor to the 3rd floor) in **western Venore**, between Dream Street to the west and Dagger Alley and Salvation Street to the east.

Travel to **Venore** by boat: at your town's harbour say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais, 170 gp, or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron, 40 gp). You arrive at the **north** harbour of Venore, next to {npc:Captain Fearless}.
Cross the city to the **southwest** to western Venore: the Paupers Palace is between Dream Street and Dagger Alley/Salvation Street.
The flats go from the ground floor to the 3rd floor; the roof is the spot used in the {wiki:Opticording Sphere Quest} ({coord:32897,32089,6}).
Go down the stairs and leave the building into the street.
To leave Venore, go to the **north** harbour and talk to {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}. On foot, the **southwest** exit of the city is close to western Venore.
Roof of the Paupers Palace (Opticording Sphere Quest)
Prison and Garrison entrance (to the south)
A tomb hidden beneath the Kha'labal desert, on the **peninsula southwest of Ankrahmun**, near the city; at the bottom lives the pharaoh {creature:Omruc} ({wiki:The Ancient Tombs Quest}).
To use the teleport to the deep parts you must put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the empty {item:Coal Basin} next to the magic flame.

Take a boat to **Ankrahmun**: for example {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or the captains of Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Darashia, Venore and Yalahar. You disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city to the **west/southwest**, to the peninsula where the entrance is ({coord:33027,32870,7}).
The entrance is hidden: use the {item:Shovel} on the indicated spot (you may need to dig several times before the hole opens) and go down.
For the deep parts, step on the blue flame ({item:Mystic Flame}) and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the {item:Coal Basin}.
Go back to the start of the tomb the way you came (the {item:Magic Forcefield} in Omruc's room, used **without** the pass item, also takes you to the start).
Climb up to the hole you opened in the sand and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface.
Walk back to **Ankrahmun** (to the **east**). {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar: {key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes}.
Ribstride boss teleport (Killing in the Name of)
The deeper you go, the stronger the creatures: on the deep floors there are dozens of {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} (bring area runes) and {creature:Vampire|Vampires}.

A secret island (the "Secluded Island" region) that can only be visited during the {wiki:Winterlight Solstice} event, on a small boat near the Svargrond harbour; it has {creature:Percht|Percht}, {creature:Schiach|Schiachs} and enchanted bunnies.
Only during the {wiki:Winterlight Solstice}: from 22 December (server save) to 10 January. Recommended level 80-100.

Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore: tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the Svargrond harbour ({coord:32347,31108,6}).
During the event a small boat appears anchored near the Svargrond harbour ({coord:32326,31106,7}). **Use it** to travel to Percht Island.
On the island, {npc:Frosty} tells you more about the place.
If you are in the island's dungeon, return to the surface the same way you came down (the first descent is at {coord:33745,31063,7}).
Go back to where the boat dropped you off on the island to return to Svargrond; the sources do not describe any other way back.
In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin (110 gp), Thais (180 gp) or Venore (150 gp): {key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}.
First descent into the island's dungeon
The boat near the Svargrond harbour
{creature:Baleful Bunny|Baleful Bunnies}, {creature:Schiach|Schiachs} and {creature:Percht|Percht} have 500-620 HP: level 80+ recommended.
The island shares the same spot on the map with {wiki:Orcsoberfest Island}: the automap may look strange if you have visited both.
The biggest dragon lair in Tibia, full of {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}, beneath the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} (southwest of Venore), on the way to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno}.
You can only get there by the path from the first parts of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}: you need the {item:Holy Tible} to get past the Shrine of Wonders and a **Premium** account.
Leave **Venore** and walk **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} and the graveyard near the {wiki:Necromant House} ({coord:32781,32330,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} in the graveyard (they all lead to the same narrow cave).
In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room: use the {item:Pick} on the **northwest corner** ({coord:32775,32344,7}) and go down through the hole.
Goshnar's grave is just to the **west**: stand 1 sqm **south** of the tombstone and use {item:Blood} on the tombstone to be taken to the catacombs.
Go **north** and step on the tile with inscriptions before the {item:Magic Wall} with the {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack (Shrine of Wonders).

To the **east**, go down through the hole by the sign *"To the Pits of Inferno"* and head **south** to the bridge. If it is broken, use {item:Oil} on the lever south of the bridge, on the west side, and pull it.
If there is lava, use the {item:Pick} on the stone next to it to cool it down. Then you will find **3 holes**, which all lead to the Dragon Lair.

To continue to the Pits of Inferno: go down through the **north** hole of the lair and, to the **east**, climb up the rope hole with the {item:Rope} to the Hall of the Five Ways ({coord:32834,32333,11}).

To leave: if the bridge collapsed with you on the other side, the only way back is through the Dragon Lair. The wiki does not describe the exit from the lair step by step; the normal way is to go back along the same route to Goshnar's grave and the graveyard cave, and from there climb to the surface and walk **northeast** to Venore.
Northwest corner of the room: use the Pick
Hall of the Five Ways (after the lair)
Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair map

There are many {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} at once, as well as {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}: do not go alone if you cannot handle more than 3 Dragon Lords at a time.

After the server save a good part of the floor is covered in fire; a pair of {item:Firewalker Boots} helps a lot. If there are fire fields on top of holes or rope holes, use a {item:Destroy Field Rune}.

The old fortress of the Nightmare Knights beneath the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **southwest of Venore**, now taken over by the Ruthless Seven and full of demons; it is the setting of {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest}.
Graveyard next to the Necromant House (Plains of Havoc)
**Premium** account: Free Account players cannot pass the Magic Wall of the Shrine of Wonders.

The {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack to cross the Shrine of Wonders (it is in a chest on a small mountain next to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, which you climb with {spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}).
To get past the Hall of the Five Ways the first time you need a team with one player of each vocation; the level door before the main room asks for level 80.

Leave **Venore** and walk **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}. Go to the graveyard near the {wiki:Necromant House} ({coord:32781,32330,7}) and use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} (they all lead to the same narrow cave).
In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room: use the {item:Pick} on the **northwest corner** ({coord:32775,32344,7}) and go down through the hole.
{wiki:Goshnar}'s grave is just to the **west**: stand **1 sqm south** of the tombstone and use the {item:Blood} on the tombstone. All players on that tile go to the catacombs.
Go **north** and step on the tile with inscriptions before the {item:Magic Wall} with the {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack: you pass to the other side (the Shrine of Wonders).

To the **east** there is a sign *"To the Pits of Inferno"*: go down that hole and head **south** to the bridge. If it is broken, use the {item:Oil} on the lever **south of the bridge, on the west side**, pull it and cross.
If there is a river of lava, use the {item:Pick} on the stone next to it to cool it down. Cross to the **3 holes**, which all lead to the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}.
In the dragon lair go down through the **north** hole; to the **east** there is a rope hole: climb up with the {item:Rope} and you reach the Hall of the Five Ways ({coord:32834,32333,11}).
By the exit sign: go back through the realm of the Ruthless Seven and follow the signs that point to the exit.
Or talk to {npc:A Ghostly Sage}, right before the rewards room, and ask him for a teleport.
Either way you appear in the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave beneath the Plains of Havoc: climb up to the surface and walk **northeast** to Venore.
Necromant House (graveyard with the Loose Stone Piles)
Northwest corner of the room: use the Pick here
Holy Tible chest (mountain next to the Knightwatch Tower)

A very high-level area (the wiki recommends 130–160+): {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} in the dragon lair, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms} and {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares} further ahead.
After the maze there is a **point of no return**: the **north** hole leads to the Slimes cave of the Plains of Havoc (no way back) and the **south** hole continues to the main room (hub).
Bring {item:Destroy Field Rune|Destroy Field Runes}: there are fire fields on top of holes and levers.

A big room inside the {wiki:Pits of Inferno} (also called *DT City*), beneath the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}, **southwest of Venore**; you get there after the Hall of the Five Ways and the PoI levers, and it is famous for the {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers}.
Necromant House (start of the path to the Pits of Inferno)
**Premium** account: Free Account players cannot pass the {item:Magic Wall} of the Shrine of Wonders.

The {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack to cross the Shrine of Wonders (it is in a chest on a small mountain next to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}; you climb up with {spell:Levitate} or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}).
A team with **one player of each vocation** (Knight, Paladin, Sorcerer, Druid and Monk) to open the flames of the Hall of the Five Ways, and at least two players to open the hole to the Spa.

Leave **Venore** by the south exit and walk **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc}. Go to the graveyard next to the {wiki:Necromant House} ({coord:32781,32330,7}) and use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile} (they all lead to the same narrow cave).

In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room: use the {item:Pick} on the **northwest corner** ({coord:32775,32344,7}) and go down. Stand **1 sqm south** of Goshnar's tombstone (to the **west**) and use {item:Blood} on it: you are taken to the catacombs.

Go **north** and step on the tile with inscriptions before the Magic Wall with the {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack. To the **east**, go down through the hole by the sign *"To the Pits of Inferno"* and head **south** to the bridge (if it is broken, use {item:Oil} on the lever south of the bridge, on the west side, and pull it).

If there is lava, use the {item:Pick} on the stone next to it. Go down one of the 3 holes into the {wiki:Pits of Inferno Dragon Lair}, go down through the **north** hole and climb up with the {item:Rope} at the rope hole to the **east**: you reach the Hall of the Five Ways ({coord:32834,32333,11}).

Each vocation goes through its own path of fires and pulls the lever at the end; once all 5 levers are pulled, the fire walls disappear and you pass to the PoI levers ({coord:32863,32345,12}). Pull the 15 levers in the right order: the final lever opens the 2 stones next to the entrance and gives access to a staircase.

Climb the staircase (ignore the 15 levers in this room: they are useless). One player stands **1 sqm south** of the stone in the middle of the room (the one with the skeleton) and another goes **north** and pulls the **two levers**: the hole that leads to the Spa opens.

In the Spa, go to the **east** part and step on the secret tile ({coord:32907,32286,12}): a staircase appears in the room above. The players up there pull you up with the {item:Rope} from the tile where the staircase appeared.

The wiki does not describe a direct exit from the Spa. The documented exit is to keep going forward: climb up with the rope (1 sqm **north** of the hole that goes back down) into the maze, cross it to the **northeast** alley, use the {item:Pick} on the middle tile, pull the lever on the **east** path and follow the one-way path to the point of no return.
There, go down through the **north** hole: it drops you in the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave beneath the Plains of Havoc. Climb up to the surface and walk **northeast** to Venore.
Holy Tible chest (mountain next to the Knightwatch Tower)

In the Spa there are {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Defiler|Defilers}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms}, {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers} and {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils}.
If the bridge collapses with you on the other side, the only way back is through the dragon lair. Bring lots of vials of {item:Blood} and {item:Oil}.
In the Hall of the Five Ways, on the wrong path the damage doubles with each fire: if you get the warning, turn back immediately.
The **north** hole at the point of no return is exit-only: there is no way to re-enter through it.
A mountain range in the Darama desert, **west of Darashia**, that separates the {wiki:Devourer (Geography)|Devourer} from {wiki:Drefia}; also called Mountain of Poison or Scorpions Rock.
Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (tell the captain in your city {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}' harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).
Leave the city and walk **west** through the desert to the mountain ({coord:33057,32436,7}).
To reach the top ({coord:33063,32432,2}): climb up and go to the **left**, where 2 {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} spawn, and keep climbing all the way up.
Go down the mountain the same way.
Walk back **east** to Darashia, where you can take {npc:Petros}' boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
River near Drefia (Nightmare Isles teleport, when active)
All over the mountain there are poisonous creatures, {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas} and {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}; halfway there are 2 {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}.
Right on the west side is {wiki:Drefia}, full of undead and necromancers.

Great battle plains in the south of the continent, **southwest of Venore** and southeast of Kazordoon, with a temple to rest in, the {wiki:Necromant House}, the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, a dragon lair and many dangerous creatures.
Set off from **Venore** and walk **southwest** to the plains. No boat or special equipment is needed.
In the middle of the plains is {npc:Oldrak}'s temple, on the 1st floor above ground ({coord:32816,32260,6}): it is the landmark and a safe place to rest.

From the temple: the dragon lair is to the **west**, the {wiki:Abandoned Monastery} just to the **east**, the {wiki:Necromant House} to the south ({coord:32781,32330,7}) and the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} in the **south** of the plains.
If you need to rest beforehand, go up to {npc:Oldrak}'s temple.
Ruined building east of the temple (Dreamer's Challenge)
Map of the Plains of Havoc (1 temple, 2 Necromant House, 3 Isle of the Mists, 4 Abandoned Monastery, 5 Knightwatch Tower, 6 dragon lair, 7 infected area, 8 Demon Oak)
An area with many dangerous creatures (cyclops, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, dragons): level 20-25+ recommended on the outskirts and 40-50+ around the temple.
Caves in {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, **north of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}** (between Kazordoon, Venore and Ab'Dendriel), whose creatures change every day with the {wiki:Poacher Caves Mini World Change}.
Take the boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city).
Walk **northwest**, passing north of the Green Claw Swamp, to the entrance at Ferngrims Gate ({coord:32754,31928,7}).
Alternatively, come from **Ab'Dendriel**: leave through the gates and head **southeast**.
Inside, follow the **southern** passages and go down the floors to where you need (down to **floor -4**).
Go back the same way: climb up through the **southern** passages to the entrance (use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down by).
Outside, walk **southeast** to Venore or **northwest** to Ab'Dendriel to take the boat.

The creatures change depending on the variant of the day: wolves, {creature:War Wolf|War Wolves}, bears and boars; or {creature:Poacher|Poachers} and {creature:Hunter|Hunters}; or {creature:Ghost Wolf|Ghost Wolves} and {creature:Gloom Wolf|Gloom Wolves}.
The northern cave on floor -4 always has {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}.

The "game" variant of the Poacher Caves, in the **south of {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}**, north of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} (northwest of Venore): 4-floor caves with Wolves, War Wolves, Bears, Boars and a few Wyverns at the bottom.
This variant is only active on some days: it is part of the {wiki:Poacher Caves Mini World Change} (on other days you will find the Poachers or Gloomy variants).
Take the boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain in your city); you arrive next to {npc:Captain Fearless}.
Walk **northwest**, passing **north** of the Green Claw Swamp, to the south of Ferngrims Gate.
The cave entrance is at {coord:32754,31928,7}; go down through the holes to the lower floors.
Go back the same way to the entrance, using the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down through.
Walk back **southeast** to Venore; at the harbour, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you by boat to other cities.
On the 4th floor there is a cave with only {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}; the rest ({creature:War Wolf|War Wolves}, {creature:Bear|Bears}, {creature:Boar|Boars}) is accessible to low levels.

The "Gloomy" variant of the Poacher Caves, in {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, north of the Green Claw Swamp (northwest of Venore), full of {creature:Ghost Wolf|Ghost Wolves} and {creature:Gloom Wolf|Gloom Wolves}; it is part of the {wiki:Poacher Caves Mini World Change}.

You only find this version when the ghost wolves dominate the cave (message *"Poachers have slaughtered nearly all wild animals north of the Green Claw Swamp. But vengeful spirits show up there now!"*). On other days the {wiki:Poacher Caves/Game} or {wiki:Poacher Caves/Poachers} variants appear.
Take the boat to **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city).
Walk **northwest**, passing north of the Green Claw Swamp, to {wiki:Ferngrims Gate} (it is also east of Kazordoon and southeast of Ab'Dendriel).
Go down through the entrance in the south of Ferngrims Gate ({coord:32754,31928,7}). The cave has 4 floors; on the 2nd floor it is split into two separate areas.
Go back the same way to the entrance, climbing up with the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down by.
Walk back to Venore, to the **southeast**, and take {npc:Captain Fearless}' boat ({coord:32955,32022,6}): {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
On the 4th floor, in the **north** area, there are {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}; the rest of the cave has Ghost Wolves and Gloom Wolves (level 20+ recommended).

Caves **south** of {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}, north of the Green Claw Swamp and beneath the Orc Lands, northwest of Venore; in this variant of the {wiki:Poacher Caves Mini World Change} they are taken over by {creature:Poacher|Poachers} and {creature:Hunter|Hunters}.
Take the boat to **Venore** (at the harbour in your city: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
From Venore walk **northwest**, passing **north** of the Green Claw Swamp, to {wiki:Ferngrims Gate} (it is also east of Kazordoon and southeast of Ab'Dendriel).
The cave entrance is in the **south** of Ferngrims Gate ({coord:32754,31928,7}). Inside there are 4 floors (floors 2 and 4 have a north part and a south part).
Go back the same way to the entrance (climb up with the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down by).

Sometimes you will not find the Poachers: the same cave may be in the {wiki:Poacher Caves/Game|Game} variant (wild animals) or the {wiki:Poacher Caves/Gloomy|Gloomy} variant (ghost wolves), depending on the mini world change.
Level 20+ recommended. Poachers and Hunters cannot see invisible players: with a {item:Stealth Ring} they will not attack you.

A colonial city of the Kingdom of Thais in the middle of the **Tiquanda** jungle, west of Ankrahmun; it is the base for exploring the jungle ({wiki:Banuta}, {wiki:Chor}, {wiki:Trapwood}, the tarantula caves, etc.).
Port Hope harbour (Charles), at the far west of the city
**Premium** account to travel by boat to Port Hope.
Take the boat to **Port Hope** at the harbour in your city: there are boats from Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay and Edron. Tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}.
For example, in **Thais** talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the harbour ({coord:32310,32210,6}).
You arrive at {npc:Charles}' dock, at the far **west** of Port Hope ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
Talk to {npc:Charles} on the boat, at the far **west** of the city: {key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes}.

Destinations and prices: {key:thais} 160 gp, {key:venore} 160 gp, {key:ankrahmun} 110 gp, {key:darashia} 180 gp, {key:edron} 150 gp, {key:liberty bay} 50 gp, {key:yalahar} 260 gp (only after a mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}) and {key:oramond} 200 gp (Citizen rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}).
If you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** of the city ({coord:32679,32775,7}), takes you straight to {wiki:Banuta} for 30 gp.
The jungle around the city is hostile: right outside the gates there are creatures that are dangerous for low levels.

A cave of {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls} in the Tiquanda jungle, **north of Port Hope**, good for levels 8 to 20, with the Holy Crab and a {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} spawn on the lower floors.
Take the boat to **Port Hope** (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the harbour, next to {npc:Charles}.
Leave the city to the **north**, through the jungle. The cave has two entrance holes: {coord:32662,32742,7} (the closest to the city) and {coord:32678,32611,7} (further north).
The southernmost cave (rats, bugs and spiders) also connects to the {wiki:Tiquanda Bandit Caves}, through the hole at {coord:32555,32679,7}.
Go back to one of the entrance holes and climb up with the {item:Rope}; one of the rooms full of Swamp Trolls also has an exit to the surface.
Walk back **south** to Port Hope and take {npc:Charles}' boat ({coord:32529,32785,6}): {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
Tiquanda Bandit Caves hole (connected to the south cave)
1st floor: cave rats, bugs and spiders
Room with many Swamp Trolls and an exit to the surface
2nd floor: Swamp Trolls and Poison Spiders
Main floor: red = Bonelords hole, blue = Holy Crab
3rd floor: Bonelords (northeast) and the Holy Crab cave (northwest)
Be careful with the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} spawn on the 3rd floor (northeast cave) if you are a low level.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia
A big quara cave on the island of {wiki:Vandura}, **southwest of Liberty Bay**, with several underwater floors connected by water channels and geysers.
To go down through the {item:Water Channel|Water Channels} to the lower floors you need a diving helmet (for example the {item:Helmet of the Deep}).
Take a boat to **Liberty Bay** (at the harbour in your city: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}).
From the Liberty Bay harbour go **west** until you find some wreckage and a ramp ({coord:32208,32887,7}). Next to the entrance there is a warning sign (*"DANGER. Quara sighted below."*).

Go down the ramp: you arrive on the first floor of the cave (floor -1). There are three spots there where you can jump into the water and swim without diving equipment; the {item:Water Channel|Water Channels} pull you down.
On the underwater floors, go up by entering the {item:Hot Geyser|Hot Geysers}, which push you upwards.
On the first floor, go up the same ramp you came in by and go back **east** to the Liberty Bay harbour.
Ramp to the Hive Outpost (northwest of the grotto)

The sign warns you not to enter a Water Channel unprepared: the lower floors have strong quaras ({creature:Quara Predator|Quara Predators}, {creature:Quara Pincher|Quara Pinchers}); the wiki recommends level 40+ on the first floor and 80+ on the second.

A big island east of Zao where two races fight for control: the town of **Gray Beach** (depot and temple) in the south, the insectoids' Hive in the north and {wiki:Fiehonja}, home of the Deeplings, in the depths. No boat docks there: you get there through {wiki:Gray Island}.
Take a boat to {wiki:Gray Island} in **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** or **Edron**: {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} (150 gp).
On Gray Island go down through the **only hole** on the island, **south** of {npc:Scrutinon} ({coord:33189,31982,7}).
On floor -1 head **northeast** and enter the {item:Water Vortex}.
On the other side use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the ground to climb up and head **north** to **Gray Beach** ({coord:33471,31304,7}). The Hive is **north** of Gray Beach.
Go back to Gray Beach (if you did the shortcut from the {wiki:Liquid Black Quest}, the teleport next to Qjell's statue in Fiehonja takes you there).
Go down to the Gray Beach entrance, **south** of the town, and take the underground passage in reverse to {wiki:Gray Island}.
Talk to {npc:Scrutinon} ({coord:33189,31982,7}): {key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}. He takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore.
Hole southeast of Gray Beach (way down to Fiehonja)
Gray Island, where you enter to get to Quirefang
Gray Beach has a depot and a temple, but outside the town you are in the territory of the Hive insectoids (to the north) and the Deeplings (below): an area for high levels.
Teleports to the Elite Fanatics room
Buddel's boat at the barbarian camps
The castle of {npc:King Tibianus}, on a small island at the end of the Royal Avenue, in the **northwest of Thais** (west of the north gate, north of the harbour and northeast of the depot).
Get to **Thais** (by boat: tell the harbour captain {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}); you land next to {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}).
From the harbour go **north** to the Royal Avenue: the castle is on a small island at the end of the avenue.
Cross the bridge and enter through the gate guarded by {npc:Baxter} ({coord:32322,32188,7}): you arrive in the courtyard, where {npc:Bozo} is.

{npc:King Tibianus}' throne room is 1 floor up, **north** of the courtyard ({coord:32311,32171,6}); the royal kitchen is in the north part of the ground floor and the cellar (with the locked Treasure Vault) is reached by the stairs next to the west room.
Leave through the courtyard gate and over the bridge to the Royal Avenue.
Go **south** to the Thais harbour, where {npc:Captain Bluebear} has a boat to other cities ({key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes}), or to the depot, southwest of the castle.

The second biggest of the {wiki:Forbidden Islands}, **northwest of Goroma**: a dry island full of undead ({creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}), with the {wiki:Lich Hell} and an underground passage to {wiki:Talahu}.
You can only reach Ramoa through {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}: you must at least have handed the {item:Spellbook of Dragha}, found in Goroma, over to {npc:Chondur}.
{npc:Jack Fate} only takes you to Goroma after the *Access to Goroma* part of the same quest.
At the **Liberty Bay** harbour, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} on his boat: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You land on the **east** coast of Goroma ({coord:32161,32558,6}).
In Goroma, go **west** to the stairs of the Teleportation Hub ({coord:32038,32561,7}) and go down.
In the Goroma hub enter the teleport (the only one there, on the right): you appear in the Ramoa hub. Climb the stairs to come out on the surface of the island.

The first time there is no shortcut yet: you reach Ramoa through the Goroma volcano, following {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} (you climb up through a hole and the hub is **northeast** of that hole).
In Ramoa, go down the Teleportation Hub stairs ({coord:31946,32557,7}) and enter the **left** teleport: you appear in the **Goroma** hub, underground.
Climb the stairs and go **east** to {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to **Liberty Bay**.
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)

The island is full of {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts} and other undead with strong melee attacks; there is a {creature:Giant Spider} just south of the hub stairs and {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} further southwest. One wrong step and you are surrounded.
A small island **north of Kilmaresh**, home of the Rascoohan (raccoons from Washingstone) and constantly attacked by the Pirats; it is the centre of {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest}.
Cave exit to the island (coming from Issavi)
Access is obtained in {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest}: gather **1500 points** of trust with {npc:Eustacio} (Pirats raids) so he tells you about the secret passage.
**First visit:** travel to **Issavi**, on the island of Kilmaresh (there is a boat from Venore, Darashia, Krailos or Oramond: {key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}; there is also a magic carpet).
In Issavi, use the small shell **north of the depot** ({coord:33919,31471,7}).

In the cave, go down at the first spot ({coord:33877,31401,8}), go up at the second ({coord:33862,31363,9}) and go up again at the third ({coord:33788,31336,8}) until you come out on the surface of the island.
On the island, look for {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} to the **west** ({coord:33729,31343,7}) and offer him {key:help}.
**Later visits:** after talking to Tik'hi Tak'he, ask {npc:Eustacio} for {key:shortcut} at the **Venore** harbour ({coord:32937,32031,7}) to go straight to the island.
Use the small boat at the dock where you arrive by Eustacio's shortcut: it takes you back to **Venore**.
Alternatively, go back through the cave to Issavi, doing the way in reverse.
Shell north of the Issavi depot
Cave: go up here (exit to the island)
Near the Issavi shell, north of the temple, there is a trap hole: if you step over it you fall next to a group of {creature:Burning Gladiator|Burning Gladiators}.
Ancient sewers beneath Lower Rathleton, the abandoned side of the city of {wiki:Oramond}; rarely used for hunting, but visited in the missions of the {wiki:Oramond Quest}.
Most used entrance of the Ancient Sewers

Get to **Rathleton**: at the Thais harbour talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}, 150 gp). From {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft enter the {item:Slime Slide}, come down from the mound, go **east** to the small boat with the portal ({coord:33628,32005,7}) and head **north** to the city. With the *Citizen* rank of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}, the Slime Slide takes you straight to the city.
In Lower Rathleton, go **north** of {npc:Roswitha} ({coord:33584,31942,7}) and pass {npc:Fillias}.

Go down through the sewer entrance ({coord:33569,31920,7}); if needed, use the sewer cover. You can also reach this entrance quickly by going down with {spell:Levitate} from the upper city. There are several other entrances on the ground floor of Lower Rathleton.
Down there, walk **east** and **north** to {npc:Elliott} ({coord:33570,31908,8}); the sewer entrance just north of him ({coord:33571,31901,8}) leads to the lower floors, where {npc:Jacob} is.
Go back the same way to the entrance you came down by ({coord:33569,31920,7}) and climb up to Lower Rathleton.

To leave Oramond, go back to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp); with the Citizen rank he also goes to Edron, Venore, Port Hope and Krailos, and Issavi is always available.
The Ancient Sewers are right next to the new sewers, but they are **not** directly connected to them.
The way between the raft and the city goes past minotaurs (the wiki advises level ~100 or going in a group).

The magistrate's building on Rathleton Magistrate Plaza, in the **north of Upper Rathleton** (Oramond island), where citizens vote and where the representatives {npc:Marvin}, {npc:Ezebeth}, {npc:Barazbaz}, {npc:Jondrin} and {npc:Sholley} are.
In **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). With the Citizen rank of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} there is also a boat from Edron and Venore.

You land at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, on a small island **west** of Oramond ({coord:33479,31988,7}). Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island, with minotaurs ({coord:33539,32014,7}).
Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat: the portal on that boat ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you across the water, near the city.
Head **north** to the main gate and then **west** to the ramp up to the upper city ({coord:33635,31943,7}). In Upper Rathleton go **north** to Rathleton Magistrate Plaza.

You enter the magistrate 2 floors above ground (floor +2), where {npc:Marvin} ({coord:33662,31878,5}), {npc:Ezebeth} (east wing, {coord:33675,31883,5}) and {npc:Barazbaz} ({coord:33650,31884,5}) are; {npc:Jondrin} is on floor +3 and {npc:Sholley} on floor +4.
Come down from the magistrate and walk the arrival route in reverse to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Rathleton {item:Slime Slide} takes you straight to the boat).
Tell {npc:Captain Gulliver} {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp). With the Citizen rank he also takes you to Edron, Venore, Port Hope and Krailos; Issavi is always available.
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off
On the mound where the Slime Slide drops you there are Oramond minotaurs, strong for low levels.
The Slime Slide inside the magistrate leads to a hunting area whose creatures depend on the votes of previous weeks.
Sewers beneath the Workshop Quarter, the new part of Rathleton in **Oramond**, with teleports that serve as shortcuts between areas; used mostly in the missions of the {wiki:Oramond Quest}.
Sewer Grate (entrance, south of the Workshop Quarter)

Go to **Oramond**: in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you there ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}, 150 gp). From {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft use the {item:Slime Slide}, go down to the ground floor, walk **east** to the small boat, use its portal and continue to **Rathleton**.
Go to the **Workshop Quarter** (the new part of the city). The entrance is **south** of the Workshop Quarter, beneath the docks, **southwest** of {npc:Doubleday}'s building ({coord:33640,31961,6}).
Enter the {item:Sewer Grate} ({coord:33621,31979,7}): you go down 2 floors and arrive on floor -2 ({coord:33622,31979,9}).
Inside you can walk or use the teleports that connect the various areas; the abnormal spots area of the Probing mission is on floor -4 ({coord:33639,31896,11}).
Go back the same way to the grate arrival point ({coord:33622,31979,9}) and climb up the {item:Rungs In The Wall|rungs in the wall} (use them like a ladder) to the surface.

To leave Oramond, retrace your way from the arrival (or, with the Citizen rank, use the Rathleton Slime Slide that leads to the boat) and tell {npc:Captain Gulliver} {key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}.
Even though they are right next to the {wiki:Rathleton Ancient Sewers}, the two sewers are not directly connected.

Creatures: {creature:Devourer|Devourers}, {creature:Glooth Anemone|Glooth Anemones}, {creature:Glooth Golem|Glooth Golems}, {creature:Rustheap Golem|Rustheap Golems}, {creature:Humongous Fungus} and {creature:Hideous Fungus}; sometimes the boss {creature:Glooth Fairy}.
The great city of the lizards in **northern Zao** (Northern Zao), with the Draken Walls, the palace and the Inner Sanctum; access is earned with the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}.

The way to the rebel hideout and the city opens up with the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} (mission 1 to reach the north, mission 2 for the quick link via the blue flame, mission 5 to enter the city).
You need {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/crates) to get past the mountain between Farmine and the Zao Steppe.
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (Kazordoon underground harbour) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below Cormaya), with {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down the mountain with {spell:Levitate}, until you come out on the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
In the north of the Zao Steppe enter the teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} ({coord:33198,31350,7}).
In the Muggy Plains use the link you reactivated in mission 2 of the quest ({npc:Chartan}'s blue flame) to reach the rebel hideout, in northern Zao ({coord:33171,31078,7}).
From the hideout head out onto the grey road and follow it **southwest** to the city gate; inside Razachai walk **west** to {npc:Zlak}'s big green building.
In the basement beneath {npc:Zlak} enter the teleport that leads to {npc:Chartan}'s room ({coord:33078,31219,8}).
Step on the blue flame **south** of Chartan: it takes you to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.
In the Muggy Plains go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport you arrived by and head **southwest** to the mountain pass.

Climb it with {spell:Levitate} and go **west** to the Farmine elevator. On the Farmine Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon or Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}).

An area for high levels (150+): on the way from the hideout to the city there are {creature:Brimstone Bug|Brimstone Bugs}, {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}, {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires} and {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles}.
After you finish the quest you can use the teleports between Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum.

The deepest part of the **Razachai** palace, in northern Zao, beyond the teleport next to {npc:Zizzle}: here the emperor keeps his best guards and the four incarnations of himself (the area of mission 10 of the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}).
Main room of the four teleports
You must have done the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} up to **mission 10** (which is why the area is sometimes called "Mission 10").
After you finish the quest you can use the teleports between Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum.
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine** (at {npc:Brodrosch}, far below Kazordoon, or at {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below Cormaya): {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.

In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate}, to the {wiki:Zao Steppe}.

Get to the Razachai palace as in the quest: through the rebel hideout ({npc:Chartan}) and the city, or — after mission 9 — through the teleport that connects the centre of Razachai to {npc:Zizzle}'s room (each passage to Zizzle's room costs a {item:Scale of Corruption}).

In {npc:Zizzle}'s room (floor -5, {coord:33103,31120,12}) enter the **southeast** teleport to the room of {npc:A Sleeping Dragon}; walk **north** of the dragon to the big door: you are teleported to another room, and the next teleport takes you to the main room of the Inner Sanctum ({coord:33071,31103,14}).
Go back through the teleports to {npc:Zizzle}'s room and use the **bottom left** teleport: it takes you to the {creature:Lizard Magistratus} building in the centre of Razachai.
In the basement beneath {npc:Zlak} ({coord:33078,31219,8}) enter the teleport to {npc:Chartan}'s room; the blue flame **south** of Chartan takes you to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.

In the Muggy Plains go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport, head **southwest** to the mountain pass ({coord:33085,31532,7}), climb it with {spell:Levitate} and go **west** to the Farmine elevator.
Mountain pass (entrance to the Zao Steppe)

An area designed for **paladins**: you may have to face up to 20 creatures in a row ({creature:Draken Abomination|Draken Abominations}, {creature:Draken Elite|Draken Elites}, {creature:Ghastly Dragon|Ghastly Dragons}, {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons}). Bring {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Wall} and {item:Bomb Rune|Bomb Runes} to cut off their path.

A small dream island, with an underground system, between Vengoth and Mistrock, which you can only reach during the {wiki:Realm of Dreams Quest} through a forcefield in the northern dragon lair of Ankrahmun; it has no creatures or NPCs.
Have the {item:Chayenne's Magical Key} in your backpack.
Have opened the chest at the top of the {wiki:Draconia} pyramid and received the book {item:Key to Magic (Book)|Key to Magic}.
Have cleared the northern dragon lair of Ankrahmun and pulled the hidden lever (see {wiki:Realm of Dreams Quest}).
Level 40 for the {item:Gate of Expertise} inside the island; Premium account.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}) and walk **north** through the {wiki:Kha'labal} desert to the entrance of the northern dragon lair ({coord:33116,32606,7}).
Kill **all** the creatures in the lair. On the top floor, use a {item:Destroy Field Rune} on the {item:Fire Field} covering the switch, step on the switch and pull the lever that appears.

Go **south**: the {item:Magic Wall} disappears (it returns 5 minutes later). With the {item:Chayenne's Magical Key} in your backpack, enter the {item:Magic Forcefield}: you are sent to the Realm of Dreams.
Follow the path to the small island and head **northeast**, where the house with someone sleeping in a bed is.

Use the portal out of the island: it takes you back to where you came from, the entrance of the northern dragon lair of Ankrahmun. Note: the quest spoiler says it is in the **northwest** of the island and the location page says **northeast** — if you cannot find it on one side, look on the other.
From there walk back **south**, through the desert, to Ankrahmun.
The switch and the lever in the dragon lair

To get there you must clear a dragon lair with {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}; if the spawn is not complete when you start, the mechanism does not work.
A castle on an island in the middle of a lava lake, at the end of the {wiki:Hellgate} (underground of Ab'Dendriel); it marks the entrance to {wiki:Draconia}.
Redbone Castle (end of the Hellgate route)
The Hellgate door opens with the {item:Key 3012} ({npc:Elathriel} sells it for 5000 gp).
Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (by boat: tell the captain in your city {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}).
In the city, go to the {wiki:Shadow Caves}, underground **northwest** of the depot: go down to the shops floor and then go down again next to the little houses ({coord:32655,31670,8}).

Go down 2 more floors and follow the cave **south** and then **east** to the Hellgate door ({coord:32676,31671,10}); open it with the {item:Key 3012}. If you do not have it, buy it from {npc:Elathriel}, nearby ({coord:32684,31671,9}).
Enter the **north** teleport and follow the route on the map through the Hellgate: it ends at the Redbone Castle ({coord:32666,31672,15}).
From the castle, the way forward is **one-way** upwards, to the island of {wiki:Draconia}.

To walk back to Ab'Dendriel, leave by the normal {wiki:Hellgate} route: climb the platform stairs, follow the corridor **west** and go down the indicated holes, use the {item:Rope} at the rope spots, cross the big room of {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} hugging the **south** wall, go down, head **northwest** and climb 2 floors with 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels} or {spell:Levitate} and the stairs.

Then go **southwest**, climb up through the hole, pull the bridge lever if it is closed and follow the only path upwards (lots of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}). You come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel ({coord:32603,31705,7}).
Route through the Hellgate to the Redbone Castle

A {creature:Demon Skeleton} guards the castle gates (you no longer need to kill it). Along the way there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Slime|Slimes}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms} and sometimes {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords}.
If you find creatures other than these in the Hellgate, you took the wrong way.

A dungeon far below {wiki:Tiquanda}, full of {creature:Iron Servant Replica|Iron Servant Replicas}; it has no entrance on the surface: you get there through the Energy Portal of the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, north of Thais (it is part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest}).
Arrival at the Replica Dungeon (Energy Portal)
The Halls of Hope temple must be restored and you must unlock the Energy Portal with {npc:Albinius}: say {key:energy portal} and hand over 50 {item:Marsh Stalker Feather|Marsh Stalker Feathers}.
Get to **Thais** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain at the port).
Leave the city by the **north** exit and keep heading north to the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, the temple of the Astral Shapers ({coord:32326,32090,7}), where {npc:Albinius} is ({coord:32335,32091,7}).
Enter the **Energy Portal** (once you have unlocked it): you appear in the Replica Dungeon ({coord:32786,32818,13}).
Go back the same way to the spot where you arrived in the Replica Dungeon ({coord:32786,32818,13}).
Enter the Energy Portal there: it takes you back to the Halls of Hope. From there walk **south** to Thais.

An underground island (also called Underground Isle) where the postman {npc:Robson} and his goblin guard {npc:Lunch} live; you can only get there on {npc:Junkar}'s steamship, when the Awash or Steamship world changes are active.

Only accessible via {npc:Junkar}'s steamship: from the {wiki:Sunken Mines} when the mines are open ({wiki:Awash World Change}), or from the steamship beneath northern Thais when the {wiki:Steamship World Change} is active.

**Via the Sunken Mines (Awash):** go to **Kazordoon** (by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} or Farmine, or on foot through the mountain), leave the mountain and walk **west** to the Sunken Mines entrance ({coord:32548,31989,7}). With the mines open, go to {npc:Junkar}'s steamship.

**Via Thais (Steamship):** leave Thais to the **north** and enter the {wiki:Ancient Temple} ({coord:32356,32171,7}). Go down the stairs two floors and, instead of going north, go **south** and a little to the **east** ({coord:32361,32190,9}): those stairs lead down to {npc:Junkar}'s room and his steamship ({coord:32524,32038,14}).
Talk to {npc:Junkar}: {key:hi}, {key:passage} and choose Robson's Isle.

Talk to {npc:Junkar} next to the island's steamship: {key:hi}, {key:passage} and choose the destination (Thais, Kazordoon or the mines). The {key:mines} option only works when the Sunken Mines are not flooded.
The wiki does not describe any other exit from the island: if the steamship is not working, there is no other documented way.

On the island there are {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Nightstalker|Nightstalkers}, a {creature:Nightmare Scion} and a {creature:Banshee}. The wiki recommends level 60–80+.

The building right **north of the Rookgaard temple**, with {npc:Vascalir} and {npc:Seymour} on the ground floor, {npc:The Oracle} on the 1st floor and {npc:Paulie}'s bank, {npc:Amber} and an exhibition in the basement.
The Academy is in **Rookgaard**, the island where new players start. From the Rookgaard temple, go **north**: it is the building right next door.
On the ground floor are {npc:Vascalir} (missions of {wiki:The Rookie Guard Quest}) and {npc:Seymour}. Go up the stairs to the 1st floor to reach {npc:The Oracle} ({coord:32104,32190,6}).
Go down the stairs to the underground floor (1 floor down) for {npc:Paulie}'s bank ({coord:32117,32188,8}) and {npc:Amber}'s rest room ({coord:32103,32183,8}).
Leave the Academy by the ground floor and go **south** to the Rookgaard temple.
To leave Rookgaard: when you reach **level 8**, talk to {npc:The Oracle}, on the 1st floor of the Academy; he teleports you to the {wiki:Island of Destiny}.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
Map of Roshamuul with the areas marked

A big underground reservoir in the **northeast of Upper Roshamuul**, full of {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps} and {creature:Feversleep|Feversleeps}, with stairs that work as fixed teleports; several tasks of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest} take place here.
Upper Roshamuul is only accessible from **stage 3** of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest} (server world change), when the wall north of Guzzlemaw Valley is open.
In **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). The boat docks at the human camp in the south, in Lower Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop}.

Cross {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} to the **northeast** and pass through the open wall ({coord:33632,32401,7}) into {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}. If you are a Roshamuul citizen, you can go straight to the Upper Roshamuul temple and avoid the valley.
The cistern is in the **northeast** of Upper Roshamuul (the wiki does not give the exact coordinate of the entrance).

Inside, each staircase always leads to the same fixed destination, which is not necessarily the floor next to it: use the maps marked below to find your way. The levers for the water wheels are on floor 8 ({coord:33677,32276,8}).
Go back by the same stairs you came in by, following the cistern maps. After the reward room of the Waters of Life task, the stairs take you straight out of the cistern ({coord:33675,32304,7}).

To leave the island, go back to the Inquisition camp in the **southwest** (from Upper Roshamuul first cross the bridge to the south) and talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Bring lots of supplies and {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Wall Runes} to trap the Terrorsleeps and Feversleeps. There are also 3 {creature:Shiversleep|Shiversleeps}.
On the way out you may appear in the middle of {creature:Retching Horror|Retching Horrors} and {creature:Choking Fear|Choking Fears}, which roam the surface of Upper Roshamuul.

A small mine on the **east** side of {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}, infested with {creature:Terrorsleep|Terrorsleeps} and {creature:Feversleep|Feversleeps}; part of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest} takes place here.
Upper Roshamuul is only accessible when your server reaches **stage 3** of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest} (Guzzlemaw Valley wall broken).
Recommended level 200–250+: all the creatures on the island are very strong.

In **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). The boat docks in Lower Roshamuul, at the Inquisition camp, in the **southwest** of the island (next to {npc:Captain Chelop}).

Cross the bridge to the **north**, to {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}, and cross the valley to the **northeast** to the gap in the wall ({coord:33632,32401,7}): you are in Upper Roshamuul. If you are a Roshamuul citizen, you can go straight to the Upper Roshamuul temple and avoid the valley.
Head to the **east** side of Upper Roshamuul to the mine entrance ({coord:33690,32348,7}). At the entrance there is a crate with the quest's {item:Dream Nebuliser}.
Go back the same way to the mine entrance, on the east side of Upper Roshamuul.

To leave Roshamuul, go back to the Inquisition camp in the **southwest** (cross the bridge to the **south** and go down the Lower Roshamuul ramp) and talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Alternatively, **northwest** of the Roshamuul depot there is a carpet ({coord:33514,32345,4}) that, when you step on it, takes you to the Thais temple.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
Carpet that leads to the Thais temple
The wiki advises against hunting here: the mine's Dreamhaunters are not very profitable and are a nuisance.

The demonic prison of {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}, **south of the depot** and west of the gap in the wall, with 3 main hunting floors for level 250+ and the bosses (such as {creature:Gaz'haragoth}) further below.
{wiki:Upper Roshamuul} is only accessible when your server reaches **stage 3** of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest} (wall open). Roshamuul citizens can go straight to the Upper Roshamuul temple.

In **Thais**, at the harbour, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}) {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). The boat docks in Lower Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop}'s camp.
Climb up from Lower Roshamuul, cross the bridge to the north and follow {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} to the **northeast** to the open wall ({coord:33632,32401,7}).
Pass through the wall into {wiki:Upper Roshamuul}: the prison entrance is **west** of the wall, **south** of the depot (the depot and the temple are northwest of the wall).
If you are a Roshamuul citizen, log out/teleport to the Upper Roshamuul temple (west of the depot) and avoid the valley.
Go back the same way to the surface of Upper Roshamuul.
Cross the wall again and {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} to the **south**, pass the bridge and go down the ramp to the Inquisition camp, in the southwest of the island.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop} next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
Recommended level 250+, ideally in a team of 4. The {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds} are the most dangerous creatures: their waves hit whoever is behind the blocker.
The whole island of Roshamuul is very dangerous: the path through {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} has strong creatures.
Underground ruins of the ancient capital Nuur, destroyed by the wrath of Suon, beneath **southern Kilmaresh** (southwest of Issavi); home of the {creature:Girtablilu Warrior|Girtablilu}.
Travel to **Issavi**, on the island of Kilmaresh: there is a boat from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** or **Oramond** ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes} to the captain) and also a magic carpet.

Leave Issavi to the **southwest**, across the steppes of southern Kilmaresh, to the ruins ({coord:33808,31694,8}). The wiki does not describe the exact entrance on the surface: the ruins are one floor below ground.

Inside the ruins, the Rimush statue is further down ({coord:33836,31714,10}); there is also a secret tunnel that connects to {wiki:Krailos}, with a sealed door that opens by drawing a sun symbol on the door, above the handle.
Return to the surface the same way you came down and walk back **northeast** to Issavi.
At the Issavi harbour, {npc:Captain Harava} takes you to other cities (for example {key:hi}, {key:krailos}, {key:yes}, 80 gp).
It is full of {creature:Venerable Girtablilu} and {creature:Girtablilu Warrior|Girtablilu Warriors}, which have 8,500 HP and hit hard.
Salt caves beneath {wiki:Kilmaresh}, **south of Issavi**, with {creature:Bashmu|Bashmus}; in the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest} this is where the {item:Eye-Shaped Frame} is.

Go to **Issavi**: there is a boat from **Venore**, **Darashia**, **Krailos** and **Oramond** ({key:hi}, {key:issavi}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Harava}, at the harbour **north** of the city ({coord:33902,31462,6}). Alternatively, come by flying carpet and you arrive at {npc:Tanyt}.
Leave Issavi to the **south** to the Salt Caves entrance ({coord:33968,31652,7}).
The cave is **one floor below** the entrance ({coord:33970,31653,8}).
After completing all the missions of the {wiki:Kilmaresh Quest}, you can use the shortcut **south of Issavi** ({coord:33891,31568,7}), which drops you next to the Salt Caves ({coord:33917,31656,7}).
Go back the same way to the entrance south of Issavi and return to the city to the **north**.
At the Issavi harbour, {npc:Captain Harava} takes you to {key:darashia}, {key:venore}, {key:krailos} or {key:oramond} ({key:hi}, destination, {key:yes}); you can also use {npc:Tanyt}'s flying carpet.
Shortcut south of Issavi (after the Kilmaresh Quest)
Shortcut exit in the Salt Caves
An area for very high levels (**300+** recommended): {creature:Bashmu|Bashmus} and {creature:Juvenile Bashmu|Juvenile Bashmus}.
An underwater hunting area **west of {wiki:Hrodmir}**, near Svargrond, split into two locations with {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents}; you get there on {npc:Captain Haba}'s boat.
Have completed {wiki:The Hunt for the Sea Serpent Quest} (level 61).
Diving equipment ({item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea}) to go underwater.
Take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat ({coord:32347,31108,6}).

{npc:Captain Haba}'s ship is the one right to the **south** ({coord:32355,31125,6}); he is on the first floor of the ship. He is the one who takes you out to the open sea (during the quest: {key:hi}, {key:hunt}, {key:yes}).

At the serpent site, equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} and step into the teleport to go underwater. You arrive on the first floor, with {creature:Deepsea Blood Crab|Deepsea Blood Crabs} and {creature:Young Sea Serpent|Young Sea Serpents}.
To reach floors -2 and -3, go down through the shafts with {spell:Levitate} or {item:Parcel|Parcels}; {item:Pot|Pots} and {item:Ice Cube|Ice Cubes} work better because the monsters don't push them.
Go up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/pots/ice cubes) at the spots where you went down and return to the point where you arrived underwater; the sources don't describe another exit.
Back on the boat on the open sea, say {key:hi} and {key:svargrond} to {npc:Captain Haba} to return to the port of Svargrond. From there, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to Carlin, Thais or Venore.
Underwater you can take the helmet off, but without full protection against drowning you take damage: keep it on.
Some shafts have caves: there may be more serpents than the ones you see from above. The wiki recommends level 70–110+.
Underwater hunting area **far below Oramond**, with the entrance **west/northwest of Rathleton**, next to the fisherman {npc:Mr Brandon}.
Mr Brandon (entrance to the Seacrest Grounds)

The main area is open to everyone; the subareas open with the {wiki:Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest}: mission 1 = Lost Mountains (west teleport), mission 2 = Sunken City (east teleport), mission 3 = Birthing Grounds (north teleport).
The boats from Venore and Edron to Oramond require the **Citizen** rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}; the one from Thais does not.

Go to **Rathleton** (Oramond) by boat: {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais ({key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes}, 150 gp), or, with the Citizen rank, {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore (130 gp) or {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron (110 gp). You arrive at {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft ({coord:33479,31986,7}).
Leave Rathleton by the **west** side and head **northwest** to {npc:Mr Brandon} ({coord:33550,31869,7}).

Step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} **south** of him, swim to the **north** side of the water and step into the {item:Maelstrom}: you appear in the Seacrest Grounds, near the {npc:Guardian of the Deep Seas}.
If you are in one of the subareas, step into the teleport back to appear next to the four teleports.
Next to the Guardian, go up the ramp to the **east** and step into the **southern** {item:Magic Forcefield}: it takes you back to {npc:Mr Brandon}.

Walk **east/southeast** to Rathleton. At {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp); with the Citizen rank he also takes you to Edron, Venore, Port Hope and Krailos, and Issavi is always available. With the Citizen rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide takes you straight to the raft.
Without a {item:Helmet of the Deep} you take drowning damage underwater (the helmet is not required to enter).

Area for level 120+: {creature:Seacrest Serpent|Seacrest Serpents}, {creature:Sea Serpent|Sea Serpents} and quaras; during the {wiki:The Fire-Feathered Serpent World Change}, {creature:Renegade Quara|Renegade Quaras} appear.
Small room with the final battle teleport

Castle in the **northeast of the icy island of Senja**, north of Carlin, where the sorcerer Alawar lived; below it lies the {wiki:Alawar's Vault}, guarded by minotaurs and a room of fire, poison and energy fields.
Go to **Carlin** (by boat, for example from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}).
Go to the raft **north of Carlin** and talk to the boatman {npc:Nielson} ({coord:32235,31675,7}): {key:hi}, {key:senja}, {key:yes} (20 gp).

You land on {npc:Anderson}'s raft, in the **west** of Senja ({coord:32127,31660,7}). Cross the island to the **northeast** to the castle ({coord:32187,31633,7}) and enter the basement ({coord:32191,31633,7}).
Leave the castle the same way (if you used the {wiki:Alawar's Vault} teleport, it drops you at the top of the castle: go down to the exit).
Go to {npc:Anderson}'s raft, in the **west** of Senja, and say {key:hi}, {key:tibia}, {key:yes} (the trip back is free). You arrive at the raft north of Carlin.
The lever hidden under the fire, in the basement

In the basement there are fire, poison and energy fields; to reach the vault you need a {item:Destroy Field Rune} to reveal the lever. On the vault side there are {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and a {creature:Minotaur Mage} that can reach you if the door is not locked.
{creature:Troll|Troll} caves and a district of houses in the **underground of Ab'Dendriel**, northwest of the depot; from here you can also go down to the {wiki:Hellgate}.

The two doors at the entrance to the monster area open with the {item:Key 3033}, which {npc:Shirith} sells (he is north of the underground apartments). Alternatively, enter through the slime/undead cave with a {item:Machete} and {item:Shovel}.
Go to **Ab'Dendriel**: by boat, say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull} ({coord:32735,31668,6}).
In the city, go underground **northwest** of the depot: go down to the shop floor and then go down again next to the little houses. You arrive at the Shadow Caves street ({coord:32655,31670,8}).
For the troll area, go through the doors with the {item:Key 3033} ({npc:Shirith} is at {coord:32646,31655,9}).
For the {wiki:Hellgate}: go down 2 more floors and head **south** and **east** to the door ({coord:32676,31671,10}), which opens with the {item:Key 3012}.
Go back through the entrance doors (with the {item:Key 3033}) and take the stairs up to the shop floor and the surface of Ab'Dendriel.
At the port, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to the other cities: {key:hi}, the destination (for example {key:thais}) and {key:yes}.
Area for low levels (level 8+): only {creature:Troll|Trolls} and {creature:Troll Champion|Troll Champions}. There is a secret passage to the slime and undead cave.
Hidden fire-themed tomb (officially Mahrdis' Cauldron), under the Kha'labal desert, **southeast of Ankrahmun**, in the shadow of the city's southeast tower.
Shadow Tomb entrance (dig with the Shovel)
Travel to **Ankrahmun** by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the port captain.
Leave the city by the **northeast** ramp and follow the city walls **south** to the southeast part of {wiki:Darama}.
Use the {item:Shovel} at the entrance spot ({coord:33255,32833,7}) to dig the hole and go down.
Go back the same way: go up the tomb floors to the entrance.
Use the {item:Rope} on the hole you dug to get out into the desert ({coord:33255,32833,7}).
Return to **Ankrahmun** via the city's **northeast** ramp and take the boat there.
Quest door on the 5th floor (A Father's Burden)
Shadow Tomb area, southeast of Ankrahmun
Some creatures turn invisible: bring area runes or the Cancel Invisibility spell.
The lower floors (after the teleports) are for higher levels (60–90): lots of fire creatures, such as {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}.
Renegade elf camp in the swamp **southeast of Venore**, surrounded by thorny vines; the {wiki:Dragon Tower Quest}, the {wiki:Time Ring Quest} and the {wiki:Heaven Blossom Quest} are located here.
Go to **Venore** and leave the city through the **east exit**.

Cross the swamp to the **southeast** to the elf camp ({coord:33075,32170,7}). The map shows the fastest route (there are others). A {item:Machete} and a {item:Shovel} are not required, but they help you cross the swamp.
Inside the camp there are stairs and holes to the lower floors; the main building has elves of all kinds and, further down, some {creature:Dragon|Dragons}.
Go back the same way: if you went down, return to the stairs or hole you came in by and go up to the surface (at a hole you need the {item:Rope}).
Leave Shadowthorn and cross the swamp to the **northwest** to the east exit of **Venore**.
Time Ring Quest hole (go up with Rope)
Fastest route from the east exit of Venore to Shadowthorn

In the swamp there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Marsh Stalker|Marsh Stalkers} and {creature:Swampling|Swamplings}; in the camp, {creature:Elf|Elves}, {creature:Elf Scout|Elf Scouts} and {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}.
During the {wiki:Thornfire World Change} the elves are replaced by {creature:Firestarter|Firestarters}.

Caribbean-inspired archipelago **west of Darama and south of the continent**, occupied by Thais: {wiki:Vandura} (with **Liberty Bay**), {wiki:Meriana}, {wiki:Nargor}, {wiki:Treasure Island}, the {wiki:Forbidden Islands} and the {wiki:Laguna Islands}.
The gateway is **Liberty Bay**, on the island of Vandura: take the boat from the port in your city ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}), for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais.

**Meriana**: in Liberty Bay, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}, on the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot ({coord:32347,32859,7}): {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp; only after the *Access to Meriana* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}).
**Nargor**: in Meriana, **south** of Sabrehaven, say {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} to {npc:Sebastian} (50 gp).

**Goroma** (Forbidden Islands): at the port of Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you there with {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp), after the *Access to Goroma* part of The Shattered Isles Quest.
**Laguna Islands**: they have no port; in Meriana, step on one of the {wiki:Sea Turtle|Sea Turtles} on the coast by the mermaid {npc:Marina} ({coord:32329,32528,7}).
From **Meriana**, {npc:Sebastian}, south of Sabrehaven ({coord:32347,32623,7}), takes you to Liberty Bay: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
From **Goroma**, go back to {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship on the east coast ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes}.
From **Treasure Island**, {npc:Captain Waverider} waits for you at the dock ({coord:32132,32913,7}).
In **Liberty Bay**, take the boat to your city (for example {npc:Jack Fate} to Venore: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).

Plateau in the **southeast of Roshamuul** (in the southeast of the {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}) where, using {item:Silencer Resonating Chamber|Silencer Resonating Chambers}, you summon waves of {creature:Silencer|Silencers} and, at the end, {creature:Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender}.
You need to be able to reach the {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} (Roshamuul bridge repaired; see {wiki:Roshamuul Quest}).

In **Thais**, talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the port: {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). You disembark at the camp in the south of Lower Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop} ({coord:33493,32569,7}).
Go up the ramp from the camp and cross the bridge to the **north** to the Guzzlemaw Valley.
Head **southeast** through the valley to the spot {coord:33655,32522,7} and **go up twice**: you are on the plateau, on floor +2 ({coord:33650,32525,5}).
Go down the two levels the same way and head back **west** through the Guzzlemaw Valley to the bridge; cross it to the **south** and go down the ramp to the camp.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.

The waves are 8, 11, 11 and 15 {creature:Silencer|Silencers}; the 5th brings 3–5 {creature:Sight of Surrender|Sights of Surrender} at the same time. Go with an organised team, with at least one high-level blocker.
The path crosses the Guzzlemaw Valley, an area for level 200+.
Mountain in the **north of Zao** ({wiki:Northern Zao}), above the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp}: an old lizard village, now in ruins and haunted by {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}.
Rebel hideout (when you leave you end up on the mountain)
To reach Northern Zao you need the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}: the first access is through the Lion's Den (mission 1); the fast route only opens after mission 2.
The teleport from the Zao Steppe to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below Cormaya): {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.

In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface. Continue **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
Use the teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, in the **north** of the Zao Steppe ({coord:33198,31350,7}).

After mission 2 of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest, use the reactivated link to the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp}. Before that, the route is through the Lion's Den: hole northeast of the {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns} village ({coord:33353,31182,7}, use the {item:Shovel}), crossed in disguise to the watchtower ({coord:33326,31082,7}); from there follow the road **west** to the rebel hideout ({coord:33171,31078,7}).
When you leave the Rebel Camp you end up in the middle of the mountain; the stairs going up to the Souleater Mountains are near the camp, coming from the **west** or the **east**.
Go down the mountain the same way to the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp}.
In {npc:Chartan}'s room, step on the blue flame **south** of him: it takes you to the Muggy Plains (only after mission 2 of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest).
Go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleport, head **southwest** to the passage ({coord:33085,31532,7}), go up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the Farmine elevator.
On the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon or Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
Plant area, above the Rebel Camp

High-level area (mages 95+, knights 150+): {creature:Souleater|Souleaters} are highly resistant to physical damage; there are also {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats}, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers} and {creature:Killer Caiman|Killer Caimans}.
On the Lion's Den route, if the guards catch you, you end up in {npc:Zumtah}'s prison.
Cave system in ancient ruins (similar to Banuta) in the **southeast of Tiquanda**, east of Port Hope, with three floors of {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s harbour ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
Leave Port Hope and cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **east**, to the **southeast** of Tiquanda, where the cave entrance is ({coord:32844,32871,7}).
Inside there are three floors; the deepest ones are those of the Giant Spiders.
Go back the same way to the entrance (use the {item:Rope} on the holes you went down).
Cross the jungle to the **west** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Room with Muddy Water and Lizard Statue (2 floors down)
On the lower floors there are {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} (recommended level 60–70+); the first floor has mostly {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}.
Three undead hunting areas under the ocean, west of Drefia; every day **one** portal opens to them, in Kha'Zeel (between Darashia and Ankrahmun), in Vengoth or in the Ghostlands.
**Premium** account (even through the Ghostlands portal, Free accounts can't enter).
For the Vengoth portal: you must have started mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}, so that {npc:Harlow} takes you to Vengoth.

Find out which portal is open that day: check the three places, listen to the Towncryer or read the World Board in the Adventurer's Guild. The entrances have ramps leading to the teleport and give off ghostly smoke.

**Darama portal**: on the {wiki:Kha'zeel|Kha'Zeel} mountain, 2 floors above ground level ({coord:33161,32561,5}). From **Darashia**, head **southwest** through the desert to the mountain and go up to the portal.
**Ghostlands portal**: leave **Carlin** to the **west**, go through the {wiki:Ghostlands} entrance cave ({coord:32222,31767,7}) and continue to the **northwest** coast ({coord:32176,31788,7}).

**Vengoth portal**: in Yalahar, at the docks of the **Trade Quarter**, talk to {npc:Harlow} ({key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes}, 100 gp). He drops you in the **west** of Vengoth; the portal is on the **south** coast ({coord:32909,31540,7}).
Step into the open portal: you arrive at the Spirit Grounds, next to {npc:The Gate Keeper}.
The wiki doesn't describe a special exit: go back to the area where the teleport dropped you (next to {npc:The Gate Keeper}) and leave the same way you came in.
Darama: go down the Kha'Zeel mountain and walk back **northeast** to Darashia (or continue to Ankrahmun).
Ghostlands: go back **east** through the entrance cave ({coord:32222,31767,7}) to Carlin.
Vengoth: go to {npc:Harlow} in the **west** of Vengoth ({coord:32857,31550,7}) and say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Map of the Ghostlands, west of Carlin
