The portal and the hunting area don't match: any portal can lead to any of the three areas — easy (Ghosts, Ghouls, Bonelords, Mummies), intermediate (Nightstalkers, Banshees, Souleaters, Braindeaths) or hard ({creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Nightmare Scion|Nightmare Scions}, {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms}). Check what is inside before pulling a lot of monsters.
Tomb under the Kha'labal desert, near **Ankrahmun** (officially Thalas' Venomous Pit), with the entrance covered by stones; full of {creature:Scarab|Scarabs}, snakes, scorpions and mummies.
Stone Tomb entrance (dig with the Shovel)

Take a boat to **Ankrahmun**: for example {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or the captains of Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Darashia, Venore and Yalahar. You disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city into the Kha'labal desert and walk to the tomb entrance ({coord:33282,32743,7}), covered by stones.
Use the {item:Shovel} at the entrance spot to open the hole and go down.
Go back the way you came to the start of the tomb (the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the pharaoh's room, used without the pass item, also takes you to the start).
Go up the ramps/stairs to the hole you opened in the sand and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface ({coord:33282,32743,7}).
Walk back to Ankrahmun. {npc:Captain Sinbeard} ({coord:33094,32884,6}) takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the name of the city, {key:yes}).
Stone Tomb entrance, covered by stones
To reach the deep parts (floor -6) you must step on the {item:Mystic Flame} and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the empty {item:Coal Basin}.
The floors after the teleports are for levels 60–90.
Small village in the **northeast of Edron**, with a graveyard, a {creature:Rotworm|Rotworm} cave next to the Stonehome Flats and {npc:Cornell}'s boat to Grimvale.

Travel to **Edron**: say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes} to the port captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais). You arrive next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({coord:33176,31764,6}).
Leave {wiki:Edron Castle} to the **south** and follow the path on foot to the **east**/**northeast** to Stonehome ({coord:33303,31773,7}).
Walk back **west**/**southwest** to Edron and take a boat at the port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse} ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
In the north of Stonehome, {npc:Cornell} ({coord:33304,31720,7}) takes you to Grimvale ({key:passage}).
Ruined tower south of Stonehome (Servant Sentry)
Quiet area, but there are {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, {creature:Bear|Bears} and {creature:Snake|Snakes} to the north, and a {creature:Wyvern} on top of a hill north of the village.

The streets of the city of **Venore**, the merchants' city built on the swamp: Dream Street, Mystic Lane (depot), Market Street, Walk of Flame (port), Paupers Palace and others; during the *Swamp Fever*, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} roam here.

Take the boat to **Venore** at the port in your city ({key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}), for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais. You arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat ({coord:32955,32022,6}).
From the port, the Walk of Flame goes **south** to Salvation Street; the depot is on Mystic Lane and the Paupers Palace is just south of it.
On foot, you reach it from Thais via the {wiki:Thaian-Venorean Road}, which enters the city from the **west**.

At the port, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to Ab'Dendriel (90 gp), Ankrahmun (150 gp), Carlin (130 gp), Darashia (60 gp), Edron (40 gp), Gray Island (150 gp), Issavi (130 gp), Krailos (100 gp), Liberty Bay (180 gp), Port Hope (160 gp), Svargrond (150 gp) or Thais (170 gp): {key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}. Oramond requires the *Citizen* rank from the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}.
On foot, leave by the **west** exit and follow the {wiki:Thaian-Venorean Road} to Thais.
The trip from Venore to Darashia has a 10% chance of ending at the {wiki:Ghostship}.
The streets of the Inner City of **Yalahar**, with a single, almost circular street around the central Yalahari building; the port, temple, depot, Shopping Tower, bank and post office are here.

To go to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay) you need the **Novice** rank of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}. Alternatively, pay 250 gp to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (west of Kazordoon) for the password ({key:whizzkid}) and travel from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}.

In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Max} on one of the boats **east** of the port: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (400 gp). With the password, {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais also takes you ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}).

If you have already done the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}, there are direct boats from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore (for example, in Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}).

You arrive at the port of Yalahar, **south** of the city centre. The main street circles the Inner City: the depot and the Shopping Tower are on the **west** side, the bank and the post office on the **east** side.
At the port, {npc:Captain Cookie} ({coord:32804,31276,6}) takes you to **Liberty Bay** ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or to **Thais** ({key:thais}, 800 gp).

If you have already unlocked the In Service of Yalahar routes, {npc:Karith} ({coord:32818,31278,5}), east of Captain Cookie, takes you to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Venore, Ankrahmun, Port Hope, Thais, Liberty Bay and Carlin ({key:hi}, {key:passage}).

To the surrounding quarters: the Foreigner Quarter (southwest) and the Magician Quarter (northeast) have no mechanism on the gate and you enter from the centre; in the others, the guards between quarters let you through ({key:pass} and the name of the destination quarter).
Karith — harbour boat (3rd deck of the boat)
Vincent — top of the Shopping Tower
Julius (Trade Quarter, next to the gate)
Map of the streets of Yalahar
Flooded mines **west of Kazordoon**, outside the mountain, which serve as a stop on the Steamship route between Kazordoon and Thais; they only open with the {wiki:Awash World Change}.
Sunken Mines entrance (south entrance of the Dwarf Mines)

The hunting area and {npc:Junkar}'s Steamship are only accessible when the {wiki:Awash World Change} is active (the water pumps run on {item:Coal} and the mines open at the next server save). {npc:Dronk} is always accessible.
Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}, or on foot through the mountain entrance.
Leave the Kazordoon mountain and walk **west** to the south entrance of the {wiki:Dwarf Mines} ({coord:32548,31989,7}).
Inside, follow the path to the **right** and go down the hole; {npc:Dronk} is **two floors below** the entrance ({coord:32567,32022,9}).
With the mines open, you can also arrive by Steamship: {npc:Junkar} at the Thais Steamship port ({coord:32524,32038,14}) takes you to the mines ({key:hi}, {key:passage}).
Go back the same way: go up the two floors to the entrance (use the {item:Rope} on the hole) and return to Kazordoon to the **east**.
With the mines open, you can also leave by {npc:Junkar}'s Steamship: {key:hi} and {key:passage}; it takes you to **Thais**, **Kazordoon** or {wiki:Robson's Isle}.
The open mines are full of {creature:Deepling Scout|Deepling Scouts} (about 50) and the {creature:Groam} may appear.
When the mines are flooded, Junkar's {key:mines} option doesn't work.
Quarter of Yalahar, **east of the city centre**, that broke apart and sank into the sea; there is still land above the water, but most of it (full of quara) is underwater.
To go underwater you need a {item:Helmet of the Deep} or a {item:Depth Galea} equipped.
The mechanism on the centre gate only works after {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} gives you access (mission 7 of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}).
Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}).

Go to the gate to the Sunken Quarter in the city centre, to the **east**, and use the mechanism to pass. Alternatively, from the Factory Quarter, talk to the guard {npc:Oliver} ({key:pass} and the destination).
There is still land above the water, so you can walk to {npc:Tarak} ({coord:32917,31199,7}).
To go underwater, ask {npc:Tarak} for a {key:trip}, equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep} (or the {item:Depth Galea}) and jump into the water.
Underwater, go down at {coord:32940,31182,10} and then at {coord:32964,31182,11}; to reach the bottom use {spell:Levitate} at {coord:32950,31205,12}.

Swim back the same way to the surface: use {spell:Levitate} to go up at {coord:32950,31205,12} and go up at the points {coord:32964,31182,11} and {coord:32940,31182,10}. **Don't take off the helmet** while you are underwater.
Once on land, return to the Sunken Quarter gate and use the mechanism again to go back to the centre of Yalahar (or pass through {npc:Oliver} to the Factory Quarter).

On the first levels there are {creature:Quara Constrictor|Quara Constrictors} and {creature:Quara Mantassin|Quara Mantassins}; deeper down {creature:Quara Hydromancer|Quara Hydromancers}, {creature:Quara Pincher|Quara Pinchers} and {creature:Quara Predator|Quara Predators} appear. Be careful at the **east** edge, where you can get surrounded by up to 12 Predators and Pinchers.
Bring all the food you need: there is little of it underwater.

6-floor tower inside an ancient tree, **south of Ab'Dendriel**, by the sea; at the top is {npc:Edala}, who sells the blessing *The Fire of the Suns*. (Not to be confused with Carlin's Suntower guildhall.)
Go to **Ab'Dendriel** (by boat: say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city; you arrive at {npc:Captain Seagull}, {coord:32735,31668,6}).
Leave through the city gates and head **south**/southeast to the ancient tree by the sea: the Suntower is inside ({coord:32697,31719,7}).
Go up the stairs to the top: {npc:Edala} is **5 floors above** the ground ({coord:32698,31718,2}).
Go down the same stairs to the ground floor.
Walk back **north** to Ab'Dendriel, where {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
The biggest human settlement on **Hrodmir**, the icy island in the north, ruled by Jarl {npc:Sven}; it is the base for the ice islands, the {wiki:Svargrond Arena} and the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}.
Take the boat to Svargrond in **Carlin**, **Thais** (for example with {npc:Captain Bluebear}) or **Venore**: say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes} to the captain.
You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, at the port in the **east** part of the city ({coord:32347,31108,6}). {npc:Captain Haba}'s ship is just to the **south**.

If you are on the surrounding islands (Okolnir, Tyrsung, Helheim, barbarian camps), {npc:Buddel} brings you back: {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} (50 gp). From Nibelor, talk to {npc:Nilsor}: {key:hi}, {key:passage}.
At the port, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you to **Carlin** (110 gp), **Venore** (150 gp) or **Thais** (180 gp): {key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}.

For the ice islands, go to {npc:Buddel}, **south** of the city ({coord:32254,31195,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage} and the destination ({key:tyrsung}, {key:okolnir}, {key:camp} or {key:helheim}), 50 gp. He only travels with you after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest}.

For **Nibelor**, go to the ice area **north** of the city and talk to {npc:Iskan}, the dog sled owner ({coord:32301,31083,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}. He only accepts after the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and the first mission of {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
For the {wiki:Formorgar Mines} and the raider camps, leave the city to the **west**, go up with {spell:Levitate} and follow the path over the mountain.
Iyad (magic carpet, on the mountain north of the depot)

{npc:Buddel} is always drunk and may drop you on the wrong island; if that happens, ask for the destination again. If you have a {item:Dwarven Ring} in your backpack he takes you to the right place for free, but keeps the ring (say {key:no} if you don't want to give it to him).
Don't kill the {creature:Husky|Huskies}: the barbarians won't forgive you.
Barbarian arena in the **north of Svargrond**, where you face 10 fights in a row against monsters on three difficulties (Greenhorn, Scrapper and Warlord) — this is the {wiki:Barbarian Arena Quest}.
Entrance fee paid to {npc:Halvar}: **1,000 gp** (Greenhorn), **5,000 gp** (Scrapper) or **10,000 gp** (Warlord); each difficulty only opens after you complete the previous one.

Go to **Svargrond**: take the boat in **Carlin**, **Thais** or **Venore** ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city ({coord:32347,31108,6}).
Cross the city to the arena, in the **north** of Svargrond, and talk to {npc:Halvar} ({coord:32230,31095,7}).
To pay: {key:fight}, the name of the difficulty ({key:greenhorn}, {key:scrapper} or {key:warlord}) and {key:yes}.
After paying, go through the door next to Halvar into the room on his right and step into one of the teleports (any one): the first fight starts.
After winning all 10 fights, the teleport on the **west** wall of the last room takes you to the prize rooms; go **north** to the room for your difficulty. The exit is **south** of the prize rooms.
To give up midway, step into the teleport on the **south** wall of the fight room (you are turned into a chicken for a few seconds) and you are taken out of the arena.
To leave Svargrond, talk to {npc:Captain Breezelda}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:thais} or {key:venore}, and {key:yes}.
You have **6 minutes** per fight (see the purple flame in the top-left corner of the room). If time runs out, you die or you give up, you lose the fee and go back to the start.
If you die in the arena you don't recover your items: the room is cleared every time someone enters. Bring all the supplies you need, there is no way to restock inside.
{creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Troll} cave in the swamp **south of Venore**, good for new players (Medicine Pouches and spears for paladins).
Swamp Troll Cave entrance (south of Venore)
Go to **Venore** (by boat, you arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}, {coord:32955,32022,6}).
Leave Venore to the **south**, through the swamp, to the cave entrance ({coord:32938,32219,7}), and go down.
Leave the cave by the same spot you came in ({coord:32938,32219,7}).
Walk back **north**, through the swamp, to Venore. At the port, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).

The main area is full of Swamp Trolls (and {creature:Slug|Slugs} to the north); there is a {creature:Ghoul} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} spawn behind a door in the **south** part, and {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} in the cave further south.
4-floor caves in the **north of the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp}**, a little northeast of the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}, home of the witch {creature:Ekatrix} from {wiki:The Tainted Souls Quest}.
Leave by the **southwest** exit of the city and follow the road **northwest**, towards the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}.
The entrance is in the **north** of the Green Claw Swamp, not far away, **northeast** of the Dwarf Bridge ({coord:32711,31939,7}).
Go down: the cave has 4 floors, all with the same monsters. One floor down, **northeast** of the entrance, is the central room with {item:Sulphur Stone|Sulphur Stones} ({coord:32729,31895,8}).
Go up the cave floors by the same spots you came down, to the entrance in the Green Claw Swamp.
From there go back **southeast** along the road to the southwest exit of Venore.
Central room with Sulphur Stones (1 floor down)
There are {creature:Tainted Soul|Tainted Souls} (also on the surface), {creature:Toad|Toads}, {creature:Gloom Wolf|Gloom Wolves} and {creature:Witch|Witches}.

The "Hydra island", **west of Goroma** in the {wiki:Shattered Isles}, with 20–30 {creature:Hydra|Hydras} on the surface; it is the second island in the {wiki:Teleportation Hub} chain and has a Mailbox in the hub.
You need access to Goroma (repair {npc:Jack Fate}'s ship) and to have unlocked Ramoa and Talahu in {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}; until then, the teleport from Ramoa to Talahu doesn't work.
In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} at the port: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). You disembark in the **east** of Goroma.
Go to the stairs of the Goroma Teleportation Hub ({coord:32038,32561,7}), go down and step into the **right** teleport: you arrive at the Ramoa hub.
At the Ramoa hub step into the **right** teleport again: you arrive at the Talahu hub. Go up the stairs ({coord:31921,32658,7}) to the surface of the island.
First time: the way is through the room with the four basins in Ramoa, as described in the "Access to Talahu" section of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}.
Go down to the Talahu hub and use the **left** teleport (Ramoa); at the Ramoa hub, the **left** one again (Goroma).
Go up the stairs of the Goroma hub and head **east** to {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32558,6}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Jack Fate in Goroma (boat to Liberty Bay)
Level door to the dungeon of Medusas and Serpent Spawns
The surface is full of {creature:Hydra|Hydras} (recommended level 60–80+); crossing the island as a group is tricky.

Beneath the island there are caves with Quara Scouts and {creature:Bog Raider|Bog Raiders}; north of the maze, a level door leads to {creature:Medusa|Medusas} and {creature:Serpent Spawn|Serpent Spawns}.
Island where new players go after leaving {wiki:Newhaven}, designed for **levels 8 to 20**; it gives access to the {wiki:Hidden Lizard Temple}, the Crimson Court and {wiki:Aragonia}.
You arrive on Targuna at the end of the {wiki:Newhaven} tutorial: the **west** exit of the village of Newhaven is a level door that only opens from **level 8**.
In {wiki:Newhaven}, when you reach **level 8**, leave the village by the **west** exit and go to the docks.
Talk to {npc:Anna} ({coord:32552,32498,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage} and {key:yes}. She takes you to Targuna.
The wiki doesn't describe any boat from the mainland to Targuna: the documented route is only from Newhaven.
Talk to {npc:Captain Indigo} on the Targuna boat ({coord:31973,31892,6}): {key:hi}, {key:thais} and {key:yes}.
He only takes you to **Thais**, and the trip costs **5000 gp** or a {item:Sail Pass} (dropped by several pirates and lizards on the island).
Captain Indigo — Targuna boat to Thais

The island's exits to the hunting areas: the {wiki:Hidden Lizard Temple} is up some stairs to the **north**, the Crimson Court is through the portal in {npc:Emiliana}'s house and {wiki:Aragonia} is through the sea turtle on the **west** coast.
Tomb under the Kha'labal desert, **northeast of Ankrahmun**, with the entrance covered in tar; at the bottom is the arena of the pharaoh {creature:Morguthis} ({wiki:The Ancient Tombs Quest}).
To get past the blue flame ({item:Mystic Flame}) to the deep parts you need a {item:Scarab Coin}, which you put in the {item:Coal Basin}.
Morguthis' arena is behind a level 75 door.

Take a boat to **Ankrahmun**: for example {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or the captains of Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Darashia, Venore and Yalahar. You disembark next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.
Leave the city into the desert and walk **northeast** to the tomb entrance ({coord:33232,32704,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} on the sand to open the hole and go down.
Inside, the ramps down are visible right away on each floor. To continue past the blue flame, step on it and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the {item:Coal Basin}.
Go back to the start of the tomb the way you came (the {item:Magic Forcefield} in Morguthis' room, used **without** the {item:Sword Hilt}, also takes you to the start).
Go up the ramps to the hole you opened in the sand and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface.

Walk back to **Ankrahmun** (to the **southwest**). {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia (100 gp), Edron (160), Liberty Bay (90), Port Hope (80), Venore (150) or Yalahar (230): {key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}.
On the first floor there is a {creature:Crypt Shambler} and a {creature:Bonelord} that are best avoided at low levels; the floors after the teleports are for levels 50–90.
Lizard and draken temple complex in the **north of {wiki:Zao}**, next to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}; it is part of the {wiki:Forgotten Knowledge Quest} (boss Soul of Dragonking Zyrtarch).
Through the **Fire Portal** in the {wiki:Halls of Hope}: only those who have completed the whole {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} can pass.
Via the Zao Steppe: the lizard teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Fast route: go to the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, **north of Thais** (leave by the north exit of the city and keep going north to the temple, {coord:32326,32090,7}), and step into the **Fire Portal**.
You appear in the north of Zao, in the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, next to the Fire Portal back ({coord:33339,31168,7}).

Long route: go to Farmine by {wiki:Steamship} ({key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes} to {npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya), go out to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} and use the lizard teleport in the north of the steppe ({coord:33198,31350,7}) to the Muggy Plains; then head **east** to the entrance ({coord:33344,31167,7}).
**East** of the building next to the portal, go up some stairs, walk **north** over a bridge and enter the Temple Complex ({coord:33334,31151,5}).
Go back the same way through the Temple Complex to the bridge and the entrance stairs ({coord:33334,31151,5}).
Go down to the spot where you arrived in Zao and step into the **Fire Portal** ({coord:33339,31168,7}): it takes you back to the {wiki:Halls of Hope}, north of Thais.

If you came on foot, return through the Muggy Plains to the lizard teleport, cross the Zao Steppe to Farmine and take {npc:Thorgrin}'s Steamship ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}).
Halls of Hope (Fire Portal), north of Thais
Arrival in Zao / Fire Portal back to the Halls of Hope
Lizard teleport to the Muggy Plains (Zao Steppe)

High-level area (recommended **150+**): {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats}, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}, high-ranking lizards ({creature:Lizard Chosen}, {creature:Lizard High Guard}) and, further down, {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters} and {creature:Draken Spellweaver|Draken Spellweavers}.
The teleport to the lower part of the complex only works by saying the password {key:zzubaran}, which you learn from {npc:A Strange Chalice}.
Ruined 7-floor temple in the **north of the {wiki:Muggy Plains}**, in Zao, full of elite lizards; it is the entrance to the {wiki:Fire Dragon Dojo}.
The lizard teleport to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} only works after the **first 8 missions** of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.
Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}).
Leave Farmine to the Zao steppe and use the old lizard teleport in the **north** of the steppe to reach the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.
The temple is in the **north** of the Muggy Plains ({coord:33176,31199,7}).

Inside, the right side of the temple can only be reached by climbing the tower to the top and going down the other side; alternatively, from the 2nd floor (left side) you can use {spell:Levitate} to reach the 1st floor of the right side.
Go back the same way to the temple entrance.
Cross the Muggy Plains to the **south** to the lizard teleport, go back to the Zao steppe and to Farmine.

The temple is full of {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards}, {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests}, {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns} and {creature:Lizard Chosen}; sometimes the {creature:Battlemaster Zunzu} appears.
In the Muggy Plains hundreds of {creature:Lancer Beetle|Lancer Beetles} can appear, which reduce your distance skill.
Event island **northwest of Rookgaard** and west of the Island of Destiny, with {npc:Lucius}'s temple; it is only accessible in November, during the {wiki:The Lightbearer} event.
Only during the {wiki:The Lightbearer} event, in November.
Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}).
Go to the **Magician Quarter** of Yalahar, in the northeast part of the city, and talk to {npc:Lucius}, south of Ethan ({coord:32892,31094,7}): say {key:hi} and {key:yes}.
He takes you to the Temple of Light. Inside, go up the stairs to find Lucius again ({coord:31971,32045,6}).
The sources don't describe the return in detail: talk to {npc:Lucius} again in the temple or look for the island's exit to return to the mainland.

The island is split into a good side and a bad side. If the world fails the event, the bad side is invaded by {creature:Eclipse Knight|Eclipse Knights}, {creature:Gloombringer|Gloombringers}, {creature:Harbinger of Darkness|Harbingers of Darkness} and {creature:Spawn of Despair}.

Sunken temple **beneath the main island of {wiki:Marapur}**, full of {creature:Naga Warrior|Naga Warriors}, {creature:Naga Archer|Naga Archers} and {creature:Makara|Makaras}; on the 2nd floor is the secret room of the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest}.
Temple of the Moon Goddess (first floor)
To reach Marapur via the portal you must have done the first part of the {wiki:Within the Tides Quest} (which requires the {wiki:The Lost Brother Quest}).
You need a diving helmet ({item:Helmet of the Deep} or {item:Depth Galea}) to move underwater.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes} to the port captain in your city) and climb the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains}, **west** of the city.
Step into the portal at the top of the mountain (floor +5, {coord:33037,32738,2}): you are teleported to Marapur.
With the diving helmet on, go down to the temple, which is beneath the main island of Marapur ({coord:33659,32740,8}). The wiki doesn't describe the exact entrance of the temple.
Leave the temple the way you came in and return to the surface of Marapur.
Go to the **Moonfall** magic carpet ({coord:33805,32768,2}) and talk to {npc:Ziyad}: {key:hi} and ask him about the destinations (magic carpets only serve Premium players).
Temple of the Moon Goddess (first floor)
Area for **level 400+**: {creature:Naga Warrior|Naga Warriors}, {creature:Naga Archer|Naga Archers} and {creature:Makara|Makaras}.

Very deep temple room in the {wiki:Hero Cave}, **north of Edron**, full of varied creatures; it has the {wiki:Vampire Shield Quest} and, behind the level 70 and level 100 doors, the teleport to the {wiki:Demon Forge}.
Level 70 for the {item:Gate of Expertise} in the **south** of the room; level 100 for the Demon Forge teleport.
Go to **Edron** by boat (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}.
From the port go **north** to the {wiki:Hero Cave} entrance ({coord:33164,31638,7}), where there are usually 3 {creature:Hunter|Hunters}. Go down the hole (1).
Go down the next hole (2), then go **north** to another hole in the same room (3) and go down.
Go **east** and then **north** to the next hole (4), in a room with 3 {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, and go down. Also go down the hole in the **middle of the next room** (5).
Loop around to the main floor (6), go **south** to the end and then **east**; at the crossing (with minotaurs) take the **south** path and go down the stairs (7): you are in the Temple of Xayepocax.
Go back the **same way**: go up the temple stairs (7) and follow the map in reverse, from 7 to 1, using the {item:Rope} on every hole you went down (5, 4, 3, 2 and the entrance one).
Outside, go **south** to Edron. {npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
The teleport behind the level 70 door is **not** an exit: it leads to the Demon Forge.
Route through the Hero Cave: numbers 1 to 8 are the points mentioned

In the temple there are 3 {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, 3 Monks, 3 Hunters, 2 {creature:Hero|Heroes}, 2 Priestesses, 2 Witches, 2 Dark Magicians, 2 Dark Apprentices, an Orc Shaman, a Stalker and a {creature:Warlock}, and they respawn quickly. Don't pull everything at once.
On the way back you pass the Dragons and the Hero again.
The surface road linking **Thais** to **Venore** on the main continent, passing through {wiki:Mount Sternum}, the {wiki:Dwarf Bridge|Dwarven Bridge} and the {wiki:Jakundaf Desert}.

From **Venore**: leave the city and head **west/southwest** along the road. To get to Venore by boat say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city (you arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}).
From **Thais**: leave the city and follow the road **east/northeast**, towards Venore. To get to Thais by boat say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (you arrive at {npc:Captain Bluebear}).
Along the road there are buildings such as the Dark Mansion, the Mount Sternum Outlook Tower, Lubo's shop, the Postal Service Headquarters, the Wolftower and the Venore Horse Station.
It's all on the surface: follow the road to whichever end suits you, Venore (**east**) or Thais (**west**).
In Venore take {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat; in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}'s ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
Mamma Longlegs' nest (Spider Nest Mini World Change)
Near the road, on the Venore side, there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}.

The oldest city in Tibia and capital of the kingdom of {npc:King Tibianus}, in the **southwest of the continent**, protected by walls, two rivers (to the north and south) and the Bay of Thais to the west.

**By boat:** the port of Thais is in the west part of the city (Harbour and Main Street). From the other ports say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain: {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore, {npc:Captain Greyhound} in Carlin (110 gp), {npc:Captain Seagull} in Ab'Dendriel, {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron (160 gp), {npc:Jack Fate} in Liberty Bay (180 gp), {npc:Karith} in Yalahar (200 gp) and {npc:Captain Breezelda} in Svargrond.
**On foot from the north:** from {wiki:Greenshore} follow the dirt path **south** through the mountain pass to Thais; from the {wiki:Ancient Temple} you enter through the **north** gate of the city.
**On foot from the northeast:** from {wiki:Kazordoon} come through the {wiki:Mount Sternum} pass to the east part of Thais.
**From Vigintia** ({wiki:Tibia Anniversary} event): {npc:Kendra} on the island takes you back with {key:hi} and {key:passage}.

**Boat:** talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the port ({coord:32310,32210,6}): {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}. Destinations: Ab'Dendriel (130 gp), Carlin (110), Edron (160), Liberty Bay (180), Port Hope (160), Roshamuul (210), Oramond (150), Svargrond (180), Venore (170), Yalahar (200) and Travora (1000). Some destinations require Premium; {wiki:The Postman Missions Quest} gives a 10 gp discount on most of them.
**On foot to the north:** leave by the north gate to the {wiki:Ancient Temple} ({coord:32356,32171,7}) or follow the dirt path north to {wiki:Greenshore} ({coord:32262,32074,7}).
**On foot to the east/northeast:** the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave} is to the east ({coord:32489,32260,7}) and {wiki:Mount Sternum} to the northeast, with the pass to Kazordoon.
**Time Travel Dungeon:** in the **northeast** wall tower ({coord:32427,32171,7}) go down the stairs and use the time machine ({coord:32429,32168,8}).
In Open PvP and Hardcore PvP worlds, Thais has many Player Killers around the city.
{npc:Jack Fate} (Liberty Bay → Thais) has about an 8% chance of leaving you stranded in {wiki:Goroma}.
Dragon lair **north of Thais**, 3 floors below ground, with {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and the rare {creature:Demodras}; the {wiki:Naginata Quest} is here.
Leave **Thais** on foot and head **northeast** to {wiki:Alatar Lake} ({coord:32393,32118,7}). The cave entrance is **north** of the lake ({coord:32357,32085,7}).
In the cave, follow the passage **southeast** and go down one more floor.
Keep going **south** and then **east** and go up the stairs.
Follow the short passage **southwest** and go down **two** floors.
Follow the passage curving **south** and go up.
Go straight **west** and go down one floor; then head **north** and go down again.

In that room, go up one floor: you are in the dragon lair ({coord:32349,32112,10}). On the way there are usually only {creature:Troll|Trolls}, {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, {creature:Snake|Snakes} and {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}.
There is no shortcut out: go back the same way (if you went down into the Naginata Quest holes, go up with the {item:Rope}).
Do the route in reverse to the cave north of Alatar Lake ({coord:32357,32085,7}) and walk back **southwest** to Thais.
Whoever owns the **Dark Mansion** house has easy access to the lair through the house's basement.
Cave entrance north of Alatar Lake
Route 2: south, east and go up
Route 3: southwest and go down two floors
Route 7: up to the dragon lair

There are 3 {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} (the one in the middle respawns very quickly), {creature:Dragon Lord Hatchling|Dragon Lord Hatchlings}, {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and {creature:Dragon Hatchling|Dragon Hatchlings}: don't let them surround you. Recommended level 40-60+.
The **Thais** jail, on Harbour Street, in the **south** of the city; the cells are underground, where the guard {npc:Henricus} is.
If you aren't in **Thais**, take a boat there ({key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city); you arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Bluebear} ({coord:32310,32210,6}).
Go to the **south** of the city, to Harbour Street, and enter the jail building ({coord:32328,32276,7}).
Go down the stairs one floor to the cells, where {npc:Henricus} is ({coord:32314,32266,8}).
Go up the same stairs to the ground floor and leave to Harbour Street.
To leave Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}, at the port, takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
During the {wiki:Kingsday Mini World Change}, if you insult {npc:King Tibianus} you are teleported to the jail and can't log out until the next Kingsday raid, which puts you next to the exit stairs.

The **Thais** lighthouse, **southwest of the city depot**: a mostly decorative tower, with a basement where someone has trapped two {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes} to forge weapons (this is the *Dark Shield Quest*, also called {wiki:Thais Lighthouse Quest}).
Go to **Thais** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the harbour of {npc:Captain Bluebear}).
From the temple or the depot, walk **southwest** to the lighthouse ({coord:32226,32277,7}). {npc:Smaralda} is just **south** of the lighthouse.
For the basement, go down the lighthouse stairs. The secret dungeon opens with a lever hidden under some boxes, which makes a staircase down appear.
The lighthouse is inside Thais: leave by the door and walk back **northeast** to the depot and the temple.
If you went down to the basement, go back the same way to the ground floor; the wiki doesn't describe another exit from the quest room.
Because of the orc invasion, orcs sometimes appear inside the tower, including {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords} (not regular).
The basement quest needs **at least 2 players** (one stands on a pressure plate while the other pulls a lever).
The sewers under **Thais**, with rats, spiders and bats; you enter through the sewer grates near the depot.
Step on one of the {item:Sewer Grate|sewer grates} near the depot: you fall to the floor below, in the sewers.
Return to the area under the depot and climb the stairs under the grate you came in by: you come out in the streets of Thais again, next to the depot.
If you went down any hole inside the sewers (for example the one for the {wiki:Battle Axe Quest}, near the **southwest** end, {coord:32302,32257,8}), use the {item:Rope} to go back up.
The sewer grates near the Thais depot
There are only weak creatures: {creature:Rat|Rats}, {creature:Cave Rat|Cave Rats}, {creature:Spider|Spiders} and {creature:Bat|Bats}.
Troll and orc cave under a small mountain **east of Thais**, good for low levels; the {wiki:Dead Archer Quest} and the {wiki:Silver Amulet Quest} are done here.
Main entrance (hole on the north side of the mountain)
Leave **Thais** by the **east** gate and head **east** to the small mountain with the cave.
The main entrance is a hole on the **north** side of the mountain ({coord:32491,32260,7}): open it with the {item:Shovel} and go down.
Down there you choose the path: on the **left** you reach the {creature:Troll|Trolls}, on the **right** the {creature:Orc|Orcs}. The two sides join on the third floor.

There is also a **back entrance in the middle of the mountain** ({coord:32503,32267,7}), which also opens with the Shovel: it doesn't connect to the main cave and leads directly to the {wiki:Silver Amulet Quest} area.
Go back the same way to the hole you came down by and go up with the {item:Rope} (go up each hole with the Rope to the surface).
Outside, Thais is to the **west**: enter through the east gate.
Back entrance (middle of the mountain, Silver Amulet Quest)

On the lower floors there are {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}, {creature:Troll Champion|Troll Champions}, {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}, {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}: it's not a place for a very low level to go in carelessly.
Hidden smugglers' and pirates' cave on the beach **east of Northport** (northeast of Carlin), with the entrance hidden between two mossy rocks; it is part of {wiki:The Isle of Evil Quest}.
The Cave entrance (beach, between the two rocks)
You can only enter after starting **mission 5** of {wiki:The Isle of Evil Quest} (and therefore only with Premium). A {item:Magic Forcefield} blocks entry for ex-premium players.

Go to **Northport**, the village **northeast of Carlin** (and west of Ab'Dendriel), where {npc:Mortimer} is ({coord:32499,31626,7}). From Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear} takes you to Carlin ({key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}).
Go to the beach **east** of Northport. The entrance is hidden in the sand, between **two mossy rocks** ({coord:32531,31628,7}): dig there with the {item:Shovel} to reveal it.
Enter and go down one more floor. The box with the {item:Nautical Map} is further down: go to the **northeast** room, go down the stairs and head **north** ({coord:32576,31572,10}).
Go back the same way: go up the stairs in the northeast room and use the {item:Rope} where you came down, to the beach east of Northport.
Walk back **southwest** to Carlin ({npc:Captain Greyhound}'s boat, {coord:32388,31822,6}) or **east** to Ab'Dendriel ({npc:Captain Seagull}'s boat).
The spot between the two rocks where you have to dig

There are many enemies: about 26 {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, 25 {creature:Bandit|Bandits}, 22 {creature:Pirate Marauder|Pirate Marauders}, 6 {creature:Pirate Cutthroat|Cutthroats}, 3 {creature:Pirate Buccaneer|Buccaneers}, 14 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, 9 {creature:Pirate Skeleton|Pirate Skeletons} and 1 {creature:Pirate Ghost}.

Building site for the expansion works of the {wiki:Museum of Tibian Arts}, in Thais, overrun by dangerous monsters; a very high level (400+) hunting area where part of {wiki:The Secret Library Quest} takes place.
Portal to The Extension Site (inside the Museum of Tibian Arts)
Premium Account (the teleport to the museum only works with a Premium account).
Go to **Thais**. **West** of the Knights Guild, go down 1 floor under the Games Hall and step into the teleport to the {wiki:Museum of Tibian Arts} ({coord:32395,32193,8}).
Inside the museum, step into the portal to The Extension Site ({coord:33246,32098,8}).
The wiki doesn't describe the exit: go back to the portal you came in by to return to the museum.
In the museum, go back the same way to the entrance teleport, which takes you back to Thais (under the Games Hall).
Teleport to the museum (Thais, under the Games Hall)
Very high-level area: the wiki recommends level 400+ (knights), 350+ (paladins) and 450+ (mages).
Lair of {creature:The First Dragon}, hidden behind a door in the {wiki:Kha'zeel Mountains|Kha'zeel} mountains, near Ankrahmun; it can only be reached with the {wiki:The First Dragon Quest} active.
Only accessible during {wiki:The First Dragon Quest}.

To open the door you need the four boss trophies: {item:Tooth of Tazhadur}, {item:Horn of Kalyassa}, {item:Scale of Gelidrazah} and {item:Bones of Zorvorax}. After you use them, access becomes **permanent**.
Go to **Ankrahmun** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}).
Cross the desert to the marked spot in the Kha'zeel mountains ({coord:33049,32758,7}).
Use {spell:Levitate} up **3 times** and then go up the ramp to the **north** to the door ({coord:33050,32721,4}).
Use the four trophies on the square in front of the **centre of the door** and then use the square to enter the lair.
The wiki doesn't describe the exit from the rewards room. If you don't find an exit teleport, go back through the lair to the door in the Kha'zeel mountains.
Come down from the hill the same way (ramp to the **south** and {spell:Levitate} down 3 times) to the desert and return to **Ankrahmun**, where {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to other cities.
Starting point in the desert (levitate up)
The NPC Kizar's room, at the back of the lair
Inside the lair you have to fight your way to the last floor, where a {item:Mystic Flame} takes you to {npc:Kizar}'s room.
Living insect hive in the **north** part of the island of {wiki:Quirefang}, north of Gray Beach, where the {wiki:War Against the Hive Quest} takes place.
The northern towers only open as the hive weakens: the **east** tower in phase 2 and the **west** tower (with the underground floor) in phase 3 of the {wiki:Hive Born World Change|Hive Born}.
To pass the {item:Hive Gate|Hive Gates} of the towers you need the insect pheromone (bought from {npc:Orockle} with Favour).
Take a boat to {wiki:Gray Island} in **Ab'Dendriel**, **Venore**, **Darashia** or **Edron** (150 gp): say {key:hi}, {key:gray island}, {key:yes} to the captain.
On Gray Island go down the island's **only hole**, **south** of {npc:Scrutinon}. On floor -1 follow the underground passage to the **northeast** and step into the {item:Water Vortex}.

On the other side use the {item:Rope} on the spot on the floor to go up and head **north** to {wiki:Gray Beach} ({coord:33471,31304,7}), the small village in the south of Quirefang ({npc:Orockle} is there).

From Gray Beach continue **north** to the Hive: to the **south** is the great Crawler habitat, to the **east** the hive's "stomach" and to the **north** the larger structure, with the east and west towers (7 floors each).
Go down the towers by the same stairs and head back **south** to **Gray Beach**. You don't get stuck behind the {item:Hive Gate|Hive Gates}: you can always leave those rooms.

To leave the island, do the underground passage in reverse to {wiki:Gray Island} and talk to {npc:Scrutinon}: he takes you **for free** to Ab'Dendriel, Darashia, Edron or Venore ({key:hi}, the city name and {key:yes}).
East part of the Hive interior
High-level area: the wiki recommends level 70–80 for the Hive floor and 130–140 for the towers and the interior.
There are {creature:Crawler|Crawlers}, {creature:Waspoid|Waspoids} and {creature:Spitter|Spitters} right on the way from Gray Beach.

Tavern inside **Kazordoon**, 2 floors below ground level, where {npc:Maryza} and {npc:Jimbin} sell food and drink and the drunk {npc:Grodrik} is; the {wiki:Explorer Brooch Quest} and parts of other quests are here.

Kazordoon has no boat. Go by {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} (for example from Edron, with {npc:Pino}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Gewen}'s carpet, on top of the Kazordoon mountain ({coord:32588,31941,0}).

Or go by {wiki:Steamship}: from Cormaya with {npc:Gurbasch} or from Farmine with {npc:Thorgrin} ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the underground port, next to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}).
Inside the city go to the floor **2 floors below ground level** (underground -2): the tavern is at {coord:32637,31888,9}. In the **north** part of the room there are 4 sewer grates.

The tavern is part of the city: go up the stairs to {npc:Gewen}'s carpet on top of the mountain ({key:hi}, destination name, {key:yes}) or go down to {npc:Brodrosch}'s underground port (steamship to Cormaya or Farmine).
Gewen's magic carpet (top of the mountain)

Crystal structure created by the gnomes that sinks into the earth, with three divisions by level (Upper 25–49, Middle 50–79, Lower 80+) and daily tasks; you get there through a crystal teleport in the temple area of **Kazordoon**.
You can only enter the division that matches your level: Upper Spike (25–49), Middle Spike (50–79) or Lower Spike (80+).
Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya ({npc:Gurbasch}) or Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}, or on foot through the mountain entrance.

In the Kazordoon temple area step into the **north** teleport, near {npc:Xelvar} ({coord:32623,31857,11}). It is a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)|large crystal teleporter}: it doesn't need {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals}.
You arrive at the Spike; the {npc:Gnommander} is on the first floor (floor -1, {coord:32248,32604,8}).
Go back to the safe zone of your section and return to the area where you arrived at the Spike.

Use the crystal teleport back to the temple area of **Kazordoon**. To leave Kazordoon, {npc:Brodrosch} at the underground port takes you by Steamship to Cormaya or Farmine ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}).

The Upper Spike has {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and {creature:Zombie|Zombies}; the Middle Spike has {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers} that are very strong for the level; the Lower Spike is hard until level 150+.
Island **north of Kilmaresh** that serves as a hideout for the Pirats; you can only get there on {npc:Captain Jack Rat}'s ship, from {wiki:Rascacoon}, during {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest}.
Have **1200 Trust Points** with {npc:Tik'hi Tak'he} in Rascacoon and defeat {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly} on the first trip (see {wiki:A Pirate's Tail Quest}). Recommended level 150-250+.

Go to {wiki:Rascacoon}: in **Venore**, say {key:shortcut} to {npc:Eustacio} at the port ({coord:32937,32031,7}) — only after the first visit to the island; the first time, enter through the shell north of the **Issavi** depot ({coord:33919,31471,7}) and cross the cave.
In Rascacoon, step into the teleport in the **southeast** of the island ({coord:33800,31359,7}) and go up **one floor** to {npc:Captain Jack Rat}'s ship ({coord:33792,31384,6}).

The first time, pull the lever: the trip includes the fight against {creature:Tentugly's Head|Tentugly} (up to 5 players, 8 minutes). After that, just say {key:sail}, {key:safe}, {key:yes} to Captain Jack Rat.
When you get off the boat you are in The Wreckoning ({coord:33882,31221,7}).
Leave the island by The Wreckoning exit teleport. The wiki doesn't give the exact destination; in the guides, after the Ratmiral, you go back to Rascacoon that way.
If you don't end up in Rascacoon, go to Venore and say {key:shortcut} to {npc:Eustacio}; in Rascacoon, the little boat at the dock where you arrive from Venore takes you back to Venore.
Teleport in the southeast of Rascacoon
The island's Pirats ({creature:Pirat Scoundrel}, {creature:Pirat Bombardier}, {creature:Pirat Cutthroat}, {creature:Pirat Mate}) have 2200 to 3200 HP: area for level 150+.
Underground exhibition room **next to the Thais Games Hall**, on Main Street, where contest prizes are displayed (mostly fansite items); it only opens on **Sundays**.
It only opens on Sundays: on other days {npc:Cillia} isn't there.
Ticket of **50 gp**, bought from Cillia; it's free during the {wiki:Kingsday Mini World Change}.
Go to **Thais** (by boat: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the harbour of {npc:Captain Bluebear}).
On Main Street, enter the Games Hall ({coord:32387,32210,7}) and go down to the floor below, where {npc:Cillia} is ({coord:32392,32199,8}).
On Sundays, buy the ticket from her (50 gp) and enter the exhibition.
Go back the same way: go up to the Games Hall and leave to Thais Main Street.

Dungeon of the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest} that runs through the history of Tibia, from version 12.80 back to the earliest days of Thais; you enter through a time machine in the basement of a wall tower in the **northeast of Thais**.
It is part of the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}: the way to the end (photo album, blue fire and the {npc:MUD}) is explained in that guide.
The time machine only brings you back after you have repaired it during the {wiki:25 Years of Tibia Quest}.
In **Thais**, go to the **northeast** wall tower ({coord:32427,32171,7}) and go down the stairs.
Down there is a teleport machine, the time machine ({coord:32429,32168,8}): use it to enter the dungeon.
Go back through the dungeon teleports to the entrance (if you are in the {creature:Lord Retro} room, leave by the teleport to the **north** of the room, only after the fight is over).
Use the repaired time machine: you appear in the basement of the **northeast** wall tower of Thais. Go up the stairs to return to the city.
The monsters (the *Memories*) are all of similar strength and designed for level 100+; they mostly give gold and consumables.
After Lord Retro, the purple teleport in the {creature:Memory of a Werelion} room works as a shortcut to near the boss teleport.
The great jungle of the Darama continent, around **Port Hope**, on the other side of the {wiki:Kha'zeel} mountains (west of Ankrahmun and southwest of Darashia), crossed by the Mahaji river.
Take a boat to **Port Hope**: say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais). You arrive at {npc:Charles}'s port ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
From Port Hope go into the jungle on foot: the northwest and the north (on the way to {wiki:Banuta}) are to the **north/northeast**, the ruins and the Trapwood area to the **south/southeast**.
If you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** end of Port Hope ({coord:32679,32775,7}), takes you directly to Banuta for 30 gp.
Walk back through the jungle to **Port Hope** (west of the jungle, by the coast).
At the port, {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}) takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, for example {key:edron}, and {key:yes}).
Beware of plants and trees: you can get trapped in the dense jungle (especially in the centre, Baksha).

The jungle has many monsters: {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas}, {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles} and even {creature:Hydra|Hydras}; the strongest are in the south and the far east (level 45–50+).

Abandoned laboratory overgrown with vegetation, under a hill **southeast of Banuta**, in the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle; it is full of {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas} and {creature:Mutated Human|Mutated Humans}.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s port.

Cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **northeast** to {wiki:Banuta} ({coord:32807,32542,7}). If you have the **Ranger** rank in the {wiki:Paw and Fur Society}, {npc:Lorek}, at the far **east** end of Port Hope, takes you directly to Banuta for 30 gp.
From Banuta head **southeast** to the hill where the laboratory entrance is ({coord:32886,32590,7}).
The wiki doesn't describe another exit: go back the same way to the entrance on the hill.
Return through the jungle to the **southwest** to Port Hope and take {npc:Charles}'s boat ({coord:32529,32785,6}): {key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}.
Recommended level 30–40+. The path through the jungle has {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas} and other Tiquanda creatures.

3-floor cave system just **north of Port Hope**, in the Tiquanda jungle, with {creature:Crocodile|Crocodiles}, {creature:Tortoise|Tortoises} and {creature:Blood Crab|Blood Crabs}; it is near the Port Hope Swamp Trolls and the Tiquanda Bandit Caves.
Go to **Port Hope** by boat ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the port captain in your city); you arrive next to {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}).
Leave the city to the **north**. There are four entrance holes, all north of the city: {coord:32613,32704,7}, {coord:32595,32703,7}, {coord:32550,32702,7} and {coord:32594,32654,7}.
Go down one of them. The teleport of the boss {creature:The Snapper} (Crocodiles task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest}) is on the 1st underground floor ({coord:32608,32714,8}).
Go back to one of the entrance holes and use the {item:Rope} to go up to the surface.
Walk back **south** to Port Hope; at the port, {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Area for level 15–20+: on the lower floors there are {creature:Blood Crab|Blood Crabs} and {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}.
Five pits in the middle of the **Tiquanda** jungle, east and northeast of Port Hope, that go down into spider caves; on the surface, around the pits, there are {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}.
Take a boat to **Port Hope** ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain); you arrive at {npc:Charles}'s harbour ({coord:32529,32785,6}).

Leave Port Hope to the **east**, through the Tiquanda jungle, to one of the five pits: {coord:32726,32794,7}, {coord:32758,32792,7} or {coord:32818,32810,7} (east of the city), or {coord:32776,32686,7} and {coord:32827,32690,7} (further **northeast**).
Go down the pit: down below you are in the spider cave.
Go back to the pit you came down by and use the {item:Rope} to go up to the surface.
Cross the jungle to the **west** to Port Hope, where {npc:Charles} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).

Down there are {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Centipede|Centipedes} and {creature:Toad|Toads}; the {item:Spider Egg|Spider Eggs} summon more spiders. Bring the {item:Rope}: without it you can't leave the pits.
Scrubland plain **south of Port Hope**, in Tiquanda, where the pygmy {creature:Dworc|Dworcs} dug a large network of caves and traps (the {wiki:Dworc Caves}).
Take the boat to **Port Hope** (say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes} to the captain in your city).
Leave the city and walk **south**: Trapwood is the south part of Tiquanda ({coord:32688,32911,7}).

The entrances to the Dworc caves are along the **south coast** of Trapwood: several hidden {wiki:Pitfall|pitfalls} and a staircase. Most pitfalls drop you inside a 'trap' closed off by wooden fences, which you have to break with a weapon.
The **southeasternmost** pitfall ({coord:32773,32912,7}) leads to the Dworc Caves used in {wiki:The Ape City Quest}.

The pitfalls are one-way (down only): don't go back the way you fell. Look for the exit from the caves — there is one entrance by stairs and a few holes with a rope spot, so bring a {item:Rope}. The wiki doesn't detail the exit route from each room.
On the surface, go back **north** to Port Hope and take the boat.

On the surface there are {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles} (mostly by the coast), {creature:Centipede|Centipedes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}, {creature:Carniphila|Carniphilas} near the jungle and {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} on the southwest coast.
Creatures can attack from a distance through the wooden fences of the traps.
At the bottom there is a circular room full of {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers} and {creature:Dworc Voodoomaster|Dworc Voodoomasters}: at a low level, stay close to the rope hole.
Former commercial quarter of **Yalahar**, **south** of the centre and next to the port, now occupied by criminals who rob the merchants arriving by boat.

Travel to **Yalahar**: in Liberty Bay talk to {npc:Captain Max} ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}; you need the Novice rank in the Explorer Society) or, in Thais, to {npc:Captain Bluebear} if you bought the password from {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice}. After you unlock {npc:Karith}'s routes (In Service of Yalahar) there is a direct boat from several cities (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}).

You arrive at the port of Yalahar, **south** of the city centre. The Trade Quarter is right there, next to the port ({coord:32826,31325,7}); the Trade Quarter docks (where {npc:Julius} and {npc:Harlow}'s boat to Vengoth are) are straight **south** from the main gate.

To enter the interior of the quarter from the centre, use the {wiki:Mechanism (Teleporter)|mechanism} next to the Trade Quarter gate. It only works after {npc:Yalahari (NPC)} gives you access (mission 4 (*Good to be Kingpin*) of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}); otherwise you get *"The gate mechanism won't move"*.

Without the mechanism, go through the guards at the gates between quarters (say {key:pass} and the destination quarter name to each one). {npc:Peter} guards the gate between the {wiki:Factory Quarter} and the Trade Quarter ({coord:32857,31302,7}).
Go back through the same doors to the street and use the Trade Quarter mechanism again to return to the centre, or leave through {npc:Peter}'s gate ({key:pass}, {key:factory quarter}).

To leave Yalahar, go to the port: {npc:Captain Cookie} ({coord:32804,31276,6}) takes you to Liberty Bay ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 400 gp) or Thais ({key:thais}, 800 gp); with the routes unlocked, {npc:Karith} ({coord:32818,31278,5}) takes you to 8 cities for less money.
The quarter is full of criminals ({creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, {creature:Bandit|Bandits} and the like): stay on the main streets.
Training schools that exist in all the main cities, with {item:Exercise Dummy|exercise dummies} and offline training statues; they are inside the cities, in a protection zone.
There is no single Training School: pick the one in the city you are in. Locations according to the wiki:

**Thais:** knight guild (melee), paladin guild (distance) and at the door of the sorcerer guild (magic level). **Carlin:** knight guild, next to the north exit. **Venore:** under the depot. **Ab'Dendriel:** underground, a little north of the depot.

**Edron:** north part of the castle, west of where you enter coming from the boat. **Kazordoon:** near the knight guild, southwest of the depot. **Darashia:** in the palace, the northernmost building in the city. **Ankrahmun:** in the paladin and knight guild pyramid, next to the shops.

**Port Hope:** the biggest open bamboo building on the south side, west of Bamboo Garden 3. **Liberty Bay:** in the fortress. **Svargrond:** near the arena. **Yalahar:** on top of the depot. **Rathleton:** in a building southwest of the depot.

**Issavi:** east of the baths. **Krailos Village:** near the depot. **Feyrist:** west of Taegen, underground. **Adventurers' Guild:** in the middle of the building. **Blue Valley:** inside the central temple (Monks only, fist fighting statue only).
In **Oskayaat** the training statues are behind locked doors, which only open at the end of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}.
The schools are inside the cities: leave by the door or stairs you came in by and continue on foot in the city.
Using a training statue logs the character out and starts offline training (it starts after 10 minutes offline, up to 12 hours in a row).
You can only train on an Exercise Dummy inside a protection zone; any action (moving, using spells or items) interrupts the training.
On a Free account offline training is limited to skill 50 on weapons and magic level 30.
Small island of the {wiki:Shattered Isles} **southwest of Liberty Bay**, turned into an enormous dig site by treasure hunters; the caves below only open with the {wiki:Treasure Island Quest}.
To enter the island's caves you have to do the {wiki:Treasure Island Quest} each time.
Go to **Liberty Bay** (for example from Venore, with {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}).
Go to the little hut on the peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} ({coord:32344,32855,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:treasure island} and {key:yes}: the trip costs **200 gp**. You land at the Treasure Island dock ({coord:32132,32913,7}).
Go back to the island dock: {npc:Captain Waverider} is there too ({coord:32132,32913,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes}: the return to Liberty Bay costs **50 gp** (save the money for the way back!).
In Liberty Bay, {npc:Jack Fate} ({coord:32161,32556,6}) takes you by boat to other cities.
Captain Waverider on Treasure Hunt Island ({wiki:Treasure Hunt Quest})

The island is full of holes and debris from the diggers: walk carefully. On the surface there are only seagulls, {creature:Larva|Larvas}, {creature:Crab|Crabs} and lots of {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}.

In the caves there are {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Pirate Ghost|Pirate Ghosts} and, in the east caves, {creature:Crustacea Gigantica}: knights should bring an enchanted weapon (for example {item:Fire Sword} or {item:Fire Axe}) for the ghosts.
Sinister tower **east of Thais**, south of Kazordoon and northwest of the Desert Dungeon, ruled at the top by a {creature:Dwarf Geomancer}, a {creature:Witch} and a {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monk}.
Leave **Thais** to the **east** and continue to the tower ({coord:32561,32118,7}).

If the entrance is closed, pull the lever hidden under debris in the desert, **on the other side of the river** ({coord:32573,32121,7}). It's a long walk there, so first check whether the tower is already open.
Enter and go up the floors: the top (3 floors up) is where the masters of the tower are.
Go down the floors the same way and leave through the entrance.
If the tower closes while you're inside, go down to the **basement** and use the teleport, which takes you outside (careful with the {creature:Bonelord} that's there).
Then go back to Thais, to the **west**.
Lever that opens the tower (under debris)

On the way there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} (invisible); at the top, {creature:Witch}, {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monk} and {creature:Dwarf Geomancer}.

Underground gnome cave, linked to the **Gnomegate** (the Gnomebase beneath the continent) by a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter}; the Mushroom Digger and Exterminators tasks of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} take place here.

You need to join the gnomes with {npc:Xelvar} in Kazordoon ({wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}) to use the {wiki:Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} (each trip uses one {item:Teleport Crystal}). The quest requires level 80.

Go to **Kazordoon** (by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine with {key:kazordoon}, by {wiki:Magic Carpet} or on foot through the mountain) and find {npc:Xelvar}, in the north part of Temple Street, near the north blesser.
If you don't have access yet, say {key:hi}, {key:adventures}, {key:recruiting}, {key:partners}, {key:gnomes}, {key:help} and {key:join} to him: you get clearance and 4 Teleport Crystals.

Enter the GCTS teleporter **east** of Xelvar ({coord:32628,31863,11}). There are also GCTS entrances in Thais (Ancient Temple), Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay and Svargrond. You appear in the teleporter room above the Gnomebase ({coord:32799,31765,9}); go down to the Gnomegate.
In the Gnomegate, enter the **north** Large Crystal Teleporter ({coord:32803,31745,10}): you arrive at Truffels Garden.
Leave through the teleporter you came in by: you are back in the Gnomegate.

Go up to the GCTS room (where {npc:Gnomette} is) and enter the teleporter for the city you want to go to: Thais (Ancient Temple), Darashia (mountain to the northwest), Edron (sewers), Kazordoon (next to the northern blesser), Liberty Bay (mountains to the southeast) or Svargrond (hole next to the west exit). It uses up one Teleport Crystal.
GCTS in Kazordoon (next to the northern blesser)

There are {creature:Wiggler|Wigglers}, {creature:Massive Earth Elemental|Massive Earth Elementals} and {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}; {creature:Mushroom Sniffer|Mushroom Sniffers} are harmless. The wiki recommends level 80+.
Frozen island **southeast of Hrodmir** (south of Svargrond), with the {wiki:Jotunar} mountain of the Frost Giants in the centre and a village of smugglers and fur hunters in the south.
For {npc:Buddel} to take you to Tyrsung you need the {wiki:Barbarian Test Quest} and to have at least started the mission *Nibelor 2: Ecological Terrorism* of the {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest}.
Take a boat to **Svargrond** (for example from Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}).
Go to the boat **south** of the town and talk to {npc:Buddel} ({coord:32254,31195,7}): {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:tyrsung}. When he asks for a {item:Dwarven Ring}, say {key:no} and pay **50 gp**.
You land at the Tyrsung dock ({coord:32332,31230,7}). Buddel is drunk and sometimes drops you on the wrong island: if that happens, ask again.

Go back to where Buddel dropped you (the dock, in the **north** of the island) and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:svargrond} to {npc:Buddel}; when he asks for the {item:Dwarven Ring}, say {key:no} and pay 50 gp.
You arrive at the dock **south** of Svargrond. If he drops you on the wrong island, ask again.
In the south of the island there is a village full of {creature:Smuggler|Smugglers}, and the mountain in the centre has {creature:Frost Giant|Frost Giants} (good hunting for levels 40–60).

The **Orc Fortress**, the largest fortress city of the orcs, on a hill on the coast **north of Venore** and southeast of Ab'Dendriel (east of {wiki:Ferngrims Gate}); at the bottom lies the throne room of {npc:The Orc King}.
Take the boat to **Venore** (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}).
From Venore, walk **north/northwest** to the fortress ({coord:32930,31774,7}). You can also get there on foot from Ab'Dendriel, to the **southeast**.

Enter through the hole marked on the map and head **east** along the blue line, the safest route. There are stairs down to the lower floors (the {wiki:Orc Fortress Quest} also goes through a level 40 {item:Gate of Expertise}).
Go back the same way: go up the stairs and return along the blue line to the hole you came in by; climb out of it with the {item:Rope}.
Walk back **south/southeast** to Venore (or **northwest** to Ab'Dendriel). In Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}).
Hidden room of the Druid Outfits Quest (2 floors down)
Map of the Orc Fortress with the entrance hole

Orcs move in groups of four or more; on the lower floors there are {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords}, {creature:Orc Leader|Orc Leaders} and {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}. Bring area runes, potions and, if you have one, a {item:Stealth Ring}.
Don't stop to rest near the fort: the siege camps around it also have orcs.

The modern glooth factory built beneath Oramond, entered through the {item:Slime Slide} in the Workshop Quarter of **Rathleton**; the Oramond Factory Raids take place here and it holds the entrance to {wiki:Jaccus Maxxen's Dungeon}.
Slime Slide to the Underground Glooth Factory
You need at least the **Citizen** rank in the {wiki:Rathleton Quest} (300 votes) to use the Slime Slide.
Go to **Oramond**: in the Thais harbour talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You land on a raft **west** of Oramond, next to {npc:Captain Gulliver}.

Enter the {item:Slime Slide} on the raft: it takes you to a mound on the main island. Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat; the portal on that boat takes you to the other side of the water.
From there go **north** to the main gate of Rathleton and enter the city.

In the Workshop Quarter, go to {npc:Terrence}'s building, just **east** of the stairs to Upper Rathleton, and enter the {item:Slime Slide} ({coord:33651,31942,7}). It takes you to the Underground Glooth Factory (floor -5).
Use the {item:Slime Slide} next to where you appeared: you are back in the Workshop Quarter of Rathleton.

To leave Oramond, retrace your steps to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide also takes you back to the boat) and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp). With the Citizen rank he also takes you to Edron, Venore, Port Hope and Krailos.
Although it lies beneath the old Glooth Factory, there is no connection between the two.
Street of houses in **Kazordoon** on **floor +2** of the dwarven mountain city (Upper Barracks 1 to 5); to the west is the Dwarven Ghost's room from the {wiki:Kissing a Pig Quest}.
Dwarven Ghost's room, west of the Upper Barracks

Kazordoon has no boat. Go by {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} (for example from Edron, with {npc:Pino}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Gewen}'s carpet, on top of the Kazordoon mountain ({coord:32588,31941,0}).

Or go by {wiki:Steamship}: from Cormaya with {npc:Gurbasch} or from Farmine with {npc:Thorgrin} ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}); you arrive at the underground port, next to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}).
Inside the city, go up or down the stairs to **floor +2** (two floors above ground level): the Upper Barracks are there. The ghost's room is to the **west** ({coord:32592,31930,5}).

Go down/up the city stairs to {npc:Gewen}'s carpet at the top of the mountain ({key:hi}, destination name, for example {key:edron}, {key:yes}) or to {npc:Brodrosch}'s underground harbour (steamship to Cormaya or Farmine).
Gewen's magic carpet (top of the mountain)
The upper city of **Rathleton** (officially *Rathleton City*), on the island of Oramond: houses, shops and most NPCs, with no creatures roaming free, unlike Lower Rathleton and the Workshop Quarter.
In **Thais**, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You land on {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, on an islet **west** of Oramond ({coord:33479,31988,7}).
Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island, with minotaurs ({coord:33539,32014,7}).
Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat: the portal on that boat ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you across the water, near the city.
From there go **north** to the main gate and then **west** to the ramp up to the upper city ({coord:33635,31943,7}).
To reach the other parts of the city, leave by the **south** stairs (to the west are the {wiki:Rathleton Workshop Quarter} and the slime river).

To return to the mainland, retrace your steps to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the *Citizen* rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide takes you straight to the boat). Say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp). With the Citizen rank he also takes you to **Edron**, **Venore**, **Port Hope** and **Krailos**; **Issavi** is always available.
Mound where the Slime Slide drops you off
Dangerous hunting area **north of the wall** that separates it from {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley}, in Roshamuul, where the depot, the temple and the entrance to the {wiki:Roshamuul Prison} are.
Gap in the wall to Upper Roshamuul
Only accessible when the server wall is open (from stage 3 of the {wiki:Roshamuul Quest}).
In **Thais**, at the harbour, tell {npc:Captain Bluebear} {key:hi}, {key:roshamuul}, {key:yes} (210 gp). The boat docks at the southern camp, in Lower Roshamuul, next to {npc:Captain Chelop}.
Cross {wiki:Guzzlemaw Valley} to the **northeast** and go through the open wall ({coord:33632,32401,7}): you are in Upper Roshamuul.
West of the wall is the entrance to the {wiki:Roshamuul Prison}; the **depot** and the **temple** are **northwest** of the wall.
Shortcut: if you are a citizen of Roshamuul, you can go straight to the Upper Roshamuul temple (just west of the depot), without crossing the valley.
Go back through the gap in the wall and cross Guzzlemaw Valley and the bridge to the **south**; go down the Lower Roshamuul ramp to the southern camp.
Talk to {npc:Captain Chelop}, next to the boat: {key:hi}, {key:sail}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (210 gp). Thais is the only destination.
Eruaran (top of the central mountain, east of the depot)

The central mountain is home to {creature:Gaz'haragoth} and his minions (until he is killed for the first time); there are also {creature:Feversleep}, {creature:Terrorsleep} and {creature:Shiversleep}.
The {wiki:Dark Grounds}, north of the depot, only open when the server completes the Soothing Bad Dreams task 20 times.

The first 3 hunting floors of {wiki:The Spike}, the gnomes' crystal structure that goes down deep into the earth; it is the division for **levels 25 to 49** ({npc:Gnomilly}'s tasks, {wiki:Spike Tasks Quest}).
**Premium** and level **25 to 49**: you can only enter the division for your level (50–79 goes to the Middle Spike, 80+ to the Lower Spike).
You don't need {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals} to get to The Spike.
Go to **Kazordoon** (on foot through the mountain entrance, or by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}).
In the temple area, enter the **north** teleporter, near {npc:Xelvar} ({coord:32623,31857,11}). It is a {item:Large Crystal Teleporter (Berg)|large crystal teleporter} and does not use up crystals.

You arrive at The Spike ({coord:32246,32601,8}); {npc:Gnomilly}, in charge of the Upper Spike, is on floor -2 ({coord:32242,32598,9}). Leave the safe zone through the large crystal teleporter to the hunting caves.
Go back to the safe zone of your division and then to the area where you arrived at the Spike.
Use the crystal teleporter back to the **Kazordoon** temple area ({coord:32623,31857,11}). From there you leave on foot through the mountain entrance or by {npc:Brodrosch}'s Steamship.

On the first hunting floor there are {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}, {creature:Mummy|Mummies}, {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, {creature:Crypt Shambler|Crypt Shamblers}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Zombie|Zombies}.
Bring a {item:Stealth Ring} in case you get cornered.
Huge vampire dungeon beneath the sands of {wiki:Drefia}, **west of Darashia**, connected to the {wiki:Necromancer Halls}; the boss {creature:The Pale Count} rests at the bottom.
Go to **Darashia**: by boat (tell your town's captain {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}'s harbour) or by flying carpet (you arrive at {npc:Chemar}).
Cross the mountains **west** to {wiki:Drefia}: for example, use the {item:Rope} to climb the mountain at {coord:33048,32429,7}, or come through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun.
In Drefia go to the entrance of the main dungeon ({coord:32996,32412,7}) and go down **3 floors** to the {wiki:Necromancer Halls} ({coord:33003,32413,10}).

In the Necromancer Halls head **south** to the way down to the crypts ({coord:33005,32480,10}). Go down, walk a little **north** and go down at the second spot ({coord:33012,32457,11}): you are on the first floor of the Vampire Crypts.
For the second floor, head **north** to the stairs going down.
Go back the same way: go up through the two spots you came down by ({coord:33012,32457,11} and {coord:33005,32480,10}; use the {item:Rope} on the holes) to the Necromancer Halls.
Go up the **3 floors** to the entrance of Drefia's main dungeon ({coord:32996,32412,7}).
Cross the mountain back to **Darashia** (via the rope spot {coord:33048,32429,7} or through the pass between Darashia and Ankrahmun) and take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Rope spot between Darashia and Drefia
The wiki says the crypts also have their own entrance, but doesn't say where: use the route through the Necromancer Halls.
On the mountain between Darashia and Drefia there are lots of {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}: keep some mana to cure the poison.

Area for level 50–60+: {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers}, {creature:Lich|Liches} and {creature:Gravedigger|Gravediggers}. Bring a {item:Blessed Wooden Stake} for the vampires.

The largest of the {wiki:Shattered Isles}, home to the city of **Liberty Bay**; known for its sugar cane plantations (rum), with caves underneath, {wiki:Vandura Mountain} to the northeast and the {wiki:Cult Cave} in the northeast of the island.

Take a boat to **Liberty Bay**: for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais or {npc:Captain Fearless} in Venore ({key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}). You arrive at {npc:Jack Fate}'s harbour ({coord:32161,32556,6}).
Liberty Bay is on Vandura island itself: you reach the rest of the island on foot from the city.

Heading **west/southwest**, through the sugar cane plantations, you reach the west side of Vandura ({coord:32166,32837,7}); heading **northeast**, you reach {wiki:Vandura Mountain} ({coord:32415,32776,7}) and the {wiki:Cult Cave} huts ({coord:32359,32721,7}).
Walk back to Liberty Bay the same way.

At the harbour, {npc:Jack Fate} takes you by boat to other cities ({key:hi}, city name, {key:yes}); {npc:Captain Waverider}, on the peninsula southeast of the depot ({coord:32347,32859,7}), takes you to Treasure Island or, with the right password, to Meriana.
Cult Cave entrance (hole in the hut)
Beware of pirate and quara attacks on the island and of the {wiki:Cult Cave} in the northeast, inside a small building.

Mountain on the island of {wiki:Vandura}, **northeast of Liberty Bay**, with several floors of {creature:Wyrm|Wyrms}, {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} and elementals, and an inner cave protected by a level 60 door.
The inner cave has a {wiki:Gate of Expertise|level door} that only lets players of **level 60** or higher through. The upper floors with Wyrms and Behemoths are open to everyone.
Go to **Liberty Bay** (for example from Thais, with {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}, 180 gp).
The mountain is on the same island as the city: leave Liberty Bay on foot and walk **northeast** to the foot of the mountain ({coord:32415,32776,7}).
Climb the mountain floor by floor; the {wiki:Lone Medusa Quest} cave is on the **4th floor** (enter the cave and go up the **south** ramp).
There is no shortcut out: go back the same way and climb down the mountain floor by floor to the ground.
Walk **southwest** to Liberty Bay and take {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat at the docks: {key:hi}, the destination and {key:yes}.
Map of Vandura island, with Liberty Bay and the mountain to the northeast

The monsters (Wyrms, {creature:Energy Elemental|Energy Elementals}, {creature:Nightstalker|Nightstalkers}, {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}) are easy to pull to the entrance. The wiki advises at least **level 75** and plenty of supplies; the Wyrms' radius was extended to 50 sqm.
On the way down, the Wyrms and elementals may have respawned: keep potions handy.
One of the three frozen islands **northwest of Carlin**; in the west lives Santa Claus, in his closed house, next to {npc:Ruprecht}'s cabin.
