Go to **Carlin** (for example, from Edron with {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Greyhound}'s harbour, {coord:32388,31822,6}).
In Carlin, head **northwest** to {npc:Nielson}'s raft ({coord:32235,31675,7}), one of the {wiki:Nordic Tibia Ferries}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:vega}, {key:yes} (20 gp from the mainland to an island). You land in the **east** of Vega, next to {npc:Carlson}'s raft ({coord:32023,31692,7}).
Santa Claus's house and {npc:Ruprecht}'s house are in the **west** of the island ({coord:31955,31712,7}).
Say {key:hi}, {key:tibia} (or {key:carlin}) and {key:yes}: the trip from an island to the mainland is **free** and drops you northwest of Carlin.
Nielson (raft to Vega, northwest of Carlin)
Carlson (arrival and return, east of Vega)
There are {creature:Frost Troll|Frost Trolls}, {creature:Polar Bear|Polar Bears}, {creature:Winter Wolf|Winter Wolves} and sometimes {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} on the island.
Ruined castle of the vampire brothers on the mountain in the **northeast** of the island of {wiki:Vengoth}, southeast of Yalahar; it is the centre of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}.
{npc:Harlow} only takes you to Vengoth from mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}.

The first entry into the castle is in mission 5 of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}: 4 players with charged {item:Blood Crystal (Charged)|Blood Crystals} step on the 4 {item:Strange Carving (Tile)|Strange Carvings} around the castle and are teleported inside. In later missions you enter through the castle entrance.

In **Yalahar**, go to the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp). He drops you in the **west** of Vengoth ({coord:32857,31550,7}).
In Vengoth, climb the **southeast** mountain and follow it, entering the {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls}.

Cross the bridge over the chasm, which links this mountain to the castle's, to the entrance ({coord:32953,31488,6}). The castle garden, guarded by {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}, is right next to it ({coord:32964,31497,6}).
Leave the castle, cross the bridge and go down the mountain through the same {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls}.
In the **west** of Vengoth, tell {npc:Harlow} {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp): he takes you back to the Trade Quarter docks in Yalahar.
The Strange Carvings around the castle
The route along the mountain has monsters ({creature:Werewolf|Werewolves}, {creature:Vampire Bride|Vampire Brides}, {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns}); the wiki recommends level 90+.
A bottomless chasm separates the two mountains: always cross by the bridge.
Dark, barren land **southeast of Yalahar** (west of Farmine), with the haunted castle of the vampire brothers; you can only get there on {npc:Harlow}'s boat.
Harlow (arrival in the west of Vengoth)
{npc:Harlow} only takes you after you have started mission 4 (The Dark Lands) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}.
Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Venore: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}).
In Yalahar, go to the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp).

He drops you in the **west** of Vengoth ({coord:32857,31550,7}). From there head **east** to the energy gate mountain ({coord:32949,31520,7}); the portal on the **south** coast is at {coord:32909,31540,7}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar} and {key:yes} (50 gp): he takes you back to the Trade Quarter docks in Yalahar, near {npc:Julius}.
Portal on the south coast of Vengoth
To reach the castle, climb the **southeast** mountain and go through the {item:Strange Whirl|Strange Whirls}; to go down, return through the same Strange Whirls.

There are {creature:War Wolf|War Wolves}, {creature:Tarantula|Tarantulas}, {creature:Haunted Treeling|Haunted Treelings}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} on the surface, and {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles} and {creature:Elder Bonelord|Elder Bonelords} in the castle. Recommended level 40+.
Cave in the mountain of the island of {wiki:Vengoth}, south of Yalahar, with about 15 Werewolves; it is one of the quickest places for the Werewolf task.
Access ramp to the Werewolf Cave (Vengoth mountain)

To go to Yalahar with {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay) you need the **Novice** rank of {wiki:The Explorer Society Quest}. Alternatively, pay 250 gp to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (west of Kazordoon) for the password ({key:whizzkid}) and travel from Thais with {npc:Captain Bluebear}. With the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} there are direct boats from several cities.
{npc:Harlow} only takes you to Vengoth from mission 4 (*The Dark Lands*) of the {wiki:Blood Brothers Quest}.
Take a boat to **Yalahar** (for example in Liberty Bay, with {npc:Captain Max}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; or, with the In Service of Yalahar routes, from Venore and other cities).
In Yalahar, go to the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
He drops you in the **west** of Vengoth ({coord:32856,31548,7}). Cross the island **east/northeast** to the cave access ramp on the mountain ({coord:32980,31497,7}).
Leave the cave by the same ramp and walk back **west** to {npc:Harlow}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes} (50 gp): he takes you back to the Trade Quarter docks in Yalahar.
Hemming boss teleport (Killing in the Name of)
{creature:Werewolf|Werewolves} summon helpers; pull them one by one into the narrow parts of the cave. The wiki recommends level 80+ (knights and paladins) and 90+ (mages).
Merchant city built on a swamp, in the **southeast** corner of the continent; it has two depots (in the centre and in the east, next to the bank).

By boat: at your city's harbour tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:venore} and {key:yes}. For example: in Thais {npc:Captain Bluebear} (170 gp), in Edron {npc:Captain Seahorse} (40 gp), in Svargrond {npc:Captain Breezelda}, in Port Hope {npc:Charles}, in Yalahar {npc:Karith} (185 gp, with the routes from the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}).
You arrive at the **north** harbour of Venore, next to {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat ({coord:32955,32022,6}).

By boat: go to the **north** harbour of the city and talk to {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, the name of the destination and {key:yes}. Destinations: Ab'Dendriel (90 gp), Ankrahmun (150), Carlin (130), Darashia (60), Edron (40), Gray Island (150), Issavi (130), Krailos (100), Liberty Bay (180), Port Hope (160), Svargrond (150), Thais (170) and Yalahar; Oramond (130) only with the *Citizen* rank of the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}.

On foot: the **east** exit goes down at {coord:33004,32095,6} to the swamp in the east (construction works of the {wiki:Venore Daily Tasks Quest}, {wiki:Venore Corym Cave}); the **southwest** exit leads to the road west (Green Claw Swamp, {wiki:Dwarf Bridge}); the **northwest** exit leads to the {wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp}; the **south** exit leads to the southern swamp (Swamp Troll Cave, Pits of Inferno).
East exit of Venore (go down here)
On the trip to Darashia with {npc:Captain Fearless} there is a 10% chance you end up on the {wiki:Ghostship}.
Around the city there are areas that are dangerous for low levels: the Dragon Lair to the **west** and the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} to the **southwest**.

Camp of {creature:Amazon|Amazons} and {creature:Valkyrie|Valkyries} a little **northwest of Venore**, on the surface, with a central hill and a cellar with a {creature:Witch}; this is where the {wiki:Skull of Ratha Quest} takes place.
Go to **Venore** (for example by boat: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to the captain of your city; you arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}).

Leave Venore by the **northwest** exit and head northwest. You pass {wiki:Villa Scapula}, a large ruined building in the swamp ({coord:32827,31959,7}); the camp is just beyond it, to the northeast ({coord:32853,31924,7}).
Alternative via the **south**: cross the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} (between Venore and Kazordoon); use the {item:Machete} on the {item:Jungle Grass} blocking the way.
You can also enter from the **north**, crossing a bridge, or arrive from the east side of {wiki:The Big Old One}.
The camp is on the surface: walk back **southeast** to Venore, the same way you came.
In Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to other cities ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
Hill in the centre of the camp
Villa Scapula (on the way from Venore)
Map of the Venore Amazon Camp
Map of the Venore Amazon Camp (continued)
In the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}: bring antidotes.
On the central hill there are {creature:Witch|Witches}, {creature:Valkyrie|Valkyries} and a {creature:Lion}; recommended area from level 10–15.
Cave of {creature:Corym Vanguard|Coryms} in the swamp **east of Venore**, with an entrance inside a building and a teleporter at the bottom to the Corym Mines.
Entrance building of the Venore Corym Cave
Take the boat to **Venore** (for example in Edron, {npc:Captain Seahorse}: {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}, 40 gp; in Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}, 170 gp).
Leave Venore by the city's **east entrance** ({coord:33002,32096,7}), the quickest way, and cross the swamp to the cave building ({coord:33073,32085,7}), northeast of Rafzan's building.
**Go up the stairs** of the building and then **go down the ladders**: that way you enter the cave without needing a rope.

To the Corym Mines: go down the hole to the **northeast**, then the next hole, head **south** and go down again; on the deepest floor follow the **north** wall in the **northwest** area to the teleporter ({coord:33054,32008,11}).
If you are in the Corym Mines, go back to the teleporter you came in by: it takes you back to the Venore Corym Cave.
Climb up with the {item:Rope} through the holes you came down by, go up the ladders and go down the stairs of the swamp building.
Return to Venore through the **east** entrance and take {npc:Captain Fearless}'s boat ({coord:32955,32022,6}): {key:hi}, the destination (for example {key:edron}, 40 gp) and {key:yes}.
Entrance of the Venore Corym Cave

The {creature:Corym Vanguard|Corym Vanguards} (with {creature:Corym Charlatan|Charlatans} and {creature:Corym Skirmisher|Skirmishers}) hit hard for low levels: the wiki recommends level 40+ for knights and 35+ for paladins and mages.
Small cave of weak orcs in the swamp **east of Venore**, good for low levels; the {wiki:Orc Shaman Quest} is here.
Venore Orc Cave entrance (hole to open with the shovel)
Go to **Venore** (by boat: tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Fearless}).
Leave through the **south** gate of the city and head **east**, crossing the swamp to a small cave ({coord:33056,32030,7}).
Use the {item:Shovel} to open the hole and go down through it.
Go back the same way: on each floor return to where you came down and go up (use the {item:Rope} on the holes).
On the entrance floor go **west** to the hole you came in by and climb up with the {item:Rope} to the swamp.
Walk **west** back to Venore's south gate. At the harbour, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you by boat to other cities.
Inside there are {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Spearman|Orc Spearmen} and, further down, an {creature:Orc Shaman}.

Festive island of the Tibia anniversary, **north of Gray Island** and northeast of Zao, with the can knockdown game, the treasure hunt and a bridge to the island of {wiki:Nostalgia}; only accessible during the {wiki:Tibia Anniversary}.
You can only go during the annual {wiki:Tibia Anniversary} event (early January).
Go and see {npc:Kendra}, just southwest of **Thais**, south of the *Open-Air Theatre* ({coord:32263,32265,7}).
Say {key:hi} and {key:passage}: she takes you to Vigintia.
If you went to {wiki:Nostalgia}, walk back **west** over the same bridge to Vigintia.
In Vigintia talk to {npc:Kendra} again (she is on the island too): {key:hi} and {key:passage} to return to Thais.
There are no creatures on the island. In the treasure hunt only a normal {item:Shovel} works ({npc:Vigintius} sells one), and you are teleported out after 90 seconds.

The ruins of the house of the former commander of the Royal Army, now the {creature:Black Knight}, half sunk in the swamp **northwest of Venore**; underneath there are cellars with {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} down to the Black Knight's room.
The cellar door may be locked: open it with {item:Key 5010}, which is in one of the two dead trees **west** of the villa.
To reach the Black Knight's room you pass a **level 50** {item:Gate of Expertise}.
Leave **Venore** by the **northwest** exit and head northwest towards the {wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp}, to a large ruined building in the swamp ({coord:32827,31959,7}).

Go down into the cellar and go to the **south** end, where there is a door. If it is locked, get the {item:Key 5010} from one of the dead trees to the west ({coord:32813,31964,7} or {coord:32800,31959,7}).
Go down the stairs, down again, follow the cave to the end and jump into the hole. Head **south** and climb up with the {item:Rope}.
Keep going **south** to the room of the {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} and jump into one of the two holes.

On the floor of the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, go **east** to the wall and then **north** to the stairs; go down. To the **north** is the level 50 {item:Gate of Expertise} and, in the big room, enter the teleporter to the **north**: it takes you to the {creature:Black Knight}'s room.
In the Black Knight's room, enter the teleporter on the **south** side: it takes you back to the floor you were on before.

Pass through the {item:Gate of Expertise} again, go up the stairs of the Bonelords floor, use the {item:Rope} on the hole in the skeleton room, go down through the spot where you climbed up with the rope, use the {item:Rope} again on the hole you jumped into at the end of the cave, and climb the stairs of the two cellars up to the villa.
Return to **Venore** through the swamp, to the **southeast**, along the same route as the Amazon Camp.
The {creature:Black Knight} hits hard (up to 500 damage); in the cellars there are Bonelords, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and a {creature:Wyvern}.

Empty, lifeless plane "at the edge of creation". The best known lies beneath the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} (entered through a broken portal in the {wiki:Necromant House}); in {wiki:The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest} {npc:Eclesius} takes you to another void, beneath his house, near Thais.
Void of the Plains of Havoc: you need {item:Key 3701} to reach the broken portal in the Necromant House.
Eclesius's void: only during mission 3 (Love's a Wicked Game) of {wiki:The Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest}.

**Via the Scatterbrained Sorcerer Quest:** go to {npc:Eclesius}'s house, near Thais ({coord:32291,32291,7}). In the final part of mission 3 say {key:hi}, {key:mission}, then {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} again: he takes you to the void in the space-time continuum beneath the house.
**Via the Plains of Havoc:** in the {wiki:Necromant House} there is a broken portal that, instead of going to the Pits of Inferno, teleports you to the Void. To get there you need {item:Key 3701}.
**Eclesius's void:** tell {npc:Eclesius} {key:hi}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}: he takes you back home.
**Void of the Plains of Havoc:** leave through another portal, which drops you near the SD quest, north of the Plains of Havoc ({coord:32768,32230,7}). From there walk **northeast** back to Venore.
Void exit (north of the Plains of Havoc)
The void in the space-time continuum
The Void beneath the Plains of Havoc

Underground war zone **east of the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub}**, far below the sea east of Kazordoon; the boss {creature:The Baron from Below} of the {wiki:Dangerous Depths Quest} is here (gnome faction of {npc:Gnomus}).
Warzone 4 entrance (east of the Gnome Deep Hub)
**Premium** and access to the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub}.

15 task points with the gnome faction ({npc:Gnomus}) — only 10 if you have already defeated the bosses of Warzones 1, 2 and 3 of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}. You spend the points by destroying a {item:Fragile Lava Funnel}, which gives you **8 hours** of access.

Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} (you arrive next to {npc:Brodrosch}), or on foot through the mountain entrance (bring a {item:Rope} and {item:Shovel}).

In Kazordoon, go to the Gnome Deep Hub entrance, near the **northern** blesser of the city, 4 floors below ground ({coord:32624,31868,11}), and enter. With level 80+ and access from {npc:Xelvar}, you can also use the crystal teleporter right next to it ({coord:32628,31863,11}, uses up one {item:Teleport Crystal}).
You arrive at the Gnome Deep Hub ({coord:33752,32190,14}); {npc:Gnomus} is just to the **north** ({coord:33749,32166,14}).
With the points done, enter the energy portal near the gnome task area and destroy a {item:Fragile Lava Funnel}. The Warzone 4 entrance is **east** of the hub ({coord:33827,32172,14}).
After the boss, leave through the teleporter to the Lava Pump room and go back the same way through the Warzone to the Gnome Deep Hub.
From the hub, leave through the **Kazordoon** entrance ({coord:32624,31868,11}).

To leave Kazordoon take {npc:Brodrosch}'s Steamship ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), use the crystal teleporter next to the hub entrance, or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
If the 8 hours of access run out while you are inside, you are not kicked out, but if you leave you can only re-enter by destroying another funnel (and spending more points).
Strong creatures: {creature:Drillworm|Drillworms}, {creature:Elder Wyrm|Elder Wyrms}, {creature:Lava Lurker|Lava Lurkers} and {creature:Chasm Spawn|Chasm Spawns}.
Sealed war zone **south of the Gnome Deep Hub**, overseen by {npc:Klom Stonecutter} (dwarf faction) in the {wiki:Dangerous Depths Quest}, where the boss {creature:The Count of the Core} is.
Premium account and access to the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub} (the quest asks for level 100, recommended 200).
**15 task points** with {npc:Klom Stonecutter} (only 10 if you have already defeated the bosses of Warzones 1, 2 and 3 of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}).
Each player has to destroy a {item:Fragile Lava Funnel} to get **8 hours** of access (the points are deducted).

Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya ({npc:Gurbasch}) or Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}) with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} (you arrive next to {npc:Brodrosch}), or on foot through the mountain entrance.

In Kazordoon, go to the Gnome Deep Hub entrance, near the **northern** blesser of the city, 4 floors below ground ({coord:32624,31868,11}), and enter. With level 80+ you can use the {wiki:Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} (access via {npc:Xelvar}, 1 {item:Teleport Crystal} per trip).
With the points done, enter the energy portal near the dwarf task area and destroy one of the three Fragile Lava Funnels.
Go to the Warzone 5 entrance, **south** of the hub ({coord:33777,32192,14}), next to {npc:Klom Stonecutter}, and go through the teleporter.
After the boss, leave through the teleporter to the Lava Pump room and go back through the Warzone to the Gnome Deep Hub. While the 8 hours last you can leave and re-enter.

From the hub, leave through the **Kazordoon** entrance ({coord:32624,31868,11}). Then take {npc:Brodrosch}'s Steamship ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), use the crystal teleporter next to the hub entrance, or leave on foot through the mountain.

Creatures: {creature:High Voltage Elemental|High Voltage Elementals}, {creature:Cave Devourer|Cave Devourers}, {creature:Tunnel Tyrant|Tunnel Tyrants} and {creature:Ember Beast|Ember Beasts}. Go as a team.
If the 8 hours of access run out and you leave, you can only re-enter by destroying another funnel and spending more points.
Sealed warzone **northeast of the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub}**, watched over by {npc:Lardoc Bashsmite}, where the boss {creature:The Duke of the Depths} of the {wiki:Dangerous Depths Quest} is.
Warzone 6 entrance (northeast of the Gnome Deep Hub)

You need **15 points** with {npc:Lardoc Bashsmite}'s Scouts (**10** if you have already defeated the bosses of Warzones 1, 2 and 3 of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}); you earn points with his tasks or by handing in {item:Suspicious Device|Suspicious Devices}.
To enter you destroy a {item:Fragile Lava Funnel} (it uses up the points) and get **8 hours** of access: you can leave and come back freely during that time.

Go to **Kazordoon**: by {wiki:Steamship} from {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Gurbasch}) or from Farmine ({npc:Thorgrin}), with {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes} (you arrive next to {npc:Brodrosch}); or on foot through the mountain entrance.

In Kazordoon, go to the entrance of the {wiki:Gnome Deep Hub}, near the **northern** blesser of the city, 4 floors below ground level ({coord:32624,31868,11}), and enter. Alternatively (level 80+), use the {wiki:Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} crystal right next to it, spending one {item:Teleport Crystal}.
In the hub, head **northeast** to {npc:Lardoc Bashsmite} ({coord:33838,32123,14}).

With the necessary points, enter the energy portal near Lardoc's task area and destroy one of the three {item:Fragile Lava Funnel|Fragile Lava Funnels}. Then go through the Warzone 6 teleporter ({coord:33829,32128,14}).
After the boss, destroy the Lava Pump and go back the **same way** through the Warzone (via the Lava Pump room) to the Gnome Deep Hub.

From the hub, leave through the **Kazordoon** entrance. To leave Kazordoon, take {npc:Brodrosch}'s {wiki:Steamship} ({key:hi}, {key:cormaya} or {key:farmine}, {key:yes}), use the crystal teleporter next to the hub entrance, or leave on foot through the mountain entrance.
Hollow Geode (opens the boss teleporter with 30 Heavy Crystal Fragments)
If the 8 hours of access run out while you are inside, you are not kicked out, but if you leave you can only re-enter by destroying another funnel and spending more points.
{creature:The Duke of the Depths} deals combos of over 4000 damage when invincible: this is a team fight.
Towers full of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}, a good source of {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}: there is one in **Rookgaard**, west of the village, and several around **Darashia**.
**Rookgaard:** from the village (for example from {npc:Vascalir}), leave by the bridge to the **north**, go to the part **west of the river** and go down the ramp to the **south**.

Follow the road **west** until you see the tower ({coord:32000,32139,7}). It has 5 levels: 1 wasp on the ground floor and one more for each floor above; on the last one is the honey flower bed ({item:Honey Flower}).

**Darashia:** go to Darashia by boat ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Petros}) or by flying carpet ({npc:Chemar}) and head out into the desert. The main tower, the one nearest the city, is at {coord:33210,32385,7}; the others are at the coordinates below.
The towers are on the surface: go down the stairs to the ground floor.
In Rookgaard go back to the village the same way: road to the **east**, up the ramp and across the bridge to the **north**.
In Darashia walk back to the city and take {npc:Petros}'s boat or {npc:Chemar}'s carpet.
Main tower of Darashia (nearest the city)
The wasps poison: bring a cure for poison (in the {wiki:The Rookie Guard Quest} Vascalir gives you a {item:Silver Amulet} that protects you).
In Darashia's main tower there are 10 wasps right on the 1st floor above the ground.

Almost entirely flooded cave in the south of Tiquanda, **south of Port Hope**, with {creature:Water Elemental|Water Elementals} on the main floor and water channels leading to deeper areas with {creature:Massive Water Elemental|Massive Water Elementals}.
To enter the 5 Water Channels leading to the deep areas you need diving equipment ({wiki:Diving Equipment}).
Take the boat to **Port Hope** (for example, {npc:Captain Bluebear} at the Thais harbour: {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}). You arrive at the city harbour, next to {npc:Charles}.
Leave Port Hope to the **south**, through the Tiquanda jungle, to the cave entrance ({coord:32679,32964,7}).
Go down to the main floor ({coord:32679,32964,8}), right after the entrance.
Climb up where you came down and walk back **north** to Port Hope.
At the harbour, {npc:Charles} ({coord:32529,32785,6}) takes you back: {key:hi}, the destination (for example {key:thais} or {key:edron}) and {key:yes}.
Water Elementals deal strong drown damage: a {item:Helmet of the Deep} helps. They are resistant to physical damage, so knights struggle here.

On the main floor there are also {creature:Quara Hydromancer Scout|Quara Scouts}; in the deep areas, Massive Water Elementals. The wiki recommends level 70+ for knights, 60+ for paladins and 55+ for mages.

The Well of Life, in a small garden at the entrance to the Pits of Inferno, beneath the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} (southwest of Venore); drinking from it restores your health once and gives the achievement **Fountain of Life**.
Well of Life (Pits of Inferno entrance)
You need the {item:Holy Tible} in your backpack to cross the Shrine of Wonders, and a Premium account (Free Accounts can't get past the shrine's {item:Magic Wall}).
For the Holy Tible: go up with {spell:Levitate} (or 3 {item:Parcel|Parcels}) to the small mountain next to the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower} and open the chest ({coord:32828,32340,7}).
Leave **Venore** and walk **southwest** to the {wiki:Plains of Havoc} ({coord:32735,32297,7}).
In the graveyard near the {wiki:Necromant House} ({coord:32781,32330,7}), use the {item:Shovel} on a {item:Loose Stone Pile}: they all lead to the same narrow cave.
In the **east** part of the cave there is a 3x4 room: use the {item:Pick} on the **northwest corner** ({coord:32775,32344,7}) and go down through the hole.
Goshnar's grave is just to the **west**: stand **1 sqm south** of the headstone and use the {item:Blood} on it. You are taken to the catacombs.
Go **north** and step on the inscribed tile before the {item:Magic Wall} (with the Holy Tible in your backpack) to get to the other side.
Go down the hole to the **north**: you arrive at the garden with the Well of Life. Use the fountain to drink.
The wiki does not describe the way out of the garden: climb up with the {item:Rope} through the hole you came down by.

The documented exits from the Pits of Inferno (the **north** hole at the point of no return, or the teleporter of {npc:A Ghostly Sage} next to the rewards room) drop you in the {creature:Slime|Slimes} cave beneath the Plains of Havoc; from there go up to the surface and walk **northeast** to Venore.
Northwest corner: use the Pick here
Holy Tible chest (mountain next to the Knightwatch Tower)
View of the Well of Life garden
Goshnar's grave (use the Blood from 1 sqm south)
You can only drink once: the second time you get *"You have already drunk from the fountain of life."*
South of the catacombs there are {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}: not easy for low levels.
Wheat fields spread across Tibia (Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel, Edron, Kazordoon, Rookgaard, …); with a {item:Scythe} you harvest {item:Bunch of Wheat} when the wheat is yellow and ripe.
Wheat field just south of the Thais gate

Pick the field nearest to you. The easiest ones are inside or at the gates of the cities: **Thais**, just south of the gate ({coord:32437,32239,7}); **Carlin**, beyond the mill in Magician's Alley ({coord:32293,31811,7}); **Ab'Dendriel**, east of the depot ({coord:32712,31678,7}) and east of the library ({coord:32699,31658,7}).

Other fields: Edron, south of the city next to the Skylane ({coord:33212,31895,7} and {coord:33244,31896,7}) and around Stonehome ({coord:33278,31762,7}); Kazordoon, in The Farms, five floors up ({coord:32602,31904,2}); Cormaya, next to the stairs to the steamship ({coord:33324,32005,7}); Fibula, behind Timur's shop ({coord:32186,32451,7}); Greenshore, beyond the west bridge ({coord:32233,32055,7}); Carlin, on the Rosebud farms ({coord:32260,31703,7}).
In Rookgaard: northeast of the centre ({coord:32077,32185,7}), on the premium side ({coord:32034,32207,7}) and northeast of the bridge ({coord:32083,32167,7}).
The fields are on the surface, inside or next to the cities: walk back the way you came (in Kazordoon go down the five floors of The Farms).
After it is cut, the wheat takes one day to grow back (it turns green) and another day to ripen (bright yellow); you can only harvest it when it is yellow.
The Nostalgia field cannot be harvested; the Mintwallin one is in the underground of Thais ({coord:32388,32121,15}).
Small temple **south of Thais**, where {npc:Norf} (the *Spiritual Shielding* blessing) and {npc:Edowir} are; the surface is a protection zone, but below there is a dungeon with undead.
Go to **Thais** (by boat, you arrive at {npc:Captain Bluebear}).

Leave through Thais' **south** gate and keep going **south**, following the white flowers, until you reach a river. Go around the river and keep going further south to the small building: it is the White Flower Temple ({coord:32346,32364,7}).
{npc:Norf} is **1 floor up** inside the temple ({coord:32346,32363,6}); {npc:Edowir} is on the ground floor ({coord:32343,32363,7}).
To enter the dungeon, go down the stairs and use the {item:Pick} or the {item:Shovel} at the spot shown in the pictures. Further down there is a **level 25** {item:Gate of Expertise}.
If you are in the dungeon, go back the same way to the hole you came down by and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the temple.
From the temple, walk back **north**, going around the river, to Thais' south gate.
Spot where you use the Pick to open the passage
Spot where you use the Shovel
Gate of Expertise (level 25) in the dungeon

After the level 25 door there are 2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and, further down, a {creature:Banshee}. There are also {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} in the dungeon.
There is another entrance to the Banshee room via the {wiki:Stalker Cave}.

Industrial district of Rathleton, in {wiki:Oramond}, between the city's **east** gate, the bridge over the glooth river to Lower Rathleton (to the west) and the stairs to Upper Rathleton (to the north); it has the entrance to the {wiki:Underground Glooth Factory}.
At the **Thais** harbour talk to {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:oramond}, {key:yes} (150 gp). You land on {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft, **west** of Oramond ({coord:33479,31986,7}).

Enter the {item:Slime Slide}: it takes you to a mound on the main island ({coord:33539,32014,7}). Go down to the ground floor and walk **east** to some buildings with a small boat; the portal on that boat ({coord:33628,32005,7}) takes you to the other side of the water.

From there go **north** to the city's main gate and then **west** to the ramp up to the upper city ({coord:33635,31943,7}): you are in the Workshop Quarter. With the *Citizen* rank from the {wiki:Rathleton Quest}, the Slime Slide next to the raft takes you straight into the city.
The building with the Slime Slide to the Underground Glooth Factory is just **east** of the stairs to Upper Rathleton ({coord:33651,31942,7}), where the guard {npc:Terrence} is.
To **Lower Rathleton**: cross the bridge over the glooth river, to the **west**. To **Upper Rathleton**: go up the stairs to the **north**.

To leave Oramond, do the route in reverse to {npc:Captain Gulliver}'s raft (with the Citizen rank, the Rathleton Slime Slide takes you back to the boat) and say {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes} (150 gp). With the Citizen rank he also takes you to **Edron**, **Venore**, **Port Hope** and **Krailos**; **Issavi** is always available.
Slime Slide to the Underground Glooth Factory
Zeronex (on top of the old factory)
A Beggar (west stairs, next to the slime river)
{creature:Rustheap Golem|Rustheap Golems} and {creature:Metal Gargoyle|Metal Gargoyles} roam free in the district.
The route between the raft and the city goes past minotaurs: the wiki advises level ~100 or going in a group.

City founded by the Yalahari on the **northern** islands, near {wiki:Mistrock} and {wiki:Fenrock} (and the only way into {wiki:Vengoth}): a safe Inner City surrounded by ruined districts, linked by guarded gates.

For {npc:Captain Max} (Liberty Bay) to take you, you need to have started the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest} and have the **Novice** rank of the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society|Explorer Society} (without it he won't talk to you).
Direct boats to/from 8 cities (with {npc:Karith}) only become available after the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission of the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}.
From **Liberty Bay**: talk to {npc:Captain Max}, on one of the boats **east** of the harbour ({coord:32298,32896,6}). Say {key:hi}, {key:yalahar} and {key:yes} (400 gp).
From **Thais**: if you paid 250 gp to {npc:Wyrdin's Apprentice} (west of Kazordoon) for the password {key:whizzkid}, {npc:Captain Bluebear} also takes you to Yalahar ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}).

After the *Searoutes around Yalahar* mission there are direct boats to Yalahar from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore (for example, in Venore, {npc:Captain Fearless}: {key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}). From Edron, first take {npc:Captain Seahorse} to Venore.
You arrive at the Yalahar harbour, **south** of the city centre, next to the {wiki:Trade Quarter}.

Inside the city, to pass from one district to another talk to the gate guard: {key:pass} and the name of the destination district (for example {npc:Peter} between the Trade and Factory Quarters). If you have already unlocked the gate mechanisms, you can use them.

Go to the harbour, **south** of the centre, and climb onto {npc:Karith}'s boat (1 floor above the dock, {coord:32818,31278,5}). With the routes from the In Service of Yalahar Quest, he takes you to Ab'Dendriel (160 gp), Ankrahmun (230 gp), Carlin (185 gp), Darashia (210 gp), Liberty Bay (275 gp), Port Hope (260 gp), Thais (200 gp) or Venore (185 gp): {key:hi}, the name of the city (for example {key:venore}) and {key:yes}.
Without those routes, use {npc:Captain Cookie}, on the boat to the left of Karith's ({coord:32804,31276,6}): {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} (400 gp) or {key:thais} (800 gp), and {key:yes}.
Captain Cookie — boat to Liberty Bay / Thais
Captain Max — boat in Liberty Bay
Only the Inner City (at ground level) is safe. In the districts around it, stay on the main streets: there are dangerous creatures off them.

Another dimension opened by a {creature:Raging Mage} at the top of a tower in the **southwest of the Zao Steppe**; it is only accessible while the mage is alive ({wiki:The Mage's Tower World Change}) and has {creature:Yielothax} with rare loot.
**Premium** account and mission 2 of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} completed (to access the tower).
Only with the world change active: ask a {wiki:Guide NPCs|guide NPC} in any city about {key:mage tower} to find out whether the Raging Mage is in the tower.
{spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) to go down and back up the mountain between Farmine and the Zao Steppe.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya}. Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.

In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the mountain surface. Follow the passage to the **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate}, until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}).
The tower is **east** of that exit. Go to the tower ramp ({coord:33133,31511,7}) and climb to the top floor (every floor except the last has {creature:Death Blob|Death Blobs}).
At the top are the {creature:Energized Raging Mage} and the portals: go through the portal to enter the Yielothax Dimension.
Leave the other dimension through the portal (the wiki does not describe the return portal in detail) and go down the tower ramp.
Return to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
In Farmine talk to {npc:Thorgrin} on the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
Exit of the Farmine pass onto the Zao Steppe
After the Raging Mage dies, the portal becomes unstable and **closes in 5 minutes** (until the next Server Save): leave the dimension in time.
{creature:Yielothax} have 1500 HP and hit hard: recommended level 100-120+.

Continent **north of Edron** and southeast of Yalahar, split between the {wiki:Farmine} mountains, the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}, the {wiki:Muggy Plains}, {wiki:Northern Zao} and the lizard city of {wiki:Razachai}.
Exit from the Farmine mountain to the Zao Steppe

The steppe is open to everyone; the areas beyond it (Muggy Plains, Northern Zao, Razachai) are opened up by {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}, the {wiki:Children of the Revolution Quest} and the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}.
The lizard teleporter in the north of the steppe to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} only works after the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}.

Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.

Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}. {npc:Curos}'s orc camp is to the **northeast**.

For the {wiki:Muggy Plains} use the old lizard teleporter in the **north** of the steppe. For {wiki:Northern Zao} follow the route of the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}: through the Lion's Den (mission 1) or, after mission 2, through the link to the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp}, beneath the Souleater Mountains.
On the steppe, go back to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
On the Steamship talk to {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp) and {key:yes}.

If you are in Northern Zao: go down to the Rebel Camp; in {npc:Chartan}'s room, the blue flame **south** of him takes you to the Muggy Plains (after mission 2 of the Wrath of the Emperor Quest). From there go back to the steppe through the lizard teleporter and follow the steps above.
Passage between the Farmine mountain and the Zao Steppe
The steppe has hostile orcs and lizards, and the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}, between the steppe and the Muggy Plains, are dragon territory.
The mountain above **Farmine**, between {wiki:Vengoth} and the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, where a tribe of cavemen led by {npc:Lazaran} lives in caves.
Vines for climbing up to the tribe
{spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) to go down the mountain from the Farmine elevator.

Reach **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: in Kazordoon talk to {npc:Brodrosch} ({coord:32661,31957,15}) and say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes} (there is also a steamship from Cormaya, with {npc:Gurbasch}). You arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}).
In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: you go up to the mountain surface.
Go down the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and, right after you land, go **north** to the vines ({coord:33025,31537,6}).
Use the vines to climb up to the tribe; {npc:Lazaran} is in a cave up there ({coord:32992,31471,3}).
Climb down the vines the same way.
Go back to the mountain passage, climb up with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) to the elevator and return to Farmine.
Vines for climbing up to the tribe
Orc territory in the **northwest** part of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}, led by Mooh'Tah minotaurs, with a wood/bamboo fort to the northwest, a ruined central base and siege machines to the east.
Last ramp in the Zao Orc Land

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Cross the steppe **northwest** to the Zao Orc Land. Follow the path along the mountain to the last ramp ({coord:33060,31328,7}) and go up.

To enter the fort from the back (always accessible): along the **east** side of the mountain there is a hidden spot under the upper floor where you can levitate up ({coord:33066,31306,6}); use {spell:Levitate} (or parcels) and follow the mountain until you are behind the bamboo fort.

Go back the **same way**: if you are in the fort, leave by the back, follow the mountain to the spot where you levitated ({coord:33066,31306,6}) and go down there with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels); then go down the mountain ramps to the steppe.

On the steppe return **southeast** to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
In Farmine talk to {npc:Thorgrin} on the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
Levitate spot (back entrance of the fort)
The **east** part is full of strong orcs on the ground floor, and the ones that appear in raids can be lured to the central base. The wiki recommends level 40–50+.
Lizard palace deep beneath the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}, in Zao, reached through the {wiki:Zao Palace Antechambers}; a high-level hunting area full of Draken.
Sealed door of the Zao Palace (in the Antechambers)
To enter the hunting areas through the sealed door you must have finished {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} and delivered at least **10 tomes** to Cael in the {wiki:Tomes of Knowledge Quest}.
The other entrance ({coord:33170,31260,10}) is only used during mission 8 of the New Frontier Quest.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship} ({npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}). In Farmine go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the mountain surface.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), to the {wiki:Zao Steppe} ({coord:33085,31532,7}), and cross the steppe **north** to the Dragonblaze Peaks.
Go north through the small mountain crevices to the only rope hole on the surface ({coord:33175,31306,7}) and climb up with the {item:Rope} **twice**.

Go **southeast** and follow the mountain to the other side; go down the ramp and head **northwest** to a {item:Large Hole}. Open it and go down to the {wiki:Zao Palace Antechambers}, and keep going down through the holes and stairs.
Cross the Antechambers to the palace's sealed door ({coord:33161,31263,10}) and enter.
Go back the **same way** to the sealed door and the Antechambers.

Go up the stairs and use the {item:Rope} on the holes you came down by (including the Large Hole) to the surface of the Dragonblaze Peaks. Follow the mountain back **northwest** to the rope hole, go down the two floors and return **south** across the steppe.

At the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator to Farmine. {npc:Thorgrin} takes you by Steamship to Kazordoon or Cormaya.
The entrance to the Zao Palace
On the way there are strong {wiki:High Class Lizards} and, in the palace, hordes of {creature:Draken Warmaster|Draken Warmasters}. The wiki recommends level 120–130+.

Lizard antechambers beneath the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}, in Zao, giving access to the {wiki:Zao Palace} and a tower; missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest} and the {wiki:Uneasy Alliance Quest} take place here.
Access to the Antechambers (go up here)
Access to the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks} depends on {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}: the south part opens as soon as you start the first mission, the north part in a later mission.
The two doors to the {wiki:Zao Palace} and the tower entrance only open during/after certain quests (one of them requires helping {npc:Cael} in the {wiki:Tomes of Knowledge Quest}).
Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship} ({npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}).
Leave Farmine onto the Zao steppe and head **north**, to the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}.
Access to the Antechambers is by going up at the spot {coord:33175,31305,7}; the antechambers themselves are underground ({coord:33163,31280,9}).
Go back the same way to the access point ({coord:33175,31305,7}) and return **south**, across the Zao steppe, to Farmine.
Zao Palace entrance (only during the quest)
Sealed door of the Zao Palace (after the quest and Cael)

There are {creature:Lizard Legionnaire|Lizard Legionnaires}, {creature:Lizard High Guard|Lizard High Guards} and {creature:Lizard Dragon Priest|Lizard Dragon Priests}; in the Dragonblaze Peaks, on the way, there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords} and {creature:Frost Dragon|Frost Dragons}.
Hideout of the lizard resistance, led by {npc:Chartan}, **beneath the Souleater Mountains** in the north of Zao; it has a Royal Mailbox and the postman {npc:Ezean}.
The first arrival is in mission 1 of the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} (through the Lion's Den, with the {item:Marked Crate}). The fast link (blue flame) only works after mission 2.
Take the {wiki:Steamship} to **Farmine**: {npc:Brodrosch} (far below Kazordoon) or {npc:Gurbasch} (8 floors below Cormaya), with {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}.

In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right lever**: the elevator takes you to the mountain surface. Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate}, until you come out onto the Zao Steppe ({coord:33085,31532,7}).

First time (WotE mission 1): use the teleporter to the {wiki:Muggy Plains} ({coord:33198,31350,7}), go to the marked spot in the east of the Muggy Plains and use the {item:Shovel} on the hole ({coord:33353,31182,7}) to enter the Lion's Den. You come out in a watchtower ({coord:33326,31082,7}); follow the road **west** to the hideout mountain ({coord:33171,31078,7}).
After mission 2: in the Muggy Plains use the link you reactivated (blue flame) to go straight to the hideout, where {npc:Chartan} is ({coord:33213,31058,9}).
After you finish WotE, there is also a teleporter between Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum (in Razachai, in the cellar beneath {npc:Zlak}).
Step on the blue flame **south** of {npc:Chartan}: it takes you to the Muggy Plains (only after mission 2 of WotE; before that, walk back along the road and through the Lion's Den).
In the Muggy Plains go back to the Zao Steppe through the teleporter you arrived by and head **southwest** to the mountain passage ({coord:33085,31532,7}).

Climb it with {spell:Levitate} and go **west** to the Farmine elevator. On the Farmine steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon or Cormaya ({key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} or {key:cormaya}, {key:yes}).

Northern Zao is dangerous: on the road there are high-class lizards, {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}, {creature:Souleater|Souleaters} and {creature:Brimstone Bug|Brimstone Bugs} (recommended level 130+).
Dry steppe of the continent of {wiki:Zao}, **east of the Farmine mountain** and south of the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}, dominated by orc camps, with the lizard fortress of Zzaion to the southeast.
Exit of the Farmine pass onto the Zao Steppe
To go down the mountain between the Farmine elevator and the steppe you need the {spell:Levitate} spell (or stacked parcels/boxes to climb up and down).

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin} ({coord:33025,31553,14}).
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
From there, the central orc camp (where {npc:Curos} is) is to the **northeast** ({coord:33173,31395,7}) and {npc:Zalamon} is in the far **east**, 1 floor below ground ({coord:33356,31411,8}).
Go back the same way: return to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
In Farmine talk to {npc:Thorgrin} at the Steamship: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp) and {key:yes}.
After the first 8 missions of {wiki:The New Frontier Quest}, the old lizard teleporter in the **north** of the steppe takes you to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}.
{creature:Orc Marauder|Orc Marauders} patrol the siege camps and chase players all over the steppe.
About once a week the orcs break through the gate of {wiki:Zzaion} and the lizards counter-attack with one of their leaders: avoid the southeast area during that attack.
Some dragons from the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks} live at ground level and can come down to the steppe.
Terramite caves at the **southernmost point of the {wiki:Zao Steppe}**, with narrow passages on one floor and 4 small caves on the floor below; a good hunting spot for low-to-mid levels.
Zao Terramite Caves entrance (south of the steppe)

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Cross the steppe **east** to the southernmost point of the steppe, where the cave entrance is ({coord:33196,31545,7}). There is another Terramite cave at {coord:33140,31476,7}.
Go back the **same way** to the entrance and leave onto the steppe.
Return **west** to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
The passages are only 1 sqm wide. Since {creature:Terramite|Terramites} don't push objects, you can use parcels or flowers to avoid being attacked by two at once.

Cave on the {wiki:Zao Steppe} **east of Curos** and south of the {wiki:Dragonblaze Peaks}, inhabited by Wailing Widows and Lancer Beetles and full of cobwebs; it has two hunting floors and a quest room on the third.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Go **northeast** to the central orc camp ({npc:Curos}, {coord:33173,31395,7}). The cave entrance is **east** of Curos, a little east of the {wiki:Zao Orc Land} ({coord:33223,31397,7}).
Inside there are cobwebs all over the cave: break them with a melee weapon or the {item:Firebug} and go down the ramps.
Go back the **same way**: climb the ramps (if the cobwebs have come back, break them again) to the exit ({coord:33223,31397,7}).
On the steppe return to the pass at {coord:33085,31532,7}, climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
The entrance of the Zao Wailing Widow Cave
Map of the first underground floor

Without a melee weapon or {item:Firebug} you can't break the cobwebs and you get stuck. The cave is for mid levels (the wiki recommends 50–60+), comparable to the Ancient Scarab floors of the Larva Caves.
In Yalahar, go to the docks of the **Trade Quarter** (straight **south** from the main gate) and talk to {npc:Harlow}: {key:hi}, {key:vengoth}, {key:yes} (100 gp).
If you cannot find the exit, a {item:Temple Teleport Scroll} sends you to your city's temple; it does not work in No-Logout zones or with a Logout Block or Protection Zone Block.
Map of Zarganash: path to each miniboss and the final boss

The last lizard fortress in the **south of Zao**: in the north there are low-class lizards, in the centre high-class lizards and, in the southern tower, {creature:Draken|Draken} and {creature:Lizard Zaogun|Lizard Zaoguns}. The gates only open during the orc raid.
The Zzaion gates only open during the {wiki:Zao Raids|orc raid on Zzaion}; they stay open until the next Server Save. It is the only chance to get in.

Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship}: {npc:Brodrosch}, at the bottom of Kazordoon, or {npc:Gurbasch}, 8 floors below {wiki:Cormaya} ({npc:Captain Seahorse} takes you from Edron to Cormaya). Say {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}; you arrive next to {npc:Thorgrin}.
In Farmine, go **east** of {npc:Ongulf}, pass through the sealed doors, stand on the switch and use the **right-hand lever**: the elevator takes you to the surface of the mountain.
Follow the passage **east**, going down with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes), until you come out onto the {wiki:Zao Steppe} at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Cross the steppe **east** to the fortress ({coord:33316,31558,7}) and wait for the gates to be opened by the orc raid.
Leave through the gates and go back across the steppe **west** to the passage at {coord:33085,31532,7}.
Climb the mountain with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and head **west** to the elevator, which takes you back to Farmine.
On the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to {key:kazordoon} (210 gp) or {key:cormaya} (110 gp): {key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}.
Mountain exit to the Zao Steppe
**You can't log out** inside Zzaion, so nobody gets stuck when the gates close: leave before the Server Save.
During the raid orcs roam the northern area and lizard bosses appear to defend the fortress. The southern tower is for very high levels (140+).
